12.21.4: na bibheti yadā cāyaṁ yadā cāsmānna bibhyati,
kāmadveṣau ca jayati tadā’’tmānaṁ ca paśyati ॥4॥
12.21.5: yadāsau sarvabhūtānāṁ na druhyati na kāṅkṣati,
karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā ॥5॥
12.21.6: evaṁ kaunteya bhūtāni taṁ taṁ dharmaṁ tathā tathā,
12.21.7: naikaṁ na cāparaṁ kecidubhayaṁ ca tathāpare ॥7॥
12.21.9: kecit sarvaṁ parityajya tūṣṇīṁ dhyāyanta āsate,
12.21.10: hatvā chittvā ca bhittvā ca kecidekāntaśīlinaḥ,
12.21.11: adroheṇaiva bhūtānāṁ yo dharmaḥ sa satāṁ mataḥ,
12.21.13: yo hi rājye sthitaḥ śaśvad vaśī tulyapriyāpriyaḥ ॥13॥
12.21.16: ya evaṁ vartate rājan sa rājā dharmaniścitaḥ ॥16॥
12.21.17: tasyāyaṁ ca paraścaiva lokaḥ syāt saphalodayaḥ,
nirvāṇaṁ hi suduṣprāpyaṁ bahuvighnaṁ ca me matam ॥17॥
12.21.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi devasthānavākye ekaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥21॥
12.22.2: jitvā cārīn naraśreṣṭha tapyate kiṁ bhr̥śaṁ bhavān ॥2॥
12.22.4: kṣatriyāṇāṁ ca nidhanaṁ saṅgrāme vihitaṁ prabho ॥4॥
12.22.6: praśastaṁ jīvitaṁ loke kṣatraṁ hi brahmasambhavam ॥6॥
12.22.7: na tyāgo na punaryajño na tapo manujeśvara,
12.22.9: tyaktvā santāpajaṁ śokaṁ daṁśito bhava karmaṇi,
12.22.11: indro vai brahmaṇaḥ putraḥ kṣatriyaḥ karmaṇābhavat,
12.22.12: taccāsya karma pūjyaṁ ca praśasyaṁ ca viśāmpate,
12.22.15: bhavitavyaṁ tathā tacca yad vr̥ttaṁ bharatarṣabha,
12.22.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi arjunavākye dvāviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥22॥
12.23.6: taṁ carādya vidhiṁ pārtha duścaraṁ durbalendriyaiḥ ॥6॥
12.23.7: vedajñānaṁ ca te kr̥tsnaṁ tapaścācaritaṁ mahat,
12.23.9: kṣatriyāṇāṁ tu vakṣyāmi tavāpi viditaṁ punaḥ ॥9॥
12.23.11: vedajñānaṁ tathā kr̥tsnaṁ tapaḥ sucaritaṁ tathā,
12.23.12: imaṁ lokamamuṁ caiva sādhayantīti naḥ śrutam ॥12॥
12.23.13: balaṁ hi kṣatriye nityaṁ bale daṇḍaḥ samāhitaḥ ॥13॥
12.23.16: prāptavān paramāṁ siddhiṁ dakṣaḥ prācetaso yathā ॥16॥
12.23.17: saṁsiddhiṁ paramāṁ prāptaḥ śrotumicchāmi taṁ nr̥pam ॥17॥
12.23.23: bhakṣayantaṁ tu taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā śaṅkho bhrātaramabravīt,
12.23.27: stenaṁ māṁ tvaṁ viditvā ca svadharmamanupālaya,
śīghraṁ dhāraya caurasya mama daṇḍaṁ narādhipa ॥27॥
12.23.32: bhakṣitāni mahārāja tatra māṁ śādhi mā ciram ॥32॥
12.23.34: brūhi kāmānato’nyāṁstvaṁ kariṣyāmi hi te vacaḥ ॥34॥
12.23.35: nānyaṁ sa varayāmāsa tasmād daṇḍādr̥te varam ॥35॥
12.23.38: na kupye tava dharmajña na tvaṁ dūṣayase mama,
12.23.39: tvaṁ gatvā bāhudāṁ śīghraṁ tarpayasva yathāvidhi,
devānr̥ṣīn pitr̥̄ṁścaivaṁ mā cādharme manaḥ kr̥thāḥ ॥39॥
12.23.40: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā śaṅkhasya likhitastadā,
12.23.41: tataḥ sa vismito bhrāturdarśayāmāsa tau karau ॥41॥
12.23.42: mā ca te’tra viśaṅkābhūd daivamatra vidhīyate ॥42॥
12.23.43: kiṁ tu nāhaṁ tvayā pūtaḥ pūrvameva mahādyute,
12.23.44: sa ca pūto narapatistvaṁ cāpi pitr̥bhiḥ saha ॥44॥
12.23.45: sa rājā pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha śreyān vai tena karmaṇā,
prāptavān paramāṁ siddhiṁ dakṣaḥ prācetaso yathā ॥45॥
12.23.46: utpatho’nyo mahārāja mā sma śoke manaḥ kr̥thāḥ ॥46॥
12.23.47: bhrāturasya hitaṁ vākyaṁ śr̥ṇu dharmajña sattama,
daṇḍa eva hi rājendra kṣatradharmo na muṇḍanam ॥47॥
12.23.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi vyāsavākye trayoviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥23॥
12.24.2: araṇye vasatāṁ tāta bhrātr̥̄ṇāṁ te manasvinām,
12.24.5: dharmamarthaṁ ca kāmaṁ ca bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha bhārata,
12.24.6: arthināṁ ca pitr̥̄ṇāṁ ca devatānāṁ ca bhārata,
ānr̥ṇyaṁ gaccha kaunteya tat sarvaṁ ca kariṣyasi ॥6॥
12.24.9: śr̥ṇuṣvaivaṁ yathā kurvan na dharmāccyavase nr̥pa ॥9॥
12.24.10d3: uktaṁ nigamanaṁ teṣāṁ prameyaṁ ca prayojanam,
12.24.11: śāstrajāṁ buddhimāsthāya yujyate nainasā hi saḥ ॥11॥
12.24.13: nibodha ca yathā’’tiṣṭhan dharmānna cyavate nr̥paḥ,
12.24.14: śāstrajāṁ buddhimāsthāya yujyate nainasā hi saḥ ॥14॥
12.24.15: na sādhayati yat karma na tatrāhuratikramam ॥15॥
12.24.16: tarasā buddhipūrvaṁ vā nigrāhyā eva śatravaḥ,
pāpaiḥ saha na sandadhyād rājyaṁ paṇyaṁ na kārayet ॥16॥
12.24.18d2: mantre ca vyavahāre ca niyoktavyā vijānatā,
12.24.18d4: vedajñā ye ca śāstrajñāste ca rājan subuddhayaḥ,
te tu sarvatra yoktavyāste ca buddheḥ paraṁ gatāḥ.
12.24.19: enasā yujyate rājā durdānta iti cocyate ॥19॥
12.24.22: kr̥te puruṣakāre tu nainaḥ spr̥śati pārthivam ॥22॥
12.24.25: kr̥tvā karma prāpya kīrtiṁ sa yuddhād
12.24.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi vyāsavākye caturviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥24॥
12.25.2: na pārthivamidaṁ rājyaṁ na bhogāśca pr̥thagvidhāḥ,
prīṇayanti mano me’dya śoko māṁ rundhayatyayam ॥2॥
12.25.15: ghnanti cānyān narā rājaṁstānapyanye tathā narāḥ,
sañjñaiṣā laukikī rājan na hinasti na hanyate ॥15॥
12.25.17: naṣṭe dhane vā dāre vā putre pitari vā mr̥te,
12.25.18: sa kiṁ śocasi mūḍhaḥ san śocyān kimanuśocasi,
paśya duḥkheṣu duḥkhāni bhayeṣu ca bhayānyapi ॥18॥
12.25.19: ātmāpi cāyaṁ na mama sarvāpi pr̥thivī mama,
yathā mama tathānyeṣāmiti paśyan na muhyati ॥19॥
12.25.21: jīveṣu parivartante duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ॥21॥
12.25.23: na nityaṁ labhate duḥkhaṁ na nityaṁ labhate sukham ॥23॥
12.25.24: sukhameva hi duḥkhāntaṁ kadācid duḥkhataḥ sukham,
tasmādetad dvayaṁ jahyād ya icchecchāśvataṁ sukham ॥24॥
12.25.26: sukhaṁ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṁ priyaṁ vā yadi vāpriyam,
12.25.27: tato jñāsyasi kaḥ kasya kena vā kathameva ca ॥27॥
12.25.28: ye ca mūḍhatamā loke ye ca buddheḥ paraṁ gatāḥ,
ta eva sukhamedhante madhyamaḥ kliśyate janaḥ ॥28॥
12.25.30: yena duḥkhena yo duḥkhī na sa jātu sukhī bhavet,
duḥkhānāṁ hi kṣayo nāsti jāyate hyaparāt param ॥30॥
12.25.31: sukhaṁ ca duḥkhaṁ ca bhavābhavau ca
12.25.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi senajidupākhyāne pañcaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥25॥
12.26.2: na svargo na sukhaṁ nārtho nirdhanasyeti tanmr̥ṣā ॥2॥
12.26.4: r̥ṣīṇāṁ samayaṁ śaśvad ye rakṣanti dhanañjaya,
12.26.6: vaikhānasānāṁ vacanaṁ yathā no viditaṁ prabho ॥6॥
12.26.9: dakṣiṇena ca panthānamaryamṇo ye divaṁ gatāḥ,
12.26.10: uttareṇa tu panthānaṁ niyamād yaṁ prapaśyasi,
ete yāgavatāṁ lokā bhānti pārtha sanātanāḥ ॥10॥
12.26.11: santoṣo vai svargatamaḥ santoṣaḥ paramaṁ sukham ॥11॥
12.26.12: tuṣṭerna kiñcit paramaṁ sā samyak pratitiṣṭhati,
12.26.14: yadā cāyaṁ na bibheti yadā cāsmānna bibhyati,
yadā necchati na dveṣṭi brahma sampadyate tadā ॥14॥
12.26.15: yadā na bhāvaṁ kurute sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam,
karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā ॥15॥
12.26.17: idaṁ tu śr̥ṇu me pārtha bruvanaḥ saṁyatendriyaḥ,
12.26.18: bhūyān doṣo hi vittasya yaśca dharmastadāśrayaḥ ॥18॥
12.26.20: druhyataḥ praiti tat prāhuḥ pratikūlaṁ yathātatham ॥20॥
12.26.21: alpena tr̥ṣito druhyan bhrūṇahatyāṁ na budhyate ॥21॥
12.26.22: durlabhaṁ ca dhanaṁ prāpya bhr̥śaṁ dattvānutapyate ॥22॥
12.26.23: adhanaḥ kasya kiṁ vācyo vimuktaḥ sarvaśaḥ sukhī,
12.26.26: etat svārthe ca kaunteya dhanaṁ dhanavatāṁ vara,
dhātā dadāti martyebhyo yajñārthamiti viddhi tat ॥26॥
12.26.27: tasmād buddhyanti puruṣā na hi tat kasyacid dhruvam,
12.26.28: labdhasya tyāgamityāhurna bhogaṁ na ca sañcayam,
tasya kiṁ sañcayenārthaḥ kārye jyāyasi tiṣṭhati ॥28॥
12.26.29: śataṁ varṣāṇi te pretya purīṣaṁ bhuñjate janāḥ ॥29॥
12.26.30: anarhate yad dadāti na dadāti yadarhate,
12.26.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhiravākye ṣaḍviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥26॥
12.27.1: dhr̥ṣṭadyumne virāṭe ca drupade ca mahīpatau ॥1॥
12.27.2: vr̥ṣasene ca dharmajñe dhr̥ṣṭaketau tu pārthive,
12.27.3: na ca muñcati māṁ śoko jñātighātinamāturam,
12.27.4: sa mayā rājyalubdhena gāṅgeyo yudhi pātitaḥ ॥4॥
12.27.6: kīryamāṇaṁ śarairdr̥ṣṭvā bhr̥śaṁ me vyathitaṁ manaḥ ॥6॥
12.27.7: ghūrṇamānaṁ yathā śailaṁ tadā me kaśmalo’bhavat ॥7॥
12.27.11: svayaṁ mr̥tyuṁ rakṣamāṇaḥ pāñcālyaṁ yaḥ śikhaṇḍinam,
12.27.13: yena saṁvardhitā bālā yena sma parirakṣitāḥ,
12.27.15: abhigamya raṇe mithyā pāpenoktaḥ sutaṁ prati,
12.27.16: satyamākhyāhi rājaṁstvaṁ yadi jīvati me sutaḥ,
12.27.18: aśvatthāmā hata iti niruktaḥ kuñjare hate ॥18॥
12.27.20: abhimanyuṁ ca yad bālaṁ jātaṁ siṁhamivādriṣu ॥20॥
12.27.22: kr̥ṣṇaṁ ca puṇḍarīkākṣaṁ kilbiṣī bhrūṇahā yathā,
12.27.25: na bhokṣye na ca pānīyamupabhokṣye kathañcana ॥25॥
12.27.30: budbudā iva toyeṣu bhavanti na bhavanti ca,
12.27.32: nālaṁ sukhāya suhr̥do nālaṁ duḥkhāya śatravaḥ,
na ca prajālamarthebhyo na sukhebhyo’pyalaṁ dhanam ॥32॥
12.27.33: yathā sr̥ṣṭo’si kaunteya dhātrā karmasu tat kuru,
ata eva hi siddhiste neśastvaṁ karmaṇāṁ nr̥pa ॥33॥
12.27.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi vyāsavākye saptaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥27॥
12.28.3: aśmānaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ prājñaṁ vaideho janako nr̥paḥ,
12.28.4: āgame yadi vāpāye jñātīnāṁ draviṇasya ca,
12.28.5: tāni tānyanuvartante duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ॥5॥
12.28.10: ye ca viṁśativarṣā vā triṁśadvarṣāśca mānavāḥ,
12.28.16: sukhaṁ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṁ bhūtānāṁ paryupasthitam,
12.28.17: pūrve vayasi madhye vāpyuttare vā narādhipa,
12.28.23: kule janma tathā vīryamārogyaṁ rūpameva ca,
12.28.26: nirmāṇe yasya yad diṣṭaṁ tena gacchati setunā,
12.28.27: dr̥śyate hi yuvaiveha vinaśyan vasumān naraḥ,
12.28.28: samr̥ddhe ca kule jātā vinaśyanti pataṅgavat ॥28॥
12.28.29: prāyeṇa śrīmatāṁ loke bhoktuṁ śaktirna vidyate,
kāṣṭhānyapi hi jīryante daridrāṇāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ ॥29॥
12.28.31: mr̥gayākṣāḥ striyaḥ pānaṁ prasaṅgā ninditā budhaiḥ,
12.28.33: jyotīṁṣi saritaḥ śailān kaḥ karoti bibharti ca ॥33॥
12.28.35: nauṣadhāni na mantrāśca na homā na punarjapāḥ,
12.28.36: yathā kāṣṭhaṁ ca kāṣṭhaṁ ca sameyātāṁ mahodadhau,
12.28.38: saṁsāreṣvanubhūtāni kasya te kasya vā vayam ॥38॥
12.28.39: naivāsya kaścid bhavitā nāyaṁ bhavati kasyacit,
12.28.40: kvāse kva ca gamiṣyāmi ko nvahaṁ kimihāsthitaḥ,
12.28.41: pathi saṅgatamevaitad bhrātā mātā pitā sakhā ॥41॥
12.28.46: te pibantaḥ kaṣāyāṁśca sarpīṁṣi vividhāni ca,
12.28.49: na hyahāni nivartante na māsā na punaḥ samāḥ,
jātānāṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ na pakṣā na punaḥ kṣapāḥ ॥49॥
12.28.51: deho vā jīvato’bhyeti jīvo vābhyeti dehataḥ,
12.28.53: kva nu te’dya pitā rājan kva nu te’dya pitāmahāḥ,
na tvaṁ paśyasi tānadya na tvāṁ paśyanti te’nagha ॥53॥
12.28.54: na caiva puruṣo draṣṭā svargasya narakasya ca,
12.29.3: sarve sma te saṁśayitāḥ punareva janārdana,
12.29.8: mā kr̥thāḥ puruṣavyāghra śokaṁ tvaṁ gātraśoṣaṇam,
na hi te sulabhā bhūyo ye hatāsmin raṇājire ॥8॥
12.29.9: evaṁ te kṣatriyā rājan ye vyatītā mahāraṇe ॥9॥
12.29.10: naiṣāṁ kaścit pr̥ṣṭhato vā palāyan vāpi pātitaḥ ॥10॥
12.29.11: sarve tyaktvā’’tmanaḥ prāṇāt yuddhvā vīrā mahāmr̥dhe,
śastrapūtā divaṁ prāptā na tān śocitumarhasi ॥11॥
12.29.12: prāptā vīragatiṁ puṇyāṁ tān na śocitumarhasi ॥12॥
12.29.14: sukhaduḥkhairahaṁ tvaṁ ca prajāḥ sarvāśca sr̥ñjaya ॥14॥
12.29.15: mahābhāgyaṁ purā rājñāṁ kīrtyamānaṁ mayā śr̥ṇu ॥15॥
12.29.18: āvikṣitaṁ maruttaṁ ca mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma ॥18॥
12.29.31: aṅgaṁ br̥hadrathaṁ caiva mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma ॥31॥
12.29.36: yasya yajñeṣu rājendra śatasaṅkhyeṣu vai purā ॥36॥
12.29.37: na jāto janitā nānyaḥ pumān yaḥ sampradāsyati ॥37॥
12.29.42: na voḍhāraṁ dhuraṁ tasya kaścinmene prajāpatiḥ ॥42॥
12.29.43: na bhūtaṁ na bhaviṣyaṁ ca sarvarājasu sr̥ñjaya,
12.29.45: bharataṁ caiva dauṣyantiṁ mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma,
12.29.46: yo baddhvā triśataṁ cāśvān devebhyo yamunāmanu,
12.29.49: paraṁ sahasrād yo baddhān hayān vedīrvitatya ca,
sahasraṁ yatra padmānāṁ kaṇvāya bharato dadau ॥49॥
12.29.51: rāmaṁ dāśarathiṁ caiva mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma,
12.29.54: rujābhayaṁ na tatrāsīd rāme rājyaṁ praśāsati ॥54॥
12.29.58: sarvā droṇadughā gāvo rāme rājyaṁ praśāsati ॥58॥
12.29.60: yuvā śyāmo lohitākṣo mātaṅga iva yūthapaḥ,
12.29.63: bhagīrathaṁ ca rājānaṁ mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma,
yasyendro vitate yajñe somaṁ pītvā madotkaṭaḥ ॥63॥
12.29.66: sarvā rathagatāḥ kanyā rathāḥ sarve caturyujaḥ,
śataṁ śataṁ rathe nāgāḥ padmino hemamālinaḥ ॥66॥
12.29.71: dilīpaṁ ca mahātmānaṁ mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma,
12.29.74: yasya yajñe mahānāsīd yūpaḥ śrīmān hiraṇmayaḥ,
taṁ devāḥ karma kurvāṇāḥ śakrajyeṣṭhā upāśrayan ॥74॥
12.29.75: caṣāle yasya sauvarṇe tasmin yūpe hiraṇmaye,
12.29.76: avādayat tatra vīṇāṁ madhye viśvāvasuḥ svayam,
12.29.77: yasyebhā hemasañchannāḥ pathi mattāḥ sma śerate ॥77॥
12.29.79: trayaḥ śabdā na jīryante dilīpasya niveśane,
12.29.81: yaṁ devā maruto garbhaṁ pituḥ pārśvādapāharan ॥81॥
12.29.90: yatra sūrya udeti sma yatra ca pratitiṣṭhati,
12.29.94: yayātiṁ nāhuṣaṁ caiva mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma,
ya imāṁ pr̥thivīṁ kr̥tsnāṁ vijitya sahasāgarām ॥94॥
12.29.100: ambarīṣaṁ ca nābhāgaṁ mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma,
yaṁ prajā vavrire puṇyaṁ goptāraṁ nr̥pasattamam ॥100॥
12.29.107: kanyāṁ kanyāṁ śataṁ nāgā nāgaṁ nāgaṁ śataṁ rathāḥ ॥107॥
12.29.108: rathe rathe śataṁ cāśvā deśajā hemamālinaḥ,
aśve aśve śataṁ gāvo gavāṁ tadvadajāvikam ॥108॥
12.29.112: yasmai vahnirvaraṁ prādāt tato vavre varān gayaḥ,
dadato yo’kṣayaṁ vittaṁ dharme śraddhā ca vardhatām ॥112॥
12.29.113: mano me ramatāṁ satye tvatprasādād hutāśana,
lebhe ca kāmāṁstān sarvān pāvakāditi naḥ śrutam ॥113॥
12.29.116: pitr̥̄n svadhābhiḥ kāmaiśca striyaḥ sa puruṣarṣabha ॥116॥
12.29.120: rantidevaṁ ca sāṅkr̥tyaṁ mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma,
samyagārādhya yaḥ śakrād varaṁ lebhe mahātapāḥ ॥120॥
12.29.121: annaṁ ca no bahu bhavedatithīṁśca labhemahi,
śraddhā ca no mā vyagamanmā ca yāciṣma kañcana ॥121॥
12.29.124: brāhmaṇebhyo dadau niṣkān sadasi pratate nr̥paḥ,
tubhyaṁ niṣkaṁ tubhyaṁ niṣkamiti krośanti vai dvijāḥ ॥124॥
12.29.126: ghaṭāḥ pātryaḥ kaṭāhāni sthālyaśca piṭharāṇi ca,
12.29.127: ālabhyanta śataṁ gāvaḥ sahasrāṇi ca viṁśatiḥ ॥127॥
12.29.128: sūpaṁ bhūyiṣṭhamaśnīdhvaṁ nādya bhojyaṁ yathā purā ॥128॥
12.29.130: sagaraṁ ca mahātmānaṁ mr̥taṁ śuśruma sr̥ñjaya,
12.29.137: rājānaṁ ca pr̥thuṁ vainyaṁ mr̥taṁ śuśruma sr̥ñjaya,
12.29.138: kṣatād yo vai trāyatīti sa tasmāt kṣatriyaḥ smr̥taḥ ॥138॥
12.29.139: pr̥thuṁ vainyaṁ prajā dr̥ṣṭvā raktāḥ smeti yadabruvan,
12.29.145: kiṁ vā tūṣṇīṁ dhyāyase sr̥ñjaya tvaṁ
12.29.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājopākhyāne ekonatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥29॥
12.30.1: parvatena kimarthaṁ vā dattastena mamāra ca ॥1॥
12.30.8: prītimantau mudā yuktau samayaṁ caiva cakratuḥ,
yo bhaveddhr̥di saṅkalpaḥ śubho vā yadi vāśubhaḥ ॥8॥
12.30.9: anyonyasya sa ākhyeyo mr̥ṣā śāpo’nyathā bhavet,
12.30.10: āvāṁ bhavati vatsyāvaḥ kañcit kālaṁ hitāya te ॥10॥
12.30.11: tatheti kr̥tvā rājā tau satkr̥tyopacacāra ha ॥11॥
12.30.14: paramaṁ saumyamityuktaṁ tābhyāṁ rājā śaśāsa tām ॥14॥
12.30.15: sā tu kanyā tathetyuktvā pitaraṁ dharmacāriṇī ॥15॥
12.30.17: vavr̥dhe hi tatastasya hr̥di kāmo mahātmanaḥ ॥17॥
12.30.18: yathā śuklasya pakṣasya pravr̥ttau candramāḥ śanaiḥ,
na ca taṁ bhāgineyāya parvatāya mahātmane ॥18॥
12.30.19: śaśaṁsa hr̥cchayaṁ tīvraṁ vrīḍamānaḥ sa dharmavit,
12.30.20: kāmārtaṁ nāradaṁ kruddhaḥ śaśāpainaṁ tato bhr̥śam,
kr̥tvā samayamavyagro bhavān vai sahito mayā ॥20॥
12.30.21: yo bhaveddhr̥di saṅkalpaḥ śubho vā yadi vāśubhaḥ,
anyonyasya sa ākhyeya iti tad vai mr̥ṣā kr̥tam ॥21॥
12.30.22: na hi kāmaṁ pravartantaṁ bhavānācaṣṭa me purā ॥22॥
12.30.24: śapsye tasmāt susaṅkruddho bhavantaṁ taṁ nibodha me ॥24॥
12.30.25: sukumārī ca te bhāryā bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ,
vānaraṁ caiva te rūpaṁ vivāhāt prabhr̥ti prabho ॥25॥
12.30.26: sa tad vākyaṁ tu vijñāya nāradaḥ parvataṁ tathā ॥26॥
12.30.27: tapasā brahmacaryeṇa satyena ca damena ca ॥27॥
12.30.28: tau tu śaptvā bhr̥śaṁ kruddhau parasparamamarṣaṇau ॥28॥
12.30.31: sā tu kanyā yathāśāpaṁ nāradaṁ taṁ dadarśa ha ॥31॥
12.30.33: upatasthe ca bhartāraṁ na cānyaṁ manasāpyagāt ॥33॥
12.30.34: devaṁ muniṁ vā yakṣaṁ vā patitve pativatsalā,
12.30.35: vanaṁ virahitaṁ kiñcit tatrāpaśyat sa nāradam,
12.30.36: bhavān prasādaṁ kurutāt svargādeśāya me prabho,
12.30.38: adyaprabhr̥ti vai vāsaṁ svarge nāvāpsyasīti ha ॥38॥
12.30.39: tava naitaddhi visadr̥śaṁ putrasthāne hi me bhavān,
12.30.41: abravīt tava bhartaiṣa nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ॥41॥
12.30.43: śāpadoṣaṁ ca taṁ bhartuḥ śrutvā prakr̥timāgatā ॥43॥
12.30.44: eṣa vakṣyati te pr̥ṣṭo yathāvr̥ttaṁ narottama ॥44॥
12.30.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi nāradaparvatopākhyāne triṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥30॥
12.31.3: kāryasyāsya tu yaccheṣaṁ tat te vakṣyāmi pr̥cchataḥ ॥3॥
12.31.4: ahaṁ ca parvataścaiva svasrīyo me mahāmuniḥ,
12.31.9: vareṇa cchandyatāṁ rājā labhatāṁ yad yadicchati,
12.31.10: tata āhūya rājānaṁ sr̥ñjayaṁ jayatāṁ varam,
12.31.12: tad gr̥hāṇa mahārāja pūjārho nau mato bhavān ॥12॥
12.31.13: prītau bhavantau yadi me kr̥tametāvatā mama,
eṣa eva paro lābho nirvr̥ttoṁ me mahāphalaḥ ॥13॥
12.31.14: vr̥ṇīṣva rājan saṅkalpaṁ yat te hr̥di ciraṁ sthitam ॥14॥
12.31.16: bhaviṣyatyeṣa te kāmo na tvāyuṣmān bhaviṣyati,
12.31.19: āyuṣmān me bhavet putro bhavatastapasā mune,
12.31.21: ahaṁ te dayitaṁ putraṁ pretarājavaśaṁ gatam,
12.31.22: evamuktvā tu nr̥patiṁ prayātau svo yathepsitam,
12.31.24: babhūva kāñcanaṣṭhīvī yathārthaṁ nāma tasya tat ॥24॥
12.31.27: codayāmāsa tad vajraṁ divyāstraṁ mūrtimat sthitam,
vyāghro bhūtvā jahīmaṁ tvaṁ rājaputramiti prabho ॥27॥
12.31.30: hr̥ṣṭaḥ sāntaḥpuro rājā vananityo babhūva ha ॥30॥
12.31.33: vyasuḥ papāta medinyāṁ tato dhātrī vicukruśe ॥33॥
12.31.36: sa dadarśa śayānaṁ taṁ gatāsuṁ pītaśoṇitam,
12.31.38: abhyadhāvanta taṁ deśaṁ yatra rājā sa sr̥ñjayaḥ ॥38॥
12.31.39: tataḥ sa rājā sasmāra māmeva gatamānasaḥ,
12.31.43: kārayāmāsa rājyaṁ ca pitari svargate nr̥pa,
12.31.46: sa tvaṁ rājendra sañjātaṁ śokamenaṁ nivartaya,
yathā tvāṁ keśavaḥ prāha vyāsaśca sumahātapāḥ ॥46॥
12.31.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi svarṇaṣṭhīvisambhavopākhyāne ekatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥31॥
12.32.3: brāhmaṇeṣu tapo dharmaḥ sa nityo vedaniścitaḥ ॥3॥
12.32.5: yaḥ svayaṁ pratihanti sma śāsanaṁ viṣaye rataḥ,
12.32.6: bhr̥tyo vā yadi vā putrastapasvī vātha kaścana ॥6॥
12.32.8: dharmaṁ vinaśyamānaṁ hi yo na rakṣet sa dharmahā,
12.32.9: svadharme vartamānastvaṁ kiṁ nu śocasi pāṇḍava,
rājā hi hanyād dadyācca prajā rakṣecca dharmataḥ ॥9॥
12.32.10: na te’bhiśaṅke vacanaṁ yad bravīṣi tapodhana,
aparokṣo hi te dharmaḥ sarvadharmavidāṁ vara ॥10॥
12.32.11: tāni karmāṇi me brahman dahanti ca pacanti ca ॥11॥
12.32.12: īśvaro vā bhavet kartā puruṣo vāpi bhārata,
haṭho vā vartate loke karmajaṁ vā phalaṁ smr̥tam ॥12॥
12.32.13: īśvareṇa niyukto hi sādhvasādhu ca bhārata,
12.32.14: yathā hi puruṣaśchindyād vr̥kṣaṁ paraśunā vane,
12.32.16: na caitadiṣṭaṁ kaunteya yadanyena kr̥taṁ phalam,
12.32.18: na hi kaścit kvacid rājan diṣṭaṁ pratinivartate,
12.32.19: yadi vā manyase rājan hatamekaṁ pratiṣṭhitam,
evamapyaśubhaṁ karma na bhūtaṁ na bhaviṣyati ॥19॥
12.32.22: tyaja tvaṁ rājaśārdūla maivaṁ śoke manaḥ kr̥thāḥ ॥22॥
12.32.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi prāyaścittavidhau dvātriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥32॥
12.33.4: asakr̥t somapān vīrān kiṁ prāpsyāmi tapodhana ॥4॥
12.33.6: dr̥ṣṭvā jñātivadhaṁ ghoraṁ hatāṁśca śataśaḥ parān,
12.33.9: apaśyantyaḥ pitr̥̄n bhrātr̥̄t patīn putrāṁśca yoṣitaḥ,
tyaktvā prāṇān striyaḥ sarvā gamiṣyanti yamakṣayam ॥9॥
12.33.10: vatsalatvād dvijaśreṣṭha tatra me nāsti saṁśayaḥ,
vyaktaṁ saukṣmyācca dharmasya prāpsyāmaḥ strīvadhaṁ vayam ॥10॥
12.33.11: yad vayaṁ suhr̥do hatvā kr̥tvā pāpamanantakam,
12.33.13: nirīkṣya nipuṇaṁ buddhyā r̥ṣiḥ provāca pāṇḍavam ॥13॥
12.33.15: kāṅkṣamāṇāḥ śriyaṁ kr̥tsnāṁ pr̥thivyāṁ ca mahad yaśaḥ,
12.33.16: na tvaṁ hantā na bhīmo’yaṁ nārjuno na yamāvapi,
12.33.17: na tasya mātāpitarau nānugrāhyo hi kaścana,
12.33.25: idaṁ tu śrūyate pārtha yuddhe devāsure purā,
12.33.31: ekaṁ hatvā yadi kule śiṣṭānāṁ syādanāmayam,
kulaṁ hatvā ca rāṣṭraṁ ca na tad vr̥ttopaghātakam ॥31॥
12.33.35: kurvannapi tathaiva syāt kr̥tvā ca nirapatrapaḥ ॥35॥
12.33.36: prāyaścittaṁ na tasyāsti hrāso vā pāpakarmaṇaḥ ॥36॥
12.33.43: teṣāṁ purāṇi rāṣṭrāṇi gatvā rājan suhr̥dvr̥taḥ,
bhrātr̥̄n putrāṁśca pautrāṁśca sve sve rājye’bhiṣecaya ॥43॥
12.33.48: rakṣasva dharmaṁ kaunteya śreyān yaḥ pretya bhārata ॥48॥
12.33.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi prāyaścittīyopākhyāne trayastriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥33॥
12.34.1: kiṁ kr̥tvā mucyate tatra tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.34.9: akāryāṇi tu vakṣyāmi yāni tāni nibodha me,
12.34.14: pitrā vivadate putro yaśca syād gurutalpagaḥ,
12.34.16: yeṣu yeṣu nimitteṣu na lipyante’tha tān śr̥ṇu ॥16॥
12.34.18: iti cāpyatra kaunteya mantro vedeṣu paṭhyate,
12.34.22: gurutalpaṁ hi gurvarthaṁ na dūṣayati mānavam,
12.34.23: bahuśaḥ kāmakāreṇa na ced yaḥ sampravartate ॥23॥
12.34.24: svayamaprāśitā yaśca na sa pāpena lipyate ॥24॥
12.34.25: gurvarthe strīṣu caiva syād vivāhakaraṇeṣu ca ॥25॥
12.34.27: pārivittyaṁ tu patite nāsti pravrajite tathā,
bhikṣite pāradāryaṁ ca tad dharmasya na dūṣakam ॥27॥
12.34.30: api sā pūyate tena na tu bhartā praduṣyati ॥30॥
12.34.31: tattvaṁ jñātvā tu somasya vikrayaḥ syādadoṣavān,
12.34.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi prāyaścittīye catustriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥34॥
12.35.1: tapasā karmaṇā caiva pradānena ca bhārata,
12.35.2: ekakālaṁ tu bhuñjīta caran bhaikṣyaṁ svakarmakr̥t,
12.35.5: japan vānyatamaṁ vedaṁ yojanānāṁ śataṁ vrajet,
12.35.6: dhanaṁ vā jīvanāyālaṁ gr̥haṁ vā saparicchadam,
12.35.10: te sarve dhūtapāpmāno bhavantīti parā śrutiḥ,
12.35.12: dogdhrīṇāṁ sa ca pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyo vipramucyate ॥12॥
12.35.13: sādhubhyo vai daridrebhyo dattvā mucyeta kilbiṣāt ॥13॥
12.35.14: śataṁ vai yastu kāmbojān brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati,
niyatebhyo mahīpāla sa ca pāpāt pramucyate ॥14॥
12.35.15: manorathaṁ tu yo dadyādekasmā api bhārata,
na kīrtayeta dattvā yaḥ sa ca pāpāt pramucyate ॥15॥
12.35.16: surāpānaṁ sakr̥t kr̥tvā yo’gnivarṇāṁ surāṁ pibet,
12.35.18: samitiṁ brāhmaṇo gacchediti vai brahmaṇaḥ śrutiḥ ॥18॥
12.35.19: bhūmipradānaṁ kuryād yaḥ surāṁ pītvā vimatsaraḥ,
punarna ca pibed rājan saṁskr̥taḥ sa ca śuddhyati ॥19॥
12.35.22: mahāvrataṁ cared yastu dadyāt sarvasvameva tu,
gurvarthe vā hato yuddhe sa mucyet karmaṇo’śubhāt ॥22॥
12.35.23: upāhr̥tya priyaṁ tasmai tasmāt pāpāt pramucyate ॥23॥
12.35.25: saṁvatsaraṁ vratī bhūtvā tathā mucyeta kilbiṣāt ॥25॥
12.35.26: dhanaṁ tu yasyāpaharet tasmai dadyāt samaṁ vasu,
12.35.28: niveśyaṁ tu punastena sadā tārayatā pitr̥̄n,
na tu striyā bhaved doṣo na tu sā tena lipyate ॥28॥
12.35.30: rajasā tā viśudhyante bhasmanā bhājanaṁ yathā ॥30॥
12.35.33: tathā vaiśye ca śūdre ca pādaḥ pādo vidhīyate,
12.35.34: trirātraṁ vāyubhakṣaḥ syāt karma ca prathayannaraḥ ॥34॥
12.35.40: atiricyeta yo yatra tatkartā labhate phalam ॥40॥
12.35.41: tasmād dānena tapasā karmaṇā ca phalaṁ śubham,
12.35.42: dadyānnityaṁ ca vittāni tathā mucyeta kilbiṣāt ॥42॥
12.35.45: jānatā tu kr̥taṁ pāpaṁ guru sarvaṁ bhavatyuta,
12.35.49: sa rājan mokṣyase pāpāt tena pūrṇena hetunā,
12.35.50: athavā te ghr̥ṇā kācit prāyaścittaṁ cariṣyasi,
12.35.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi prāyaścittīye pañcatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥35॥
12.36.1: kiṁ bhakṣyaṁ cāpyabhakṣyaṁ ca kiṁ ca deyaṁ praśasyate,
kiṁ ca pātramapātraṁ vā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.36.4: kāryākāryaṁ ca yat sarvaṁ śaṁsa vai tvaṁ prajāpate ॥4॥
12.36.8: etāni medhyaṁ puruṣaṁ kurvantyāśu na saṁśayaḥ ॥8॥
12.36.9: na garveṇa bhavet prājñaḥ kadācidapi mānavaḥ,
12.36.11: sa eva dharmaḥ so’dharmo deśakāle pratiṣṭhitaḥ,
12.36.14: daivaṁ ca daivasaṁyuktaṁ prāṇaśca prāṇadaśca ha,
12.36.18: kṣayaṁ śokaṁ prakurvāṇo na mriyeta yadā naraḥ,
12.36.19: varjayanti ca ye dharmaṁ teṣāṁ dharmo na vidyate ॥19॥
12.36.20: yad brūyuḥ kārya utpanne sa dharmo dharmasaṁśaye ॥20॥
12.36.23: bhāsā haṁsāḥ suparṇāśca cakravākāḥ plavā bakāḥ,
12.36.24: kravyādā daṁṣṭriṇaḥ sarve catuṣpāt pakṣiṇaśca ye,
12.36.25: mānuṣīṇāṁ mr̥gīṇāṁ ca na pibed brāhmaṇaḥ payaḥ ॥25॥
12.36.28: mr̥ṣyanti ye copapatiṁ strījitānnaṁ ca sarvaśaḥ ॥28॥
12.36.31: vāmahastāhr̥taṁ cānnaṁ bhaktaṁ paryuṣitaṁ ca yat ॥31॥
12.36.35: yathā pravrajito bhikṣustathaiva sve gr̥he vaset ॥35॥
12.36.36: na dadyād yaśase dānaṁ na bhayānnopakāriṇe ॥36॥
12.36.37: na matte caiva nonmatte na stene na ca kutsake ॥37॥
12.36.38: na vāgghīne vivarṇe vā nāṅgahīne na vāmane,
na durjane dauṣkule vā vratairyo vā na saṁskr̥taḥ,
12.36.39: asamyak caiva yad dattamasamyak ca pratigrahaḥ,
12.36.42: kapāle yadvadāpaḥ syuḥ śvadr̥tau ca yathā payaḥ,
12.36.44: āptācarita ityeva dharma ityeva vā punaḥ ॥44॥
12.36.46: yathā dārumayo hastī yathā carmamayo mr̥gaḥ,
12.36.47: yathā ṣaṇḍho’phalaḥ strīṣu yathā gaurgavi cāphalā,
12.36.48: grāmo dhānyairyathā śūnyo yathā kūpaśca nirjalaḥ,
12.36.50: etat te kathitaṁ sarvaṁ yathāvr̥ttaṁ yudhiṣṭhira,
12.36.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi vyāsavākye ṣaṭtriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥36॥
12.37.2: āpatsu ca yathā nītiḥ praṇetavyā dvijottama,
12.37.4: dharmacaryā ca rājyaṁ ca nityameva virudhyate,
12.37.7: sa te dharmarahasyeṣu saṁśayān manasi sthitān,
12.37.8: janayāmāsa yaṁ devī divyā tripathagā nadī,
12.37.16: tamabhyehi purā prāṇān sa vimuñcati dharmavit ॥16॥
12.37.25: kuru priyamamitraghna lokasya ca hitaṁ kuru ॥25॥
12.37.30: sa taiḥ parivr̥to rājā nakṣatrairiva candramāḥ,
12.37.40: narayānena tu jyeṣṭhaḥ pitā pārthasya bhārata,
12.37.41: kurustriyaśca tāḥ sarvāḥ kuntī kr̥ṣṇā tathaiva ca,
12.37.48: sitāḥ sumanaso gaurāḥ sthāpitāstatra tatra ha ॥48॥
12.37.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirapraveśe saptatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥37॥
12.38.5: dhanyā tvamasi pāñcāli yā tvaṁ puruṣasattamān,
12.38.10: diṣṭyā rājyaṁ punaḥ prāptaṁ dharmeṇa ca balena ca ॥10॥
12.38.11: bhava nastvaṁ mahārāja rājeha śaradāṁ śatam,
12.38.17: tāṁstu vai pūjayāmāsa kaunteyo vidhivad dvijān,
dhaumyaṁ guruṁ puraskr̥tya jyeṣṭhaṁ pitarameva ca ॥17॥
12.38.20: haṁsavad viduṣāṁ rājan dvijānāṁ tatra bhāratī,
12.38.22: niḥśabde ca sthite tatra tato viprajane punaḥ,
12.38.23: sākṣaḥ śikhī tridaṇḍī ca dhr̥ṣṭo vigatasādhvasaḥ ॥23॥
12.38.26: ime prāhurdvijāḥ sarve samāropya vaco mayi,
12.38.27: kiṁ tena syāddhi kaunteya kr̥tvemaṁ jñātisaṅkṣayam,
ghātayitvā gurūṁścaiva mr̥taṁ śreyo na jīvitam ॥27॥
12.38.28: iti te vai dvijāḥ śrutvā tasya duṣṭasya rakṣasaḥ,
12.38.29: tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve sa ca rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
12.38.31: tato rājan brāhmaṇāste sarva eva viśāmpate,
12.38.34: vayaṁ brūmo na dharmātman vyetu te bhayamīdr̥śam,
12.39.1: tatastatra tu rājānaṁ tiṣṭhantaṁ bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha,
12.39.4: vareṇa cchandyamānaśca brahmaṇā ca punaḥ punaḥ,
12.39.8: tānuvāca tato devo vihitastatra vai mayā,
12.39.9: rājā duryodhano nāma sakhāsya bhavitā nr̥ṣu,
12.39.10: dhakṣyanti vāgbalāḥ pāpaṁ tato nāśaṁ gamiṣyati ॥10॥
12.39.11: sa eṣa nihataḥ śete brahmadaṇḍena rākṣasaḥ,
12.39.13: sa tvamātiṣṭha kāryāṇi mā te’bhūd glāniracyuta,
śatrūn jahi prajā rakṣa dvijāṁśca paripūjaya ॥13॥
12.39.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi cārvākavaradānādikathane ekonacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥39॥
12.40.6: dhr̥tarāṣṭro yato rājā tataḥ sarve samāviśan ॥6॥
12.40.9: pr̥thivīṁ ca suvarṇaṁ ca ratnāni vividhāni ca,
12.40.20: te prītā brāhmaṇā rājan svastyūcurjayameva ca,
12.40.22: tvaṁ cāpi kuśalī rājan mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau ॥22॥
12.40.24: pratipede mahad rājyaṁ suhr̥dbhiḥ saha bhārata ॥24॥
12.40.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirābhiṣeke catvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥40॥
12.41.3: anugrāhyā vayaṁ nūnaṁ bhavatāmiti me matiḥ,
12.41.4: dhr̥tarāṣṭro mahārājaḥ pitā me daivataṁ param,
12.41.5: etadarthaṁ hi jīvāmi kr̥tvā jñātivadhaṁ mahat,
12.41.7: eṣa nātho hi jagato bhavatāṁ ca mayā saha,
asyaiva pr̥thivī kr̥tsnā pāṇḍavāḥ sarva eva ca ॥7॥
12.41.10: mantre ca niścaye caiva ṣāḍguṇyasya ca cintane,
12.41.15: tena gopyo hi nr̥patiḥ sarvāvastho viśāmpate ॥15॥
12.41.16: yān yānamanyad yogyāṁśca yeṣu yeṣviha karmasu,
12.41.17: viduraṁ sañjayaṁ caiva yuyutsuṁ ca mahāmatim,
12.41.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi bhīmādikarmaniyoge ekacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥41॥
12.42.1: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā jñātīnāṁ ye hatā yudhi,
12.42.6: ye cānye pr̥thivīpālā yeṣāṁ nāsti suhr̥jjanaḥ ॥6॥
12.42.10: yāśca tatra striyaḥ kāścid hatavīrā hatātmajāḥ ॥10॥
12.42.12: sa vijitya mahīṁ kr̥tsnāmānr̥ṇyaṁ prāpya vairiṣu,
12.42.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi śrāddhakriyāyāṁ dvicatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥42॥
12.43.2: tava kr̥ṣṇa prasādena nayena ca balena ca,
buddhyā ca yaduśārdūla tathā vikramaṇena ca ॥2॥
12.43.5: viṣṇo jiṣṇo hare kr̥ṣṇa vaikuṇṭha puruṣottama ॥5॥
12.43.6: adityāḥ saptadhā tvaṁ tu purāṇo garbhatāṁ gataḥ,
12.43.11: samrāḍ virāṭ svarāṭ caiva surarājo bhavodbhavaḥ,
12.43.15: ambhonidhistvaṁ brahmā tvaṁ pavitraṁ dhāma dhāmavit,
hiraṇyagarbhaṁ tvāmāhuḥ svadhā svāhā ca keśava ॥15॥
12.43.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi vāsudevastutau tricatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥43॥
12.44.13: mumude tacca labdhvāsau kailāsaṁ dhanado yathā ॥13॥
12.44.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi gr̥havibhāge catuścatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥44॥
12.45.4: cāturvarṇyaṁ yathāyogyaṁ sve sve sthāne nyaveśayat ॥4॥
12.45.8: vidurāya ca rājāsau pūjāṁ cakre yatavrataḥ ॥8॥
12.45.11: dhr̥tarāṣṭrāya tad rājyaṁ gāndhāryai vidurāya ca,
12.45.12: tathā sarvaṁ sa nagaraṁ prasādya bharatarṣabha,
12.45.16: naupamyaṁ vidyate tasya triṣu lokeṣu kiñcana,
12.45.17: sukhena te niśā kaccid vyuṣṭā buddhimatāṁ vara ॥17॥
12.45.19: vayaṁ rājyamanuprāptāḥ pr̥thivī ca vaśe sthitā,
12.45.20: jayaṁ prāptā yaśaścāgryaṁ na ca dharmacyutā vayam,
12.45.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi kr̥ṣṇaṁ prati yudhiṣṭhiravākye pañcacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥45॥
12.46.2: apakrānto yato devastena me vismitaṁ manaḥ ॥2॥
12.46.4: vāk ca sattvaṁ ca govinda buddhau saṁveśitāni te,
sarve caiva guṇā devāḥ kṣetrajñe te niveśitāḥ ॥4॥
12.46.5: neṅganti tava romāṇi sthirā buddhistathā manaḥ,
12.46.6: yathā dīpo nivātastho niriṅgo jvalate punaḥ,
tathāsi bhagavan deva pāṣāṇa iva niścalaḥ ॥6॥
12.46.7: yadi śrotumihārhāmi na rahasyaṁ ca te yadi,
12.46.8: tvaṁ hi kartā vikartā ca kṣaraṁ caivākṣaraṁ ca hi,
12.46.9: dhyānasyāsya yathā tattvaṁ brūhi dharmabhr̥tāṁ vara ॥9॥
12.46.10: tataḥ sve gocare nyasya manobuddhīndriyāṇi saḥ,
12.46.11: māṁ dhyāti puruṣavyāghrastato me tadgataṁ manaḥ ॥11॥
12.46.12: na sehe devarājo’pi tamasmi manasā gataḥ ॥12॥
12.46.14: na ca rāmeṇa nistīrṇastamasmi manasā gataḥ ॥14॥
12.46.15: śaraṇaṁ māmupāgacchat tato me tadgataṁ manaḥ ॥15॥
12.46.19: sa hi bhūtaṁ bhaviṣyacca bhavacca bharatarṣabha,
vetti dharmavidāṁ śreṣṭhaṁ tamasmi manasā gataḥ ॥19॥
12.46.20: tasmin hi puruṣavyāghre karmabhiḥ svairdivaṁ gate,
12.46.25: yad bhavānāha bhīṣmasya prabhāvaṁ prati mādhava,
tathā tannātra sandeho vidyate mama mādhava ॥25॥
12.46.29: āvr̥te bhagavatyarke sa hi lokān gamiṣyati,
12.46.30: darśanaṁ tvasya lābhaḥ syāt tvaṁ hi brahmamayo nidhiḥ ॥30॥
12.46.31: pārśvasthaṁ sātyakiṁ prāha ratho me yujyatāmiti ॥31॥
12.46.32: dārukaṁ prāha kr̥ṣṇasya yujyatāṁ ratha ityuta ॥32॥
12.46.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi mahāpuruṣastave ṣaṭcatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥46॥
12.47.2d1: prājāpatye ca nakṣatre madhyaṁ prāpte divākare.
12.47.6: tathā jaimininā caiva pailena ca mahātmanā,
12.47.18: anādyantaṁ paraṁ brahma na devā narṣayo viduḥ ॥18॥
12.47.19: eko yaṁ veda bhagavān dhātā nārāyaṇo hariḥ,
12.47.21: yaṁ na jānanti ko hyeṣa kuto vā bhagavāniti,
yasmin viśvāni bhūtāni tiṣṭhanti ca viśanti ca ॥21॥
12.47.22: yasmin nitye tate tantau dr̥ḍhe sragiva tiṣṭhati ॥22॥
12.47.25: garīyasāṁ gariṣṭhaṁ ca śreṣṭhaṁ ca śreyasāmapi ॥25॥
12.47.32: purāṇe puruṣaṁ proktaṁ brahma proktaṁ yugādiṣu,
12.47.35: r̥tamekākṣaraṁ brahma yat tat sadasatoḥ param,
12.47.38: yaṁ vai viśvasya kartāraṁ jagatastasthuṣāṁ patim,
12.47.39: ekaṁ dvādaśadhā jajñe tasmai sūryātmane namaḥ ॥39॥
12.47.40: śukle devān pitr̥̄n kr̥ṣṇe tarpayatyamr̥tena yaḥ,
yaśca rājā dvijātīnāṁ tasmai somātmane namaḥ ॥40॥
12.47.41: yaṁ jñātvā mr̥tyumatyeti tasmai jñeyātmane namaḥ ॥41॥
12.47.42: yaṁ br̥hantaṁ br̥hatyukthe yamagnau yaṁ mahādhvare,
yaṁ viprasaṅghā gāyanti tasmai vedātmane namaḥ ॥42॥
12.47.43: yaṁ saptatantuṁ tanvanti tasmai yajñātmane namaḥ ॥43॥
12.47.44: hūyate ca punardvābhyāṁ tasmai homātmane namaḥ ॥44॥
12.47.45: rathantaraṁ br̥hat sāma tasmai stotrātmane namaḥ ॥45॥
12.47.48: pajñāṅgo yo varāho vai bhūtvā gāmujjahāra ha,
12.47.49d4: yaṁ hi sūkṣmaṁ vicinvanti paraṁ sūkṣmavido janāḥ,
sūkṣmāt sūkṣmaṁ ca yad brahma tasmai sūkṣmātmane namaḥ.
12.47.49d5: matsyo bhūtvā viriñcāya yena vedāḥ samāhr̥tāḥ,
12.47.49d9: trailokyaṁ krāntavān yastu tasmai krāntātmane namaḥ.
12.47.49d10: mahīṁ niḥkṣatriyāṁ cakre tasmai rāmātmane namaḥ.
12.47.49d11: jaghāna kṣatriyān saṅkhye tasmai krodhātmane namaḥ.
12.47.49d12: jaghāna rāvaṇaṁ saṅkhye tasmai kṣatrātmane namaḥ.
12.47.49d13: yo halī musalī śrīmān nīlāmbaradharaḥ sthitaḥ,
12.47.49d20: dadau rājyaṁ mahendrāya tasmai mukhyātmane namaḥ.
12.47.56: śāntāḥ saṁnyāsino yānti tasmai mokṣātmane namaḥ ॥56॥
12.47.59: tad yasya nābhyāṁ sambhūtaṁ yasmin viśvaṁ pratiṣṭhitam,
12.47.63: yo niṣaṇṇo bhaved rātrau divā bhavati viṣṭhitaḥ,
iṣṭāniṣṭasya ca draṣṭā tasmai draṣṭrātmane namaḥ ॥63॥
12.47.64: vaikuṇṭhasya ca tad rūpaṁ tasmai kāryātmane namaḥ ॥64॥
12.47.65: kruddho nijaghne samare tasmai krauryātmane namaḥ ॥65॥
12.47.68: brahma vaktraṁ bhujau kṣatraṁ kr̥tsnamūrūdaraṁ viśaḥ,
12.47.70: paraḥ kālāt paro yajñāt parāt parataraśca yaḥ,
12.47.72: yo dhārayati bhūtāni tasmai prāṇātmane namaḥ ॥72॥
12.47.75: yaṁ na devā na gandharvā na daityā na ca dānavāḥ,
tattvato hi vijānanti tasmai sūkṣmātmane namaḥ ॥75॥
12.47.76: jagad dhārayate kr̥tsnaṁ tasmai vīryātmane namaḥ ॥76॥
12.47.84: yasmin sarvaṁ yataḥ sarvaṁ yaḥ sarvaṁ sarvataśca yaḥ,
yaśca sarvamayo nityaṁ tasmai sarvātmane namaḥ ॥84॥
12.47.86: namaste dikṣu sarvāsu tvaṁ hi sarvamayo nidhiḥ ॥86॥
12.47.87: tvaṁ hi kartā hr̥ṣīkeśa saṁhartā cāparājitaḥ ॥87॥
12.47.88: na hi paśyāmi te bhāvaṁ divyaṁ hi triṣu vartmasu,
tvāṁ tu paśyāmi tattvena yat te rūpaṁ sanātanam ॥88॥
12.47.89: divaṁ te śirasā vyāptaṁ padbhyāṁ devī vasundharā,
12.47.91: ye namasyanti govindaṁ na teṣāṁ vidyate bhayam ॥91॥
12.47.97: yathā viṣṇumayaṁ satyaṁ yathā viṣṇumayaṁ jagat,
yathā viṣṇumayaṁ sarvaṁ pāpmā me naśyatāṁ tathā ॥97॥
12.47.100: nārāyaṇaḥ paro devaḥ sarvaṁ nārāyaṇaḥ sadā ॥100॥
12.47.102: abhigamya tu yogena bhaktiṁ bhīṣmasya mādhavaḥ,
trailokyadarśanaṁ jñānaṁ divyaṁ dattvā yayau hariḥ ॥102॥
12.47.104: bhīṣmaṁ ca śanakaiḥ sarve praśaśaṁsuḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥104॥
12.47.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi bhīṣmastavarāje saptacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥47॥
12.48.1: tataḥ sa ca hr̥ṣīkeśaḥ sa ca rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
kr̥pādayaśca te sarve catvāraḥ pāṇḍavāśca te ॥1॥
12.48.8: amī rāmahradāḥ pañca dr̥śyante pārtha dūrataḥ,
12.48.9: ihedānīṁ tato rāmaḥ karmaṇo virarāma ha ॥9॥
12.48.10: rāmeṇeti tathā’’ttha tvamatra me saṁśayo mahān ॥10॥
12.48.15: āgamo hi paraḥ kr̥ṣṇa tvatto no vāsavānuja ॥15॥
12.49.1: śr̥ṇu kaunteya rāmasya prabhāvo yo mayā śrutaḥ,
maharṣīṇāṁ kathayatāṁ vikramaṁ tasya janma ca ॥1॥
12.49.2: yathā ca jāmadagnyena koṭiśaḥ kṣatriyā hatāḥ,
udbhūtā rājavaṁśeṣu ye bhūyo bhārate hatāḥ ॥2॥
12.49.7: tasya kanyābhavad rājan nāmnā satyavatī prabho,
12.49.8: tasyāḥ prītaḥ sa śaucena bhārgavaḥ kurunandana,
12.49.14: carudvayaṁ gr̥hītvā ca rājan satyavatī tadā,
12.49.15: mātā tu tasyāḥ kaunteya duhitre svaṁ caruṁ dadau,
12.49.19: viśvaṁ hi brahma sumahaccarau tava samāhitam ॥19॥
12.49.20: kṣatravīryaṁ ca sakalaṁ tava mātre samarpitam,
12.49.21: mātuste brāhmaṇo bhūyāt tava ca kṣatriyaḥ sutaḥ,
12.49.22: brāhmaṇāpasadaṁ putraṁ prāpsyasīti hi māṁ prabho ॥22॥
12.49.23: naiṣa saṅkalpitaḥ kāmo mayā bhadre tathā tvayi,
12.49.24: icchallom̐kānapi mune sr̥jethāḥ kiṁ punaḥ sutam,
12.49.26: dr̥ṣṭametat purā bhadre jñātaṁ ca tapasā mayā,
brahmabhūtaṁ hi sakalaṁ pitustava kulaṁ bhavet ॥26॥
12.49.27: kāmamevaṁ bhavet pautro mameha tava ca prabho,
12.49.28: putre nāsti viśeṣo me pautre ca varavarṇini,
yathā tvayoktaṁ vacanaṁ tathā bhadre bhaviṣyati ॥28॥
12.49.37: dadau sa pr̥thivīṁ sarvāṁ saptadvīpāṁ saparvatām,
12.49.39: grāmān purāṇi rāṣṭrāṇi ghoṣāṁścaiva tu vīryavān,
12.49.43: tvayā na varjitaṁ yasmānmamedaṁ hi mahad vanam,
dagdhaṁ tasmād raṇe rāmo bāhūṁste chetsyate’rjuna ॥43॥
12.49.45: nācintayat tadā śāpaṁ tena dattaṁ mahātmanā,
12.49.48: taṁ bhramantaṁ tato vatsaṁ jāmadagnyaḥ svamāśramam ॥48॥
12.49.54: sa tathā’’śu mahātejāḥ kr̥tvā niḥkṣatriyāṁ mahīm ॥54॥
12.49.57: ye te yayātipatane yajñe santaḥ samāgatāḥ ॥57॥
12.49.58: pratardanaprabhr̥tayo rāma kiṁ kṣatriyā na te,
12.49.59: sā punaḥ kṣatriyaśataiḥ pr̥thivī sarvataḥ str̥tā ॥59॥
12.49.60: tato ye kṣatriyā rājan śataśastena varjitāḥ ॥60॥
12.49.62: jātaṁ jātaṁ sa garbhaṁ tu punareva jaghāna ha ॥62॥
12.49.66: na te mad viṣaye rāma vastavyamiha karhicit,
12.49.68: kr̥tvā brāhmaṇasaṁsthāṁ vai praviṣṭaḥ sumahad vanam,
12.49.70: pīḍyante na hi vipreṣu prabhutvaṁ kasyacit tadā,
12.49.72: tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā dravatīṁ tatra santrāsāt sa mahāmanāḥ,
12.49.73: dhr̥tā tenoruṇā yena tenorvīti mahī smr̥tā,
12.49.74: santi brahman mayā guptāḥ srīṣu kṣatriyapuṅgavā ॥74॥
12.49.75: haihayānāṁ kule jātāste saṁrakṣantu māṁ mune,
12.49.77: sarvakarmāṇi kurute śūdravat tasya sa dvijaḥ ॥77॥
12.49.79: vane saṁvardhito gobhiḥ so’bhirakṣatu māṁ mune,
12.49.80: vatsaiḥ saṁvardhitoṁ goṣṭhe sa māṁ rakṣatu pārthivaḥ,
12.49.88: teṣāṁ putrāśca pautrāśca yeṣāṁ vaṁśāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ,
12.49.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi rāmopākhyāne ekonapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥49॥
12.50.1: tato rāmasya tat karmaṁ śrutvā rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
12.50.4: aho dhanyo nr̥loko’yaṁ sabhāgyāśca narā bhuvi,
12.50.8: dūrādeva tamālokya kr̥ṣṇo rājā ca dharmajaḥ,
12.50.10: abhivādya tu govindaḥ sātyakiste ca pārthivāḥ,
12.50.11: tato vr̥ddhaṁ tathā dr̥ṣṭvā gāṅgeyaṁ yadukauravāḥ,
12.50.13: kaccinna vyākulā caiva buddhiste vadatāṁ vara ॥13॥
12.50.14: śarābhighātaduḥkhāt te kaccid gātraṁ na dūyate,
12.50.16: susūkṣmo’pi tu dehe vai śalyo janayate rujam,
12.50.18: yacca bhūtaṁ bhaviṣyaṁ ca bhavacca puruṣarṣabha,
12.50.19: viditaste mahāprājña tvaṁ hi dharmamayo nidhiḥ ॥19॥
12.50.20: tvāṁ hi rājye sthitaṁ sphīte samagrāṅgamarogiṇam,
12.50.21: r̥te śāntanavād bhīṣmāt triṣu lokeṣu pārthiva,
12.50.23: satye tapasi dāne ca yajñādhikaraṇe tathā,
dhanurvede ca vede ca nītyāṁ caivānurakṣaṇe ॥23॥
12.50.26: sa tvaṁ bhīṣma mahābāho vasūnāṁ vāsavopamaḥ,
12.50.28: manuṣyeṣu manuṣyendra na dr̥ṣṭo na ca me śrutaḥ,
bhavato vā guṇairyuktaḥ pr̥thivyāṁ puruṣaḥ kvacit ॥28॥
12.50.29: tapasā hi bhavān śaktaḥ sraṣṭuṁ lokāṁścarācarān ॥29॥
12.50.32: cāturvidye ca ye proktāścāturhotre ca bhārata ॥32॥
12.50.33: yoge sāṅkhye ca niyatā ye ca dharmāḥ sanātanāḥ,
cāturvarṇyasya yaścokto dharmo na sma virudhyate ॥33॥
12.50.36: dharmaśāstraṁ ca sakalaṁ nityaṁ manasi te sthitam ॥36॥
12.50.37: teṣāṁ chettā nāsti loke tvadanyaḥ puruṣarṣabha ॥37॥
12.50.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi kr̥ṣṇavākye pañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥50॥
12.51.1: śrutvā tu vacanaṁ bhīṣmo vāsudevasya dhīmataḥ,
12.51.2: tvaṁ hi kartā hr̥ṣīkeśa saṁhartā cāparājitaḥ ॥2॥
12.51.5: tena paśyāmi te divyān bhāvān hi triṣu vartmasu ॥5॥
12.51.6: tacca paśyāmi govinda yat te rūpaṁ sanātanam,
12.51.7: divaṁ te śirasā vyāptaṁ padbhyāṁ devī vasundharā,
12.51.10: yataḥ khalu parā bhaktirmayi te puruṣarṣabha,
tato mayā vapurdivyaṁ tvayi rājan pradarśitam ॥10॥
12.51.11: na hyabhaktāya rājendra bhaktāyānr̥jave na ca,
12.51.12: dame tapasi satye ca dāne ca nirataḥ śuciḥ ॥12॥
12.51.13: arhastvaṁ bhīṣma māṁ draṣṭuṁ tapasā svena pārthiva,
tava hyupasthitā lokā yebhyo nāvartate punaḥ ॥13॥
12.51.17: amuṁ ca lokaṁ tvayi bhīṣma yāte
12.51.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi kr̥ṣṇavākye ekapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥51॥
12.52.1: tataḥ kr̥ṣṇasya tad vākyaṁ dharmārthasahitaṁ hitam,
12.52.3: kiṁ cāhamabhidhāsyāmi vākyaṁ te tava saṁnidhau,
yadā vācogataṁ sarvaṁ tava vāci samāhitam ॥3॥
12.52.4: yacca kiñcit kvacilloke kartavyaṁ kriyate ca yat,
tvattastanniḥsr̥taṁ deva loke buddhimato hi te ॥4॥
12.52.6: gātrāṇi cāvasīdanti na ca buddhiḥ prasīdati ॥6॥
12.52.7: na ca me pratibhā kācidasti kiñcit prabhāṣitum,
12.52.8: balaṁ me prajahātīva prāṇāḥ santvarayanti ca,
12.52.9: daurbalyāt sajjate vāṅ me sa kathaṁ vaktumutsahe,
12.52.10: tat kṣamasva mahābāho na brūyāṁ kiñcidacyuta,
12.52.11: na diśaḥ samprajānāmi nākāśaṁ na ca medinīm,
12.52.13: kathaṁ tvayi sthite kr̥ṣṇe śāśvate lokakartari,
prabrūyānmadvidhaḥ kaścid gurau śiṣya iva sthite ॥13॥
12.52.16: na te glānirna te mūrchā na dāho na ca te rujā,
12.52.18: sattvasthaṁ ca mano nityaṁ tava bhīṣma bhaviṣyati,
12.52.21: bhīṣma drakṣyasi tattvena jale mīna ivāmale ॥21॥
12.52.25: vavau śivaḥ sukho vāyuḥ sarvagandhavahaḥ śuciḥ,
12.52.28: sātyakiḥ sañjayaścaiva sa ca śāradvataḥ kr̥paḥ ॥28॥
12.52.29: śvaḥ sameṣyāma ityuktvā yatheṣṭaṁ tvaritā yayuḥ ॥29॥
12.52.32: yayau rathānāṁ purato hi sā camū-
12.52.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirādyāgamane dvipañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥52॥
12.53.2: avalokya tataḥ paścād dadhyau brahma sanātanam ॥2॥
12.53.5: sahāsa iva vistīrṇaḥ śuśruve tasya veśmanaḥ ॥5॥
12.53.10: api sajjo mahātejā bhīṣmaṁ draṣṭuṁ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥10॥
12.53.15: na sainikaiśca yātavyaṁ yāsyāmo vayameva hi,
na ca pīḍayitavyo me bhīṣmo dharmabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ ॥15॥
12.53.20: rathasthāḥ saṁvidaṁ kr̥tvā sukhāṁ pr̥ṣṭvā ca śarvarīm ॥20॥
12.53.25: tato’vatīrya govindo rathāt sa ca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥25॥
12.53.26: bhīmo gāṇḍīvadhanvā ca yamau sātyakireva ca,
12.53.27: sa taiḥ parivr̥to rājā nakṣatrairiva candramāḥ,
12.53.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi bhīṣmābhigamane tripañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥53॥
12.54.10: eṣa vr̥ddhaḥ parāllom̐kān samprāpnoti tanuṁ tyajan,
12.54.15: kaccit sukhena rajanī vyuṣṭā te rājasattama,
12.54.16: na glāyate ca hr̥dayaṁ na ca te vyākulaṁ manaḥ ॥16॥
12.54.17: dāho mohaḥ śramaścaiva klamo glānistathā rujā,
tava prasādād vārṣṇeya sadyaḥ pratigatāni me ॥17॥
12.54.20: śiṣṭaiśva dharmo yaḥ proktaḥ sa ca me hr̥di vartate,
12.54.21: caturṣvāśramadharmeṣu yo’rthaḥ sa ca hr̥di sthitaḥ,
12.54.22: yacca yatra ca vaktavyaṁ tad vakṣyāmi janārdana,
tava prasādāddhi śubhā mano me buddhirāviśat ॥22॥
12.54.24: svayaṁ kimarthaṁ tu bhavān śreyo na prāha pāṇḍavam,
kiṁ te vivakṣitaṁ cātra tadāśu vada mādhava ॥24॥
12.54.25: yaśasaḥ śreyasaścaiva mūlaṁ māṁ viddhi kaurava,
12.54.26: tathaiva yaśasā pūrṇe mayi ko vismayiṣyati ॥26॥
12.54.27: ādheyaṁ tu mayā bhūyo yaśastava mahādyute,
tato me vipulā buddhistvayi bhīṣma samarpitā ॥27॥
12.54.31: etasmāt kāraṇād bhīṣma matirdivyā mayā hi te,
dattā yaśo viprathayet kathaṁ bhūyastaveti ha ॥31॥
12.54.32: yāvaddhi prathate loke puruṣasya yaśo bhuvi,
12.54.35: janmaprabhr̥ti te kaścid vr̥jinaṁ na dadarśa ha,
12.54.36: tebhyaḥ piteva putrebhyo rājan brūhi paraṁ nayam,
12.54.37: dharmaṁ śuśrūṣamāṇebhyaḥ pr̥ṣṭena ca satā punaḥ ॥37॥
12.54.38: apratibruvataḥ kaṣṭo doṣo hi bhavitā prabho ॥38॥
12.54.39: tasmāt putraiśca pautraiśca dharmān pr̥ṣṭān sanātanān,
12.54.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi kr̥ṣṇavākye catuḥpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥54॥
12.55.1: hanta dharmān pravakṣyāmi dr̥ḍhe vāṅmanasī mama ॥1॥
12.55.2: tava prasādād govinda bhūtātmā hyasi śāśvataḥ,
evaṁ prīto bhaviṣyāmi dharmān vakṣyāmi cākhilān ॥2॥
12.55.3: ahr̥ṣyannr̥ṣayaḥ sarve sa māṁ pr̥cchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥3॥
12.55.4: yasya nāsti samaḥkaścit sa māṁ pr̥cchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥4॥
12.55.5: yasminnojaśca tejaśca sa māṁ pr̥cchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥5॥
12.55.6: sammānayati satkr̥tya sa māṁ pr̥cchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥6॥
12.55.7: yasminnetāni sarvāṇi sa māṁ pr̥cchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥7॥
12.55.8: kuryādadharmaṁ dharmātmā sa māṁ pr̥cchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥8॥
12.55.9: yo dadāti satāṁ nityaṁ sa māṁ pr̥cchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥9॥
12.55.10: kṣāntaḥ śrutarahasyaśca sa māṁ pr̥cchatu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥10॥
12.55.15: mithyāpravr̥ttān yaḥ saṅkhye nihanyād dharma eva saḥ ॥15॥
12.55.16: nihanti samare pāpān kṣatriyo yaḥ sa dharmavit ॥16॥
12.55.17: nihanti yastaṁ samare kṣatriyo vai sa dharmavit ॥17॥
12.55.18: mahīṁ karoti yuddheṣu kṣatriyo yaḥ sa dharmavit ॥18॥
12.55.19: dharmyaṁ svargyaṁ ca lokyaṁ ca yuddhaṁ hi manurabravīt ॥19॥
12.55.21: athāsya pādau jagrāha bhīṣmaścāpi nananda tam,
12.55.22: māṁ pr̥ccha tāta viśrabdhaṁ mā bhaistvaṁ kurusattama ॥22॥
12.55.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirāśvāsane pañcapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥55॥
12.56.2: rājñāṁ vai paramo dharma iti dharmavido viduḥ,
mahāntametaṁ bhāraṁ ca manye tad brūhi pārthiva ॥2॥
12.56.6: lokasya saṁsthā na bhavet sarvaṁ ca vyākulībhavet ॥6॥
12.56.7: udayan hi yathā sūryo nāśayatyaśubhaṁ tamaḥ,
12.56.8: tadagre rājadharmān hi madarthe tvaṁ pitāmaha,
prabrūhi bharataśreṣṭha tvaṁ hi dharmabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ ॥8॥
12.56.10: namo dharmāya mahate namaḥ kr̥ṣṇāya vedhase,
12.56.13: ānr̥ṇyaṁ yāti dharmasya lokena ca samarcyate ॥13॥
12.56.15: pauruṣaṁ hi paraṁ manye daivaṁ niścitamucyate ॥15॥
12.56.16: vipanne ca samārambhe santāpaṁ mā sma vai kr̥thāḥ,
12.56.17: na hi satyādr̥te kiñcid rājñāṁ vai siddhikārakam,
satye hi rājā nirataḥ pretya ceha ca nandati ॥17॥
12.56.19: sudarśaḥ sthūlalakṣyaśca na bhraśyeta sadā śriyaḥ ॥19॥
12.56.21: mr̥durhi rājā satataṁ laṅghyo bhavati sarvaśaḥ,
12.56.22: adaṇḍyāścaiva te putra viprāśca dadatāṁ vara,
bhūtametat paraṁ loke brāhmaṇo nāma pāṇḍava ॥22॥
12.56.23: manunā caiva rājendra gītau ślokau mahātmanā,
dharmeṣu sveṣu kauravya hr̥di tau kartumarhasi ॥23॥
12.56.24: teṣāṁ sarvatragaṁ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu śāmyati ॥24॥
12.56.25: brahma ca kṣatriyo dveṣṭi tadā sīdanti te trayaḥ ॥25॥
12.56.26: evaṁ kr̥tvā mahārāja namasyā eva te dvijāḥ,
12.56.27: nigrāhyā eva satataṁ bāhubhyāṁ ye syurīdr̥śāḥ ॥27॥
12.56.28: ślokau cośanasā gītau purā tāta maharṣiṇā,
12.56.30: vinaśyamānaṁ dharmaṁ hi yo’bhirakṣet sa dharmavit,
12.56.31: evaṁ caiva naraśreṣṭha rakṣyā eva dvijātayaḥ,
12.56.32: brahmaghne gurutalye ca bhrūṇahatye tathaiva ca ॥32॥
12.56.35: durgeṣu ca mahārāja ṣaṭsu ye śāstraniścitāḥ,
12.56.36: dharmātmā satyavāk caiva rājā rañjayati prajāḥ ॥36॥
12.56.37: na ca kṣāntena te nityaṁ bhāvyaṁ putra samantataḥ,
adharmo hi mr̥dū rājā kṣamāvāniva kuñjaraḥ ॥37॥
12.56.38: bārhaspatye ca śāstre ca śloko nigaditaḥ purā,
12.56.40: vāsantārka iva śrīmān na śīto na ca gharmadaḥ ॥40॥
12.56.41: parīkṣyāste mahārāja sve pare caiva nityaśaḥ ॥41॥
12.56.42: na caiva na prayuñjīta saṅgaṁ tu parivarjayet ॥42॥
12.56.45: yathā hi garbhiṇī hitvā svaṁ priyaṁ manaso’nugam,
12.56.46: svaṁ priyaṁ tu parityajya yad yallokahitaṁ bhavet ॥46॥
12.56.47: na santyājyaṁ ca te dhairyaṁ kadācidapi pāṇḍava,
dhīrasya spaṣṭadaṇḍasya na bhayaṁ vidyate kvacit ॥47॥
12.56.48: kartavyo rājaśārdūla doṣamatra hi me śr̥ṇu ॥48॥
12.56.49: sve sthāne na ca tiṣṭhanti laṅghayanti ca tadvacaḥ ॥49॥
12.56.53: vāntaṁ niṣṭhīvanaṁ caiva kurvate cāsya saṁnidhau,
12.56.54: hayaṁ vā dantinaṁ vāpi rathaṁ vā nr̥pasattama,
12.56.55: idaṁ te duṣkaraṁ rājannidaṁ te duṣṭaceṣṭitam,
12.56.56: kruddhe cāsmin hasantyeva na ca hr̥ṣyanti pūjitāḥ,
12.56.57: visraṁsayanti mantraṁ ca vivr̥ṇvanti ca duṣkr̥tam,
12.56.58: alaṅkāre ca bhojye ca tathā snānānulepane,
12.56.59: na vr̥ttyā parituṣyanti rājadeyaṁ haranti ca ॥59॥
12.57.5: saptāṅgasya ca rājyasya viparītaṁ ya ācaret,
gururvā yadi vā mitraṁ pratihantavya eva saḥ ॥5॥
12.57.6: maruttena hi rājñā vai gītaḥ ślokaḥ purātanaḥ,
12.57.8: bāhoḥ putreṇa rājñā ca sagareṇa ca dhīmatā,
12.57.9: asamañjāḥ sarayvāṁ sa paurāṇāṁ bālakān nr̥pa,
12.57.12: na hiṁsyāt paravittāni deyaṁ kāle ca dāpayet,
vikrāntaḥ satyavāk kṣānto nr̥po na calate pathaḥ ॥12॥
12.57.13: dharme cārthe ca kāme ca mokṣe ca satataṁ rataḥ ॥13॥
12.57.16: na viśvasecca nr̥patirna cātyarthaṁ ca viśvaset,
12.57.21: na cādadīta vittāni satāṁ hastāt kadācana,
12.57.22: svayaṁ prahartā dātā ca vaśyātmā ramyasādhanaḥ,
kāle dātā ca bhoktā ca śuddhācārastathaiva ca ॥22॥
12.57.26: pratyakṣā ca parokṣā ca vr̥ttiścāsya bhavet samā,
evaṁ kurvan narendro’pi na khedamiha vindati ॥26॥
12.57.32: yasya sajñaḥ pradr̥śyanti sa rājā rājasattamaḥ ॥32॥
12.57.33: putrā iva piturgehe viṣaye yasya mānavāḥ,
12.57.36: vaśyā neyā vidheyāśca na ca saṅgharṣaśīlinaḥ,
viṣaye dānarucayo narā yasya sa pārthivaḥ ॥36॥
12.57.37: na yasya kūṭaṁ kapaṭaṁ na māyā na ca matsaraḥ,
12.57.38: yaḥ satkaroti jñānāni jñeye parahite rataḥ,
12.57.39: yasya cārāśca mantrāśca nityaṁ caiva kr̥tākr̥tāḥ,
na jñāyante hi ripubhiḥ sa rājā rājyamarhati ॥39॥
12.57.41: rājānaṁ prathamaṁ vindet tato bhāryāṁ tato dhanam,
rājanyasati lokasya kuto bhāryā kuto dhanam ॥41॥
12.57.42: r̥te rakṣāṁ tu vispaṣṭāṁ rakṣā lokasya dhāriṇī ॥42॥
12.57.45: grāmakāmaṁ ca gopālaṁ vanakāmaṁ ca nāpitam ॥45॥
12.58.4: rājñāṁ rājīvatāmrākṣa sādhanaṁ cātra me śr̥ṇu ॥4॥
12.58.6: satāṁ saṅgrahaṇaṁ śauryaṁ dākṣyaṁ satyaṁ prajāhitam,
12.58.14: utthānena mahendreṇa śraiṣṭhyaṁ prāptaṁ divīha ca ॥14॥
12.58.19: rājño rahasyaṁ yad vākyaṁ jayārthaṁ lokasaṅgrahaḥ,
hr̥di yaccāsya jihmaṁ syāt kāraṇena ca yad bhavet ॥19॥
12.58.21: rājyaṁ hi sumahat tantraṁ dhāryate nākr̥tātmabhiḥ,
12.58.23: yadyapyasya vipattiḥ syād rakṣamāṇasya vai prajāḥ,
so’pyasya vipulo dharma evaṁvr̥ttā hi bhūmipāḥ ॥23॥
12.58.25: tato vyāsaśca bhagavān devasthāno’śma eva ca,
12.58.28: śva idānīṁ svasandehaṁ prakṣyāmi tvāṁ pitāmaha,
12.59.2: sukhāṁ ca rajanīṁ pr̥ṣṭvā gāṅgeyaṁ rathināṁ varam ॥2॥
12.59.5: ya eṣa rājan rājeti śabdaścarati bhārata,
12.59.10: ekasya tu prasādena kr̥tsno lokaḥ prasīdati,
12.59.11: kr̥tsnaṁ tanme yathātattvaṁ prabrūhi vadatāṁ vara ॥11॥
12.59.12: yadekasmin jagat sarvaṁ devavad yāti saṁnatim ॥12॥
12.59.14: na vai rājyaṁ na rājā’’sīnna ca daṇḍo na dāṇḍikaḥ,
dharmeṇaiva prajāḥ sarvā rakṣanti sma parasparam ॥14॥
12.59.19: tāṁstu kāmavaśaṁ prāptān rāgo nāma samaspr̥śat,
12.59.20: bhakṣyābhakṣyaṁ ca rājendra doṣādoṣaṁ ca nātyajan ॥20॥
12.59.21: viplute naraloke vai brahma caiva nanāśa ha,
12.59.22: naṣṭe brahmaṇi dharme ca devāṁstrāsaḥ samāviśat,
te trastā naraśārdūla brahmāṇaṁ śaraṇaṁ yayuḥ ॥22॥
12.59.30: trivarga iti vikhyāto gaṇa eṣa svayambhuvā,
12.59.32: sahāyāḥ kāraṇaṁ caiva ṣaḍvargo nītijaḥ smr̥taḥ ॥32॥
12.59.33: trayī cānvīkṣikī caiva vārtā ca bharatarṣabha,
12.59.35: sāma bhedaḥ pradānaṁ ca tato daṇḍaśca pārthiva,
12.59.36: mantraśca varṇitaḥ kr̥tsnastathā bhedārtha eva ca,
12.59.48: tathā khātavidhānaṁ ca yogaḥ sañcāra eva ca,
12.59.54: arthasya kāle dānaṁ ca vyasane cāprasaṅgitā ॥54॥
12.59.56: śaṅkitatvaṁ ca sarvasya pramādasya ca varjanam ॥56॥
12.59.64: upārjanaṁ ca dravyāṇāṁ parimardaśca tāni ṣaṭ ॥64॥
12.59.67: ekena ca yathottheyaṁ satyatvaṁ madhurā giraḥ,
12.59.70: rakṣaṇaṁ caiva paurāṇāṁ rāṣṭrasya ca vivardhanam,
maṇḍalasthā ca yā cintā rājan dvādaśarājikā ॥70॥
12.59.75: etat kr̥tvā śubhaṁ śāstraṁ tataḥ sa bhagavān prabhuḥ,
12.59.78: daṇḍena nīyate cedaṁ daṇḍaṁ nayati vā punaḥ,
12.59.80: tatastāṁ bhagavān nītiṁ pūrvaṁ jagrāha śaṅkaraḥ,
12.59.81: sañcikṣepa tataḥ śāstraṁ mahāstraṁ brahmaṇā kr̥tam ॥81॥
12.59.87: eko yo’rhati martyebhyaḥ śraiṣṭhyaṁ vai taṁ samādiśa ॥87॥
12.59.88: tataḥ sañcintya bhagavān devo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ,
12.59.91: prajāpateḥ kardamasya tvanaṅgo nāma vai sutaḥ,
12.59.93: mr̥tyostu duhitā rājan sunīthā nāma mānasī,
12.59.95: tato’sya vikr̥to jajñe hrasvāṅgaḥ puruṣo bhuvi ॥95॥
12.59.100: taṁ daṇḍanītiḥ sakalā śritā rājan narottamam,
12.59.101: anayā kiṁ mayā kāryaṁ tanme tattvena śaṁsata ॥101॥
12.59.102: tadahaṁ vai kariṣyāmi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ॥102॥
12.59.103: niyato yatra dharmo vai tamaśaṅkaḥ samācara ॥103॥
12.59.104: kāmaṁ krodhaṁ ca lobhaṁ ca mānaṁ cotsr̥jya dūrataḥ ॥104॥
12.59.108: adaṇḍyā me dvijāśceti pratijānīhi he vibho,
12.59.113: tayoḥ prīto dadau rājā pr̥thurvainyaḥ pratāpavān,
12.59.114: vaiṣamyaṁ hi paraṁ bhūmerāsīditi ca naḥ śrutam ॥114॥
12.59.116: sa viṣṇunā ca devena śakreṇa vibudhaiḥ saha ॥116॥
12.59.117: taṁ sākṣāt pr̥thivī bheje ratnānyādāya pāṇḍava ॥117॥
12.59.120: dharme cārthe ca kāme ca samarthaṁ pradadau dhanam,
12.59.121: na jarā na ca durbhikṣaṁ nādhayo vyādhayastathā ॥121॥
12.59.124: teneyaṁ pr̥thivī dugdhā sasyāni daśa sapta ca,
12.59.131: ko heturyad vaśe tiṣṭhelloko daivādr̥te guṇāt,
12.59.132: śrīḥ sambhūtā yato devī patnī dharmasya dhīmataḥ,
12.59.134: mahattvena ca saṁyukto vaiṣṇavena naro bhuvi ॥134॥
12.59.135: tiṣṭhatyekasya ca vaśe taṁ cedaṁ na vidhīyate ॥135॥
12.59.137: yo’sya vai mukhamadrākṣīt saumyaṁ so’sya vaśānugaḥ,
subhagaṁ cārthavantaṁ ca rūpavantaṁ ca paśyati ॥137॥
12.59.141: tapo jñānamahiṁsā ca satyāsatyena yaḥ paraḥ ॥141॥
12.59.143: bhuvi cādhogataṁ yacca tacca sarvaṁ samarpitam,
12.59.144: tato jagati rājendra satataṁ śabditaṁ budhaiḥ,
12.59.145: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ mahattvaṁ prati rājasu,
12.59.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi sūtrādhyāye ekonaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥59॥
12.60.2: ke dharmāḥ sarvavarṇānāṁ cāturvarṇyasya ke pr̥thak,
12.60.3: kena vai vardhate rāṣṭraṁ rājā kena vivardhate,
12.60.4: kośaṁ daṇḍaṁ ca durgaṁ ca sahāyān mantriṇastathā,
12.60.5: kuto vā’’tmā dr̥ḍhaṁ rakṣyastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥5॥
12.60.6: namo dharmāya mahate namaḥ kr̥ṣṇāya vedhase,
12.60.7: prajanaḥ sveṣu dāreṣu śaucamadroha eva ca ॥7॥
12.60.8: brāhmaṇasya tu yo dharmastaṁ te vakṣyāmi kevalam ॥8॥
12.60.13: kṣatriyasyāpi yo dharmastaṁ te vakṣyāmi bhārata,
dadyād rājan na yāceta yajeta na ca yājayet ॥13॥
12.60.16: kṣatriyo nāsya tat karma praśaṁsanti purāvidaḥ ॥16॥
12.60.21: vaiśyasyāpi hi yo dharmastaṁ te vakṣyāmi śāśvatam,
12.60.22: pitr̥vat pālayed vaiśyo yuktaḥ sarvān paśūniha,
vikarma tad bhavedanyat karma yat sa samācaret ॥22॥
12.60.23: rakṣayā sa hi teṣāṁ vai mahat sukhamavāpnuyāt,
12.60.24: brāhmaṇāya ca rājñe ca sarvāḥ paridade prajāḥ,
12.60.25: ṣaṇṇāmekāṁ pibed dhenuṁ śatācca mithunaṁ haret,
labdhācca saptamaṁ bhāgaṁ tathā śr̥ṅge kalāṁ khure ॥25॥
12.60.26: na ca vaiśyasya kāmaḥ syānna rakṣeyaṁ paśūniti ॥26॥
12.60.27: śūdrasyāpi hi yo dharmastaṁ te vakṣyāmi bhārata ॥27॥
12.60.30: sañcayāṁśca na kurvīta jātu śūdraḥ kathañcana,
pāpīyān hi dhanaṁ labdhvā vaśe kuryād garīyasaḥ ॥30॥
12.60.31: rājñā vā samanujñātaḥ kāmaṁ kurvīta dhārmikaḥ,
12.60.32: avaśyaṁ bharaṇīyo hi varṇānāṁ śūdra ucyate,
12.60.34: śūdrāyaiva pradeyāni tasya dharmadhanaṁ hi tat,
yaṁ ca kañcid dvijātīnāṁ śūdraḥ śuśrūṣurāvrajet ॥34॥
12.60.35: kalpyāṁ tena tu te prāhurvr̥ttiṁ dharmavido janāḥ,
12.60.36: śūdreṇa tu na hātavyo bhartā kasyāñcidāpadi,
12.60.37: na hi svamasti śūdrasya bhartr̥hāryadhano hi saḥ,
12.60.39: śūdraḥ paijavano nāma sahasrāṇāṁ śataṁ dadau,
12.60.41: daivataṁ hi mahacchraddhā pavitraṁ yajatāṁ ca yat,
daivataṁ hi paraṁ viprāḥ svena svena parasparam ॥41॥
12.60.43: devānāmapi ye devā yad brūyuste paraṁ hitam,
tasmād varṇaiḥ sarvayajñāḥ saṁsr̥jyante na kāmyayā ॥43॥
12.60.44: r̥gyajuḥsāmavit pūjyo nityaṁ syād devavad dvijaḥ,
12.60.45: nāsya yajñakr̥to devā īhante netare janāḥ,
12.60.49: vahniṁ juhoti dharmeṇa śraddhā vai kāraṇaṁ mahat ॥49॥
12.60.50: yat skannamasya tat pūrvaṁ yadaskannaṁ taduttaram,
12.60.52: steno vā yadi vā pāpo yadi vā pāpakr̥ttamaḥ,
yaṣṭumicchati yajñaṁ yaḥ sādhumeva vadanti tam ॥52॥
12.60.54: na hi yajñasamaṁ kiñcit triṣu lokeṣu vidyate,
12.60.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi varṇāśramadharmakathane ṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥60॥
12.61.19: brahmacārī vratī nityaṁ nityaṁ dīkṣāparo vaśī,
paricārya tathā vedaṁ kr̥tyaṁ kurvan vaset sadā ॥19॥
12.61.20: śuśrūṣāṁ satataṁ kurvan guroḥ sampraṇameta ca,
12.61.21: na caratyadhikāreṇa seveta dviṣato na ca,
12.61.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi caturāśramadharmakathane ekaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥61॥
12.62.5: yā sañjñā vihitā loke dāse śuni vr̥ke paśau,
vikarmaṇi sthite vipre saiva sañjñā ca pāṇḍava ॥5॥
12.62.8: yo yasmin kurute karma yādr̥śaṁ yena yatra ca,
12.62.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi varṇāśramadharmakathane dviṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥62॥
12.63.2: sevyaṁ tu brahma ṣaṭkarma gr̥hasthena manīṣiṇā,
12.63.3: kauṭilyaṁ kaulaṭeyaṁ ca kusīdaṁ ca vivarjayet ॥3॥
12.63.10: sadyaḥ sarve cāśramasthā na vai syuḥ ॥10॥
12.63.14: tathā vaiśyasya rājendra rājaputrasya caiva hi ॥14॥
12.63.16: santānādīni karmāṇi kr̥tvā somaṁ niṣevya ca ॥16॥
12.63.17: pālayitvā prajāḥ sarvā dharmeṇa vadatāṁ vara,
12.63.18: saṅgrāme vijayaṁ prāpya tathālpaṁ yadi vā bahu ॥18॥
12.63.19: sthāpayitvā prajāpālaṁ putraṁ rājye ca pāṇḍava,
12.63.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi varṇāśramadharmakathane triṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥63॥
12.64.7: udāhr̥taṁ te rājendra yathā viṣṇuṁ mahaujasam ॥7॥
12.64.12: babhūva rājā rājendra māndhātā nāma vīryavān,
12.64.29: loke bhūtāni sarvāṇi carante nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥29॥
12.64.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi varṇāśramadharmakathane catuḥṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥64॥
12.65.6: svaṁ svaṁ dharmaṁ yena caranti varṇā-
12.65.11: yo vikarmasthito vipro na sa sammānamarhati,
karma svaṁ nopayuñjānamaviśvāsyaṁ hi taṁ viduḥ ॥11॥
12.65.15: madvidhaiśca kathaṁ sthāpyāḥ sarve vai dasyujīvinaḥ ॥15॥
12.65.19: dānāni ca yathākālaṁ dvijebhyo visr̥jet sadā ॥19॥
12.65.27: tadā dharmo na calate sadbhūtaḥ śāśvataḥ paraḥ ॥27॥
12.65.28: na tasya dattaṁ na hutaṁ na śrāddhaṁ phalate kvacit ॥28॥
12.65.31: pravr̥ttasya hi dharmasya buddhyā yaḥ smarate gatim,
sa me mānyaśca pūjyaśca tatra kṣatraṁ pratiṣṭhitam ॥31॥
12.65.34: antarā vilayaṁ yānti yathā pathi vicakṣuṣaḥ ॥34॥
12.65.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi indramāndhātr̥saṁvāde pañcaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥65॥
12.66.1: śrutā me kathitāḥ pūrve catvāro mānavāśramāḥ,
12.66.16: mr̥tyurvā rakṣaṇaṁ veti yasya rājño viniścayaḥ,
12.66.26: yaḥ sthitaḥ puruṣo dharme dhātrā sr̥ṣṭe yathārthavat,
12.66.27: yasminna naśyanti guṇāḥ kaunteya puruṣe sadā,
12.66.28: sthānamānaṁ kule mānaṁ vayomānaṁ tathaiva ca,
12.66.32: ye dharmakuśalā loke dharmaṁ kurvanti bhārata,
12.66.33: dharmārāmān dharmaparān ye na rakṣanti mānavān,
pārthivāḥ puruṣavyāghra teṣāṁ pāpaṁ haranti te ॥33॥
12.66.34: ye cāpyatra sahāyāḥ syuḥ pārthivānāṁ yudhiṣṭhira,
12.66.36: ātmopamastu bhūteṣu yo vai bhavati mānavaḥ,
12.66.38: yadā nivr̥ttaḥ sarvasmāt kāmo yo’sya hr̥di sthitaḥ,
12.66.41: vane caranti ye dharmamāśrameṣu ca bhārata,
12.66.42: eṣa te vividho dharmaḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha kīrtitaḥ,
12.66.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi cāturāśramyavidhau ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥66॥
12.67.1: rāṣṭrasya yat kr̥tyatamaṁ tato brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.67.8: sa cet samanupaśyeta samagraṁ kuśalaṁ bhavet,
12.67.9: bhūyāṁsaṁ labhate kleśaṁ yā gaurbhavati durduhā,
atha yā suduhā rājan naiva tāṁ vitudantyapi ॥9॥
12.67.10: yat svayaṁ namate dāru na tat saṁnāmayantyapi ॥10॥
12.67.11: indrāya sa praṇamate namate yo balīyase ॥11॥
12.67.14: pāpā hyapi tadā kṣemaṁ na labhante kadācana,
ekasya hi dvau harato dvayośca bahavo’pare ॥14॥
12.67.15: adāsaḥ kriyate dāso hriyante ca balāt striyaḥ,
12.67.17: arājakāḥ prajāḥ pūrvaṁ vineśuriti naḥ śrutam,
parasparaṁ bhakṣayanto matsyā iva jale kr̥śān ॥17॥
12.67.21: yaṁ pūjayema sambhūya yaśca naḥ pratipālayet,
12.67.22: bibhemi karmaṇaḥ pāpād rājyaṁ hi bhr̥śadustaram,
12.67.23: tamabruvan prajā mā bhaiḥ kartr̥̄neno gamiṣyati,
12.67.26: sa tvaṁ jātabalo rājā duṣpradharṣaḥ pratāpavān,
sukhe dhāsyasi naḥ sarvān kubera iva nairr̥tān ॥26॥
12.67.27: yaṁ ca dharmaṁ cariṣyanti prajā rājñā surakṣitāḥ,
caturthaṁ tasya dharmasya tvatsaṁsthaṁ vai bhaviṣyati ॥27॥
12.67.28: tena dharmeṇa mahatā sukhaṁ labdhena bhāvitaḥ,
12.67.29: mānaṁ vidhama śatrūṇāṁ jayo’stu tava sarvadā ॥29॥
12.67.30: sa niryayau mahātejā balena mahatā vr̥taḥ,
12.67.31: tasya dr̥ṣṭvā mahattvaṁ te mahendrasyeva devatāḥ,
12.67.32: tato mahīṁ pariyayau parjanya iva vr̥ṣṭimān,
śamayan sarvataḥ pāpān svakarmasu ca yojayan ॥32॥
12.67.33: evaṁ ye bhūtimiccheyuḥ pr̥thivyāṁ mānavāḥ kvacit,
12.67.34: namasyeraṁśca taṁ bhaktyā śiṣyā iva guruṁ sadā,
devā iva ca devendraṁ tatra rājānamantike ॥34॥
12.67.36: tasmācchatraṁ ca patraṁ ca vāsāṁsyābharaṇāni ca ॥36॥
12.67.39: īkṣitaḥ prativīkṣeta mr̥du valgu ca suṣṭhu ca ॥39॥
12.67.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi rāṣṭre rājakaraṇāvaśyakatvakathane saptaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥67॥
12.68.3: rājā vasumanā nāma kausalyo dhīmatāṁ varaḥ,
12.68.6: kena bhūtāni vardhante kṣayaṁ gacchanti kena vā,
12.68.15: na dārā na ca putraḥ syānna dhanaṁ na parigrahaḥ,
viṣvaglopaḥ pravarteta yadi rājā na pālayet ॥15॥
12.68.16: hareyuḥ sahasā pāpā yadi rājā na pālayet ॥16॥
12.68.17: adharmaḥ pragr̥hītaḥ syād yadi rājā na pālayet ॥17॥
12.68.18: kliśnīyurapi hiṁsyurvā yadi rājā na pālayet ॥18॥
12.68.19: mamatvaṁ ca na vindeyuryadi rājā na pālayet ॥19॥
12.68.20: pateyurnarakaṁ ghoraṁ yadi rājā na pālayet ॥20॥
12.68.21: na yonidoṣo varteta na kr̥ṣirna vaṇikpathaḥ,
majjed dharmastrayī na syād yadi rājā na pālayet ॥21॥
12.68.22: na vivāhāḥ samājo vā yadi rājā na pālayet ॥22॥
12.68.23: na vr̥ṣāḥ sampravarteran na mathyeraṁśca gargarāḥ,
ghoṣāḥ praṇāśaṁ gaccheyuryadi rājā na pālayet ॥23॥
12.68.24: kṣaṇena vinaśet sarvaṁ yadi rājā na pālayet ॥24॥
12.68.25: vidhivad dakṣiṇāvanti yadi rājā na pālayet ॥25॥
12.68.26: vidyāsnātā vratasnātā yadi rājā na pālayet ॥26॥
12.68.27: hartā svasthendriyo gacched yadi rājā na pālayet ॥27॥
12.68.28: bhayārtaṁ vidravet sarvaṁ yadi rājā na pālayet ॥28॥
12.68.29: durbhikṣamāviśed rāṣṭraṁ yadi rājā na pālayet ॥29॥
12.68.31: nākruṣṭaṁ sahate kaścit kuto vā hastalāghavam,
yadi rājā na samyag gāṁ rakṣayatyapi dhārmikaḥ ॥31॥
12.68.35: vārtāmūlo hyayaṁ lokastrayyā vai dhāryate sadā,
tat sarvaṁ vartate samyag yadā rakṣati bhūmipaḥ ॥35॥
12.68.36: yadā rājā dhuraṁ śreṣṭhāmādāya vahati prajāḥ,
12.68.37: bhāve ca bhāvo nityaṁ syāt kastaṁ na pratipūjayet ॥37॥
12.68.38: tiṣṭhan priyahite rājña ubhau lokāvimau jayet ॥38॥
12.68.40: na hi jātvavamantavyo manuṣya iti bhūmipaḥ,
12.68.43: kṣemaṁ ca kr̥tvā vrajati tadā bhavati bhāskaraḥ ॥43॥
12.68.44: aśucīṁśca yadā kruddhaḥ kṣiṇoti śataśo narān,
12.68.47: tadā vaiśravaṇo rājā loke bhavati bhūmipaḥ ॥47॥
12.68.49: na hi rājñaḥ pratīpāni kurvan sukhamavāpnuyāt,
putro bhrātā vayasyo vā yadyapyātmasamo bhavet ॥49॥
12.68.50: na tu rājābhipannasya śeṣaṁ kvacana vidyate ॥50॥
12.68.54: rājā bhojo virāṭ samrāṭ kṣatriyo bhūpatirnr̥paḥ,
ya ebhiḥ stūyate śabdaiḥ kastaṁ nārcitumarhati ॥54॥
12.69.1: kathaṁ rakṣyo janapadaḥ kathaṁ jeyāśca śatravaḥ ॥1॥
12.69.2: kathaṁ cāraṁ prayuñjīta varṇān viśvāsayet katham,
kathaṁ bhr̥tyān kathaṁ dārān kathaṁ putrāṁśca bhārata ॥2॥
12.69.4: ātmā jeyaḥ sadā rājñā tato jeyāśca śatravaḥ,
12.69.6: nyaseta gulmān durgeṣu sandhau ca kurunandana,
12.69.7: saṁsthāneṣu ca sarveṣu pureṣu nagareṣu ca,
12.69.9: amātyeṣu ca sarveṣu mitreṣu vividheṣu ca,
12.69.10: yathā na vidyuranyonyaṁ praṇidheyāstathā hi te ॥10॥
12.69.13: cāre hi vidite pūrvaṁ hitaṁ bhavati pāṇḍava ॥13॥
12.69.14: amātyaiḥ saha sammantrya kuryāt sandhiṁ balīyasā ॥14॥
12.69.15: ajñāyamāne hīnatve sandhiṁ kuryāt pareṇa vai,
12.69.19: vyāsaktaṁ ca pramattaṁ ca durbalaṁ ca vicakṣaṇaḥ ॥19॥
12.69.20: pūrvaṁ kr̥tvā vidhānaṁ ca yātrāyāṁ nagare tathā ॥20॥
12.69.21: na ca vaśyo bhavedasya nr̥po yaścātivīryavān,
12.69.24: sāntvena tu pradānena bhedena ca narādhipa,
yadarthaṁ śaknuyāt prāptuṁ tena tuṣyeta paṇḍitaḥ ॥24॥
12.69.27: yathā putrāstathā pautrā draṣṭavyāste na saṁśayaḥ,
12.69.28: śrotuṁ caiva nyased rājā prājñān sarvārthadarśinaḥ,
12.69.29: ākare lavaṇe śulke tare nāgabale tathā,
nyasedamātyān nr̥patiḥ svāptān vā puruṣān hitān ॥29॥
12.69.30: nr̥pasya satataṁ daṇḍaḥ samyag dharmaḥ praśasyate ॥30॥
12.69.32: ete guṇāḥ samastāḥ syurnr̥pasya satataṁ sthirāḥ,
vyavahāralope nr̥pateḥ kutaḥ svargaḥ kuto yaśaḥ ॥32॥
12.69.33: yadā tu pīḍito rājā bhaved rājñā balīyasā,
12.69.38: vināśayed vā tat sarvaṁ balenātha svakena vā ॥38॥
12.69.42: pravr̥ddhānāṁ ca vr̥kṣāṇāṁ śākhāṁ pracchedayet tathā,
12.69.44: teṣāṁ ca dvāravad guptiḥ kāryā sarvātmanā bhavet ॥44॥
12.69.45: dvāreṣu ca gurūṇyeva yantrāṇi sthāpayet sadā,
12.69.47: nirharecca tr̥ṇaṁ māsi caitre vahnibhayāt tathā ॥47॥
12.69.50: mahādaṇḍaśca tasya syād yasyāgnirvai divā bhavet,
12.69.56: tailaṁ vasā madhu ghr̥tamauṣadhāni ca sarvaśaḥ ॥56॥
12.69.59: auṣadhāni ca sarvāṇi mūlāni ca phalāni ca,
12.69.62: dānena ca yathārheṇa sāntvena vividhena ca ॥62॥
12.69.63: nirvedayitvā tu paraṁ hatvā vā kurunandana,
tato’nr̥ṇo bhaved rājā yathā śāstre nidarśitam ॥63॥
12.69.64: rājñā saptaiva rakṣyāṇi tāni caiva nibodha me,
ātmāmātyāśca kośāśca daṇḍo mitrāṇi caiva hi ॥64॥
12.69.66: ṣāḍguṇyaṁ ca trivargaṁ ca trivargaparamaṁ tathā,
yo vetti puruṣavyāghra sa bhuṅkte pr̥thivīmimām ॥66॥
12.69.69: kṣayaḥ sthānaṁ ca vr̥ddhiśca trivargaḥ paramastathā ॥69॥
12.69.71: asminnarthe ca ślokau dvau gītāvaṅgirasā svayam,
12.69.72: kr̥tvā sarvāṇi kāryāṇi samyak sampālya medinīm,
12.69.73: kiṁ tasya tapasā rājñaḥ kiṁ ca tasyādhvarairapi,
12.69.73d2: bhārgavāṅgirasaṁ karma ṣoḍaśāṅgaṁ ca yad balam,
viṣaṁ māyā ca daivaṁ ca pauruṣaṁ cārthasiddhaye.
12.69.73d4: ṣaṭ pañca ca vinirjitya daśa cāṣṭau ca bhūpatiḥ,
12.69.73d5: na buddhiṁ parigr̥hṇīta strīṇāṁ mūrkhajanasya ca,
12.69.73d6: na teṣāṁ śr̥ṇuyād rājā buddhisteṣāṁ parāṅmukhī,
12.69.73d7: vidvāṁsaḥ prathitā ye ca ye cāptāḥ sarvakarmasu.
12.69.73d8: daivaṁ puruṣakāraṁ ca trivargaṁ ca samāśritaḥ.
12.69.73d9: daivatāni ca viprāṁśca praṇamya vijayī bhavet,
12.69.74: kasya kiṁ kurvataḥ siddhyet tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥74॥
12.69.75: śr̥ṇu me śaṁsato rājan yathāvadiha bhārata ॥75॥
12.69.78: svāmye prayatnaṁ kurvanti trayo varṇā yathāvidhi,
12.69.79: kālo vā kāraṇaṁ rājño rājā vā kālakāraṇam,
iti te saṁśayo mā bhūd rājā kālasya kāraṇam ॥79॥
12.69.80: daṇḍanīratyāṁ yadā rājā samyak kārtsnyena vartate,
12.69.81: tataḥ kr̥tayuge dharmo nādharmo vidyate kvacit,
12.69.84: vidhavā na bhavantyatra kr̥paṇo na tu jāyate ॥84॥
12.69.86: nādharmo vidyate tatra dharma eva tu kevalam,
12.69.89: tatastu dvāparaṁ nāma sa kālaḥ sampravartate ॥89॥
12.69.92: kalāvadharmo bhūyiṣṭhaṁ dharmo bhavati na kvacit,
12.69.96: kvacid varṣati parjanyaḥ kvacit sasyaṁ prarohati ॥96॥
12.69.97: rasāḥ sarve kṣayaṁ yānti yadā necchati bhūmipaḥ,
12.69.98: yugasya ca caturthasya rājā bhavati kāraṇam ॥98॥
12.69.101: tato vasati duṣkarmā narake śāśvatīḥ samāḥ,
prajānāṁ kalmaṣe magno’kīrtiṁ pāpaṁ ca vindati ॥101॥
12.69.102: anavāptaṁ ca lipseta labdhaṁ ca paripālayet ॥102॥
12.69.104: yasyāṁ bhavanti bhūtāni tad viddhi manujarṣabha,
eṣa eva paro dharmo yad rājā daṇḍanītimān ॥104॥
12.69.105: tasmāt kauravya dharmeṇa prajāḥ pālaya nītimān,
evaṁ vr̥ttaḥ prajā rakṣan svargaṁ jetāsi durjayam ॥105॥
12.70.3: cared dharmānakaṭuko muñcet snehaṁ na cāstikaḥ,
12.70.6: arthaṁ brūyānna cāsatsu guṇān brūyānna cātmanaḥ,
12.70.7: nāparīkṣya nayed daṇḍaṁ na ca mantraṁ prakāśayet,
12.70.8: striyaḥ seveta nātyarthaṁ mr̥ṣṭaṁ bhuñjīta nāhitam ॥8॥
12.70.10: seveta praṇayaṁ hitvā dakṣaḥ syānna tvakālavit,
12.70.11: praharenna tvavijñāya hatvā śatrūn na śocayet,
12.70.12: evaṁ carasva rājyastho yadi śreya ihecchasi,
12.71.2: samāsenaiva te rājan dharmān vakṣyāmi śāśvatān,
12.71.6: ārjavena ca sampanno dhr̥tyā buddhyā ca bhārata,
12.71.7: na sa dharmaṁ na cāpyarthaṁ pratigr̥hṇāti bāliśaḥ ॥7॥
12.71.8: mā sma lubdhāṁśca mūrkhāṁśca kāmārthe ca prayūyujaḥ,
12.71.11: dāpayitvā karaṁ dharmyaṁ rāṣṭraṁ nītyā yathāvidhi,
12.71.13: dharmārthāvadhruvau tasya yo na śāstraparo bhavet ॥13॥
12.71.14: asthāne cāsya tad vittaṁ sarvameva vinaśyati ॥14॥
12.71.16: ūdhaśchindyāt tu yo dhenvāḥ kṣīrārthī na labhet payaḥ,
12.71.17: yo hi dogdhrīmupāste ca sa nityaṁ vindate payaḥ,
12.71.19: dogdhrī dhānyaṁ hiraṇyaṁ ca mahī rājñā surakṣitā,
nityaṁ svebhyaḥ parebhyaśca tr̥ptā mātā yathā payaḥ ॥19॥
12.71.22: mā sma te brāhmaṇaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā dhanasthaṁ pracalenmanaḥ,
12.71.24: svantaṁ puṇyaṁ yaśo nityaṁ prāpsyase kurunandana ॥24॥
12.71.26: eṣa eva paro dharmo yad rājā rakṣati prajāḥ,
bhūtānāṁ hi yathā dharmo rakṣaṇaṁ paramā dayā ॥26॥
12.71.27: yo rājā rakṣaṇe yukto bhūteṣu kurute dayām ॥27॥
12.71.29: yadahnā kurute dharmaṁ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan,
12.71.33: sa rājyaṁ dhr̥timān prāpya dharmeṇa paripālaya,
indraṁ tarpaya somena kāmaiśca suhr̥do janān ॥33॥
12.72.1: ya eva tu sato rakṣedasataśca nivartayet,
sa eva rājñaḥ kartavyo rājan rājapurohitaḥ ॥1॥
12.72.4: bāhubhyāṁ kṣatriyaḥ sr̥ṣṭa ūrubhyāṁ vaiśya eva ca ॥4॥
12.72.5: varṇaścaturthaḥ paścāt tu padbhyāṁ śūdro vinirmitaḥ ॥5॥
12.72.9: dharmataḥ saha vittena samyag vāyo pracakṣva me ॥9॥
12.72.11: svameva brāhmaṇo bhuṅkte svaṁ vaste svaṁ dadāti ca,
gururhi sarvavarṇānāṁ jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaśca vai dvijaḥ ॥11॥
12.72.12: patyabhāve yathaiva strī devaraṁ kurute patim,
ānantaryāt tathā kṣatraṁ pr̥thivī kurute patim,
eṣa te prathamaḥ kalpa āpadyanyo bhavet tataḥ ॥12॥
12.72.13: yadi svargaṁ paraṁ sthānaṁ svadharmaṁ parimārgasi,
12.72.15: yo rājānaṁ naved buddhyā sarvataḥ paripūrṇayā,
brāhmaṇo hi kule jātaḥ kr̥taprajño vinītavān ॥15॥
12.72.16: rājā carati yad dharmaṁ brāhmaṇena nidarśitam ॥16॥
12.72.19: rāṣṭre caranti yaṁ dharmaṁ rājñā sādhvabhirakṣitāḥ ॥19॥
12.72.20: caturthaṁ tasya dharmasya rājā bhāgaṁ tu vindati,
12.72.23: agnau vāsasi sūrye ca sukhaṁ śīte’dhigacchati,
śabde sparśe rase rūpe gandhe ca ramate manaḥ ॥23॥
12.72.24: teṣu bhogeṣu sarveṣu na bhīto labhate sukham,
abhayasya hi yo dātā tasyaiva sumahat phalam,
na hi prāṇasamaṁ dānaṁ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate ॥24॥
12.72.25: indro rājā yamo rājā dharmo rājā tathaiva ca,
rājā bibharti rūpāṇi rājñā sarvamidaṁ dhr̥tam ॥25॥
12.73.1: rājñā purohitaḥ kāryo bhaved vidvān bahuśrutaḥ,
12.73.2: dharmātmā mantravid yeṣāṁ rājñāṁ rājan purohitaḥ,
rājā caivaṅguṇo yeṣāṁ kuśalaṁ teṣu sarvaśaḥ ॥2॥
12.73.2d2: ucchiṣṭaḥ sa bhaved rājā yasya nāsti purohitaḥ,
śatrūṇāṁ ca bhaved vadhyo yasya nāsti purohitaḥ.
12.73.2d3: brūyāt kāryāṇi satataṁ mahotpātāni yāni ca,
12.73.3: ubhau prajā vardhayato devān sarvān sutān pitr̥̄n,
12.73.9: naiṣāṁ brahma ca vardhate nota putrā
12.73.11: kṣatraṁ vai brahmaṇo yoniryoniḥ kṣatrasya vai dvijāḥ ॥11॥
12.73.14: brahmavr̥kṣo rakṣyamāṇo madhu hema ca varṣati,
12.73.19: svaṁ svaṁ dehaṁ paradehaṁ ca hanti,
12.73.25: yo vai puṇyaṁ carate yaśca pāpam ॥25॥
12.73.26: na tatra mr̥tyurna jarā nota duḥkham ॥26॥
12.73.29: agryo hi brāhmaṇaḥ proktaḥ sarvasyaiveha dharmataḥ ॥29॥
12.73.30: pūrvaṁ hi brahmaṇaḥ sr̥ṣṭiriti brahmavido viduḥ,
12.73.31: sarvaṁ śreṣṭhaṁ viśiṣṭaṁ ca nivedyaṁ tasya dharmataḥ ॥31॥
12.73.32: brahma vardhayati kṣatraṁ kṣatrato brahma vardhate,
evaṁ rājñā viśeṣaṇa pūjyā vai brāhmaṇāḥ sadā ॥32॥
12.73.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi ailakaśyapasaṁvāde trisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥73॥
12.74.1: yogakṣemo hi rājño hi samāyattaḥ purohite ॥1॥
12.74.2: dr̥ṣṭaṁ ca rājā bāhubhyāṁ tad rājyaṁ sukhamedhate ॥2॥
12.74.6: sa hanyamāne sainye sve mucukundo narādhipaḥ,
12.74.9: na caivaṁ samavartanta yathā tvamiha vartase ॥9॥
12.74.15: tathā ca māṁ pravartantaṁ kiṁ garhasyalakādhipa ॥15॥
12.74.19: tato vaiśravaṇo rājā vismayaṁ paramaṁ yayau,
12.74.21: evaṁ yo dharmavid rājā brahmapūrvaṁ pravartate,
12.74.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi mucukundopākhyāne catuḥsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥74॥
12.75.1: puṇyāṁśca lokān jayati tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.75.3: sarvāścaiva prajā nityaṁ rājā dharmeṇa pālayan,
12.75.4: rājñā hi pūjito dharmastataḥ sarvatra pūjyate,
yad yadācarate rājā tat prajānāṁ sma rocate ॥4॥
12.75.5: nihanyāt sarvato dasyūn na kāmāt kasyacit kṣamet ॥5॥
12.75.6: yaṁ hi dharmaṁ carantīha prajā rājñā surakṣitāḥ,
caturthaṁ tasya dharmasya rājā bhārata vindati ॥6॥
12.75.7: rājā caturthabhāk tasya prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ॥7॥
12.75.8: caturthaṁ tasya pāpasya rājā bhārata vindati ॥8॥
12.75.10: tādr̥śāt kilbiṣād rājā śr̥ṇu yena pramucyate,
12.75.11: sarvavarṇaiḥ sadā rakṣyaṁ brahmasvaṁ brāhmaṇā yathā,
na stheyaṁ viṣaye tena yo’pakuryād dvijātiṣu ॥11॥
12.75.12: brahmasve rakṣyamāṇe tu sarvaṁ bhavati rakṣitam,
12.75.14: na hi kāmātmanā rājñā satataṁ kāmabuddhinā,
12.75.15: dharmārthaṁ rocaye rājyaṁ dharmaścātra na vidyate ॥15॥
12.75.16: tadalaṁ mama rājyena yatra dharmo na vidyate,
12.75.19: klībaṁ dharmaghr̥ṇāyuktaṁ na loko bahu manyate ॥19॥
12.75.20: naiva rājñāṁ tathā vr̥ttaṁ yathā tvaṁ sthātumicchasi ॥20॥
12.75.22: na hyetāmāśiṣaṁ pāṇḍurna ca kuntī tvayācata,
12.75.23: śauryaṁ balaṁ ca satyaṁ ca pitā tava sadābravīt,
12.75.24: nityaṁ svāhā svadhā nityaṁ cobhe mānuṣadaivate,
12.75.26: kāle dhuri ca yuktānāṁ vahatāṁ bhāramāhitam,
12.75.27: nirdoṣaḥ karmavacanāt siddhiḥ karmaṇa eva sā ॥27॥
12.75.28: dharmī gr̥hī vā rājā vā brahmacārī yathā punaḥ ॥28॥
12.75.29: alpaṁ hi sārabhūyiṣṭhaṁ yat karmodārameva tat,
12.75.32: yaṁ hi vaidyāḥ kule jātā hyavr̥ttibhayapīḍitāḥ,
12.75.33: kiṁ tāta paramaṁ svargyaṁ kā tataḥ prītiruttamā,
kiṁ tataḥ paramaiśvaryaṁ brūhi me yadi paśyasi ॥33॥
12.75.34: yasmin bhayārditaḥ samyak kṣemaṁ vindatyapi kṣaṇam,
12.75.35: bhava rājā jaya svargaṁ sato rakṣāsato jahi ॥35॥
12.75.36: anu tvāṁ tāta jīvantu suhr̥daḥ sādhubhiḥ saha,
12.76.5: tān sarvān dhārmiko rājā baliṁ viṣṭiṁ ca kārayet ॥5॥
12.76.6d1: gatvā tu brāhmaṇastāṁśca cāṇḍālaḥ pretya ceha ca.
12.76.6d3: brāhmaṇo r̥gyajuḥsāmnāṁ mūḍhaḥ kr̥tvā tu viplavam,
12.76.10: brāhmaṇānāṁ ca ye kecid vikarmasthā bhavantyuta ॥10॥
12.76.12: yasya sma viṣaye rājan steno bhavati vai dvijaḥ,
rājña evāparādhaṁ taṁ manyante tadvido janāḥ ॥12॥
12.76.13: avr̥ttyā yo bhavet steno vedavit snātakastathā,
rājan sa rājñā bhartavya iti vedavido viduḥ ॥13॥
12.76.14: tato nirvāsanīyaḥ syāt tasmād deśāt sabāndhavaḥ ॥14॥
12.77.1: kayā ca vr̥ttyā varteta tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.77.2: brāhmaṇānāṁ ca ye kecid vikarmasthā bhavantyuta ॥2॥
12.77.4: yasya sma viṣaye rājñaḥ steno bhavati vai dvijaḥ,
rājña evāparādhaṁ taṁ manyante kilbiṣaṁ nr̥pa ॥4॥
12.77.8: na me steno janapade na kadaryo na madyapaḥ,
12.77.16: saṁvibhāgaṁ damaṁ śaucaṁ sauhr̥daṁ ca vyapāśritāḥ,
12.77.22d1: kr̥taṁ rājyaṁ mayā sarvaṁ rājyasthenāpi kāryavat,
12.77.24: svāmī sarvasya rāṣṭrasya dhīmān mama purohitaḥ ॥24॥
12.77.28d2: vigrahaśca sadā tasmin deśe bhavati dāruṇaḥ.
12.77.29: tasmāt prāpnuhi kaikeya gr̥haṁ svasti vrajāmyaham ॥29॥
12.77.30: yeṣāṁ gobrāhmaṇaṁ rakṣyaṁ prajā rakṣyāśca kekaya,
na rakṣobhyo bhayaṁ teṣāṁ kuta eva tu pāvakāt ॥30॥
12.77.31: yeṣāṁ purogamā viprā yeṣāṁ brahma paraṁ balam,
12.77.32: tasmād dvijātīn rakṣeta te hi rakṣanti rakṣitāḥ,
12.77.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi kaikeyopākhyāne saptasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥77॥
12.78.1: kathaṁ svid vaiśyadharmeṇa sañjīved brāhmaṇo na vā ॥1॥
12.78.4: vr̥ṣabhān madhumāṁsaṁ ca kr̥tānnaṁ ca yudhiṣṭhira ॥4॥
12.78.5: eteṣāṁ vikrayāt tāta brāhmaṇo narakaṁ vrajet ॥5॥
12.78.9: atra te vartayiṣyāmi yathā dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ,
12.78.10: rucito vartate dharmo na balāt sampravartate ॥10॥
12.78.12: atha tāta yadā sarvāḥ śastramādadate prajāḥ,
12.78.13: rājā trātā tu lokasya kathaṁ ca syāt parāyaṇam,
12.78.17: yadā bhuvi jayī rājā kṣemaṁ rāṣṭre’bhisandadhet,
12.78.18: unmaryāde pravr̥tte tu dasyubhiḥ saṅkare kr̥te,
sarve varṇā na duṣyeyuḥ śastravanto yudhiṣṭhira ॥18॥
12.78.19: atha cet sarvataḥ kṣatraṁ praduṣyed brāhmaṇaṁ prati,
kastasya brāhmaṇastrātā ko dharmaḥ kiṁ parāyaṇam ॥19॥
12.78.20: tapasā brahmacaryeṇa śastreṇa ca balena ca,
amāyayā māyayā ca niyantavyaṁ tadā bhavet ॥20॥
12.78.21: brahmaiva saṁniyantr̥ syāt kṣatraṁ hi brahmasambhavam ॥21॥
12.78.22: teṣāṁ sarvatragaṁ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu śāmyati ॥22॥
12.78.23: kṣatraṁ ca brāhmaṇaṁ dveṣṭi tadā naśyanti te trayaḥ ॥23॥
12.78.26: ye tatra yuddhaṁ kurvanti tyaktvā jīvitamātmanaḥ,
12.78.30: tebhyo namaśca bhadraṁ ca ye śarīrāṇi juhvate,
12.78.33: dharmyāḥ pāpāni kurvāṇā gacchanti paramāṁ gatim ॥33॥
12.78.36: brāhmaṇo yadi vā vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā rājasattama,
dasyubhyo’tha prajā rakṣed daṇḍaṁ dharmeṇa dhārayan ॥36॥
12.78.37: kāryaṁ kuryānna vā kuryāt saṁvāryo vā bhavenna vā,
12.78.38: apāre yo bhavet pāramaplave yaḥ plavo bhavet,
śūdro vā yadi vāpyanyaḥ sarvathā mānamarhati ॥38॥
12.78.41: kiṁ tairye’naḍuho nohyāḥ kiṁ dhenvā vāpyadugdhayā,
12.78.42: yathā dārumayo hastī yathā carmamayo mr̥gaḥ,
yathā hyanarthaḥ ṣaṇḍho vā pārtha kṣetraṁ yathoṣaram ॥42॥
12.78.43: evaṁ vipro’nadhīyāno rājā yaśca na rakṣitā,
megho na varṣate yaśca sarvathā te nirarthakāḥ ॥43॥
12.78.44: sa eva rājā kartavyastena sarvamidaṁ dhr̥tam ॥44॥
12.79.1: kathaṁvidhāśca rājendra tad brūhi vadatāṁ vara ॥1॥
12.79.2: chandaḥ sāmādi vijñāya dvijānāṁ śrutameva ca ॥2॥
12.79.7: idaṁ deyamidaṁ deyaṁ na kvacid vyavatiṣṭhate ॥7॥
12.79.8: ājñā śāstrasya ghoreyaṁ na śaktiṁ samavekṣate ॥8॥
12.79.10: na vedānāṁ paribhavānna śāṭhyena na māyayā,
12.79.13: taṁ ca vikretumicchanti na vr̥thā vr̥ttiriṣyate ॥13॥
12.79.14: tena krītena yajñena tato yajñaḥ pratāyate,
12.79.15: pumān yajñaśca somaśca nyāyavr̥tto yadā bhavet,
anyāyavr̥ttaḥ puruṣo na parasya na cātmanaḥ ॥15॥
12.79.17: tat te tapaḥ pravakṣyāmi vidvaṁstadapi me śr̥ṇu ॥17॥
12.79.18: etat tapo vidurdhīrā na śarīrasya śoṣaṇam ॥18॥
12.79.19: avyavasthā ca sarvatra tad vai nāśanamātmanaḥ ॥19॥
12.79.20: cittiḥ sruk cittamājyaṁ ca pavitraṁ jñānamuttamam ॥20॥
12.80.2: kīdr̥śe viśvased rājā kīdr̥śe na ca viśvaset ॥2॥
12.80.4: dharmātmā pañcamaścāpi mitraṁ naikasya na dvayoḥ,
yato dharmastato vā syād dharmastho vā tato bhavet ॥4॥
12.80.5: yastasyārtho na roceta na taṁ tasya prakāśayet,
12.80.6: caturṇāṁ madhyamau śreṣṭhau nityaṁ śaṅkyau tathāparau,
12.80.7: na hi rājñā pramādo vai kartavyo mitrarakṣaṇe,
12.80.8: ariśca mitraṁ bhavati mitraṁ cāpi praduṣyati ॥8॥
12.80.9: tasmātpradhānaṁ yat kāryaṁ pratyakṣaṁ tat samācaret ॥9॥
12.80.12: tasmād viśvasitavyaṁ ca śaṅkitavyaṁ ca keṣucit,
12.80.16: yastu vr̥ddhyā na tr̥pyeta kṣaye dīnataro bhavet,
12.80.17: tasmin kurvīta viśvāsaṁ yathā pitari vai tathā ॥17॥
12.80.18: nityaṁ kṣatād vārayati yo dharmeṣvapi karmasu ॥18॥
12.80.19: ye tasya kṣatamicchanti te tasya ripavaḥ smr̥tāḥ ॥19॥
12.80.20: vyasanānnityabhīto yaḥ samr̥ddhyā yo na duṣyati,
12.80.21: kulīnaḥ śīlasampannaḥ sa te syāt pratyanantaraḥ ॥21॥
12.80.22: yo mānito’mānito vā na ca duṣyet kadācana ॥22॥
12.80.24: sa te vidyāt paraṁ mantraṁ prakr̥tiṁ cārthadharmayoḥ,
viśvāsaste bhavet tatra yathā pitari vai tathā ॥24॥
12.80.25: naiva dvau na trayaḥ kāryā na mr̥ṣyeran parasparam,
ekārthe hyeva bhūtānāṁ bhedo bhavati sarvadā ॥25॥
12.80.26: kīrtipradhāno yastu syād yaśca syāt samaye sthitaḥ,
samarthān yaśca na dveṣṭi nānarthān kurute ca yaḥ ॥26॥
12.80.27: yo na kāmād bhayāllobhāt krodhād vā dharmamutsr̥jet,
dakṣaḥ paryāptavacanaḥ sa te syāt pratyanantaraḥ ॥27॥
12.80.31: ete karmāṇi kurvanti spardhamānā mithaḥ sadā,
12.80.36: teṣu santi guṇāścaiva nairguṇyaṁ caiva lakṣyate ॥36॥
12.80.38: sammānayet pūjayecca vācā nityaṁ ca karmaṇā,
12.80.39: na hi doṣo guṇo veti nirūpyasteṣu dr̥śyate ॥39॥
12.81.4: sa te sauhr̥damāsthāya kiñcid vakṣyāmi nārada,
12.81.5: ardhaṁ bhoktāsmi bhogānāṁ vāgduruktāni ca kṣame ॥5॥
12.81.6: vācā duruktaṁ devarṣe tanme dahati nityadā ॥6॥
12.81.9: yasya na syurna vai sa syād yasya syuḥ kr̥tsnameva tat,
dvābhyāṁ nivārito nityaṁ vr̥ṇomyekataraṁ na ca ॥9॥
12.81.10: syātāṁ yasyāhukākrūrau kiṁ nu duḥkhataraṁ tataḥ,
yasya cāpi na tau syātāṁ kiṁ nu duḥkhataraṁ tataḥ ॥10॥
12.81.15: arthahetorhi kāmād vā vācā bībhatsayāpi vā,
12.81.18: tacca sidhyet prayatnena kr̥tvā karma suduṣkaram,
mahākṣayaṁ vyayo vā syād vināśo vā punarbhavet ॥18॥
12.81.20: anāyasaṁ mune śastraṁ mr̥du vidyāmahaṁ katham,
12.81.22: girā tvaṁ hr̥dayaṁ vācaṁ śamayasva manāṁsi ca ॥22॥
12.81.24: sarva eva guruṁ bhāramanaḍvān vahate same,
durge pratītaḥ sugavo bhāraṁ vahati durvaham ॥24॥
12.81.25: yathā tvāṁ prāpya notsīdedayaṁ saṅghastathā kuru ॥25॥
12.81.27: jñātīnāmavināśaḥ syād yathā kr̥ṣṇa tathā kuru ॥27॥
12.81.28: āyatyāṁ ca tadātve ca na te’styaviditaṁ prabho,
12.81.30: tvaṁ guruḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ jānīṣe tvaṁ gatāgatam,
12.81.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi vāsudevanāradasaṁvādo nāmaikāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥81॥
12.82.1: yaḥ kaścijjanayedarthaṁ rājñā rakṣyaḥ sadā naraḥ ॥1॥
12.82.2: hriyamāṇamamātyena bhr̥tyo vā yadi vā bhr̥taḥ,
12.82.7: sa kākaṁ pañjare baddhvā viṣayaṁ kṣemadarśinaḥ,
sarvaṁ paryacarad yuktaḥ pravr̥ttyarthī punaḥ punaḥ ॥7॥
12.82.8: adhīdhvaṁ vāyasīṁ vidyāṁ śaṁsanti mama vāyasāḥ,
12.82.9: iti rāṣṭre paripatan bahubhiḥ puruṣaiḥ saha,
12.82.10: sa buddhvā tasya rāṣṭrasya vyavasāyaṁ hi sarvaśaḥ,
12.82.13: asau cāsau ca jānīte rājakośastvayā hr̥taḥ,
12.82.14: na cāsya vacanaṁ kiñcidanr̥taṁ śrūyate kvacit ॥14॥
12.82.16: vāyasaṁ tu vinirbhinnaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bāṇena pañjare,
12.82.21: taṁ rājā pratyuvācedaṁ yat kiñcinmāṁ bhavān vadet,
12.82.22: kariṣyāmi hi te vākyaṁ yadasmānvipra vakṣyasi ॥22॥
12.82.27: naikāntena pramādo hi śakyaḥ kartuṁ mahīpatau,
na tu pramādaḥ kartavyaḥ kathañcid bhūtimicchatā ॥27॥
12.82.28: pramādāddhi skhaled rājā skhalite nāsti jīvitam,
12.82.31: devateva hi sarvārthān kuryād rājā prasāditaḥ,
12.82.32: iti rājan yamaḥ prāha vartate ca tathaiva tat,
12.82.34: na ca me’tra bhavān garhyo na ca yeṣāṁ bhavān priyaḥ,
12.82.35: ye tvādānaparā eva vasanti bhavato gr̥he,
12.82.37: tairhi me sandhito bāṇaḥ kāke nipatitaḥ prabho ॥37॥
12.82.41: agninā tāmasaṁ durgaṁ naubhirāpyaṁ ca gamyate,
12.82.42: neha viśvasintu śakyaṁ bhavatāpi kuto mayā ॥42॥
12.82.43: ato nāyaṁ śūbho vāsastulye sadasatī iha,
vadho hyevātra sukr̥te duṣkr̥te na ca saṁśayaḥ ॥43॥
12.82.44: nyāyato duṣkr̥te ghātaḥ sukr̥te na kathañcana,
neha yuktaṁ sthiraṁ sthātuṁ javenaivāvrajed budhaḥ ॥44॥
12.82.45: sītā nāma nadī rājan plavo yasyāṁ nimajjati,
12.82.46: asatāmiva te bhāvo vartate na satāmiva ॥46॥
12.82.51: tvayā caiva kr̥tā rājan bhavatā paripālitāḥ,
12.82.54: kaccideṣāṁ priyo rājā kaccid rājñaḥ priyā prajāḥ,
12.82.55: tasya me rocate rājan kṣudhitasyeva bhojanam,
amātyā me na rocante vitr̥ṣṇasya yathodakam ॥55॥
12.82.56: bhavato’rthakr̥dityevaṁ mayi doṣo hi taiḥ kr̥taḥ,
vidyate kāraṇaṁ nānyaditi me nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥56॥
12.82.58: pūjito brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha bhūyo vasa gr̥he mama ॥58॥
