12.82.59: ye tvāṁ brāhmaṇa necchanti te na vatsyanti me gr̥he,
12.82.60: yathā syāt sudhr̥to daṇḍo yathā ca sukr̥taṁ kr̥tam,
tathā samīkṣya bhagavan śreyase viniyuṅkṣva mām ॥60॥
12.82.63: vayaṁ tu brāhmaṇā nāma mr̥dudaṇḍāḥ kr̥pālavaḥ,
svasti cecchāma bhavataḥ pareṣāṁ ca yathā’’tmanaḥ ॥63॥
12.82.65: pituḥ sakhā ca bhavataḥ sammataḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ,
vyāpanne bhavato rājye rājan pitari saṁsthite ॥65॥
12.82.66: snehāt tvāṁ tu bravīmyetanmā bhūyo vibhramediti ॥66॥
12.82.67: ubhe dr̥ṣṭvā duḥkhasukhe rājyaṁ prāpya yadr̥cchayā,
12.82.68: tato rājakule nāndī sañjajñe bhūyasā punaḥ,
12.82.70: tathā ca kr̥tavān rājā yathoktaṁ tena bhārata ॥70॥
12.82.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi amātyaparīkṣāyāṁ kālakavr̥kṣīyopākhyāne dvyaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥82॥
12.83.2: śaktāḥ kathayituṁ samyak te tava syuḥ sabhāsadaḥ ॥2॥
12.83.4: kulīnaḥ pūjito nityaṁ na hi śaktiṁ nigūhati ॥4॥
12.83.11: anāryā ye na jānanti samayaṁ mandacetasaḥ,
12.83.12: yastveko bahubhiḥ śreyān kāmaṁ tena gaṇaṁ tyajet ॥12॥
12.83.13: śreyaso lakṣaṇaṁ caitad vikramo yasya dr̥śyate,
kīrtipradhāno yaśca syāt samaye yaśca tiṣṭhati ॥13॥
12.83.14: samarthān pūjayed yaśca nāspardhaiḥ spardhate ca yaḥ,
na ca kāmād bhayāt krodhāllobhād vā dharmamutsr̥jet ॥14॥
12.83.16: śūraḥ kr̥tajñaḥ satyaśca śreyasaḥ pārtha lakṣaṇam ॥16॥
12.83.22: parīkṣya ca guṇān nityaṁ prauḍhabhāvān dhurandharān,
12.83.28: upāyajño’pi nālaṁ sa karma prāpayituṁ ciram ॥28॥
12.83.32: vācā kṣipati saṁrabdhaḥ punaḥ paścāt prasīdati ॥32॥
12.83.36: yo’mitraiḥ saha sambaddho na paurān bahu manyate,
asuhr̥t tādr̥śo jñeyo na mantraṁ śrotumarhati ॥36॥
12.83.37: asuhr̥t krodhano lubdho na mantraṁ śrotumarhati ॥37॥
12.83.38: satkr̥taḥ saṁvibhakto vā na mantraṁ śrotumarhati ॥38॥
12.83.39: satkr̥taḥ sthāpitaḥ so’pi na mantraṁ śrotumarhati ॥39॥
12.83.41: sarvakarmasu yaḥ śuddhaḥ sa mantraṁ śrotumarhati ॥41॥
12.83.43: pitr̥paitāmaho yaḥ syāt sa mantraṁ śrotumarhati ॥43॥
12.83.48: mantriṇāṁ mantramūlaṁ hi rājño rāṣṭraṁ vivardhate ॥48॥
12.83.50: mantragūḍhā hi rājyasya mantriṇo ye manīṣiṇaḥ,
12.83.54: niṣṭhā kr̥tā tena yadā sahaḥ syāt
12.83.56: nāndho jaḍaḥ strī ca napuṁsakaṁ ca,
na cātra tiryak ca puro na paścā-
12.83.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi sabhyādilakṣaṇakathane tryaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥83॥
12.84.5: yo hi nābhāṣate kiñcit sarvadā bhrukuṭīmukhaḥ,
dveṣyo bhavati bhūtānāṁ sa sāntvamiha nācaran ॥5॥
12.84.9: phalaṁ ca janayatyevaṁ na cāsyodvijate janaḥ ॥9॥
12.84.10: sukr̥tasya hi sāntvasya ślakṣṇasya madhurasya ca,
12.84.11: ityuktaḥ kr̥tavān sarvaṁ yathā śakraḥ purodhasā,
12.84.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi indrabr̥haspatisaṁvāde caturaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥84॥
12.85.1: kathaṁ svidiha rājendra pālayan pārthivaḥ prajāḥ,
12.85.2: prāpya dharmaṁ ca kīrtiṁ ca lokānāpnotyubhau śuciḥ ॥2॥
12.85.4: ye caiva pūrvaṁ kathitā guṇāste puruṣaṁ prati,
naikasmin puruṣe hyete vidyanta iti me matiḥ ॥4॥
12.85.7: caturo brāhmaṇān vaidyān pragalbhān snātakān śucīn,
12.85.8: trīṁśca śūdrān vinītāṁśca śucīn karmaṇi pūrvake ॥8॥
12.85.12: tataḥ sampreṣayed rāṣṭre rāṣṭriyāya ca darśayet,
12.85.13: na cāpi gūḍhaṁ dravyaṁ te grāhyaṁ kāryopaghātakam,
kārye khalu vipanne tvāṁ so’dharmastāṁśca pīḍayet ॥13॥
12.85.14: vidraveccaiva rāṣṭraṁ te śyenāt pakṣigaṇā iva,
12.85.18: nātho vai bhūmipo nityamanāthānāṁ nr̥ṇāṁ bhavet ॥18॥
12.85.22: rājño vadhaṁ cikīrṣed yastasya citro vadho bhavet,
12.85.23: yuktasya vā nāstyadharmo dharma eva hi śāśvataḥ ॥23॥
12.85.26: na tu hanyānnr̥po jātu dūtaṁ kasyāñcidāpadi,
12.85.33: putreṣvapi hi rājendra viśvāso na praśasyate ॥33॥
12.85.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi amātyavibhāge pañcāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥85॥
12.86.1: kr̥taṁ vā kārayitvā vā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.86.2: nyāyyaṁ tatra paripraṣṭuṁ vr̥ttiṁ guptiṁ ca bhārata ॥2॥
12.86.5: manuṣyadurgam abdurgaṁ vanadurgaṁ ca tāni ṣaṭ ॥5॥
12.86.11: tatra kośaṁ balaṁ mitraṁ vyavahāraṁ ca vardhayet,
12.86.17: prājñā medhāvino dāntā dakṣāḥ śūrā bahuśrutāḥ,
12.86.19: cāraiḥ suviditaṁ kr̥tvā tataḥ karma prayojayet ॥19॥
12.86.20: carānmantraṁ ca kośaṁ ca daṇḍaṁ caiva viśeṣataḥ,
anutiṣṭhet svayaṁ rājā sarvaṁ hyatra pratiṣṭhitam ॥20॥
12.86.23: prajānāṁ rakṣaṇaṁ kāryaṁ na kāryaṁ dharmabādhakam ॥23॥
12.86.24: yogakṣemaṁ ca vr̥ttiṁ ca nityameva prakalpayet ॥24॥
12.86.29: na cāpyabhīkṣṇaṁ seveta bhr̥śaṁ vā pratipūjayet ॥29॥
12.86.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi durgaparīkṣāyāṁ ṣaḍaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥86॥
12.87.1: rāṣṭraguptiṁ ca me rājan rāṣṭrasyaiva tu saṅgraham,
12.87.2: rāṣṭraguptiṁ ca te samyag rāṣṭrasyaiva tu saṅgraham,
12.87.4: tān brūyād daśapāyāsau sa tu viṁśatipāya vai ॥4॥
12.87.9: teṣāṁ saṅgrāmakr̥tyaṁ syād grāmakr̥tyaṁ ca teṣu yat ॥9॥
12.87.11: bhavet sa tān parikrāmet sarvāneva sabhāsadaḥ ॥11॥
12.87.12: teṣāṁ vr̥ttiṁ pariṇayet kaścid rāṣṭreṣu taccaraḥ,
12.87.14: yogakṣemaṁ ca samprekṣya vaṇijāṁ kārayet karān,
utpattiṁ dānavr̥ttiṁ ca śilpaṁ samprekṣya cāsakr̥t ॥14॥
12.87.15: śilpaṁ prati karānevaṁ śilpinaḥ prati kārayet,
12.87.16: phalaṁ karma ca samprekṣya tataḥ sarvaṁ prakalpayet ॥16॥
12.87.17: phalaṁ karma ca nirhetu na kaścit sampravartate,
yathā rājā ca kartā ca syātāṁ karmaṇi bhāginau ॥17॥
12.87.18: saṁvekṣya tu tathā rājñā praṇeyāḥ satataṁ karāḥ,
12.87.20: pradviṣṭasya kutaḥ śreyo nāpriyo labhate phalam,
12.87.21: bhr̥to vatso jātabalaḥ pīḍāṁ sahati bhārata,
na karma kurute vatso bhr̥śaṁ dugdho yudhiṣṭhira ॥21॥
12.87.22: rāṣṭramapyatidugdhaṁ hi na karma kurute mahat,
12.87.23: āpadarthaṁ ca niryātaṁ dhanaṁ tviha vivardhayet ॥23॥
12.87.24: rāṣṭraṁ ca kośabhūtaṁ syāt kośo veśmagatastathā,
12.87.25: bāhyaṁ janaṁ bhedayitvā bhoktavyo madhyamaḥ sukham,
12.87.30: pratidāsye ca bhavatāṁ sarvaṁ cāhaṁ bhayakṣaye,
12.87.33: na ca priyataraṁ kāryaṁ dhanaṁ kasyāñcidāpadi ॥33॥
12.87.35: yogakṣemaṁ ca samprekṣya gominaḥ kārayet karam ॥35॥
12.87.37: gomināṁ pārtha kartavyaḥ saṁvibhāgaḥ priyāṇi ca ॥37॥
12.87.38: prabhāvayanti rāṣṭraṁ ca vyavahāraṁ kr̥ṣiṁ tathā ॥38॥
12.87.39: tasmād gomiṣu yatnena prītiṁ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ,
12.87.40: na hyataḥ sadr̥śaṁ kiñcid varamasti yudhiṣṭhira ॥40॥
12.87.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi rāṣṭraguptyādikathane saptāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥87॥
12.88.1: kathaṁ pravarteta tadā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.88.2: anuśiṣyāt prajā rājā dharmārthī taddhite rataḥ ॥2॥
12.88.3: yathā tāsāṁ ca manyeta śreya ātmana eva ca,
tathā karmāṇi sarvāṇi rājā rāṣṭreṣu vartayet ॥3॥
12.88.4: madhudohaṁ duhed rāṣṭraṁ bhramarā iva pādapam,
12.88.5: vyāghrīva ca haret putrān sandaśenna ca pīḍayet ॥5॥
12.88.12: na cāsthāne na cākāle karāṁstebhyo nipātayet,
12.88.13: upāyān prabravīmyetān na me māyā vivakṣitā,
12.88.17: sarva eva ime lokā na bhaveyurasaṁśayam ॥17॥
12.88.18: prabhurniyamane rājā ya etān na niyacchati,
bhuṅkte sa tasya pāpasya caturbhāgamiti śrutiḥ ॥18॥
12.88.19: bhoktā tasya tu pāpasya sukr̥tasya yathā tathā,
niyantavyāḥ sadā rājñā pāpā ye syurnarādhipa ॥19॥
12.88.20: kr̥tapāpastvasau rājā ya etān na niyacchati,
12.88.23: āpadyeva tu yācante yeṣāṁ nāsti parigrahaḥ,
12.88.24: mā te rāṣṭre yācanakā bhūvanmā cāpi dasyavaḥ,
eṣāṁ dātāra evaite naite bhūtasya bhāvakāḥ ॥24॥
12.88.25: ye bhūtānyanugr̥hṇanti vardhayanti ca ye prajāḥ,
te te rāṣṭreṣu vartantāṁ mā bhūtānāmabhāvakāḥ ॥25॥
12.88.28: saṁśayaṁ labhate kiñcit tena rājā vigarhyate ॥28॥
12.88.31: prājñaḥ śūro dhanasthaśca svāmī dhārmika eva ca,
12.88.32: tasmāt sarveṣu bhūteṣu prītimān bhava pārthiva,
12.88.33: evaṁ daṇḍaṁ ca kośaṁ ca mitraṁ bhūmiṁ ca lapsyasi,
12.88.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi kośasañcayaprakārakathane aṣṭāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥88॥
12.89.5: asaṁśayaṁ nivarteta na ced vakṣyatyataḥ param,
12.89.7: ūrdhvaṁ caiva trayī vidyā sā bhūtān bhāvayatyuta ॥7॥
12.89.9: śatrūn jaya prajā rakṣa yajasva kratubhirnr̥pa,
12.89.10: saṁrakṣyān pālayed rājā sa rājā rājasattamaḥ,
ye kecit tān na rakṣanti tairartho nāsti kaścana ॥10॥
12.89.12: parān parebhyaḥ svān svebhyaḥ sarvān pālaya nityadā ॥12॥
12.89.13: ātmānaṁ sarvato rakṣan rājan rakṣasva medinīm,
12.89.14: kiṁ chidraṁ ko nu saṅgo me kiṁ vāstyavinipātitam,
kuto māmāśrayed doṣa iti nityaṁ vicintayet ॥14॥
12.89.15: atītadivase vr̥ttaṁ praśaṁsanti na vā punaḥ,
12.89.16: jānīyuryadi te vr̥ttaṁ praśaṁsanti na vā punaḥ,
kaccid rocejjanapade kaccid rāṣṭre ca me yaśaḥ ॥16॥
12.89.17: rāṣṭre tu ye’nujīvanti ye tu rājño’nujīvinaḥ ॥17॥
12.89.18: amātyānāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ madhyasthānāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ,
12.89.19: ekāntena hi sarveṣāṁ na śakyaṁ tāta rocitum,
12.89.20: kathaṁ syādadhikaḥ kaścit sa ca bhuñjīta mānavān ॥20॥
12.89.21: āśīviṣā iva kruddhā bhujaṅgān bhujagā iva ॥21॥
12.89.23: kaccit te vaṇijo rāṣṭre nodvijanti karārditāḥ,
12.89.24: ye vahanti dhuraṁ rājñāṁ te bharantītarānapi ॥24॥
12.89.26: eṣā te rāṣṭravr̥ttiśca rājñāṁ guptiśca bhārata,
12.89.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi rāṣṭraguptau ekonanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥89॥
12.90.2: tat te sarvaṁ pravakṣyāmi nikhilena yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
12.90.3: dharmāya rājā bhavati na kāmakaraṇāya tu,
12.90.4: rājā carati ced dharmaṁ devatvāyaiva kalpate,
12.90.5: dharme tiṣṭhanti bhūtāni dharmo rājani tiṣṭhati,
taṁ rājā sādhu yaḥ śāsti sa rājā pr̥thivīpatiḥ ॥5॥
12.90.6: devāśca garhāṁ gacchanti dharmo nāstīti cocyate ॥6॥
12.90.9: na vai vyavasthā bhavati yadā pāpo na vāryate ॥9॥
12.90.10: naiva bhāryā na paśavo na kṣetraṁ na niveśanam,
12.90.11: devāḥ pūjāṁ na jānanti na svadhāṁ pitarastadā,
na pūjyante hyatithayo yadā pāpo na vāryate ॥11॥
12.90.12: na yajñāṁstanvate viprā yadā pāpo na vāryate ॥12॥
12.90.13: manuṣyāṇāṁ mahārāja yadā pāpo na vāryate ॥13॥
12.90.15: yasmin dharmo virājeta taṁ rājānaṁ pracakṣate,
yasmin vilīyate dharmastaṁ devā vr̥ṣalaṁ viduḥ ॥15॥
12.90.16: vr̥ṣo hī bhagavān dharmo yastasya kurute hyalam,
12.90.17: tasmin hrasati hrīyante tasmād dharmaṁ na lopayet ॥17॥
12.90.18: dhanāt sravati dharmo hi dhāraṇād veti niścayaḥ,
12.90.19: prabhavārthaṁ hi bhūtānāṁ dharmaḥ sr̥ṣṭaḥ svayambhuvā,
12.90.20: sa rājā yaḥ prajāḥ śāsti sādhukr̥t puruṣarṣabha ॥20॥
12.90.22: dharmasya brāhmaṇo yonistasmāt tān pūjayet sadā,
12.90.26: tasmād budhyasva māndhātarmā tvāṁ jahyāt pratāpinī ॥26॥
12.90.27: darpo nāma śriyaḥ putro jajñe’dharmāditi śrutiḥ,
tena devāsurā rājan nītāḥ subahavo vyayam ॥27॥
12.90.28: rājā bhavati taṁ jitvā dāsastena parājitaḥ ॥28॥
12.90.32: atyāgaṁ cābhimānaṁ ca dambhaṁ krodhaṁ ca varjayet ॥32॥
12.90.33: avijñātāsu ca strīṣu klībāsu svairiṇīṣu ca,
12.90.35: ete cānye ca jāyante yadā rājā pramādyati,
12.90.37: aśīte vidyate śītaṁ śīte śītaṁ na vidyate,
12.90.39: arakṣitātmā yo rājā prajāścāpi na rakṣati,
12.90.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi utathyagītāsu navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥90॥
12.91.1: kālavarṣī ca parjanyo dharmacārī ca pārthivaḥ,
sampad yadeṣā bhavati sā bibharti sukhaṁ prajāḥ ॥1॥
12.91.2: yo na jānāti hartuṁ vā vastrāṇāṁ rajako malam,
raktānāṁ vā śodhayituṁ yathā nāsti tathaiva saḥ ॥2॥
12.91.4: brahmacaryaṁ tapo mantrāḥ satyaṁ cāpi dvijātiṣu ॥4॥
12.91.5: teṣāṁ yaḥ kṣatriyo veda vastrāṇāmiva śodhanam,
śīladoṣān vinirhartuṁ sa pitā sa prajāpatiḥ ॥5॥
12.91.6: kr̥taṁ tretā dvāparaṁ ca kaliśca bharatarṣabha,
12.91.7: sarvaṁ pramuhyate hyetad yadā rājā pramādyati ॥7॥
12.91.8: sarva eva pramādyanti yadā rājā pramādyati ॥8॥
12.91.9: rājaiva kartā bhūtānāṁ rājaiva ca vināśakaḥ,
12.91.10: sametya sarve śocanti yadā rājā pramādyati ॥10॥
12.91.12: abalaṁ tu mahadbhūtaṁ yasmin sarvaṁ pratiṣṭhitam ॥12॥
12.91.13: yacca bhūtaṁ sambhajate ye ca bhūtāstadanvayāḥ,
adharmasthe hi nr̥patau sarve śocanti pārthiva ॥13॥
12.91.16: na hi durbaladagdhasya kule kiñcit prarohati,
12.91.19: mā sma tāta raṇe sthitvā bhuñjīthā durbalaṁ janam,
12.91.20: tāni putrān paśūn ghnanti teṣāṁ mithyābhiśaṁsanāt ॥20॥
12.91.21: yadi nātmani putreṣu na cet pautreṣu naptr̥ṣu,
na hi pāpaṁ kr̥taṁ karma sadyaḥ phalati gauriva ॥21॥
12.91.23: yuktā yadā jānapadā bhikṣante brāhmaṇā iva,
12.91.25: kr̥paṇaṁ yācamānānāṁ tad rājño vaiśasaṁ mahat ॥25॥
12.91.29: mantre ca yuddhe ca nr̥po niyuñjyāt,
12.91.30: yaccāpi sukr̥taṁ karma vācaṁ caiva subhāṣitām,
12.91.31: nihanti balinaṁ dr̥ptaṁ sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥31॥
12.91.32: trāyate hi yadā sarvaṁ vācā kāyena karmaṇā,
putrasyāpi na mr̥ṣyecca sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥32॥
12.91.33: tadā bhavanti balinaḥ sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥33॥
12.91.34: yadā jayati saṅgrāme sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥34॥
12.91.35: priyasyāpi na mr̥ṣyeta sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥35॥
12.91.36: bhinatti ca na maryādāṁ sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥36॥
12.91.38: harṣaṁ sañjanayan nr̥̄ṇāṁ sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥38॥
12.91.39: sampūjayati sādhūṁśca sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥39॥
12.91.40: satyaṁ pālayati prītyā nityaṁ bhūmiṁ prayacchati,
pūjayedatithīn bhr̥tyān sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥40॥
12.91.41: asmin loke pare caiva rājā sa prāpnute phalam ॥41॥
12.91.43: yadā samyak pragr̥hṇāti sa rājño dharma ucyate ॥43॥
12.91.45: sa paśyati ca yaṁ dharmaṁ sa dharmaḥ puruṣarṣabha ॥45॥
12.91.46: apramādena śikṣethāḥ kṣamāṁ buddhiṁ dhr̥tiṁ matim,
bhūtānāṁ caiva jijñāsā sādhvasādhu ca sarvadā ॥46॥
12.91.47: saṅgrahaḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ dānaṁ ca madhuraṁ vacaḥ,
12.91.48: na jātvadakṣo nr̥patiḥ prajāḥ śaknoti rakṣitum,
bhāro hi sumahāṁstāta rājyaṁ nāma suduṣkaram ॥48॥
12.91.51: atastvaṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ dharmaṁ vetsyasi vai param,
svadeśe paradeśe vā na te dharmo vinaṅkṣyati ॥51॥
12.91.53: saṅgrahaścaiva bhūtānāṁ dānaṁ ca madhurā ca vāk ॥53॥
12.91.54: apramādaśca śaucaṁ ca rājño bhūtikaraṁ mahat,
12.91.56: etad vr̥ttaṁ vāsavasya yamasya varuṇasya ca,
12.91.58: dharmavr̥ttaṁ hi rājānaṁ pretya ceha ca bhārata,
12.91.60: dharmaṁ kr̥tvā mahīṁ rakṣa svarge sthānamavāpsyasi ॥60॥
12.91.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi utathyagītāsu ekanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥91॥
12.92.1: kathaṁ dharme sthātumicchan rājā varteta dhārmikaḥ,
pr̥cchāmi tvāṁ kuruśreṣṭha tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.92.3: rājā vasumanā nāma jñānavān dhr̥timān śuciḥ,
12.92.4: yena vr̥ttena vai tiṣṭhan na hīyeyaṁ svadharmataḥ ॥4॥
12.92.6: dharme sthitā hi rājāno jayanti pr̥thivīmimām ॥6॥
12.92.7: arthasiddheḥ paraṁ dharmaṁ manyate yo mahīpatiḥ,
vr̥ddhyāṁ ca kurute buddhiṁ sa dharmeṇa virājate ॥7॥
12.92.10: api sarvāṁ mahīṁ labdhvā kṣiprameva vinaśyati ॥10॥
12.92.13: etāni śr̥ṇvam̐llabhate yaśaḥ kīrtiṁ śriyaṁ prajāḥ ॥13॥
12.92.14: arthān samīkṣya bhajate sa dhruvaṁ mahadaśnute ॥14॥
12.92.16: atha pāpakr̥taṁ buddhyā na ca paśyatyabuddhimān,
12.92.18: yasya nāsti gururdharme na cānyānapi pr̥cchati,
12.92.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi vāmadevagītāsu dvinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥92॥
12.93.6: yo na mānayate dveṣāt kṣatradharmādapaiti saḥ ॥6॥
12.93.7: śaktaḥ syāt susukho rājā kuryāt karaṇamāpadi,
priyo bhavati bhūtānāṁ na ca vibhraśyate śriyaḥ ॥7॥
12.93.8: apriyaṁ yasya kurvīta bhūyastasya priyaṁ caret,
nacireṇa priyaḥ sa syād yo’priyaḥ priyamācaret ॥8॥
12.93.9: na kāmānna ca saṁrambhānna dveṣād dharmamutsr̥jet ॥9॥
12.93.9d1: amāyayaiva varteta na ca satyaṁ tyajed budhaḥ,
damaṁ dharmaṁ ca śīlaṁ ca kṣatradharmaṁ prajāhitam.
12.93.10: na tvareta na cāsūyet tathā saṅgr̥hyate paraḥ ॥10॥
12.93.11: priye nātibhr̥śaṁ hr̥ṣyedapriye na ca sañjvaret,
12.93.12: yaḥ priyaṁ kurute nityaṁ guṇato vasudhādhipaḥ,
tasya karmāṇi siddhyanti na ca santyajyate śriyā ॥12॥
12.93.17: kārye mahati yuñjāno hīyate nr̥patiḥ śriyā ॥17॥
12.93.18: rakṣitātmā ca yo rājā rakṣyān yaścānurakṣati,
prajāśca tasya vardhante dhruvaṁ ca mahadaśnute ॥18॥
12.93.22: vikrameṇa mahīṁ labdhvā prajā dharmeṇa pālayet,
12.93.23: tasmād dharme sthito rājā prajā dharmeṇa pālayet ॥23॥
12.93.25: etāni yasya guptāni sa rājā rājasattamaḥ,
12.93.26: teṣu sarvaṁ pratiṣṭhāpya rājā bhuṅkte ciraṁ mahīm ॥26॥
12.93.27: asantyaktamanuṣyaṁ ca taṁ janāḥ kurvate nr̥pam ॥27॥
12.93.28: yastu niḥśreyasaṁ śrutvā jñānaṁ tat pratipadyate,
12.93.30: agrāmyacaritāṁ vr̥ttiṁ yo na seveta nityadā,
12.93.32: mukhyānamātyān yo hitvā nihīnān kurute priyān,
sa vai vyasanamāsādya gādhamārto na vindati ॥32॥
12.93.36: ke vānuraktāḥ rājānaḥ ke bhayāt samupāśritāḥ,
12.93.37: na jātu balavān bhūtvā durbale viśvaset kvacit,
12.93.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi vāmadevagītāsu trinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥93॥
12.94.2: na cāpyalabdhaṁ lipseta mūle nātidr̥ḍhe sati,
na hi durbalamūlasya rājño lābho vidhīyate ॥2॥
12.94.4: alpenāpi sa daṇḍena mahīṁ jayati pārthivaḥ ॥4॥
12.94.4d1: daṇḍo hi balavān yatra tatra sāma prayujyate,
12.94.4d2: trayāṇāṁ viphalaṁ karma yadā paśyeta bhūmipaḥ,
12.94.8: yaḥ samyag vartamāneṣu sveṣu mithyā pravartate ॥8॥
12.94.9: krodhaṁ nihantuṁ yo veda tasya dveṣṭā na vidyate ॥9॥
12.94.12: idaṁ vr̥ttaṁ manuṣyeṣu vartate yo mahīpatiḥ,
12.94.13: ityukto vāmadevena sarvaṁ tat kr̥tavān nr̥paḥ,
tathā kurvaṁstvamapyetau lokau jetā na saṁśayaḥ ॥13॥
12.94.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi vāmadevagītāsu caturnavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥94॥
12.95.1: atha yo vijigīṣeta kṣatriyaḥ kṣatriyaṁ yudhi,
kastasya vijaye dharmo hyetaṁ pr̥ṣṭo vadasva me ॥1॥
12.95.2: brūyādahaṁ vo rājeti rakṣiṣyāmi ca vaḥ sadā ॥2॥
12.95.3: mama dharmabaliṁ datta kiṁ vā māṁ pratipatsyatha,
te cet tamāgataṁ tatra vr̥ṇuyuḥ kuśalaṁ bhavet ॥3॥
12.95.5: aśastraṁ kṣatriyaṁ matvā śastraṁ gr̥hṇād yathāparaḥ,
12.95.6: athaḥ yaḥ kṣatriyo rājā kṣatriyaṁ pratyupāvrajet,
12.95.7: eka ekena vācyaśca visr̥jeti kṣipāmi ca ॥7॥
12.95.8: sa cet sannaddha āgacchet sannaddhavyaṁ tato bhavet,
12.95.9: atha ced dharmato yuddhyed dharmeṇaiva nivārayet ॥9॥
12.95.10: vyasane na prahartavyaṁ na bhītāya jitāya ca ॥10॥
12.95.12: sādhūnāṁ tu mitho bhedāt sādhuśced vyasanī bhavet,
12.95.13: cikitsyaḥ syāt svaviṣaye prāpyo vā svagr̥he bhavet ॥13॥
12.95.14: nirvraṇaśca sa moktavya eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ,
12.95.15: satsu nityaḥ satāṁ dharmastamāsthāya na nāśayet,
12.95.17: dharmeṇa nidhanaṁ śreyo na jayaḥ pāpakarmaṇā,
12.95.18: pāpena karmaṇā vittaṁ labdhvā pāpaḥ prahr̥ṣyati ॥18॥
12.95.19: sa vardhamānaḥ steyena pāpaḥ pāpe prasajjati,
12.95.21: tataḥ samūlo hriyate nadīṁ kūlādiva drumaḥ ॥21॥
12.95.22: tasmād dharmeṇa vijayaṁ kośaṁ lipseta bhūmipaḥ ॥22॥
12.95.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi vijigīṣamāṇavr̥tte pañcanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥95॥
12.96.1: adharmavijayaṁ labdhvā ko nu manyeta bhūmipaḥ ॥1॥
12.96.3: kr̥tāñjaliṁ nyastaśastraṁ gr̥hītvā na hi hiṁsayet ॥3॥
12.96.4: balena vijito yaśca na taṁ yudhyeta bhūmipaḥ,
12.96.6: na tu vadhyadhanaṁ tiṣṭhet pibeyurbrāhmaṇāḥ payaḥ,
12.96.12: sāntvena bhogadānena sa rājñāṁ paramo nayaḥ ॥12॥
12.96.18: pūjārhāḥ pūjitā yasya sa vai lokaviducyate ॥18॥
12.96.19: etenaiva ca vr̥ttena mahīṁ prāpa surottamaḥ,
12.96.20: bhūmivarjaṁ dhanaṁ rājā jitvā rājan mahāhave,
12.96.23: āsan rājñāṁ purāṇānāṁ sarvaṁ tanmama rocate ॥23॥
12.96.24: na māyayā na dambhena ya icched bhūtimātmanaḥ ॥24॥
12.96.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi vijigīṣamāṇavr̥tte ṣaṇṇavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥96॥
12.97.2: atha sma karmaṇā kena lokān jayati pārthivaḥ,
12.97.3: nigraheṇa ca pāpānāṁ sādhūnāṁ saṅgraheṇa ca,
12.97.4: ta eva vijayaṁ prāpya vardhayanti punaḥ prajāḥ ॥4॥
12.97.6: hinasti dhānyaṁ kakṣaṁ ca na ca dhānyaṁ vinaśyati ॥6॥
12.97.7: tasyaiṣāṁ niṣkr̥tiḥ kr̥tsnā bhūtānāṁ bhāvanaṁ punaḥ ॥7॥
12.97.8: yo bhūtāni dhanākrāntyā vadhāt kleśācca rakṣati,
dasyubhyaḥ prāṇadānāt sa dhanadaḥ sukhado virāṭ ॥8॥
12.97.12: tasya śastrāṇi yāvanti tvacaṁ bhindanti saṁyuge,
12.97.14: yāni duḥkhāni sahate kṣatriyo yudhi tāpitaḥ,
tena tena tapo bhūya iti dharmavido viduḥ ॥14॥
12.97.16: pratirūpaṁ janaṁ kuryānna cet tadvartate tathā ॥16॥
12.97.17: yuktaṁ nyāyyaṁ ca kuryuste na ca tad vartate tathā ॥17॥
12.97.20: ye sahāyān raṇe hitvā svastimanto gr̥hān yayuḥ ॥20॥
12.97.24: kṣatriyo nāsya tat karma praśaṁsanti purāvidaḥ ॥24॥
12.97.25: na gr̥he maraṇaṁ tāta kṣatriyāṇāṁ praśasyate,
12.97.26: idaṁ duḥkhaṁ mahat kaṣṭaṁ pāpīya iti niṣṭanan,
12.97.30: sa saṅkhye nidhanaṁ prāpya praśastaṁ lokapūjitam,
12.97.32: yatra yatra hataḥ śūraḥ śatrubhiḥ parivāritaḥ,
akṣayāllam̐bhate lokān yadi dainyaṁ na sevate ॥32॥
12.98.1: bhavanti nidhanaṁ prāpya tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.98.3: ambarīṣo hi nābhāgiḥ svargaṁ gatvā sudurlabham,
12.98.4: uparyupari gacchantaṁ svaṁ vai senāpatiṁ prabhum ॥4॥
12.98.5: r̥ddhiṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sudevasya vismitaḥ prāha vāsavam ॥5॥
12.98.10: āsīd yodhaḥ praśāntātmā so’yaṁ kasmādatīva mām ॥10॥
12.98.11d1: yadanena kr̥taṁ karma pratyakṣaṁ te mahīpate.
12.98.11d2: purā pālayataḥ samyak pr̥thivīṁ dharmato nr̥pa,
12.98.11d4: atha tasmin śubhe kāle tava yajñaṁ vitanvataḥ,
tasya te khalu vighnārtham āgatā rākṣasāstrayaḥ.
12.98.11d6: vihvalāśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ sarve ca tava sainikāḥ,
12.98.11d7: śrutvā teṣāṁ vaco bhūyaḥ sopadhaṁ vasudhādhipa,
12.98.11d10: samprāptaśca sa taṁ deśaṁ yatra bandīkr̥tāḥ prajāḥ,
12.98.11d13: tataḥ senāṁ punaḥ sarvāṁ preṣayāmāsa pārthiva,
12.98.11d14: tato rudraṁ mahādevaṁ prapanno jagataḥ pratim,
12.98.11d16: sapāṇiḥ saha śastreṇa dr̥ṣṭvā cedamuvāca ha,
kimidaṁ sāhasaṁ putra kartukāmo vadasva me,
sa uvāca mahādevaṁ śirasā tvavanīṁ gataḥ.
12.98.11d17: aśakto’haṁ raṇe jetuṁ tasmāt tyakṣyāmi jīvitam.
12.98.11d21: rathaṁ ca sumahābhāgaṁ yena tat tripuraṁ hatam,
dhanuḥ pinākaṁ khaḍgaṁ ca raudramastraṁ ca śaṅkaraḥ.
12.98.11d23: māyayā mohito bhūmau na padaṁ kartumarhasi.
12.98.11d25: rathaṁ sūryasahasrābhaṁ kimu yoddhuṁ tvayā saha,
sa jitvā rākṣasān sarvān kr̥tvā bandīvimokṣaṇam,
ghātayitvā ca tān sarvān bāhuyuddhetvayaṁ hataḥ,
12.98.13: saṁnaddho dīkṣitaḥ sarvo yodhaḥ prāpya camūmukham,
12.98.14: kāni yajñe havīṁṣyasmin kimājyaṁ kā ca dakṣiṇā,
12.98.18: r̥juḥ suniśitaḥ pītaḥ sāyakaśca sruvo mahān ॥18॥
12.98.19: hastihastaharaḥ khaḍgaḥ sphyo bhavet tasya saṁyuge ॥19॥
12.98.21: āvegād yacca rudhiraṁ saṅgrāme sravate bhuvi ॥21॥
12.98.22: chindhi bhindhīti yaḥ śabdaḥ śrūyate vāhinīmukhe ॥22॥
12.98.24: kuñjarāṇāṁ hayānāṁ ca varmiṇāṁ ca samuccayaḥ,
agniḥ śyenacito nāma sa ca yajñe vidhīyate ॥24॥
12.98.25: uttiṣṭhate kabandho’tra sahasre nihate tu yaḥ,
12.98.27: brahmasve hriyamāṇe tu tyaktvā yuddhe priyāṁ tanum ॥27॥
12.98.28: bharturarthe ca yaḥ śūro vikramed vāhinīmukhe ॥28॥
12.98.29: na bhayād vinivarteta tasya lokā yathā mama,
12.98.30: yasya vedirupastīrṇā tasya lokā yathā mama,
yastu nāpekṣate kañcit sahāyaṁ vijaye sthitaḥ ॥30॥
12.98.31: vigāhya vāhinīmadhyaṁ tasya lokā yathā mama,
12.98.40: yastu yodhaḥ parāvr̥ttaḥ santrasto hanyate paraiḥ ॥40॥
12.98.41: apratiṣṭhaḥ sa narakaṁ yāti nāstyatra saṁśayaḥ,
12.98.43: nāyakaṁ tatkumāraṁ vā yo vā syād yatra pūjitaḥ ॥43॥
12.98.44: jīvagrāhaṁ pragr̥hṇāti tasya lokā yathā mama,
āhave tu hataṁ śūraṁ na śoceta kathañcana ॥44॥
12.98.45: aśocyo hi hataḥ śūraḥ svargaloke mahīyate,
na hyannaṁ nodakaṁ tasya na snānaṁ nāpyaśaucakam ॥45॥
12.98.46: hatasya kartumicchanti tasya lokān śr̥ṇuṣva me,
12.98.47: etat tapaśca puṇyaṁ ca dharmaścaiva sanātanaḥ ॥47॥
12.98.48: vr̥ddhabālau na hantavyau na ca strī naiva pr̥ṣṭhataḥ ॥48॥
12.98.49: jambhaṁ vr̥traṁ balaṁ pākaṁ śatamāyaṁ virocanam ॥49॥
12.98.50: durvāryaṁ caiva namuciṁ naikamāyaṁ ca śambaram,
vipracittiṁ ca daiteyaṁ danoḥ putrāṁśca sarvaśaḥ,
12.98.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi indrāmbarīṣasaṁvāde aṣṭanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥98॥
12.99.3: yodhān svān darśayāmāsa svargaṁ narakameva ca ॥3॥
12.99.10: ya evaṁ vyūhate rājā sa nityaṁ jayati dviṣaḥ,
12.99.12: jitāṁ ca bhūmiṁ rakṣeta bhagnān nātyanusārayet ॥12॥
12.99.14: na hi prahartumicchanti śūrāḥ pradravato bhr̥śam,
12.99.18: na hi śauryāt paraṁ kiñcit triṣu lokeṣu vidyate,
śūraḥ sarvaṁ pālayati sarvaṁ śūre pratiṣṭhitam ॥18॥
12.99.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi vijigīṣamāṇavr̥tte navanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥99॥
12.100.1: īṣad dharmaṁ prapīḍyāpi tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.100.2: satyena hi sthito dharma upapattyā tathā pare,
12.100.5: ubhe prajñe veditavye r̥jvī vakrā ca bhārata,
jānan vakrāṁ na seveta pratibādheta cāgatām ॥5॥
12.100.6: tāṁ rājā nikr̥tiṁ jānan yathāmitrān prabādhate ॥6॥
12.100.10: caitryāṁ vā mārgaśīrṣyāṁ vā senāyogaḥ praśasyate ॥10॥
12.100.12: ete hi yogāḥ senāyāḥ praśastāḥ parabādhane ॥12॥
12.100.20: yato vāyuryataḥ sūryo yataḥ śukrastato jayaḥ,
pūrvaṁ pūrvaṁ jyāya eṣāṁ saṁnipāte yudhiṣṭhira ॥20॥
12.100.26: vijayaṁ labhate nityaṁ senāṁ samyak prayojayan,
12.100.29: paricaryāvato dvāre ye ca kecana vargiṇaḥ ॥29॥
12.100.30: anīkaṁ ye vibhindanti bhinnaṁ saṁsthāpayanti ca,
12.100.32: vijayārthaṁ hi saṅgrāme na tyakṣyāmaḥ parasparam ॥32॥
12.100.33: ihaiva te nivartantāṁ ye ca kecana bhīravaḥ,
12.100.34: na saṁnipāte pradaraṁ vadhaṁ vā kuryurīdr̥śāḥ,
ātmānaṁ ca svapakṣaṁ ca pālayan hanti saṁyuge ॥34॥
12.100.37: rāśivardhanamātrāste naiva te pretya no iha ॥37॥
12.100.39: yasya sma saṅgrāmagatā yaśo vai ghnanti śatravaḥ,
12.100.40: jayaṁ jānīta dharmasya mūlaṁ sarvasukhasya ca,
12.100.41: jayanto vadhyamānā vā prāpnuyāma ca sadgatim ॥41॥
12.100.44: api tasmin pure vr̥ddhā bhaveyurye purogamāḥ ॥44॥
12.100.48: samprayukte nikr̥ṣṭe vā satyaṁ vā yadi vānr̥tam,
pragr̥hya bāhun krośeta bhagnā bhagnāḥ pare iti ॥48॥
12.100.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi senānītikathane śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥100॥
12.101.1: kiṁsannāhāḥ kathaṁśastrā janāḥ syuḥ saṅgare kṣamāḥ ॥1॥
12.101.6: prāya eva samuddiṣṭā lakṣaṇāni tu me śr̥ṇu ॥6॥
12.101.19: puraskāryāḥ sadā sainye hanyante ghnanti cāpi ye ॥19॥
12.101.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi vijigīṣamāṇavr̥tte ekādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥101॥
12.102.5: yasyāṁ bhavanti senāyāṁ dhruvaṁ tasyāṁ paro jayaḥ ॥5॥
12.102.14: dhairyaṁ cāviśate yodhān vijayasya mukhaṁ ca tat ॥14॥
12.102.17: jaghanya eṣa vijayo yad yuddhaṁ nāma bhārata,
yādr̥cchiko yudhi jayo daivo veti vicāraṇam ॥17॥
12.102.19: bhagnā ityeva bhajyante vidvāṁso’pi na kāraṇam,
12.102.21: api vā pañca ṣaṭ sapta saṁhatāḥ kr̥taniścayāḥ,
12.102.22: saṁnipāto na mantavyaḥ śakye sati kathañcana,
12.102.24: teṣāṁ syandanti gātrāṇi yodhānāṁ vijayasya ca ॥24॥
12.102.26: teṣāṁ sāntvaṁ krūramiśraṁ praṇetavyaṁ punaḥ punaḥ,
12.102.27: yaśca tasmāt paro rājā tena sandhiḥ praśasyate ॥27॥
12.102.28: na hi tasyānyathā pīḍā śakyā kartuṁ tathāvidhā,
12.102.29: kṣamā vai sādhumāyāti na hyasādhūnkṣamā sadā,
12.102.31: manyate karṣayitvā tu kṣamā sādhvīti śambaraḥ,
asantaptaṁ tu yad dāru pratyeti prakr̥tiṁ punaḥ ॥31॥
12.102.35: na me priyaṁ yannihatāḥ saṅgrāme māmakairnaraiḥ,
na ca kurvanti me vākyamucyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥35॥
12.102.37: kr̥taṁ mamāpriyaṁ tena tenāyaṁ nihato mr̥dhe,
iti vācā badan intr̥̄n pūjayeta rahogataḥ ॥37॥
12.102.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi senānītikathane dvyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥102॥
12.103.1: kathaṁ mr̥dau kathaṁ tīkṣṇe mahāpakṣe ca pārthiva,
12.103.8: krodhaṁ bhayaṁ ca harṣaṁ ca niyamya svayamātmani ॥8॥
12.103.11: tān dvijān kurute vaśyāṁstathā yukto mahīpatiḥ,
12.103.12: na nityaṁ paribhūyārīn sukhaṁ svapiti vāsava,
12.103.13: na saṁnipātaḥ kartavyaḥ sāmānye vijaye sati,
12.103.17: na tvevaṁ khalu saṁsargaṁ rocayedaribhiḥ saha ॥17॥
12.103.19: na sadyo’rīn vihanyācca draṣṭavyo vijayo dhruvaḥ,
na śalyaṁ vā ghaṭayati na vācā kurute vraṇam ॥19॥
12.103.20: prāpte ca praharet kāle na ca saṁvartate punaḥ,
12.103.21: yo hi kālo vyatikrāmet puruṣaṁ kālakāṅkṣiṇam,
12.103.22: akāle sādhayenmitraṁ na ca prāpte prapīḍayet ॥22॥
12.103.23: vihāya kāmaṁ krodhaṁ ca tathāhaṅkārameva ca,
12.103.25: nihatyaitāni catvāri māyāṁ prati vidhāya ca,
12.103.27: aśakyamiti kr̥tvā vā tato’nyaiḥ saṁvidaṁ caret,
12.103.28: bhedaṁ ca prathamaṁ yuñjyāt tūṣṇīṁ daṇḍaṁ tathaiva ca,
12.103.30: amitramapi seveta na ca jātu viśaṅkayet ॥30॥
12.103.31: na ca teṣvāśvased rājā jāgratīha nirākr̥tāḥ ॥31॥
12.103.32: na hyato duṣkaraṁ karma kiñcidasti surottama,
12.103.34: mā tīkṣṇo mā mr̥durbhūstvaṁ tīkṣṇo bhava mr̥durbhava ॥34॥
12.103.36: sāmnā dānena bhedena daṇḍena ca purandara ॥36॥
12.103.45: kathaṁ duṣṭaṁ vijānīyāmetat pr̥ṣṭo vadasva me ॥45॥
12.103.47: tūṣṇīmbhāve’pi vijñeyaṁ na bhed bhavati kāraṇam,
12.103.49: āsane śayane yāne bhāvā lakṣyā viśeṣataḥ ॥49॥
12.103.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi indrabr̥haspatisaṁvāde tryadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥103॥
12.104.1: cyutaḥ kośācca daṇḍācca sukhamicchan kathaṁ caret ॥1॥
12.104.4: artheṣu bhāgī puruṣa īhamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ,
alabdhvā madvidho rājyaṁ brahman kiṁ kartumarhati ॥4॥
12.104.7: tyaktvā prītiṁ ca śokaṁ ca labdhvā buddhimayaṁ vasu ॥7॥
12.104.8: mama hyarthāḥ subahavo naṣṭāḥ svapna ivāgatāḥ ॥8॥
12.104.12: anityaṁ sarvamevaitadahaṁ ca mama cāsti yat ॥12॥
12.104.13: yat kiñcinmanyase’stīti sarvaṁ nāstīti viddhi tat,
evaṁ na vyathate prājñaḥ kr̥cchrāmapyāpadaṁ gataḥ ॥13॥
12.104.14: yaddhi bhūtaṁ bhaviṣyaṁ ca sarvaṁ tanna bhaviṣyati,
12.104.15: yacca pūrvaṁ samāhāre yacca pūrvaṁ pare pare,
sarvaṁ tannāsti te caiva tajjñātvā ko’nusañjvaret ॥15॥
12.104.16: bhūtvā ca na bhavatyetadabhūtvā ca bhaviṣyati,
śoke na hyasti sāmarthyaṁ śokaṁ kuryāt kathañcana ॥16॥
12.104.17: kva nu te’dya pitā rājan kva nu te’dya pitāmahaḥ,
na tvaṁ paśyasi tānadya na tvāṁ paśyanti te’pi ca ॥17॥
12.104.18: buddhyā caivānubuddhyasva dhruvaṁ hi na bhaviṣyasi ॥18॥
12.104.19: ahaṁ ca tvaṁ ca nr̥pate suhr̥daḥ śatravaśca te,
avaśyaṁ na bhaviṣyāmaḥ sarvaṁ ca na bhaviṣyati ॥19॥
12.104.20: ye tu viṁśativarṣā vai triṁśadvarṣāśca mānavāḥ,
arvāgeva hi te sarve mariṣyanti śaracchatāt ॥20॥
12.104.24: na ca tvamiva śocanti tasmāt tvamapi mā śucaḥ,
kiṁ na tvaṁ tairnaraiḥ śreyāṁstulyo vā buddhipauruṣaiḥ ॥24॥
12.104.30: dhātāraṁ garhate nityaṁ labdhārthaśca na mr̥ṣyate ॥30॥
12.104.32: kaccit tvaṁ na tathā rājan matsarī kosalādhipa ॥32॥
12.104.33: sahasva śriyamanyeṣāṁ yadyapi tvayi nāsti sā,
anyatrāpi satīṁ lakṣmīṁ kuśalā bhuñjate sadā ॥33॥
12.104.34: śriyaṁ ca putrapautraṁ ca manuṣyā dharmacāriṇaḥ,
12.104.34d1: tyaktaṁ svāyambhuve vaṁśe śubhena bharatena ca,
12.104.34d2: tyaktvā rājyāni sarve ca vane vanyaphalāśanāḥ.
12.104.34d3: gatāśca tapasaḥ pāraṁ duḥkhasyāntaṁ ca bhūmipāḥ,
12.104.36: tvaṁ punaḥ prājñarūpaḥ san kr̥paṇaṁ paritapyase,
12.104.40d1: anityāṁ tāṁ śriyaṁ matvā śriyaṁ vā kaḥ parīpsati,
12.104.42: na jīvitārthaṁ manyante puruṣā hi dhanādr̥te ॥42॥
12.104.44: sañcaye ca vināśānte maraṇānte ca jīvite,
saṁyoge ca viyogānte ko nu vipraṇayenmanaḥ ॥44॥
12.104.45: dhanaṁ vā puruṣo rājan puruṣaṁ vā punardhanam,
12.104.45d1: tena śāntiṁ na labhate nāhameveti kāraṇāt.
12.104.47: niyaccha yaccha saṁyaccha indriyāṇi mano giram,
12.104.54: daive pratiniviṣṭe ca kiṁ śreyo manyate bhavān ॥54॥
12.104.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi kālakavr̥kṣīye caturadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥104॥
12.105.1: atha cet pauruṣaṁ kiñcit kṣatriyātmani paśyasi,
bravīmi tāṁ tu te nītiṁ rājyasya pratipattaye ॥1॥
12.105.2: tāṁ cecchaknoṣi nirmātuṁ karma caiva kariṣyasi,
śr̥ṇu sarvamaśeṣeṇa yat tvāṁ vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ ॥2॥
12.105.3: rājyaṁ rājyasya mantraṁ vā mahatīṁ vā punaḥ śriyam ॥3॥
12.105.4: athaitad rocate rājan punarbrūhi bravīmi te,
12.105.5: hitvā dambhaṁ ca kāmaṁ ca krodhaṁ harṣaṁ bhayaṁ tathā ॥5॥
12.105.10: pramāṇaṁ sarvabhūteṣu gatvā ca grahaṇaṁ mahat,
12.105.12: alabhyā ye śubhā bhāvāḥ striyaścācchādanāni ca,
12.105.14: na jātu vivr̥taḥ kāryaḥ śatruḥ sunayamicchatā ॥14॥
12.105.18: te tvāṁ pratikariṣyanti taṁ bhokṣyanti vr̥kā iva ॥18॥
12.105.25: ete cānye ca bahavo dambhayogāḥ sucintitāḥ,
12.105.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi kālakavr̥kṣīye pañcādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥105॥
12.106.1: na nikr̥tyā na dambhena brahmannicchāmi jīvitum,
12.106.2: yena māṁ nābhiśaṅketa yena kr̥tsnaṁ hitaṁ bhavet ॥2॥
12.106.5: ubhayoreva vāmarthe yatiṣye tava tasya ca,
12.106.7: yastvaṁ pracyāvito rājyād vyasanaṁ cottamaṁ gataḥ,
12.106.10: nāsmin paśyāmi vr̥jinaṁ sarvato me parīkṣitaḥ ॥10॥
12.106.11: tena te sandhirevāstu viśvasāsmin yathā mayi,
12.106.12: amātyaḥ śūra eva syād buddhisampanna eva vā,
12.106.15: yadyayaṁ pratiyuddhyet tvāṁ svakarma kṣatriyasya tat,
12.106.16: ayudhvaiva niyogānme vaśe kuru hite sthitaḥ ॥16॥
12.106.17: na ca kāmānna ca drohāt svadharmaṁ hātumarhasi ॥17॥
12.106.18: naiva nityaṁ jayastāta naiva nityaṁ parājayaḥ,
12.106.22: yad yad vacanamukto’smi kariṣyāmi ca tat tathā,
etaddhi paramaṁ śreyo na me’trāsti vicāraṇā ॥22॥
12.106.25: nāvamanyāmi te buddhiṁ nāvamanye ca pauruṣam,
12.106.26: yathāvat pūjito rājan gr̥haṁ gantāsi me bhr̥śam,
tataḥ sampūjya tau vipraṁ viśvastau jagmaturgr̥hān ॥26॥
12.106.28: dadau duhitaraṁ cāsmai ratnāni vividhāni ca,
12.106.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi kālakavr̥kṣīye ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥106॥
12.107.1: dharmavr̥ttaṁ ca vittaṁ ca vr̥ttyupāyāḥ phalāni ca ॥1॥
12.107.2: rājñāṁ vittaṁ ca kośaṁ ca kośasañcayanaṁ jayaḥ,
12.107.3: parijñānaṁ ca duṣṭasya lakṣaṇaṁ ca satāmapi ॥3॥
12.107.4: madhyamasya ca tuṣṭyarthaṁ yathā stheyaṁ vivardhatā ॥4॥
12.107.7: yathā gaṇāḥ pravardhante na bhidyante ca bhārata,
12.107.9: yathā ca te na bhidyeraṁstacca me vada pārthiva ॥9॥
12.107.10: gaṇānāṁ ca kulānāṁ ca rājñāṁ bharatasattama,
12.107.14: bhede gaṇā vineśurhi bhinnāstu sujayāḥ paraiḥ,
12.107.18: putrān bhrātr̥̄n nigr̥hṇanto vinayantaśca tān sadā,
12.107.20: mānayantaḥ sadā yuktā vivardhante gaṇā nr̥pa ॥20॥
12.107.22: krodho bhedo bhayaṁ daṇḍaḥ karṣaṇaṁ nigraho vadhaḥ,
12.107.24: na gaṇāḥ kr̥tsnaśo mantraṁ śrotumarhanti bhārata ॥24॥
12.107.29: ābhyantaraṁ bhayaṁ rājan sadyo mūlāni kr̥ntati,
12.107.30: jātyā ca sadr̥śāḥ sarve kulena sadr̥śāstathā ॥30॥
12.107.31: na codyogena buddhyā vā rūpadravyeṇa vā punaḥ,
12.107.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi gaṇavr̥tte saptādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥107॥
12.108.2: kiṁ kāryaṁ sarvadharmāṇāṁ garīyo bhavato matam,
yathāhaṁ paramaṁ dharmamiha ca pretya cāpnuyām ॥2॥
12.108.3: iha yukto naro lokān yaśaśca mahadaśnute ॥3॥
12.108.5: yaṁ ca te’bhyanujānīyuḥ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ ॥5॥
12.108.6: eta eva trayo lokā eta evāśramāstrayaḥ,
eta eva trayo vedā eta eva trayo’gnayaḥ ॥6॥
12.108.8: pitr̥vr̥ttyā tvimaṁ lokaṁ mātr̥vr̥ttyā tathā param ॥8॥
12.108.10: yaśaḥ prāpsyasi bhadraṁ te dharmaṁ ca sumahatphalam,
12.108.11: kīrtiṁ puṇyaṁ yaśo lokān prāpsyase rājasattama ॥11॥
12.108.12: sarve tasyādr̥tā lokā yasyaite traya ādr̥tāḥ,
12.108.13: na cāyaṁ na paro lokastasya caiva parantapa,
12.108.15: tebhya eva hi yat sarvaṁ kr̥tvā ca visr̥jāmyaham,
12.108.17: pitr̥̄n daśa tu mātaikā sarvā vā pr̥thivīmapi ॥17॥
12.108.19: śarīrameva sr̥jataḥ pitā mātā ca bhārata ॥19॥
12.108.20: ācāryaśiṣṭā yā jātiḥ sā divyā sājarāmarā,
avadhyā hi sadā mātā pitā cāpyapakāriṇau ॥20॥
12.108.21: na sanduṣyati tat kr̥tvā na ca te dūṣayanti tam,
12.108.22: taṁ vai manyeta pitaraṁ mātaraṁ ca
12.108.25: yena prīṇāti pitaraṁ tena prītaḥ prajāpatiḥ,
prīṇāti mātaraṁ yena pr̥thivī tena pūjitā ॥25॥
12.108.26: yena prīṇātyupādhyāyaṁ tena syād brahma pūjitam,
12.108.27: r̥ṣayaśca hi devāśca prīyante pitr̥bhiḥ saha,
12.108.28: na ca mātā na ca pitā manyate yādr̥śo guruḥ ॥28॥
12.108.29: na te’vamānamarhanti na teṣāṁ dūṣayet kr̥tam,
12.108.31: bhr̥to vr̥ddho yo na bibharti putraḥ
12.108.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi mātr̥pitr̥gurumāhātmye aṣṭādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥108॥
12.109.1: kathaṁ dharme sthātumicchan naro varteta bhārata,
12.109.3: kiṁsvit satyaṁ kimanr̥taṁ kiṁsvid dharmyaṁ sanātanam,
kasmin kāle vadet satyaṁ kasmin kāle’nr̥taṁ vadet ॥3॥
12.109.4: satyasya vacanaṁ sādhu na satyād vidyate param,
yattu lokeṣu durjñānaṁ tat pravakṣyāmi bhārata ॥4॥
12.109.5: bhavet satyaṁ na vaktavyaṁ vaktavyamanr̥taṁ bhavet,
yatrānr̥taṁ bhavet satyaṁ satyaṁ vāpyanr̥taṁ bhavet ॥5॥
12.109.10: yaḥ syāt prabhavasaṁyuktaḥ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ ॥10॥
12.109.11: yaḥ syād dhāraṇasaṁyuktaḥ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ ॥11॥
12.109.12: yaḥ syādahiṁsāsampr̥ktaḥ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ ॥12॥
12.109.12d3: asmin dharme sthito rājan naro bhadrāṇi paśyati,
12.109.13: na ca tatpratyasūyāmo na hi sarvaṁ vidhīyate ॥13॥
12.109.14: tebhyastu na tadākhyeyaṁ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ ॥14॥
12.109.17: na tebhyo’pi dhanaṁ deyaṁ śakye sati kathañcana,
pāpebhyo hi dhanaṁ dattaṁ dātāramapi pīḍayet ॥17॥
12.109.25: niryajñāstapasā hīnā mā sma taiḥ saha saṅgamaḥ ॥25॥
12.109.26: ayaṁ te rocatāṁ dharma iti vācyaḥ prayatnataḥ ॥26॥
12.109.27: na kaścidasti pāpānāṁ dharma ityeṣa niścayaḥ,
tathāgataṁ ca yo hanyānnāsau pāpena lipyate ॥27॥
12.109.28: svakarmaṇā hataṁ hanti hata eva sa hanyate,
teṣu yaḥ samayaṁ kaścid kurvīta hatabuddhiṣu ॥28॥
12.109.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi satyānr̥takavibhāge navādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥109॥
12.110.3: ye dambhānnācaranti sma yeṣāṁ vr̥ttiśca saṁyatā,
12.110.4: pratyāhurnocyamānā ye na hiṁsanti ca hiṁsitāḥ,
12.110.7: ye vā pāpaṁ na kurvanti karmaṇā manasā girā,
12.110.10: āhaveṣu ca ye śūrāstyaktvā maraṇajaṁ bhayam,
12.110.13: anadhyāyeṣu ye viprāḥ svādhyāyaṁ neha kurvate,
12.110.16: yeṣāṁ na kaścit trasati na trasanti hi kasyacit,
12.110.17: paraśriyā na tapyanti ye santaḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ,
12.110.19: ye na mānitvamicchanti mānayanti ca ye parān,
12.110.20: ye ca śrāddhāni kurvanti tithyāṁ tithyāṁ prajārthinaḥ,
12.110.21: na ca kupyanti bhūtānāṁ durgāṇyatitaranti te ॥21॥
12.110.22: madhu māṁsaṁ ca ye nityaṁ varjayantīha mānavāḥ,
12.110.23: yātrārthaṁ bhojanaṁ yeṣāṁ santānārthaṁ ca maithunam,
12.110.25: suhr̥d bhrātā ca mitraṁ ca sambandhī ca tathācyutaḥ ॥25॥
12.110.27: sthitaḥ priyahite jiṣṇoḥ sa eṣa puruṣottamaḥ,
12.110.28: ya enaṁ saṁśrayantīha bhaktā nārāyaṇaṁ harim,
te tarantīha durgāṇi na cātrāsti vicāraṇā ॥28॥
12.110.29: durgātitaraṇaṁ ye ca paṭhanti śrāvayanti ca,
12.110.30: tarante yena durgāṇi paratreha ca mānavāḥ ॥30॥
12.110.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi durgātitaraṇaṁ nāma daśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥110॥
12.111.3: purikāyāṁ puri purā śrīmatyāṁ pauriko nr̥paḥ,
12.111.5: saṁsmr̥tya pūrvabhūtiṁ ca nirvedaṁ paramaṁ gataḥ,
12.111.8: cālayanti sma tāṁ buddhiṁ vacanaiḥ praśrayottaraiḥ ॥8॥
12.111.10: bhuṅkṣva śaucaṁ parityajya yaddhi bhuktaṁ sadāstu te ॥10॥
12.111.11: iti teṣāṁ vacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca samāhitaḥ,
12.111.12: prārthayāmi ca tatkarma yena vistīryate yaśaḥ ॥12॥
12.111.13: śmaśāne yadi me vāsaḥ samādhirme niśamyatām,
12.111.14: āśrame yo dvijaṁ hanyād gāṁ vā dadyādanāśrame,
kiṁ tu tatpātakaṁ na syāt tadvā dattaṁ vr̥thā bhavet ॥14॥
12.111.15: anubandhe trayo doṣāstān na paśyanti mohitāḥ ॥15॥
12.111.16: iha cāmutra cāniṣṭāṁ tasmād vr̥ttiṁ na rocaye ॥16॥
12.111.17: taṁ śuciṁ paṇḍitaṁ matvā śārdūlaḥ khyātavikramaḥ,
12.111.18: saumya vijñātarūpastvaṁ gaccha yātrāṁ mayā saha,
12.111.19: tīkṣṇā iti vayaṁ khyātā bhavantaṁ jñāpayāmahe,
12.111.20: atha sampūjya tad vākyaṁ mr̥gendrasya mahātmanaḥ,
12.111.25: na kāmaye sukhān bhogānaiśvaryaṁ ca tadāśrayam ॥25॥
12.111.26: na yokṣyati hi me śīlaṁ tava bhr̥tyaiḥ purātanaiḥ,
12.111.31: na tat tiṣṭhati tuṣṭānāṁ vane mūlaphalāśinām ॥31॥
12.111.32: pānīyaṁ vā nirāyāsaṁ svādvannaṁ vā bhayottaram,
vicārya khalu paśyāmi tatsukhaṁ yatra nirvr̥tiḥ ॥32॥
12.111.34: yadi tvetanmayā kāryaṁ mr̥gendra yadi manyase,
12.111.35: madīyā mānanīyāste śrotavyaṁ ca hitaṁ vacaḥ,
kalpitā yā ca me vr̥ttiḥ sā bhavet tvayi susthirā ॥35॥
12.111.36: nītimantaḥ parīpsanto vr̥thā brūyuḥ pare mayi ॥36॥
12.111.37: eka ekena saṅgamya raho brūyāṁ hitaṁ vacaḥ,
na ca te jñātikāryeṣu praṣṭavyo’haṁ hitāhite ॥37॥
12.111.38: mayā sammantrya paścācca na hiṁsyāḥ sacivāstvayā,
madīyānāṁ ca kupito mā tvaṁ daṇḍaṁ nipātayeḥ ॥38॥
12.111.40: taṁ tathā sukr̥taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pūjyamānaṁ svakarmasu,
12.111.41: mitrabuddhyā ca gomāyuṁ sāntvayitvā prasādya ca,
12.111.44: na cāpi sa mahāprājñastasmād dhairyāccacāla ha,
athāsya samayaṁ kr̥tvā vināśāya tathā pare ॥44॥
12.111.45: īpsitaṁ tu mr̥gendrasya māṁsaṁ yat yatra saṁskr̥tam,
apanīya svayaṁ taddhi tairnyastaṁ tasya veśmani ॥45॥
12.111.46: tasya tad viditaṁ sarvaṁ kāraṇārthaṁ ca marṣitam ॥46॥
12.111.51: chidraṁ tu tasya tad dr̥ṣṭvā procuste pūrvamantriṇaḥ ॥51॥
12.111.53: idaṁ tasyedr̥śaṁ karma kiṁ tena na kr̥taṁ bhavet,
śrutaśca svāminā pūrvaṁ yādr̥śo naiva tādr̥śaḥ ॥53॥
12.111.55: yadi vipratyayo hyeṣa tadidaṁ darśayāma te ॥55॥
12.111.56: māṁsāpanayanaṁ jñātvā vyāghraḥ śrutvā ca tadvacaḥ ॥56॥
12.111.60: śucerapi hi yuktasya doṣa eva nipātyate,
12.111.64: necchate dīyamānaṁ ca sādhu tāvad vimr̥śyatām ॥64॥
12.111.66: na caivāsti talaṁ vyomni khadyote na hutāśanaḥ ॥66॥
12.111.68: na duṣkaramidaṁ putra yat prabhurghātayet param,
ślāghanīyā yaśasyā ca loke prabhavatāṁ kṣamā ॥68॥
12.111.71: dharmātmā tena cākhyātaṁ yathaitat kapaṭaṁ kr̥tam ॥71॥
12.111.77: svayaṁ copahr̥tā bhr̥tyā ye cāpyupahitāḥ paraiḥ ॥77॥
12.111.78: hr̥tasvā mānino ye ca tyaktādānā mahepsavaḥ ॥78॥
12.111.80: kathaṁ yāsyasi viśvāsamahaṁ tiṣṭhāmi vā katham ॥80॥
12.111.82: na vācyaṁ tasya vaiguṇyaṁ pratijñāṁ parirakṣatā ॥82॥
12.111.83: evaṁ cāvamatasyeha viśvāsaṁ me na yāsyasi,
12.111.85: duḥkhena śliṣyate bhinnaṁ śliṣṭaṁ duḥkhena bhidyate,
bhinnā śliṣṭā tu yā prītirna sā snehena vartate ॥85॥
12.111.90: gomāyuḥ prāyamāsthāya tyaktvā dehaṁ divaṁ yayau ॥90॥
12.111.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi vyāghragomāyusaṁvāde ekādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥111॥
12.112.1: kiṁ pārthivena kartavyaṁ kiṁ ca kr̥tvā sukhī bhavet,
12.112.2: yathā rājñeha kartavyaṁ yacca kr̥tvā sukhī bhavet ॥2॥
12.112.3: uṣṭrasya tu mahad vr̥ttaṁ tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥3॥
12.112.6: yojanānāṁ śataṁ sāgraṁ gacchāmi carituṁ vibho ॥6॥
12.112.7: pratilabhya varaṁ śreṣṭhaṁ yayāvuṣṭraḥ svakaṁ vanam ॥7॥
12.112.9: sa kadācit prasāryaiva tāṁ grīvāṁ śatayojanām,
12.112.10: sa guhāyāṁ śiro grīvāṁ nidhāya paśurātmanaḥ,
12.112.12: sa dr̥ṣṭvā māṁsajīvī tu subhr̥śaṁ kṣucchramānvitaḥ,
12.112.13: yadā tvabudhyatātmānaṁ bhakṣyamāṇaṁ sa vai paśuḥ,
12.112.14: tāvat tena sadāreṇa jambukena sa bhakṣitaḥ ॥14॥
12.112.15: sa hatvā bhakṣayitvā ca tamuṣṭraṁ jambukastadā,
12.112.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi uṣṭragrīvopākhyāne dvādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥112॥
12.113.2: saritāṁ caiva saṁvādaṁ sāgarasya ca bhārata ॥2॥
12.113.5: avajñayā vā nānītaḥ kiṁ ca vā tena vaḥ kr̥tam ॥5॥
12.113.6: yathā cemāni kūlāni hitvā nāyāti vetasaḥ ॥6॥
12.113.8: te tyajanti tataḥ sthānaṁ prātilomyānna vetasaḥ ॥8॥
12.113.11: oṣadhyaḥ pādapā gulmā na te yānti parābhavam ॥11॥
12.113.12: pūrvaṁ na sahate vegaṁ kṣiprameva vinaśyati ॥12॥
12.113.13: jānan vicarati prājño na sa yāti parābhavam ॥13॥
12.113.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi saritsāgarasaṁvāde trayodaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥113॥
12.114.5: iti saṁślāghate nityaṁ tena pāpena karmaṇā,
12.114.8: prākr̥to hi praśaṁsan vā nindan vā kiṁ kariṣyati,
12.114.9: yadi vāgbhiḥ prayogaḥ syāt prayoge pāpakarmaṇaḥ,
vāgevārtho bhavet tasya na hyevārtho jighāṁsataḥ ॥9॥
12.114.11: yasyāvācyaṁ na loke’sti nākāryaṁ cāpi kiñcana,
12.114.12: pratyakṣaṁ guṇavādī yaḥ parokṣe cāpi nindakaḥ,
12.114.15: parivādaṁ bruvāṇo hi durātmā vai mahājane,
12.114.16: taṁ svakarmāṇi kurvāṇaṁ pratikartuṁ ya icchati,
12.114.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi ṭiṭṭibhakaṁ nāma caturdaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥114॥
12.115.1: sañchettavyastvayā rājan bhavān kulakaro hi naḥ ॥1॥
12.115.3: āyatyāṁ ca tadātve ca kṣemavr̥ddhikaraṁ ca yat ॥3॥
12.115.4: annapāne śarīre ca hitaṁ yattad bravīhi me ॥4॥
12.115.5: abhiṣikto hi yo rājā rāṣṭrastho mitrasaṁvr̥taḥ,
sasuhr̥tsamupeto vā sa kathaṁ rañjayet prajāḥ ॥5॥
12.115.7: tasya bhr̥tyā viguṇatāṁ yānti sarve kulodgatāḥ,
na ca bhr̥tyaphalairarthaiḥ sa rājā samprayujyate ॥7॥
12.115.9: kṣattā caiko mahāprājño yo naḥ śaṁsati sarvadā ॥9॥
12.115.11: kīdr̥śaiḥ kiṁ kulīnairvā saha yātrā vidhīyate ॥11॥
12.115.12: na hyeko bhr̥tyarahito rājā bhavati rakṣitā,
12.115.13: na ca praśāstuṁ rājyaṁ hi śakyamekena bhārata,
12.115.14: labdhuṁ labdhā hyapi sadā rakṣituṁ bharatarṣabha,
12.116.0d1: na santi kulajā yatra sahāyāḥ pārthivasya tu,
12.116.8: dattvā ca te sukhapraśnaṁ sarve yānti yathāgatam,
12.116.13: provāca ivā muniṁ tatra tacchr̥ṇuṣva viśāmpate ॥13॥
12.116.15: tathā kuru mahābāho sarvajñastvaṁ na saṁśayaḥ,
12.116.16: na bhayaṁ dvīpinaḥ kāryaṁ mr̥tyutaste kathañcana,
12.116.18: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sammukhe dvīpī ātmanaḥ sadr̥śaṁ paśum,
12.116.21: sa dvīpī vyāghratāṁ nīto ripūṇāṁ balavattaraḥ ॥21॥
12.116.22: tato dr̥ṣṭvā sa śārdūlo nāhanat taṁ viśāmpate,
sa tu śvā vyāghratāṁ prāpya balavān piśitāśanaḥ ॥22॥
12.116.23: tathaiva sa mahārāja vyāghraḥ samabhavat tadā ॥23॥
12.116.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi śvarṣisaṁvāde ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥116॥
12.117.4: mahāmeghanibhaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sa bhīto hyabhavad gajaḥ ॥4॥
12.117.9: sa tataḥ siṁhatāṁ nīto nāgendro muninā tadā,
12.117.10: dr̥ṣṭvā ca so’bhavat siṁho vanyo bhayasamanvitaḥ,
12.117.13d1: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā śarabhaṁ yāntaṁ siṁhaḥ parabhayāturaḥ,
12.117.14: tataḥ sa śarabho vanyo muneḥ śarabhamagrataḥ ॥14॥
12.117.15: sa evaṁ śarabhasthāne saṁnyasto muninā tadā ॥15॥
12.117.19d1: asya prabhāvāt samprāpto vāṅmātreṇa tu kevalam.
12.117.19d5: na dadāti balaṁ tuṣṭaḥ sattvasyānyasya kasyacit.
12.117.20: vijñāya sa mahāprājño muniḥ śvānaṁ tamuktavān,
12.117.22: tasmāt svayonimāpannaḥ śvaiva tvaṁ hi bhaviṣyasi ॥22॥
12.117.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi śvarṣisaṁvāde saptadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥117॥
12.118.2: ārjavaṁ prakr̥tiṁ satyaṁ śrutaṁ vr̥ttaṁ kulaṁ damam ॥2॥
12.118.3: anukrośaṁ balaṁ vīryaṁ prabhāvaṁ praśrayaṁ kṣamām,
bhr̥tyā ye yatra yogyāḥ syustatra sthāpyāḥ surakṣitāḥ ॥3॥
12.118.8: kr̥tajñaṁ balavantaṁ ca kṣāntaṁ dāntaṁ jitendriyam,
12.118.26d1: naipuṇyaṁ cārthacaryāsu yasyaite tasya sā mahī.
12.118.26d2: yasyaitāni na vidyānte tasyaiva suciraṁ mahī.
12.118.26d3: dharmacaryāḥ sadā yasya tasyeyaṁ suciraṁ mahī.
12.118.26d5: utthānaṁ caiva daivaṁ ca tayornānātvameva ca,
manunā varṇitaṁ pūrvaṁ vakṣye śr̥ṇu tadeva hi.
12.118.27: sarvasaṅgrahaṇe yukto nr̥po bhavati yaḥ sadā,
12.118.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi śvarṣisaṁvāde aṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥118॥
12.119.1: evaṁ guṇayutān bhr̥tyān sve sve sthāne narādhipaḥ,
12.119.5: vyāghro vyāghra iva sthāpyo dvīpī dvīpī yathā tathā ॥5॥
12.119.8: na bāliśā na ca kṣudrā nāprājñā nājitendriyāḥ,
12.119.10: svasthānānapakruṣṭā ye te syū rājñāṁ bahiścarāḥ ॥10॥
12.119.11: siṁhasya satataṁ pārśve siṁha evānugo bhavet,
12.119.12: yastu siṁhaḥ śvabhiḥ kīrṇaḥ siṁhakarmaphale rataḥ,
na sa siṁhaphalaṁ bhoktuṁ śaktaḥ śvabhirupāsitaḥ ॥12॥
12.119.13: kulīnaiḥ saha śakyeta kr̥tsnā jetuṁ vasundharā ॥13॥
12.119.16: kośamūlā hi rājānaḥ kośo vr̥ddhikaro bhavet ॥16॥
12.119.20: eṣā te naiṣṭhikī buddhiḥ prajāsvabhihitā mayā,
śuno nidarśanaṁ tāta kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ॥20॥
12.119.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi śvarṣisaṁvāde ekonaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥119॥
12.120.3: tad yathā rakṣaṇaṁ kuryāt tathā śr̥ṇu mahīpate ॥3॥
12.120.4: tathā bahuvidhaṁ rājā rūpaṁ kurvīta dharmavit ॥4॥
12.120.6: yasminnarthe hitaṁ yat syāt tadvarṇaṁ rūpamādiśet,
bahurūpasya rājño hi sūkṣmo’pyartho na sīdati ॥6॥
12.120.7: nityaṁ rakṣitamantraḥ svād yathā mūkaḥ śaracchikhī,
12.120.10: mr̥jāvān syāt svayūthyeṣu bhaumāni caraṇaiḥ kṣipet,
12.120.15: praṇayed vāpi tāṁ bhūmiṁ praṇaśyed gahane punaḥ,
12.120.21: sa nikr̥ṣṭāṁ kathāṁ prājño yadi buddhyā br̥haspatiḥ,
12.120.23: svakarmaṇi niyuñjīta ye cānye ca balādhikāḥ ॥23॥
12.120.25: mamāyamiti rājā yaḥ sa parvata ivācalaḥ ॥25॥
12.120.32: carān svanucarān vidyāt tathā buddhyā svayaṁ caret ॥32॥
12.120.36: buddhyā tu buddhyedātmānaṁ na cābuddhiṣu viśvaset ॥36॥
12.120.45: vidyā tapo vā vipulaṁ dhanaṁ vā
12.120.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi rājadharmakathane viṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥120॥
12.121.5: ko daṇḍaḥ kīdr̥śo daṇḍaḥ kiṁrūpaḥ kimparāyaṇaḥ,
12.121.7: kaśca vijñāyate pūrvaṁ ko varo daṇḍasañjñitaḥ,
kiṁsaṁsthaśca bhaved daṇḍaḥ kā vāsya gatirucyate ॥7॥
12.121.8: śr̥ṇu kauravya yo daṇḍo vyavahāro yathā ca saḥ,
yasmin hi sarvamāyattaṁ sa daṇḍa iha kevalaḥ ॥8॥
12.121.10: api caitat purā rājan manunā proktamāditaḥ ॥10॥
12.121.11: prajā rakṣati yaḥ samyagdharma eva sa kevalaḥ ॥11॥
12.121.16: etad rūpaṁ bibhartyugraṁ daṇḍo nityaṁ durādharaḥ ॥16॥
12.121.18: daṇḍa eva sa sarvātmā loke carati mūrtimān ॥18॥
12.121.23: daṇḍo hi bhagavān viṣṇurdaṇḍo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ,
śaśvad rūpaṁ mahad bibhranmahān puruṣa ucyate ॥23॥
12.121.28: antaścādiśca madhyaṁ ca kr̥tyānāṁ ca prapañcanam,
madaḥ pramādo darpaśca dambho dhairyaṁ nayānayau ॥28॥
12.121.30: anr̥taṁ jñānitā satyaṁ śraddhāśraddhe tathaiva ca,
12.121.32: asūyā cānasūyā ca dharmādharmau tathaiva ca,
12.121.34: na syād yadīha daṇḍo vai pramatheyuḥ parasparam,
bhayād daṇḍasya nānyonyaṁ ghnanti caiva yudhiṣṭhira ॥34॥
12.121.37: babhūva yajño vedebhyo yajñaḥ prīṇāti devatāḥ ॥37॥
12.121.39: tasmāt prajāḥ pratiṣṭhante daṇḍo jāgarti tāsu ca ॥39॥
12.121.40: rakṣan prajāḥ sa jāgarti nityaṁ svavahito’kṣaraḥ ॥40॥
12.121.41: īśvaraḥ puruṣaḥ prāṇaḥ sattvaṁ cittaṁ prajāpatiḥ,
12.121.43: kulaṁ bahudhanāmātyāḥ prajñā proktā balāni tu,
12.121.46: kośo mitrāṇi dhānyaṁ ca sarvopakaraṇāni ca ॥46॥
12.121.47: rājyasya daṇḍamevāṅgaṁ daṇḍaḥ prabhava eva ca ॥47॥
12.121.48: daṇḍo dattaḥ samānātmā daṇḍo hīdaṁ sanātanam ॥48॥
12.121.49: rājñāṁ pūjyatamo nānyo yathā dharmaḥ pradarśitaḥ,
12.121.50: tasmād yaḥ sa hito dr̥ṣṭo bhartr̥pratyayalakṣaṇaḥ ॥50॥
12.121.52: jñeyo naḥ sa narendrastho daṇḍaḥ pratyaya eva ca ॥52॥
12.121.55: trīn dhārayati lokān vai satyātmā bhūtivardhanaḥ ॥55॥
12.121.56: yaśca daṇḍaḥ sa dr̥ṣṭo no vyavahāraḥ sanātanaḥ,
vyavahāraśca dr̥ṣṭo yaḥ sa veda iti niścitam ॥56॥
12.121.57: yaśca vedaḥ sa vai dharmo yaśca dharmaḥ sa satpathaḥ,
12.121.60: mātā pitā ca bhrātā ca bhāryā caiva purohitaḥ,
nādaṇḍyo vidyate rājño yaḥ svadharme na tiṣṭhati ॥60॥
12.121.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi daṇḍasvarūpādhikathane ekaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥121॥
12.122.1: aṅgeṣu rājā dyutimān vasuhoma iti śrutaḥ ॥1॥
12.122.2: sa rājā dharmavinnityaṁ saha patnyā mahātapāḥ,
12.122.4: muñjapr̥ṣṭha iti proktaḥ sa deśo rudrasevitaḥ ॥4॥
12.122.9: apr̥cchad vasuhomastaṁ rājan kiṁ karavāṇi te ॥9॥
12.122.12: kiṁ cāsya pūrvaṁ jāgarti kiṁ vā paramamucyate ॥12॥
12.122.14: śr̥ṇu rājan yathā daṇḍaḥ sambhūto lokasaṅgrahaḥ,
12.122.15: r̥tvijaṁ nātmanastulyaṁ dadarśeti hi naḥ śrutam ॥15॥
12.122.16: pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu sa garbhaḥ kṣuvato’patat ॥16॥
12.122.18: tasmin pravr̥tte satre tu brahmaṇaḥ pārthivarṣabha,
12.122.19: naiva kāryaṁ na vākāryaṁ bhojyābhojyaṁ na vidyate ॥19॥
12.122.20: gamyāgamyaṁ tadā nāsīt svaṁ parasvaṁ ca vai samam ॥20॥
12.122.23: saṅkaro na bhavedatra yathā tad vai vidhīyatām ॥23॥
12.122.24: tataḥ sa bhagavān dhyātvā ciraṁ śūlavarāyudhaḥ,
12.122.25: sasr̥je daṇḍanītiṁ sā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā ॥25॥
12.122.26: bhūyaḥ sa bhagavān dhyātvā ciraṁ śūlavarāyudhaḥ,
12.122.28: parvatānāṁ patiṁ meruṁ saritāṁ ca mahodadhim ॥28॥
12.122.29: apāṁ rājye’surāṇāṁ ca vidadhe varuṇaṁ prabhum,
12.122.32: vīrudhāmaṁśumantaṁ ca bhūtānāṁ ca prabhuṁ varam,
12.122.36: daṇḍaṁ dharmasya goptāraṁ viṣṇave satkr̥taṁ dadau ॥36॥
12.122.40: vibhajya daṇḍaḥ kartavyo dharmeṇa na yadr̥cchayā,
duṣṭānāṁ nigraho daṇḍo hiraṇyaṁ bāhyataḥ kriyā ॥40॥
12.122.41: vyaṅgatvaṁ va śarīrasya vadho nālpasya kāraṇāt,
12.122.49: r̥ṣibhyo bhagavān somaḥ somād devāḥ sanātanāḥ,
12.122.51: prajā jāgarti loke’smin daṇḍo jāgarti tāsu ca,
12.122.52: jāgarti kālaḥ pūrvaṁ ca madhye cānte ca bhārata,
12.122.52d1: devadevaḥ śivaḥ sarvo jāgarti satataṁ prabhuḥ.
12.122.54: ityeṣa daṇḍo vikhyāta ādau madhye tathāvare,
12.122.55: itīdaṁ vasuhomasya śr̥ṇuyād yo mataṁ naraḥ,
12.122.56: iti te sarvamākhyātaṁ yo daṇḍo manujarṣabha,
12.122.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi daṇḍotpatyupākhyāne dvāviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥122॥
12.123.1: lokayātrā hi kārtsnyena tiṣṭhet keṣu pratiṣṭhitā ॥1॥
12.123.2: anyonyaṁ cānuṣajjante vartante ca pr̥thak pr̥thak ॥2॥
12.123.3: yadā te syuḥ sumanaso loke dharmārthaniścaye,
12.123.6: kāmo ratiphalaścātra sarve te ca rajasvalāḥ ॥6॥
12.123.8: karmaṇā buddhipūrveṇa bhavatyartho na vā punaḥ ॥8॥
12.123.14: taṁ cāpi prathitaṁ loke kathaṁ rājā nivartayet ॥14॥
12.123.17: durācārān yadā rājā praduṣṭān na niyacchati,
12.123.18: taṁ prajā nānuvartante brāhmaṇā na ca sādhavaḥ,
12.123.20: sevitavyā trayī vidyā satkāro brāhmaṇeṣu ca ॥20॥
12.123.25: guravo hi paraṁ dharmaṁ yaṁ brūyustaṁ tathā kuru,
gurūṇāṁ hi prasādād vai śreyaḥ paramavāpsyasi ॥25॥
12.123.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi kāmandakāṅgariṣṭhasaṁvāde trayoviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥123॥
12.124.1: ime janā naraśreṣṭha praśaṁsanti sadā bhuvi,
dharmasya śīlamevādau tato me saṁśayo mahān ॥1॥
12.124.3: kathaṁ tat prāpyate śīlaṁ śrotumicchāmi bhārata,
kiṁlakṣaṇaṁ ca tat proktaṁ brūhi me vadatāṁ vara ॥3॥
12.124.5: sabhāyāṁ cāha vacanaṁ tat sarvaṁ śr̥ṇu bhārata ॥5॥
12.124.12: dr̥ṣṭvā ca tāṁ sabhāṁ divyāṁ divyapuṣpaphalānvitām,
12.124.14: yadīcchasi śriyaṁ tāta yādr̥śī sā yudhiṣṭhire,
viśiṣṭāṁ vā naravyāghra śīlavān bhava putraka ॥14॥
12.124.15: śīlena hi trayo lokāḥ śakyā jetuṁ na saṁśayaḥ,
na hi kiñcidasādhyaṁ vai loke śīlavatāṁ bhavet ॥15॥
12.124.17: ete hi pārthivāḥ sarve śīlavanto dayānvitāḥ,
12.124.18: kathaṁ tat prāpyate śīlaṁ śrotumicchāmi bhārata,
yena śīlena taiḥ prāptā kṣiprameva vasundharā ॥18॥
12.124.20: śīlamāśritya daityena trailokyaṁ ca vaśe kr̥tam ॥20॥
12.124.23: indrastu bhūyaḥ papraccha ko viśeṣo bhavediti ॥23॥
12.124.24: atrāgamaya bhadraṁ te bhūya eva surarṣabha ॥24॥
12.124.28: sa tato brāhmaṇo bhūtvā prahrādaṁ pākaśāsanaḥ,
gatvā provāca medhāvī śreya icchāmi veditum ॥28॥
12.124.30: brāhmaṇastvabravīd rājan yasmin kāle kṣaṇo bhavet,
12.124.31: tathetyuktvā śubhe kāle jñānatattvaṁ dadau tadā ॥31॥
12.124.33: trailokyarājyaṁ dharmajña kāraṇaṁ tad bravīhi me,
12.124.34: kāvyāni vadatāṁ teṣāṁ saṁyacchāmi vahāmi ca ॥34॥
12.124.35: te viśrabdhāḥ prabhāṣante saṁyacchanti ca māṁ sadā,
12.124.40: varaṁ vr̥ṇīṣva bhadraṁ te pradātāsmi na saṁśayaḥ ॥40॥
12.124.41: kr̥tamityeva daityendramuvāca sa ca vai dvijaḥ,
12.124.42: yadi rājan prasannastvaṁ mama cedicchasi priyam,
12.124.45: datte vare gate vipre cintā’’sīnmahatī tadā,
prahrādasya mahārāja niścayaṁ na ca jagmivān ॥45॥
12.124.47: pratyāhataṁ tu śīlo’smi tyakto gacchāmyahaṁ tvayā ॥47॥
12.124.49: ityuktvāntarhitaṁ tad vai śakraṁ cānvāviśat prabho,
12.124.50: dharmaṁ prahrāda māṁ viddhi yatrāsau dvijasattamaḥ ॥50॥
12.124.51: tatra yāsyāmi daityendra yataḥ śīlaṁ tato hyaham,
12.124.52: ko bhavāniti pr̥ṣṭaśca tamāha sa mahādyutiḥ ॥52॥
12.124.54: vr̥ttaṁ prahrāda māṁ viddhi yataḥ satyaṁ tato hyaham ॥54॥
12.124.55: tasmin gate mahāśabdaḥ śarīrāt tasya niryayau,
pr̥ṣṭaścāha balaṁ viddhi yato vr̥ttamahaṁ tataḥ ॥55॥
12.124.56: ityuktvā prayayau tatra yato vr̥ttaṁ narādhipa,
tataḥ prabhāmayī devī śarīrāt tasya niryayau ॥56॥
12.124.58: tvayā tyaktā gamiṣyāmi balaṁ hyanugatā hyaham,
12.124.59: apr̥cchat sa tato bhūyaḥ kva yāsi kamalālaye,
tvaṁ hi satyavratā devī lokasya parameśvarī,
12.124.60: trailokye te yadaiśvaryaṁ tat tenāpahr̥taṁ prabho ॥60॥
12.124.61: śīlena hi trayo lokāstvayā dharmajña nirjitāḥ,
tadvijñāya surendreṇa tava śīlaṁ hr̥taṁ prabho ॥61॥
12.124.62: dharmaḥ satyaṁ tathā vr̥ttaṁ balaṁ caiva tathāpyaham,
12.124.63: evamuktvā gatā śrīstu te ca sarve yudhiṣṭhira,
12.124.64: prāpyate ca yathā śīlaṁ taṁ copāyaṁ vadasva me ॥64॥
12.124.65: saṅkṣepeṇa tu śīlasya śr̥ṇu prāptiṁ nareśvara ॥65॥
12.124.67: yadanyeṣāṁ hitaṁ na syādātmanaḥ karma pauruṣam,
apatrapeta vā yena na tat kuryāt kathañcana ॥67॥
12.124.68: tattu karma tathā kuryād yena ślāghyeta saṁsadi,
12.124.69: na bhuñjate ciraṁ tāta samūlāśca na santi te ॥69॥
12.124.70: etad viditvā tattvena śīlavān bhava putraka,
12.124.71: etat kuruṣva kaunteya tataḥ prāpsyasi tat phalam ॥71॥
12.124.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi śīlavarṇanaṁ nāma caturviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥124॥
12.125.1: śīlaṁ pradhānaṁ puruṣe kathitaṁ te pitāmaha,
kathaṁ tvāśā samutpannā yā cāśā tad vadasva me ॥1॥
12.125.2: chettā ca tasya nānyo’sti tvattaḥ parapurañjaya ॥2॥
12.125.3: prāpte yuddhe tu tad yuktaṁ tat kartāyamiti prabho ॥3॥
12.125.8: atra te vartayiṣyāmi yudhiṣṭhira nibodha tat,
12.125.10: sa ca rājā balāt tūrṇaṁ sasāra mr̥gayūthapam ॥10॥
12.125.11: tato nimnaṁ sthalaṁ caiva sa mr̥go’dravadāśugaḥ,
12.125.12: tataḥ sa rājā tāruṇyādaurasena balena ca,
12.125.13: tato nadān nadīścaiva palvalāni vanāni ca,
12.125.14: sa tu kāmānmr̥go rājannāsādyāsādya taṁ nr̥pam,
12.125.17: samādāya śaraṁ śreṣṭhaṁ kārmuke tu tathāsr̥jat ॥17॥
12.125.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi r̥ṣabhagītāsu pañcaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥125॥
12.126.2: taṁ kārmukadharaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā śramārtaṁ kṣudhitaṁ tadā,
12.126.4: te tasya rājño vacanaṁ sampragr̥hya tapodhanāḥ,
12.126.6: kasmin kule tu jātastvaṁ kiṁnāmā cāsi brūhi naḥ ॥6॥
12.126.7: tataḥ sa rājā sarvebhyo dvijebhyaḥ puruṣarṣabha,
12.126.9: mr̥gastu viddho bāṇena mayā sarati śalyavān ॥9॥
12.126.11: kiṁ nu duḥkhamato’nyad vai yadahaṁ śramakarśitaḥ,
12.126.12: duḥkhaṁ karoti tat tīvraṁ yathā’’śā vihatā mama ॥12॥
12.126.13: himavān vā mahāśailaḥ samudro vā mahodadhiḥ,
12.126.14: bhavatāṁ viditaṁ sarvaṁ sarvajñā hi tapodhanāḥ ॥14॥
12.126.16: kiṁ nu jyāyastaraṁ loke mahattvāt pratibhāti vaḥ,
12.126.17: yadi guhyaṁ na vo nityaṁ tadā prabrūta mā ciram,
12.126.18: bhavat tapovighāto vā yadi syād virame tataḥ,
yadi vāsti kathāyogo yo’yaṁ praśno mayeritaḥ ॥18॥
12.126.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi r̥ṣabhagītāsu ṣaḍviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥126॥
12.127.3: yatra sā badarī ramyā hrado vaihāyasastathā,
yatra cāśvaśirā rājan vedān paṭhati śāśvatān ॥3॥
12.127.4: tasmin sarasi kr̥tvāhaṁ vidhivat tarpaṇaṁ purā,
12.127.7: kr̥śatā cāpi rājarṣe na dr̥ṣṭā tādr̥śī kvacit ॥7॥
12.127.9: śiraḥ kāyānurūpaṁ ca karṇau netre tathaiva ca,
tasya vākcaiva ceṣṭā ca sāmānye rājasattama ॥9॥
12.127.10: dr̥ṣṭvāhaṁ taṁ kr̥śa vipraṁ bhītaḥ paramadurmanāḥ,
12.127.11: nivedya nāmagotre ca pitaraṁ ca nararṣabha,
12.127.15: iha drakṣyāmi taṁ putraṁ drakṣyāmīheti pārthivaḥ,
12.127.16: durlabhaḥ sa mayā draṣṭuṁ nūnaṁ paramadhārmikaḥ,
ekaḥ putro mahāraṇye naṣṭa ityasakr̥t tadā ॥16॥
12.127.17: durlabhaḥ sa mayā draṣṭumāśā ca mahatī mama,
12.127.20: durlabhaṁ kiṁ nu devarṣem āśāyāścaiva kiṁ mahat,
bravītu bhagavānetad yadi guhyaṁ na te mayi ॥20॥
12.127.22: arthayan kalaśaṁ rājan kāñcanaṁ valkalāni ca,
12.127.24: arghyaṁ tataḥ samānīya pādyaṁ caiva mahānr̥ṣiḥ,
12.127.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi r̥ṣabhagītāsu saptaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥127॥
12.128.1: vīradyumna iti khyāto rājāhaṁ dikṣu viśrutaḥ,
12.128.2: ekaḥ putraḥ sa viprāgrya bāla eva ca me’nagha,
12.128.3: tūṣṇīmevābhavat tatra na ca pratyuktavān nr̥pam ॥3॥
12.128.4: sa hi tena purā vipro rājñā nātyarthamānitaḥ,
12.128.5: anyeṣāṁ caiva varṇānāmiti kr̥tvā dhiyaṁ tadā ॥5॥
12.128.7: āśāyāḥ kiṁ kr̥śatvaṁ ca kiṁ ceha bhuvi durlabham,
12.128.9: tasyā vai durlabhatvācca prārthitāḥ pārthivā mayā ॥9॥
12.128.10: kr̥śākr̥śe mayā bahman gr̥hīte vacanāt tava,
12.128.12: tvattaḥ kr̥śataraṁ kiṁ nu bravītu bhagavānidam,
yadi guhyaṁ na te kiñcid vidyate munisattama ॥12॥
12.128.14: yā saktā sarvabhūteṣu sā’’śā kr̥śatarī mayā ॥14॥
12.128.15: kr̥taghneṣu ca yā saktā nr̥śaṁseṣvalaseṣu ca,
12.128.16: ekaputraḥ pitā putre naṣṭe vā proṣite’pi vā,
pravr̥ttiṁ yo na jānāti sā’’śā kr̥śatarī mayā ॥16॥
12.128.17: tathā narendra dhanināṁ sā’’śā kr̥śatarī mayā ॥17॥
12.128.19: etacchrutvā tato rājan sa rājā sāvarodhanaḥ,
12.128.22: putramasyānayat kṣipraṁ tapasā ca śrutena ca,
12.128.24: etad dr̥ṣṭaṁ mayā rājaṁstathā ca vacanaṁ śrutam,
12.128.26: evaṁ tvamapi kaunteya śrutvā vāṇīmimāṁ mama,
12.128.27: tvaṁ hi praṣṭā ca śrotā ca kr̥cchreṣvanugateṣviha,
12.128.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi r̥ṣabhagītāsu aṣṭāviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥128॥
12.129.2: na hi tr̥ptimahaṁ yāmi piban dharmāmr̥taṁ hi te ॥2॥
12.129.3: gautamasya ca saṁvādaṁ yamasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥3॥
12.129.4: uvāsa gautamo yaṁ ca kālaṁ tamapi me śr̥ṇu ॥4॥
12.129.9: kathaṁ ca lokānāpnoti puruṣo durlabhān śucīn ॥9॥
12.129.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi rājadharmānuśāsanaparvaṇi yamagautamasaṁvāde ekonatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥129॥
12.130.4: aprāpyaṁ ca bhavet sāntvaṁ bhedo vāpyatipīḍanāt,
jīvitaṁ tvarthaheturvā tatra kiṁ sukr̥taṁ bhavet ॥4॥
12.130.7: karmaṇā buddhipūrveṇa bhavatyāḍhyo na vā punaḥ,
12.130.9: duḥkhādāna iha hyeṣa syāt tu paścāt kṣayopamaḥ,
12.130.10: yathā yathā hi puruṣo nityaṁ śāstramavekṣate,
12.130.13: kośaṁ ca janayed rājā nirjalebhyo yathā jalam,
12.130.15: dharmaṁ prāpya nyāyavr̥ttiṁ na balīyān na vindati,
12.130.16: adharmo jāyate tasminniti vai kavayo viduḥ ॥16॥
12.130.18: sarvātmanaiva dharmasya na parasya na cātmanaḥ,
12.130.23: bhaikṣyacaryā na vihitā na ca viṭ śūdrajīvikā ॥23॥
12.130.27: hantāraṁ rakṣitāraṁ ca prajānāṁ kṣatriyaṁ viduḥ,
12.130.30: parasparaṁ hi saṁrakṣā rājñā rāṣṭreṇa cāpadi,
nityameva hi kartavyā eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥30॥
12.130.32: kośaṁ daṇḍaṁ balaṁ mitraṁ yadanyadapi sañcitam,
na kurvītāntaraṁ rāṣṭre rājā parigataḥ kṣudhā ॥32॥
12.130.34: dhik tasya jīvitaṁ rājño rāṣṭraṁ yasyāvasīdati,
12.130.36: tadarthaṁ pīḍayitvā ca doṣaṁ prāptuṁ na so’rhati ॥36॥
12.130.37: etasmāt kāraṇād rājā na doṣaṁ prāptamarhati ॥37॥
12.130.40: yūpaṁ chindanti yajñārthaṁ tatra ye paripanthinaḥ ॥40॥
12.130.41: drumāḥ kecana sāmantā dhruvaṁ chindanti tānapi,
12.130.42: evaṁ kośasya mahato ye narāḥ paripanthinaḥ,
12.130.47: na ca rājyasamo dharmaḥ kaścidasti parantapa,
12.130.49: sarvaṁ dhanavatā prāpyaṁ sarvaṁ tarati kośavān ॥49॥
12.130.50: taṁ ca dharmeṇa lipseta nādharmeṇa kadācana ॥50॥
12.131.6: apāsya rājadhānīṁ vā tared dravyeṇa cāpadam,
12.131.8: na tvevātmā pradātavyaḥ śakye sati kathañcana ॥8॥
12.131.9: kṣīṇe kośe śrute mantre kiṁ kāryamavaśiṣyate ॥9॥
12.131.10: kṣipraṁ vā sandhikāmaḥ syāt kṣipraṁ vā tīkṣṇavikramaḥ,
12.131.11: alpenāpi hi sainyena mahīṁ jayati bhūmipaḥ ॥11॥
12.131.12: yuddhe hi santyajan prāṇān śakrasyaiti salokatām ॥12॥
12.132.2: kena svid brāhmaṇo jīvejjaghanye kāla āgate,
12.132.9: na brāhmaṇān ghātayīta doṣān prāpnoti ghātayan ॥9॥
12.132.10: tat pramāṇo’vagāheta tena tat sādhvasādhu vā ॥10॥
12.132.11: na teṣāṁ vacanād rājā satkuryād ghātayīta vā ॥11॥
12.132.12: na vācyaḥ parivādo’yaṁ na śrotavyaḥ kathañcana,
12.132.15: yathā yathāsya bahavaḥ sahāyāḥ syustathā pare,
12.132.17: na tādr̥ksadr̥śaṁ kiñcit pramāṇaṁ dr̥śyate kvacit ॥17॥
12.132.18: vyājena vindan vittaṁ hi dharmāt sa parihīyate ॥18॥
12.132.20: aheriva hi dharmasya padaṁ duḥkhaṁ gaveṣitum ॥20॥
12.132.21: yathā mr̥gasya viddhasya padamekaṁ padaṁ nayet,
12.132.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi rājarṣivr̥ttaṁ nāma dvātriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥132॥
12.133.1: kośāddhi dharmaḥ kaunteya rājyamūlaṁ ca vardhate ॥1॥
12.133.3: na kośaḥ śuddhaśaucena na nr̥śaṁsena jātucit,
12.133.4: abalasya kutaḥ kośo hyakośasya kuto balam,
12.133.5: tasmāt kośaṁ balaṁ mitramatha rājā vivardhayet ॥5॥
12.133.7: śriyo hi kāraṇād rājā satkriyāṁ labhate parām,
sāsya gūhati pāpāni vāso guhyamiva striyāḥ ॥7॥
12.133.9: īdr̥śasya kuto rājñaḥ sukhaṁ bhavati bhārata,
12.133.13: alpe’pyarthe ca maryādā loke bhavati pūjitā ॥13॥
12.133.14: nāyaṁ loko’sti na para iti vyavasito janaḥ,
nālaṁ gantuṁ hi viśvāsaṁ nāstike bhayaśaṅkite ॥14॥
12.134.2: adharmo dharma ityetad yathā vr̥kapadaṁ tathā ॥2॥
12.134.5: bahvapathyaṁ balavati na kiñcit kriyate bhayāt,
12.134.6: atidharmād balaṁ manye balād dharmaḥ pravartate,
12.134.7: anīśvaro bale dharmo drume vallīva saṁśritā ॥7॥
12.134.16: sukhaṁ ca citraṁ bhuñjīta kr̥tenaikena gopayet ॥16॥
12.134.17: loke ca labhate pūjāṁ paratreha mahat phalam ॥17॥
12.135.1: yathā dasyuḥ samaryādaḥ pretyabhāve na naśyati ॥1॥
12.135.8: api tebhyo gr̥hān gatvā nināya satataṁ vane ॥8॥
12.135.9: teṣāmāsajya geheṣu kalya eva sa gacchati ॥9॥
12.135.12: yathā yathā vakṣyasi naḥ kariṣyāmastathā tathā,
pālayāsmān yathānyāyaṁ yathā mātā yathā pitā ॥12॥
12.135.13: mā vadhīstvaṁ striyaṁ bhīruṁ mā śiśuṁ mā tapasvinam,
nāyuddhyamāno hantavyo na ca grāhyā balāt striyaḥ ॥13॥
12.135.14: sarvathā strī na hantavyā sarvasattveṣu kenacit,
nityaṁ tu brāhmaṇe svasti yoddhavyaṁ ca tadarthataḥ ॥14॥
12.135.15: śasyaṁ ca nāpi hartavyaṁ sāravighnaṁ ca mā kr̥thāḥ,
12.135.17: na tasya triṣu lokeṣu trātā bhavati kaścana ॥17॥
12.135.18: yo brāhmaṇān parivaded vināśaṁ cāpi rocayet,
sūryodaya iva dhvānte dhruvaṁ tasya parābhavaḥ ॥18॥
12.135.19: ye ye no na pradāsyanti tāṁstāṁstenābhiyāsyasi ॥19॥
12.135.20: śiṣṭyarthaṁ vihito daṇḍo na vr̥ddhyarthaṁ viniścayaḥ,
ye ca śiṣṭān prabādhante daṇḍasteṣāṁ vadhaḥ smr̥taḥ ॥20॥
12.135.21: ye ca rāṣṭroparodhena vr̥ddhiṁ kurvanti kecana,
12.135.22: api te dasyavo bhūtvā kṣipraṁ siddhimavāpnuyuḥ ॥22॥
12.135.25: nāraṇyebhyo hi bhūtebhyo bhayaṁ prāpnoti kiñcana ॥25॥
12.135.26: na bhayaṁ tasya bhūtebhyaḥ sarvebhyaścaiva bhārata,
nāsato vidyate rājan sa hyaraṇyeṣu gopatiḥ ॥26॥
12.135.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi kāyavyacarite pañcatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥135॥
12.136.1: yena mārgeṇa rājā vai kośaṁ sañjanayatyuta ॥1॥
12.136.2: na dhanaṁ yajñaśīlānāṁ hāryaṁ devasvameva ca,
12.136.3: dhanaṁ hi kṣatriyasyaiva dvitīyasya na vidyate ॥3॥
12.136.4: tadasya syād balārthaṁ vā dhanaṁ yajñārthameva ca,
12.136.5: yo vai na devān na pitr̥̄n na martyāna haviṣārcati,
12.136.6: haret tad draviṇaṁ rājan dhārmikaḥ pr̥thivīpatiḥ,
tataḥ prīṇayate lokaṁ na kośaṁ tadvidhaṁ nr̥paḥ ॥6॥
12.136.8: tathā tathā jayellokān śaktyā caiva yathā yathā,
12.137.6: abravīd dīrghadarśī tu tāvubhau suhr̥dau tadā ॥6॥
12.137.8: sa na saṁśayamāpnoti rocatāṁ bho vrajāmahe ॥8॥
12.137.9: na tu kāryā tvarā tāvaditi me niścitā matiḥ ॥9॥
12.137.10: prāpte kāle na me kiñcinnyāyataḥ parihāsyate ॥10॥
12.137.14: udyāne kriyamāṇe tu matsyānāṁ tatra rajjubhiḥ,
12.137.15: gr̥hyameva tadudyānaṁ gr̥hītvā taṁ tathaiva saḥ,
12.137.18: sa vinaśyati vai kṣipraṁ dīrghasūtro yathā jhaṣaḥ ॥18॥
12.137.19: ādau na kurute śreyaḥ kuśalo’smīti yaḥ pumān,
12.137.21: kāṣṭhāḥ kalā muhūrtāśca divā rātristathā lavāḥ,
māsāḥ pakṣāḥ ṣaḍ r̥tavaḥ kalpaḥ saṁvatsarāstathā ॥21॥
12.137.22: pr̥thivī deśa ityuktaḥ kālaḥ sa ca na dr̥śyate,
12.137.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi śākulopākhyāne saptatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥137॥
12.138.1: sarvatra buddhiḥ kathitā śreṣṭhā te bharatarṣabha,
12.138.2: tadicchāmi parāṁ śrotuṁ buddhiṁ te bharatarṣabha,
yathā rājā na muhyeta śatrubhiḥ parivāritaḥ ॥2॥
12.138.8: kathaṁ tu puruṣaḥ kuryāt kr̥tvā kiṁ vā sukhī bhavet ॥8॥
12.138.9: vigrahaṁ kena vā kuryāt sandhiṁ vā kena yojayet,
12.138.10: etad vai sarvakr̥tyānāṁ paraṁ kr̥tyaṁ parantapa,
naitasya kaścid vaktāsti śrotā vāpi sudurlabhaḥ ॥10॥
12.138.12: śr̥ṇu me putra kārtsnyena guhyamāpatsu bhārata ॥12॥
12.138.13: amitro mitratāṁ yāti mitraṁ cāpi praduṣyati,
12.138.14: tasmād viśvasitavyaṁ ca vigrahaṁ ca samācaret,
12.138.15: amitrairapi sandheyaṁ prāṇā rakṣyā hi bhārata ॥15॥
12.138.16: na so’rthaṁ prāpnuyāt kiñcit phalānyapi ca bhārata ॥16॥
12.138.18: mārjārasya ca saṁvādaṁ nyagrodhe mūṣikasya ca ॥18॥
12.138.21: tasya mūlaṁ samāśritya kr̥tvā śatamukhaṁ bilam,
vasati sma mahāprājñaḥ palito nāma mūṣikaḥ ॥21॥
12.138.22: śākhāṁ tasya samāśritya vasati sma sukhaṁ purā,
12.138.24: tatra snāyumayān pāśān yathāvat saṁvidhāya saḥ,
gr̥haṁ gatvā sukhaṁ śete prabhātāmeti śarvarīm ॥24॥
12.138.25: tatra sma nityaṁ badhyante naktaṁ bahuvidhā mr̥gāḥ,
12.138.26: taṁ kālaṁ palito jñātvā pracacāra sunirbhayaḥ ॥26॥
12.138.34: athāsyāsīdiyaṁ cintā tat prāpya sumahad bhayam,
12.138.35: samantād bhaya utpanne kathaṁ kāryaṁ hitaiṣiṇā,
sa tathā sarvato ruddhaḥ sarvatra bhayadarśanaḥ ॥35॥
12.138.37: gataṁ māṁ sahasā bhūmiṁ nakulo bhakṣayiṣyati ॥37॥
12.138.39: kariṣye jīvite yatnaṁ yāvad yuktyā pratigrahāt,
12.138.41: na tvanyāmiha mārjārād gatiṁ paśyāmi sāmpratam,
viṣamastho hyayaṁ śatruḥ kr̥tyaṁ cāsya mahanmayā ॥41॥
12.138.44: mūḍho grāhayituṁ svārthaṁ saṅgatyā yadi śakyate ॥44॥
12.138.45: kadācid vyasanaṁ prāpya sandhiṁ kuryānmayā saha,
12.138.46: śreṣṭho hi paṇḍitaḥ śatrurna ca mitramapaṇḍitaḥ ॥46॥
12.138.50: jīvitaṁ hi tavecchāmi śreyaḥ sādhāraṇaṁ hi nau ॥50॥
12.138.51: na te saumya bhayaṁ kāryaṁ jīviṣyasi yathāsukham,
ahaṁ tvāmuddhariṣyāmi yadi māṁ na jighāṁsasi ॥51॥
12.138.52: yena śakyastvayā mokṣaḥ prāptuṁ śreyastathā mayā ॥52॥
12.138.53: ātmārthaṁ ca tvadarthaṁ ca śreyaḥ sādhāraṇaṁ hi nau ॥53॥
12.138.54: na dharṣayati mārjāra tena me svasti sāmpratam ॥54॥
12.138.56: satāṁ sāptapadaṁ maitraṁ sa sakhā me’si paṇḍitaḥ,
sāṁvāsyakaṁ kariṣyāmi nāsti te bhayamadya vai ॥56॥
12.138.57: na hi śakto’si mārjāra pāśaṁ chettuṁ mayā vinā,
ahaṁ chetsyāmi pāśāṁste yadi māṁ tvaṁ na hiṁsasi ॥57॥
12.138.62: sa tārayati tat kāṣṭhaṁ sa ca kāṣṭhena tāryate ॥62॥
12.138.63: ahaṁ tvāṁ tārayiṣyāmi māṁ ca tvaṁ tārayiṣyasi ॥63॥
12.138.64: hetumad grahaṇīyaṁ ca kālāpekṣī nyavekṣya ca ॥64॥
12.138.68: nandāmi saumya bhadraṁ te yo māṁ jīvitumicchasi,
śreyaśca yadi jānīṣe kriyatāṁ mā vicāraya ॥68॥
12.138.69: dvayorāpannayoḥ sandhiḥ kriyatāṁ mā cirāya ca ॥69॥
12.138.70: vidhāsye prāptakālaṁ yat kāryaṁ siddhikaraṁ vibho,
mayi kr̥cchrād vinirmukte na vinaṅkṣyati te kr̥tam ॥70॥
12.138.73: vihito yastu mārgo me hitārthaṁ śr̥ṇu taṁ mama ॥73॥
12.138.74: trāyasva bho mā vadhīstvaṁ śakto’smi tava rakṣaṇe ॥74॥
12.138.75: ulūkāccaiva māṁ rakṣa kṣudraḥ prārthayate hi mām,
ahaṁ chetsyāmi te pāśān sakhe satyena te śape ॥75॥
12.138.77: taṁ sampūjyātha palitaṁ mārjāraḥ sauhr̥de sthitaḥ,
sa vicintyābravīd dhīraḥ prītastvarita eva ca ॥77॥
12.138.78: śīghramāgaccha bhadraṁ te tvaṁ me prāṇasamaḥ sakhā,
tava prājña prasādāddhi prāyaḥ prāpsyāmi jīvitam ॥78॥
12.138.79: yad yadevaṅgatenādya śakyaṁ kartuṁ mayā tava,
12.138.80: sarvakāryāṇi kartāhaṁ priyāṇi ca hitāni ca ॥80॥
12.138.83: grāhayitvā tu taṁ svārthaṁ mārjāraṁ mūṣikastathā,
12.138.85: līnaṁ tu tasya gātreṣu mārjārasya ca mūṣikam,
12.138.86: dr̥ṣṭvā tayoḥ parāṁ prītiṁ vismayaṁ paramaṁ gatau ॥86॥
12.138.87: aśaktau tu nayāt tasmāt sampradharṣayituṁ balāt ॥87॥
12.138.89: līnaḥ sa tasya gātreṣu palito deśakālavit,
ciccheda pāśān nr̥pate kālāpekṣī śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ॥89॥
12.138.92: chindhi pāśānamitraghna purā śvapaca eti ca ॥92॥
12.138.94: tūṣṇīṁ bhava na te saumya tvarā kāryā na sambhramaḥ,
12.138.96: akāle vipramuktānme tvatta eva bhayaṁ bhavet,
tasmāt kālaṁ pratīkṣasva kimiti tvarase sakhe ॥96॥
12.138.97: tataśchetsyāmi te pāśān prāpte sādhāraṇe bhaye ॥97॥
12.138.98: na hi te jīvitādanyat kiñcit kr̥tyaṁ bhaviṣyati ॥98॥
12.138.99: tato bhavatyapakrānte traste bhīte ca lomaśa,
ahaṁ bilaṁ pravekṣyāmi bhavān śākhāṁ bhajiṣyati ॥99॥
12.138.102: na hyevaṁ mitrakāryāṇi prītyā kurvanti sādhavaḥ,
yathā tvāṁ mokṣitaḥ kr̥cchrāt tvaramāṇena vai mayā ॥102॥
12.138.103: tathā hi tvaramāṇena tvayā kāryaṁ hitaṁ mama,
12.138.104: athavā pūrvavairaṁ tvaṁ smaran kālaṁ jihīrṣasi,
12.138.105: na tanmanasi kartavyaṁ kṣāmaye tvāṁ prasīda me ॥105॥
12.138.107: śrutaṁ me tava mārjāra svamarthaṁ parigr̥hṇataḥ,
12.138.109: kr̥tvā balavatā sandhimātmānaṁ yo na rakṣati,
apathyamiva tad bhuktaṁ tasya nārthāya kalpate ॥109॥
12.138.110: na kaścit kasyacinmitraṁ na kaścit kasyacid ripuḥ,
12.138.111: na ca kaścit kr̥te kārye kartāraṁ samavekṣate ॥111॥
12.138.115: kṣayaṁ jagāma sā rātrirlomaśaṁ tvāviśad bhayam,
12.138.118: atha tāvapi santrastau taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā ghorasaṅkulam ॥118॥
12.138.121: tataściccheda taṁ pāśaṁ mārjārasya ca mūṣikaḥ ॥121॥
12.138.123: bilaṁ viveśa palitaḥ śākhāṁ lebhe sa lomaśaḥ,
12.138.127: gatvā ca mama viśvāsaṁ dattvā ca mama jīvitam,
12.138.128: kr̥tvā hi pūrvaṁ mitrāṇi yaḥ paścānnānutiṣṭhati,
na sa mitrāṇi labhate kr̥cchrāsvāpatsu durmatiḥ ॥128॥
12.138.130: yāni me santi mitrāṇi ye ca sambandhibāndhavāḥ,
sarve tvāṁ pūjayiṣyanti śiṣyā gurumiva priyam ॥130॥
12.138.131: jīvitasya pradātāraṁ kr̥tajñaḥ ko na pūjayet ॥131॥
12.138.132: arthānāṁ caiva sarveṣāmanuśāstā ca me bhava ॥132॥
12.138.133: amātyo me bhava prājña piteveha praśādhi mām,
12.138.134: tvaṁ mantrabalayukto hi dattvā jīvitamadya me ॥134॥
12.138.135: evamuktaḥ parāṁ śāntiṁ mārjāreṇa sa mūṣikaḥ,
12.138.136: yad bhavānāha tat sarvaṁ mayā te lomaśa śrutam,
mamāpi tāvad bruvataḥ śr̥ṇu yat pratibhāti me ॥136॥
12.138.137: etat susūkṣmaṁ loke’smin dr̥śyate prājña sammatam ॥137॥
12.138.139: nāsti jātu ripurnāma mitraṁ nāma na vidyate,
12.138.140: yo yasmin jīvati svārthaṁ paśyet pīḍāṁ na jīvati,
sa tasya mitraṁ tāvat syād yāvanna syād viparyayaḥ ॥140॥
12.138.141: nāsti maitrī sthirā nāma na ca dhruvamasauhr̥dam,
12.138.143: yo viśvasiti mitreṣu na viśvasiti śatruṣu,
12.138.144: mitre vā yadi vā śatrau tasyāpi calitā matiḥ,
12.138.145: arthayuktyā hi jāyante pitā mātā sutastathā ॥145॥
12.138.146: putraṁ hi mātāpitarau tyajataḥ patitaṁ priyam ॥146॥
12.138.147: loko rakṣati cātmānaṁ paśya svārthasya sāratām,
sāmānyā niṣkr̥tiḥ prājña yo mokṣāt pratyanantaram ॥147॥
12.138.150: bravīṣi madhuraṁ yacca priyo me’dya bhavāniti ॥150॥
12.138.151: tanmitra kāraṇaṁ sarvaṁ vistareṇāpi me śr̥ṇu,
12.138.152: arthārthī jīvaloko’yaṁ na kaścit kasyacit priyaḥ,
12.138.153: yadyapi bhrātaraḥ kruddhā bhāryā vā kāraṇāntare ॥153॥
12.138.156: kiṁ nu tat kāraṇaṁ manye yenāhaṁ bhavataḥ priyaḥ ॥156॥
12.138.158: na tvīdr̥śaṁ tvayā vācyaṁ viduṣi svārthapaṇḍite ॥158॥
12.138.160: adyaiva hi ripurbhūtvā punaradyaiva me suhr̥t ॥160॥
12.138.162: sā gatā saha tenaiva kālayuktena hetunā,
tvaṁ hi me jātitaḥ śatruḥ sāmarthyānmitratāṁ gataḥ ॥162॥
12.138.164: praviśeyaṁ kathaṁ pāśaṁ tvatkr̥te tad vadasva me,
12.138.165: tvaṁ hi saumya kr̥tārtho’dya nirvr̥ttārthāstathā vayam ॥165॥
12.138.166: na te’styadya mayā kr̥tyaṁ kiñcidanyatra bhakṣaṇāt,
ahamannaṁ bhavān bhoktā durbalo’haṁ bhavān balī ॥166॥
12.138.167: sa manye’haṁ tava prajñāṁ yanmokṣāt pratyanantaram ॥167॥
12.138.168: bhakṣyārthaṁ hyavabaddhastvaṁ sa muktaḥ pīḍitaḥ kṣudhā ॥168॥
12.138.170: sa tvaṁ māmabhisandhāya bhakṣyaṁ mr̥gayase punaḥ,
tvaṁ cāpi putradārastho yat sandhiṁ sr̥jase mayi ॥170॥
12.138.171: śuśrūṣāṁ yatase kartuṁ sakhe mama na tat kṣamam,
tvayā māṁ sahitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā priyā bhāryā sutāśca te ॥171॥
12.138.172: kasmāt te māṁ na khādeyurhr̥ṣṭāḥ praṇayinastvayi,
nāhaṁ tvayā sameṣyāmi vr̥tto hetuḥ samāgame ॥172॥
12.138.173: śivaṁ dhyāyasva me svasthaḥ sukr̥taṁ smarase yadi,
12.138.174: bhakṣyaṁ mr̥gayamāṇasya kaḥ prājño viṣayaṁ vrajet,
12.138.175: viśvastaṁ vā pramattaṁ vā etadeva kr̥taṁ bhavet,
12.138.176: nāhaṁ tvayā sameṣyāmi nivr̥tto bhava lomaśa,
yadi tvaṁ sukr̥taṁ vetsi tat sakhyamanusāraya ॥176॥
12.138.177: praśāntādapi me pāpād bhetavyaṁ balinaḥ sadā,
yadi svārthaṁ na te kāryaṁ brūhi kiṁ karavāṇi te ॥177॥
12.138.178: kāmaṁ sarvaṁ pradāsyāmi na tvā’’tmānaṁ kadācana,
ātmārthe santatistyājyā rājyaṁ ratnaṁ dhanāni ca ॥178॥
12.138.181: ātmā hi sarvadā rakṣyo dārairapi dhanairapi,
12.138.182: śatrūn samyag vijānanti durbalā ye balīyasaḥ ॥182॥
12.138.185: satyaṁ śape tvayāhaṁ vai mitradroho vigarhitaḥ,
tanmanye’haṁ tava prajñāṁ yastvaṁ mama hite rataḥ ॥185॥
12.138.186: na tu māmanyathā sādho tvaṁ grahītumihārhasi ॥186॥
12.138.189: tvayā hi vācyamāno’haṁ jahyāṁ prāṇān sabāndhavaḥ,
12.138.191: sādhurbhavān śrutārtho’smi prīye ca na ca viśvase ॥191॥
12.138.192: na hyamitre vaśaṁ yānti prājñā niṣkāraṇaṁ sakhe ॥192॥
12.138.193: asminnarthe ca gāthe dve nibodhośanasā kr̥te,
12.138.195: nityaṁ viśvāsayedanyān pareṣāṁ tu na viśvaset,
12.138.198: tvadvidhebhyo mayā hyātmā rakṣyo mārjāra sarvadā ॥198॥
12.138.200: śākhāṁ hitvā javenāśu mārjāraḥ prayayau tataḥ,
12.138.207: kālena ripuṇā sandhiḥ kāle mitreṇa vigrahaḥ ॥207॥
12.138.210: na bhayaṁ vidyate rājan bhītasyānāgate bhaye ॥210॥
12.138.214: śrutvā tvaṁ suhr̥dāṁ madhye yathāvat samupācara,
12.138.216: samāgataścared yuktyā kr̥tārtho na ca viśvaset,
12.138.217: brāhmaṇaiścāpi te sārdhaṁ yātrā bhavatu pāṇḍava ॥217॥
12.138.218: brāhmaṇā vai paraṁ śreyo divi ceha ca bhārata,
ete dharmasya vettāraḥ kr̥tajñāḥ satataṁ prabho ॥218॥
12.138.219: rājyaṁ śreyaḥ paraṁ rājan yaśaḥ kīrtiṁ ca lapsyase ॥219॥
12.138.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi mārjāramūṣikasaṁvāde aṣṭātriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥138॥
12.139.1: ukto mantro mahābāho viśvāso nāsti śatruṣu,
kathaṁ hi rājā varteta yadi sarvatra nāśvaset ॥1॥
12.139.2: kathaṁ hi nāśvasan rājā śatrūn jayati pārthivaḥ ॥2॥
12.139.7: samakālaṁ ca rājño’pi devyāṁ putro vyajāyata ॥7॥
12.139.8: tayorarthe kr̥tajñā sā khecarī pūjanī sadā,
12.139.9: puṣṭyarthaṁ ca svaputrasya rājaputrasya caiva ha,
12.139.10: ādāyādāya saivāśu tayoḥ prādāt punaḥ punaḥ ॥10॥
12.139.11: tataḥ sa dhātryā kakṣeṇa uhyamāno nr̥pātmajaḥ ॥11॥
12.139.13: hatvā tataḥ sa rājendra dhātryā hastamupāgataḥ ॥13॥
12.139.15: bāṣpapūrṇamukhī dīnā dr̥ṣṭvā taṁ rudatī sutam,
12.139.16: kṣatriye saṅgataṁ nāsti na prītirna ca sauhr̥dam,
12.139.20: ityuktvā caraṇābhyāṁ tu netre nr̥pasutasya sā,
bhittvā svasthā tata idaṁ pūjanī vākyamabravīt ॥20॥
12.139.21: kr̥taṁ pratikr̥taṁ yeṣāṁ na naśyati śubhāśubham ॥21॥
12.139.22: pāpaṁ karma kr̥taṁ kiñcid yadi tasmin na dr̥śyate,
nr̥pate tasya putreṣu pautreṣvapi ca naptr̥ṣu ॥22॥
12.139.24: ubhayaṁ tat samībhūtaṁ vasa pūjani mā gamaḥ ॥24॥
12.139.26: sāntve prayukte satataṁ kr̥tavaire na viśvaset,
kṣipraṁ sa badhyate mūḍho na hi vairaṁ praśāmyati ॥26॥
12.139.29: kāmaṁ viśvāsayedanyān pareṣāṁ ca na viśvaset ॥29॥
12.139.33: jahyāt tat sattvavān sthānaṁ śatroḥ sammānito’pi san ॥33॥
12.139.35: yaḥ kr̥te pratikuryād vai na sa tatrāparādhnuyāt,
anr̥ṇastena bhavati vasa pūjani mā gamaḥ ॥35॥
12.139.36: na kr̥tasya tu kartuśca sakhyaṁ sandhīyate punaḥ,
hr̥dayaṁ tatra jānāti kartuścaiva kr̥tasya ca ॥36॥
12.139.37: kr̥tasya caiva kartuśca sakhyaṁ sandhīyate punaḥ,
12.139.39: tarasā ye na śakyante śastraiḥ suniśitairapi,
sāmnā te’pi nigr̥hyante gajā iva kareṇubhiḥ ॥39॥
12.139.40: anyonyasya ca viśvāsaḥ śvapacena śuno yathā ॥40॥
12.139.43: tatra dātā na hantavyaḥ kṣatriyeṇa viśeṣataḥ,
12.139.45: na vittena na pāruṣyairna sāntvena na ca śrutaiḥ,
12.139.49: kālena kriyate kāryaṁ tathaiva vividhāḥ kriyāḥ,
12.139.50: tulyaṁ cobhe pravartete maraṇaṁ janma caiva ha,
kāryate caiva kālena tannimittaṁ na jīvati ॥50॥
12.139.52: nāhaṁ pramāṇaṁ naiva tvamanyonyaṁ kāraṇaṁ śubhe,
kālo nityamupādatte sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ ca dehinām ॥52॥
12.139.53: yat kr̥taṁ tat tu me kṣāntaṁ tvaṁ ca vai kṣama pūjani ॥53॥
12.139.54: yadi kālaḥ pramāṇaṁ te na vairaṁ kasyacid bhavet,
12.139.55: yadi kālena niryāṇaṁ sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ bhavābhavau ॥55॥
12.139.56: yadi kālena pacyante bheṣajaiḥ kiṁ prayojanam ॥56॥
12.139.57: yadi kālaḥ pramāṇaṁ te kasmād dharmo’sti kartr̥ṣu ॥57॥
12.139.58: tava putro mamāpatyaṁ hatavān sa hato mayā,
anantaraṁ tvayāhaṁ ca hantavyā hi narādhipa ॥58॥
12.139.59: yathā tvayā prahartavyaṁ tathā tattvaṁ ca me śr̥ṇu ॥59॥
12.139.60: bhakṣyārthaṁ krīḍanārthaṁ ca narā vāñchanti pakṣiṇaḥ,
12.139.62: sarvasya dayitāḥ prāṇāḥ sarvasya dayitāḥ sutāḥ,
12.139.65: yo duḥkhaṁ nābhijānāti sa jalpati mahājane ॥65॥
12.139.66: yastu śocati duḥkhārtaḥ sa kathaṁ vaktumutsahet,
12.139.67: yat kr̥taṁ te mayā rājaṁstvayā ca mama yat kr̥tam,
12.139.68: smr̥tvā smr̥tvā hi te putraṁ navaṁ vairaṁ bhaviṣyati ॥68॥
12.139.70: uśanā caiva gāthe dvai prahlādāyābravīt purā ॥70॥
12.139.71: ye vairiṇaḥ śraddadhate satye satyetare’pi vā,
12.139.72: na hi vairāṇi śāmyanti kule duḥkhagatāni ca,
ākhyātāraśca vidyante kule vai dhriyate pumān ॥72॥
12.139.74: sadā na viśvased rājan pāpaṁ kr̥tveha kasyacit,
12.139.76: yasyeha vraṇinau pādau padbhyāṁ ca parisarpati,
khanyete tasya tau pādau suguptamiha dhāvataḥ ॥76॥
12.139.80: yastu tiktaṁ kaṣāyaṁ vā svādu vā madhuraṁ hitam,
12.139.81: pathyaṁ muktvā tu yo mohād duṣṭamaśnāti bhojanam,
12.139.82: udārāṇāṁ tu satkarma daivaṁ klībā upāsate ॥82॥
12.139.83: karma cātmahitaṁ kāryaṁ tīkṣṇaṁ vā yadi vā mr̥du,
12.139.84: tasmāt sarvaṁ vyapohyārthaṁ kārya eva parākramaḥ,
12.139.85: vidyā śauryaṁ ca dākṣyaṁ ca balaṁ dhairyaṁ ca pañcamam,
12.139.86: niveśanaṁ ca kupyaṁ ca kṣetraṁ bhāryā suhr̥jjanaḥ,
12.139.87: sarvatra ramate prājñaḥ sarvatra ca virājate,
na vibhīṣayate kaścid bhīṣito na bibheti ca ॥87॥
12.139.89: kustrī khādati māṁsāni māghamāṁ segavā iva ॥89॥
12.139.90: gr̥haṁ kṣetrāṇi mitrāṇi svadeśa iti cāpare,
12.139.91: anyatra vastuṁ gacched vā vased vā nityamānitaḥ ॥91॥
12.139.92: kr̥tametadanāryaṁ me tava putre ca pārthiva ॥92॥
12.139.93: kubhāryāṁ ca kuputraṁ ca kurājānaṁ kusauhr̥dam,
12.139.94: kuputre nāsti viśvāsaḥ kubhāryāyāṁ kuto ratiḥ,
12.139.96: sā bhāryā yā priyaṁ brūte sa putro yatra nirvr̥tiḥ,
tanmitraṁ yatra viśvāsaḥ sa deśo yatra jīvyate ॥96॥
12.139.97: yatra nāsti balātkāraḥ sa rājā tīvraśāsanaḥ,
bhīreva nāsti sambandho daridraṁ yo bubhūṣate ॥97॥
12.139.100: na rakṣati prajāḥ samyag yaḥ sa pārthivataskaraḥ ॥100॥
12.139.102: dattvābhayaṁ svayaṁ rājā pramāṇaṁ kurute yadi,
12.139.104: pitā hi rājā rāṣṭrasya prajānāṁ yo’nukampanaḥ,
tasmin mithyāvinīto hi tiryag gacchati mānavaḥ ॥104॥
12.139.107: na tasya bhramate rājyaṁ svayaṁ dharmānupālanāt ॥107॥
12.139.108: sa sukhaṁ prekṣate rājā iha loke paratra ca ॥108॥
12.139.111: balinā vigraho rājan na kadācit praśasyate,
balinā vigraho yasya kuto rājyaṁ kutaḥ sukham ॥111॥
12.139.113: etat te brahmadattasya pūjanyā saha bhāṣitam,
