12.139.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi brahmadattapūjanyoḥ saṁvāda ekonacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥139॥
12.140.1: yugakṣayāt parikṣīṇo dharme loke ca bhārata,
dasyubhiḥ pīḍyamāne ca kathaṁ stheyaṁ pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.140.2: utsr̥jyāpi ghr̥ṇāṁ kāle yathā varteta bhūmipaḥ ॥2॥
12.140.5: alabdhasya kathaṁ lipsā labdhaṁ kena vivardhate,
vardhitaṁ pālyate kena pālitaṁ praṇayet katham ॥5॥
12.140.13: vāṅmātreṇa vinītaḥ syād hr̥dayena yathā kṣuraḥ,
12.140.14: sapatnasahite kārye kr̥tvā sandhiṁ na viśvaset,
12.140.17: añjaliṁ śapathaṁ sāntvaṁ praṇamya śirasā vadet,
12.140.23: na ca lokaravād bhītā na vai śaśvat pratīkṣiṇaḥ ॥23॥
12.140.26: etāni yuktyā seveta prasaṅgo hyatra doṣavān ॥26॥
12.140.29: parasya ca balaṁ jñātvā tatrātmānaṁ niyojayet ॥29॥
12.140.30: daṇḍenopanataṁ śatruṁ yo rājā na niyacchati,
12.140.31: āmaḥ syāt pakvasaṅkāśo na ca śīryeta kasyacit ॥31॥
12.140.32: āśāṁ kālavatīṁ kuryāt tāṁ ca vighnena yojayet,
12.140.37: yo’riṇā saha sandhāya sukhaṁ svapiti viśvasan,
sa vr̥kṣāgre prasupto vā patitaḥ pratibuddhyate ॥37॥
12.140.38: karmaṇā yena tenaiva mr̥dunā dāruṇena ca,
12.140.41: pānāgāre praveśeṣu tīrtheṣu ca sabhāsu ca ॥41॥
12.140.44: athāsya praharet kāle kiñcid vicalite pade ॥44॥
12.140.47: putro vā yadi vā bhrātā pitā vā yadi vā suhr̥t,
12.140.51: nāsti jātyā ripurnāma mitraṁ vāpi na vidyate,
12.140.52: duḥkhaṁ tatra na kartavyaṁ hanyāt pūrvāpakāriṇam ॥52॥
12.140.54: asināpi śiraśchittvā śoceta ca rudeta ca ॥54॥
12.140.56: na śuṣkavairaṁ kurvīta bāhubhyāṁ na nadīṁ taret,
12.140.58: punaḥ punaḥ pravardhante tasmāccheṣaṁ na dhārayet ॥58॥
12.140.60: kaṇṭako’pi hi duśchinno vikāraṁ kurute ciram ॥60॥
12.140.61: vadhena ca manuṣyāṇāṁ mārgāṇāṁ dūṣaṇena ca,
12.140.66: mr̥dunaiva mr̥duṁ hanti mr̥dunā hanti dāruṇam,
nāsādhyaṁ mr̥dunā kiñcit tasmāt tīkṣṇataro mr̥duḥ ॥66॥
12.140.67: kāle mr̥duryo bhavati kāle bhavati dāruṇaḥ,
12.140.68: dīrghau buddhimato bāhū yābhyāṁ hiṁsati hiṁsitaḥ ॥68॥
12.140.69: na tat tared yasya na pāramuttare-
na tat khaned yasya na mūlamuddhare-
nna taṁ hanyād yasya śiro na pātayet ॥69॥
12.140.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi kaṇikopadeśe catvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥140॥
12.141.1: adharme dharmatāṁ nīte dharme cādharmatāṁ gate ॥1॥
12.141.5: avarṣati ca parjanye mitho bhede samutthite ॥5॥
12.141.8: kathaṁ ca rājā varteta loke kaluṣatāṁ gate,
12.141.9: prajāsu vyādhayaścaiva maraṇaṁ ca bhayāni ca ॥9॥
12.141.10: kr̥taṁ tretāṁ dvāparaṁ ca kaliśca bharatarṣabha,
12.141.24: tasmin pratibhaye kāle kṣate dharme yudhiṣṭhira,
12.141.34: na ca kvacidavindat sa bhikṣamāṇo’pi kauśikaḥ,
māṁsamannaṁ phalaṁ mūlamanyad vā tatra kiñcana ॥34॥
12.141.35: aho kr̥cchraṁ mayā prāptamiti niścitya kauśikaḥ,
12.141.36: sa cintayāmāsa muniḥ kiṁ nu me sukr̥taṁ bhavet,
kathaṁ vr̥thā na mr̥tyuḥ syāditi pārthivasattama ॥36॥
12.141.37: sa dadarśa śvamāṁsasya kutantrīṁ vitatāṁ muniḥ,
cāṇḍālasya gr̥he rājan sadyaḥ śastrahatasya vai ॥37॥
12.141.38: sa cintayāmāsa tadā stainyaṁ kāryamito mayā,
12.141.42: tasmin deśe sa suṣvāpa śvapaco yatra bhārata ॥42॥
12.141.43: sa vigāḍhāṁ niśāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā supte cāṇḍālapakkaṇe,
12.141.45: jāgarmi nātra supto’smi hato’sīti ca dāruṇaḥ ॥45॥
12.141.47: mā vadhīrmama sadbuddhe yadi samyak prapaśyasi ॥47॥
12.141.49: uvāca kauśikaṁ rātrau brahman kiṁ te cikīrṣitam ॥49॥
12.141.52: avasīdanti me prāṇāḥ śrutirme naśyati kṣudhā,
12.141.53: aṭan bhaikṣyaṁ na vindāmi yadā yuṣmākamālaye ॥53॥
12.141.54: tadā buddhiḥ kr̥tā pāpe hariṣyāmi śvajāghanīm,
12.141.55: yathāvat sarvabhūg brahmā tathā māṁ viddhi dharmataḥ,
tamuvāca sa cāṇḍālo maharṣe śr̥ṇu me vacaḥ ॥55॥
12.141.56: śrutvā tat tvaṁ tathā’’tiṣṭha yathā dharmo na hīyate,
dharmaṁ tavāpi viprarṣe śr̥ṇu yat te bravīmyaham ॥56॥
12.141.60: jānatā vihitaṁ dharmaṁ na kāryo dharmasaṅkaraḥ,
mā sma dharmaṁ parityākṣīstvaṁ hi dharmabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ ॥60॥
12.141.63: yena yena viśeṣaṇa karmaṇā yena kenacit,
12.141.70: pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyā brahmakṣatrasya vai viśaḥ,
yathā śāstraṁ pramāṇaṁ te mābhakṣye mānasaṁ kr̥thāḥ ॥70॥
12.141.72: na nūnaṁ kāryametad vai hara kāmaṁ śvajāghanīm ॥72॥
12.141.74: asatā yat samācīrṇaṁ na ca dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ,
nākāryamiha kāryaṁ vai mā chalenāśubhaṁ kr̥thāḥ ॥74॥
12.141.75: samau ca śvamr̥gau manye tasmād bhokṣye śvajāghanīm ॥75॥
12.141.76: sa vai dharmo yatra na pāpamasti
12.141.83: suhr̥d bhūtvānuśāse tvāṁ kr̥pā hi tvayi me dvija,
yadidaṁ śreya ādhatsva mā lobhāt pātakaṁ kr̥thāḥ ॥83॥
12.141.93: tato jagrāha sa śvāṅgaṁ jīvitārthī mahāmuniḥ,
12.141.96: tataḥ samārabhat karma daivaṁ pitryaṁ ca bhārata,
12.141.97: etasminneva kāle tu pravavarṣa sa vāsavaḥ,
12.141.99: sa saṁhr̥tya ca tat karma anāsvādya ca taddhaviḥ,
12.141.101: etāṁ buddhiṁ samāsthāya jīvitavyaṁ sadā bhavet,
12.141.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi viśvāmitraśvapacasaṁvāde ekacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥141॥
12.142.5: jñeyo bhavati kauravya sadā tad viddhi me vacaḥ ॥5॥
12.142.12: te sarve nr̥pa pāpiṣṭhā dharmasya paripanthinaḥ ॥12॥
12.142.17: na dharmavacanaṁ vācā naiva buddhyeti naḥ śrutam,
iti bārhaspataṁ jñānaṁ provāca maghavā svayam ॥17॥
12.142.23: jñānamapyapadiśyaṁ hi yathā nāsti tathaiva tat,
12.142.24: ugrāyaiva hi sr̥ṣṭo’si karmaṇe na tvamīkṣase ॥24॥
12.142.25: yathā pramucyate tvanyo yadarthaṁ na pramodate ॥25॥
12.142.27: sā caiva khalu maryādā yāmayaṁ parivarjayet ॥27॥
12.142.28: tasmāt tīkṣṇaḥ prajā rājā svadharme sthāpayet tataḥ,
12.142.29: yasya dasyugaṇā rāṣṭre dhvāṅkṣā matsyān jalādiva,
12.142.30: praśādhi pr̥thivīṁ rājan prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ॥30॥
12.142.33: kaṣṭaḥ kṣatriyadharmo’yaṁ sauhr̥daṁ tvayi me sthitam,
ugrakarmaṇi sr̥ṣṭo’si tasmād rājyaṁ praśādhi vai ॥33॥
12.142.35: pr̥cchāmi tvāṁ satāṁ śreṣṭha tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥35॥
12.142.37: yā devatāsu vr̥ttiste sāstu vipreṣu nityadā,
kruddhairhi vipraiḥ karmāṇi kr̥tāni bahudhā nr̥pa ॥37॥
12.142.38: prītyā hyamr̥tavad viprāḥ kruddhāścaiva viṣaṁ yathā ॥38॥
12.143.1: śaraṇaṁ pālayānasya yo dharmastaṁ vadasva me ॥1॥
12.143.5: svamāṁsaṁ bhojitaḥ kāṁ ca gatiṁ lebhe sa bhārata ॥5॥
12.143.8: imāṁ yathā kapotena siddhiḥ prāptā narādhipa ॥8॥
12.143.12: naiva tasya suhr̥t kaścinna sambandhī na bāndhavāḥ,
sa hi taiḥ samparityaktastena raudreṇa karmaṇā ॥12॥
12.143.13: ātmānaṁ yo’bhisandhatte so’nyasya syāt kathaṁ hitaḥ ॥13॥
12.143.14: udvejanīyā bhūtānāṁ vyālā iva bhavanti te ॥14॥
12.143.15: sa vai kṣārakamādāya dvijān hatvā vane sadā,
12.143.16: evaṁ tu vartamānasya tasya vr̥ttiṁ durātmanaḥ,
12.143.22: naiva nimnaṁ sthalaṁ vāpi so’vindata vihaṅgahā,
pūrito hi jalaughena tasya mārgo vanasya ca ॥22॥
12.143.25: sa tu śītahatairgātrairna jagāma na tasthivān,
12.143.26: dr̥ṣṭvā’’rto’pi hi pāpātmā sa tāṁ pañjarake’kṣipat,
12.143.31: dūrato me niveśaśca asmād deśāditi prabho ॥31॥
12.143.32: kr̥tabuddhirdrume tasmin vastuṁ tāṁ rajanīṁ tataḥ,
12.143.33: sa śilāyāṁ śiraḥ kr̥tvā parṇānyāstīrya bhūtale,
12.143.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi kapotalubdhakasaṁvādopakrame tricatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥143॥
12.144.2: prāptāṁ ca rajanīṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sa pakṣī paryatapyata ॥2॥
12.144.3: kiṁ nu tat kāraṇaṁ yena sādyāpi na nivartate ॥3॥
12.144.4: api svasti bhavet tasyāḥ priyāyā mama kānane,
tayā virahitaṁ hīdaṁ śūnyamadya gr̥haṁ mama ॥4॥
12.144.7: adya nāyāti me kāntā na kāryaṁ jīvitena me ॥7॥
12.144.8: na bhuṅkte mayyabhukte yā nāsnāte snāti suvratā,
12.144.9: hr̥ṣṭe bhavati sā hr̥ṣṭā duḥkhite mayi duḥkhitā,
12.144.10: yasya syāt tādr̥śī bhāryā dhanyaḥ sa puruṣo bhuvi ॥10॥
12.144.11: sā hi śrāntaṁ kṣudhārtaṁ ca jānīte māṁ tapasvinī,
anuraktā sthirā caiva bhaktā snigdhā yaśasvinī ॥11॥
12.144.12: vr̥kṣamūle’pi dayitā yasya tiṣṭhati tad gr̥ham,
prāsādo’pi tayā hīnaḥ kāntāra iti niścitam ॥12॥
12.144.14: bhāryā hi paramo hyarthaḥ puruṣasyeha paṭhyate,
12.144.17: yasya bhāryā gr̥he nāsti sādhvī ca priyavādinī,
araṇyaṁ tena gantavyaṁ yathāraṇyaṁ tathā gr̥ham ॥17॥
12.144.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi bhāryāpraśaṁsāyāṁ catuścatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥144॥
12.145.1: evaṁ vilapatastasya śrutvā tu karuṇaṁ vacaḥ,
12.145.2: aho’tīva subhāgyāhaṁ yasyā me dayitaḥ patiḥ,
asato vā sato vāpi guṇānevaṁ prabhāṣate ॥2॥
12.145.3: na sā strī hyabhimantavyā yasyāṁ bhartā na tuṣyati,
tuṣṭe bhartari nārīṇāṁ tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ ॥3॥
12.145.5: bhasmībhavati sā nārī yasyā bhartā na tuṣyati,
iti sañcintya duḥkhārtā bhartāraṁ duḥkhitaṁ tadā ॥5॥
12.145.6: hanta vakṣyāmi te śreyaḥ śrutvā tu kuru tat tathā ॥6॥
12.145.7: eṣa śākunikaḥ śete tava vāsaṁ samāśritaḥ ॥7॥
12.145.8: yo hi kaścid dvijaṁ hanyād gāṁ ca lokasya mātaram ॥8॥
12.145.9: śaraṇāgataṁ ca yo hanyāt tulyaṁ teṣāṁ ca pātakam,
12.145.11: sa tvaṁ santānavānadya putravānasi ca dvija ॥11॥
12.145.12: tat svadehe dayāṁ tyaktvā dharmārthau parigr̥hya ca,
pūjāmasmai prayuṅkṣva tvaṁ prīyetāsya mano yathā ॥12॥
12.145.13: matkr̥te mā ca santāpaṁ kurvīthāstvaṁ vihaṅgama,
12.145.14: iti sā śakunī vākyaṁ pañjarasthā tapasvinī,
12.145.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi kapotaṁ prati kapotīvākye pañcacacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥145॥
12.146.2: taṁ vai śākunikaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā vidhidr̥ṣṭena karmaṇā,
sa pakṣī pūjayāmāsa yatnāt taṁ pakṣijīvinam ॥2॥
12.146.3: uvāca svāgataṁ te’dya brūhi kiṁ karavāṇi te,
santāpaśca na kartavyaḥ svagr̥he vartate bhavān ॥3॥
12.146.4: tad bravītu bhavān kṣipraṁ kiṁ karomi kimicchasi,
praṇayena bravīmi tvāṁ tvaṁ hi naḥ śaraṇāgataḥ ॥4॥
12.146.7: tasya nāyaṁ na ca paro loko bhavati dharmataḥ ॥7॥
12.146.8: tad brūhi māṁ suviśrabdho yat tvaṁ vācā vadiṣyasi,
tat kariṣyāmyahaṁ sarvaṁ mā tvaṁ śoke manaḥ kr̥thāḥ ॥8॥
12.146.9: bādhate khalu me śītaṁ santrāṇaṁ hi vidhīyatām ॥9॥
12.146.10: yathāśaktyā hi parṇena jvalanārthaṁ drutaṁ yayau ॥10॥
12.146.12: sa sandīptaṁ mahat kr̥tvā tamāha śaraṇāgatam,
12.146.15: dattamāhāramicchāmi tvayā kṣud bādhate hi mām,
12.146.16: na me’sti vibhavo yena nāśayeyaṁ kṣudhāṁ tava,
utpannena hi jīvāmo vayaṁ nityaṁ vanaukasaḥ ॥16॥
12.146.21: r̥ṣīṇāṁ devatānāṁ ca pitr̥̄ṇāṁ ca mahātmanām,
12.146.23: tataḥ kr̥tapratijño vai sa pakṣī prahasanniva,
12.146.24: agnimadhye praviṣṭaṁ tu lubdho dr̥ṣṭvā tu pakṣiṇam,
cintayāmāsa manasā kimidaṁ vai mayā kr̥tam ॥24॥
12.146.25: adharmaḥ sumahān ghoro bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ ॥25॥
12.146.26: evaṁ bahuvidhaṁ bhūri vilalāpa sa lubdhakaḥ,
garhayan svāni karmāṇi dvijaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tathāgatam ॥26॥
12.146.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi kapotalubdhakasaṁvāde ṣaṭcatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥146॥
12.147.1: tataḥ sa lubdhakaḥ paśyan kṣudhayāpi pariplutaḥ,
12.147.2: bhaviṣyati hi me nityaṁ pātakaṁ kr̥tajīvinaḥ ॥2॥
12.147.5: so’haṁ tyakṣye priyān prāṇān putrān dārāṁstathaiva ca ॥5॥
12.147.6: upadiṣṭo hi me dharmaḥ kapotena mahātmanā,
12.147.7: yathā svalpaṁ saro grīṣme śoṣayiṣyāmyahaṁ tathā,
12.147.9: tasmād dharmaṁ cariṣyāmi dharmo hi paramā gatiḥ,
dr̥ṣṭo dharmo hi dharmiṣṭhe yādr̥śo vihagottame ॥9॥
12.147.11: tato yaṣṭiṁ śalākāṁ ca kṣārakaṁ pañjaraṁ tathā,
tāṁ ca baddhāṁ kapotīṁ sa pramucya visasarja ha ॥11॥
12.147.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi lubdhakoparatau saptacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥147॥
12.148.1: tato gate śākunike kapotī prāha duḥkhitā,
saṁsmr̥tya sā ca bhartāraṁ rudatī śokakarśitā ॥1॥
12.148.2: nāhaṁ te vipriyaṁ kānta kadācidapi saṁsmare,
12.148.4: kandareṣu ca śailānāṁ nadīnāṁ nirjhareṣu ca ॥4॥
12.148.5: drumāgreṣu ca ramyeṣu ramitāhaṁ tvayā saha,
12.148.6: ramāmi sma purā kānta tanme nāstyadya kiñcana,
mitaṁ dadāti hi pitā mitaṁ bhrātā mitaṁ sutaḥ ॥6॥
12.148.7: amitasya hi dātāraṁ bhartāraṁ kā na pūjayet,
nāsti bhartr̥samo nātho nāsti bhartr̥samaṁ sukham ॥7॥
12.148.8: visr̥jya dhanasarvasvaṁ bhartā vai śaraṇaṁ striyāḥ,
na kāryamiha me nātha jīvitena tvayā vinā ॥8॥
12.148.9: patihīnā tu kā nārī satī jīvitumutsahet,
evaṁ vilapya bahudhā karuṇaṁ sā suduḥkhitā ॥9॥
12.148.12: karmaṇā pūjitastatra reme sa saha bhāryayā ॥12॥
12.148.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi kapotasvargagamane aṣṭacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥148॥
12.149.1: vimānasthau tu tau rājan lubdhakaḥ khe dadarśa ha,
dr̥ṣṭvā tau dampatī rājan vyacintayata tāṁ gatim ॥1॥
12.149.5: pipāsārto’pi tad dr̥ṣṭvā tr̥ptaḥ syānnātra saṁśayaḥ,
12.149.6: mahāntaṁ niścayaṁ kr̥tvā lubdhakaḥ praviveśa ha ॥6॥
12.149.8: tato drumāṇāṁ mahatā pavanena vane tadā ॥8॥
12.149.14: evaṁ khalu kapotaśca kapotī ca pativratā,
lubdhakena saha svargaṁ gatāḥ puṇyena karmaṇā ॥14॥
12.149.15: virājate hi sā kṣipraṁ kapotīva divi sthitā ॥15॥
12.149.16: kapotasya ca dharmiṣṭhā gatiḥ puṇyena karmaṇā ॥16॥
12.149.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi lubdhakasvargagamane ekonapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥149॥
12.150.1: mucyate sa kathaṁ tasmādetat sarvaṁ vadasva me ॥1॥
12.150.4: sa jagāma vanaṁ rājā dahyamāno divāniśam ॥4॥
12.150.6: paryaṭan pr̥thivīṁ kr̥tsnāṁ deśo deśe narādhipaḥ ॥6॥
12.150.9: r̥ṣirdr̥ṣṭvā nr̥paṁ tatra jagarhe subhr̥śaṁ tadā,
12.150.10: kiṁ tvayāsmāsu kartavyaṁ mā māṁ sprākṣīḥ kathañcana,
gaccha gaccha na te sthānaṁ prīṇātyasmāniti bruvan ॥10॥
12.150.11: rudhirasyeva te gandhaḥ śavasyeva ca darśanam,
12.150.13: moghaṁ te jīvitaṁ rājan parikliṣṭaṁ ca jīvasi,
pāpāyaiva hi sr̥ṣṭo’si karmaṇe hi yavīyase ॥13॥
12.150.16: teṣu tvaṁ satataṁ dveṣṭā brāhmaṇeṣu nirarthakaḥ ॥16॥
12.150.19: yadidaṁ manyase rājan nāyamasti kutaḥ paraḥ,
12.150.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi indrotapārikṣitīyasaṁvāde pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥150॥
12.151.1: garhyaṁ bhavān garhayate nindyaṁ nindati māṁ punaḥ ॥1॥
12.151.2: dhikkāryaṁ māṁ dhikkurute tasmāt tvāhaṁ prasādaye,
12.151.3: prāpya ghoraṁ bhayaṁ nūnaṁ mayā vaivasvatādapi ॥3॥
12.151.4: sarvaṁ manyuṁ vinīya tvamabhi māṁ vada śaunaka ॥4॥
12.151.5: astu śeṣaṁ kulasyāsya mā parābhūdidaṁ kulam ॥5॥
12.151.6: na hi no brahmaśaptānāṁ śeṣaṁ bhavitumarhati,
12.151.8: na hyayajñā amuṁ lokaṁ prāpnuvanti kathañcana,
12.151.9: avijñāyaiva me prajñāṁ bālasyeva sa paṇḍitaḥ,
brahman piteva putrasya prītimān bhava śaunaka ॥9॥
12.151.10: iti vai paṇḍito bhūtvā bhūtānāṁ nānukupyate ॥10॥
12.151.12: na copalabhyate tena na cāścaryāṇi kurvate,
12.151.13: viditaṁ bhavato vīryaṁ māhātmyaṁ veda āgame,
12.151.15: anutapye ca pāpena na ca dharmaṁ vilopaye,
bubhūṣuṁ bhajamānaṁ ca prītimān bhava śaunaka ॥15॥
12.151.16: chittvāṁ dambhaṁ ca mānaṁ ca prītimicchāmi te nr̥pa,
12.151.17: na bhayānna ca kārpaṇyānna lobhāt tvāmupāhvaye,
tāṁ me daivīṁ giraṁ satyāṁ śr̥ṇu tvaṁ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha ॥17॥
12.151.18: so’haṁ na kenaciccārthī tvāṁ ca dharmādupāhvaye,
12.151.19: tā vācaḥ suhr̥daḥ śrutvā sañjvariṣyanti me bhr̥śam ॥19॥
12.151.20: jānīhi matkr̥taṁ tāta brāhmaṇān prati bhārata ॥20॥
12.151.21: yathā te matkr̥te kṣemaṁ labhante te tathā kuru,
12.151.22: naiva vācā na manasā punarjātu na karmaṇā,
drogdhāsmi brāhmaṇān vipra caraṇāvapi te spr̥śe ॥22॥
12.151.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi indrotapārikṣitīye ekapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥151॥
12.152.3: kr̥tsnaṁ nūnaṁ sa dahati iti loko vyavasyati,
12.152.4: hitvā tu suciraṁ bhakṣyaṁ bhojyāṁśca tapa āsthitaḥ,
12.152.5: yo’durlabho bhaved dātā kr̥paṇo vā tapodhanaḥ,
12.152.6: yaccet samīkṣayaiva syād bhavet tasmiṁstato guṇaḥ ॥6॥
12.152.7: yajño dānaṁ dayā vedāḥ satyaṁ ca pr̥thivīpate,
12.152.12: yatrāvagāhya pītvā ca nainaṁ śvomaraṇaṁ tapet,
12.152.15: yathā kumāraḥ satyo vai naiva puṇyo na pāpakr̥t ॥15॥
12.152.16: na hyasti sarvabhūteṣu duḥkhamasmin kutaḥ sukham,
12.152.17: yattveva rājño jyāyiṣṭhaṁ kāryāṇāṁ tad bravīmi te ॥17॥
12.152.19: brāhmaṇānāṁ sukhārthaṁ hi tvaṁ pāhi vasudhāṁ nr̥pa,
12.152.25: ye sugandhīni sevante tathāgandhā bhavanti te ॥25॥
12.152.26: ye durgandhīni sevate tathāgandhā bhavanti te,
12.152.31: tat kṣipraṁ nudate pāpaṁ satkāraṁ labhate tathā,
12.152.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi indrotapārikṣitīye dvipañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥152॥
12.153.6: taṁ bālaṁ bhūtale kṣipya pratigantuṁ na śaknuyuḥ ॥6॥
12.153.7: ekātmajamimaṁ loke tyaktvā gacchata mā ciram ॥7॥
12.153.8: iha puṁsāṁ sahasrāṇi strīsahasrāṇi caiva ha,
samānītāni kālena hitvā vai yānti bāndhavāḥ ॥8॥
12.153.10: gr̥hītvā ye ca gacchanti ye na yānti ca tān mr̥tān,
12.153.12: priyo vā yadi vā dveṣyaḥ prāṇināṁ gatirīdr̥śī ॥12॥
12.153.18: gacchamānān sma tānāha nirghr̥ṇāḥ khalu mānuṣāḥ ॥18॥
12.153.19: ādityo’yaṁ sthito mūṛhāḥ snehaṁ kuruta mā bhayam,
12.153.21: na vo’styasmin sute sneho bāle madhurabhāṣiṇi,
12.153.22: na teṣāṁ dhārayitvā tān kaścidasti phalāgamaḥ ॥22॥
12.153.24: na guṇo dr̥śyate kaścit prajāḥ sandhārayanti ca ॥24॥
12.153.25: apaśyatāṁ priyān putrāṁsteṣāṁ śoko na tiṣṭhati,
na ca puṣṇanti saṁvr̥ddhāste mātāpitarau kvacit ॥25॥
12.153.26: mānuṣāṇāṁ kutaḥ sneho yeṣāṁ śoko bhaviṣyati,
imaṁ kulakaraṁ putraṁ tyaktvā kva nu gamiṣyatha ॥26॥
12.153.27: ciraṁ muñcata bāṣpaṁ ca ciraṁ snehena paśyata,
12.153.29: sarvasya dayitāḥ prāṇāḥ sarvaḥ snehaṁ ca vindati,
12.153.31: nyavartanta tadā sarve śavārthaṁ te sma mānuṣāḥ ॥31॥
12.153.34: tapaḥ kuruta vai tīvraṁ mucyadhvaṁ yena kilbiṣāt,
tapasā labhyate sarvaṁ vilāpaḥ kiṁ kariṣyati ॥34॥
12.153.35: aniṣṭāni ca bhāgyāni jātāni saha mūrtinā,
12.153.36: dhanaṁ gāvaḥ suvarṇaṁ ca maṇiratnamathāpi ca,
12.153.37: gr̥hītvā jāyate janturduḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ॥37॥
12.153.38: na karmaṇā pituḥ putraḥ pitā vā putrakarmaṇā,
12.153.39: dharmaṁ carata yatnena na cādharme manaḥ kr̥thāḥ,
vartadhvaṁ ca yathākālaṁ daivateṣu dvijeṣu ca ॥39॥
12.153.41: yat karoti śubhaṁ karma tathā karma sudāruṇam,
tat kartaiva samaśnāti bāndhavānāṁ kimatra ha ॥41॥
12.153.42: iha tyaktvā na tiṣṭhanti bāndhavā bāndhavaṁ priyam,
12.153.43: prājño vā yadi vā mūrkhaḥ sadhano nirdhano’pi vā,
12.153.44: sarvasya hi prabhuḥ kālo dharmataḥ samadarśanaḥ ॥44॥
12.153.50: yatno hi satataṁ kāryastato daivena siddhyati,
12.153.51: anirvedaḥ sadā kāryo nirvedāddhi kutaḥ sukham,
prayatnāt prāpyate hyarthaḥ kasmād gacchatha nirdayam ॥51॥
12.153.52: pitr̥̄ṇāṁ vaṁśakartāraṁ vane tyaktvā kva yāsyatha ॥52॥
12.153.53: tato neṣyatha vā putramihasthā vā bhaviṣyatha ॥53॥
12.153.54: adya varṣasahasraṁ me sāgraṁ jātasya mānuṣāḥ,
na ca paśyāmi jīvantaṁ mr̥taṁ strīpuṁnapuṁsakam ॥54॥
12.153.55: mr̥tā garbheṣu jāyante jātamātrā mriyanti ca,
12.153.57: dahyamānāḥ sma śokena gr̥haṁ gacchanti nityaśaḥ ॥57॥
12.153.61: cakṣurbhyāṁ na ca karṇābhyāṁ saṁśr̥ṇoti samīkṣate,
kasmādenaṁ samutsr̥jya na gr̥hān gacchatāśu vai ॥61॥
12.153.62: mayoktā gacchata kṣipraṁ svaṁ svameva niveśanam ॥62॥
12.153.63: śoko dviguṇatāṁ yāti dr̥ṣṭvā smr̥tvā ca ceṣṭitam ॥63॥
12.153.64: apaśyat taṁ tadā suptaṁ drutamāgatya jambukaḥ ॥64॥
12.153.66: na snehasya ca vicchedo vilāparuditasya ca,
mr̥tasyāsya parityāgāt tāpo vai bhavitā dhruvam ॥66॥
12.153.69: tathā kaścillabhet siddho munirvā devatāpi vā,
12.153.73: dināni caiva rātrīśca duḥkhaṁ tiṣṭhanti bhūtale ॥73॥
12.153.76: atha rudraḥ kumāro vā brahmā vā viṣṇureva ca ॥76॥
12.153.77: naiva bāṣpavimokṣeṇa na vā śvāsakr̥te na ca ॥77॥
12.153.78: ahaṁ ca kroṣṭukaścaiva yūyaṁ ye cāsya bāndhavāḥ ॥78॥
12.153.80: dharmaṁ satyaṁ śrutaṁ nyāyyaṁ mahatīṁ prāṇināṁ dayām ॥80॥
12.153.82: jīvato ye na paśyanti teṣāṁ dharmaviparyayaḥ,
yo na paśyati cakṣurbhyāṁ neṅgate ca kathañcana ॥82॥
12.153.87: kathaṁ gacchata niḥsnehāḥ sutasnehaṁ visr̥jya ca,
12.153.90: kulaśobhākaraṁ mūḍhāḥ putraṁ tyaktvā kva yāsyatha,
12.153.91: vināśo nāsya na hi vai sukhaṁ prāpsyatha mānuṣāḥ ॥91॥
12.153.98: nadanti paruṣaṁ śyenāḥ śivāḥ krośanti dāruṇam,
12.153.103: sthīyatāṁ neha bhetavyaṁ yāvat tapati bhāskaraḥ,
12.153.104d1: dāruṇe’smin vanoddeśe bhayaṁ vo na bhaviṣyati,
12.153.105: yadi gr̥dhrasya vākyāni tīvrāṇi rabhasāni ca,
gr̥hṇīta mohitātmānaḥ suto vo na bhaviṣyati ॥105॥
12.153.106: gr̥dhro’stamityāha gato gato neti ca jambukaḥ,
12.153.112: te pratyūcuridaṁ vākyaṁ duḥkhitāḥ praṇatāḥ sthitāḥ,
12.153.114: jīvitaṁ sma kumārāya prādād varṣaśatāni vai,
12.153.115: tataḥ praṇamya te devaṁ prāyo harṣasamanvitāḥ ॥115॥
12.153.116: kr̥takr̥tyāḥ sukhaṁ hr̥ṣṭāḥ prātiṣṭhanta tadā vibho,
12.153.117: paśya daivasya saṁyogaṁ bāndhavānāṁ ca niścayam ॥117॥
12.153.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi gr̥dhragomāyusaṁvāde kumārasañjīvane tripañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥153॥
12.154.9: tasya tā vipulāḥ śākhā dr̥ṣṭvā skandhaṁ ca sarvaśaḥ,
12.154.12: na vai prabhagnān paśyāmi mārutena kathañcana ॥12॥
12.154.13: kiṁ nu te pavanastāta prītimānathavā suhr̥t,
tvāṁ rakṣati sadā yena vane’tra pavano dhruvam ॥13॥
12.154.16: saṁrakṣati tvāṁ pavanaḥ sakhitvena na saṁśayaḥ,
12.154.17: idaṁ ca ramaṇīyaṁ te pratibhāti vanaspate,
12.154.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi pavanaśālmalisaṁvāde catuṣpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥154॥
12.155.3: na taṁ paśyāmyahaṁ vr̥kṣaṁ parvataṁ veśma cedr̥śam,
yaṁ na vāyubalād bhagnaṁ pr̥thivyāmiti me matiḥ ॥3॥
12.155.4: tvaṁ punaḥ kāraṇairnūnaṁ rakṣyase śālmale yathā,
12.155.5: na me vāyuḥ sakhā brahman na bandhurna ca me suhr̥t,
parameṣṭhī tathā naiva yena rakṣati vānilaḥ ॥5॥
12.155.6: mama tejo balaṁ bhīmaṁ vāyorapi hi nārada,
12.155.8: sa mayā bahuśo bhagnaḥ prabhañjan vai prabhañjanaḥ,
12.155.9: śālmale viparītaṁ te darśanaṁ nātra saṁśayaḥ,
na hi vāyorbalenāsti bhūtaṁ tulyabalaṁ kvacit ॥9॥
12.155.10: naite’pi tulyā marutaḥ kiṁ punastvaṁ vanaspate ॥10॥
12.155.11: yacca kiñcidiha prāṇī ceṣṭate śālmale bhuvi,
12.155.13: na pūjayasi pūjyaṁ taṁ kimanyad buddhilāghavāt ॥13॥
12.155.17: taiścāpi naivaṁ durbuddhe kṣipto vāyuḥ kr̥tātmabhiḥ,
te’pi jānanti vāyośca balamātmana eva ca ॥17॥
12.155.18: tasmāt taṁ vai namasyanti śvasanaṁ tarusattamāḥ,
12.155.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi pavanaśālmalisaṁvāde pañcapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥155॥
12.156.3: na yuktāni mayā vāyo tāni vaktuṁ tavāgrataḥ ॥3॥
12.156.4: variṣṭhaṁ ca gariṣṭhaṁ ca krodhe vaivasvataṁ yathā ॥4॥
12.156.5: etat tu vacanaṁ śrutvā nāradasya samīraṇaḥ,
12.156.6: ahaṁ vāyuḥ prabhāvaṁ te darśayāmyātmano balam ॥6॥
12.156.10: pavana tvaṁ ca me kruddho darśayātmānamātmanā ॥10॥
12.156.11: mayi vai tyajyatāṁ krodhaḥ kiṁ me kruddhaḥ kariṣyasi,
na te bibhemi pavana yadyapi tvaṁ svayaṁ prabhuḥ ॥11॥
12.156.12: balādhiko’haṁ tvattaśca na bhīḥ kāryā mayā tava,
ye tu buddhyā hi balinaste bhavanti balīyasaḥ ॥12॥
12.156.13: prāṇamātrabalā ye vai naiva te balino matāḥ,
12.156.15: nārade yanmayā proktaṁ vacanaṁ prati tanmr̥ṣā ॥15॥
12.156.16: asamartho hyahaṁ vāyorbalena balavān hi saḥ,
māruto balavān nityaṁ yathā vai nārado’bravīt ॥16॥
12.156.17: ahaṁ tu durbalo’nyebhyo vr̥kṣebhyo nātra saṁśayaḥ,
kiṁ tu buddhyā samo nāsti mayā kaścid vanaspatiḥ ॥17॥
12.156.18: yadi tāṁ buddhimāsthāya tiṣṭheyuḥ parṇino vane ॥18॥
12.156.19: ariṣṭāḥ syuḥ sadā kuddhāt pavanānnātra saṁśayaḥ,
te tu bālā na jānanti yathā vai tān samīraṇaḥ,
12.156.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi pavanaśālmalisaṁvāde ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥156॥
12.157.2: sa parityajya śākhāśca patrāṇi kusumāni ca,
12.157.3: tataḥ kruddhaḥ śvasan vāyuḥ pātayan vai mahādrumān,
ājagāmātha taṁ deśamāste yatra sa śālmaliḥ ॥3॥
12.157.7: atapyata vacaḥ smr̥tvā nārado yat tadābravīt ॥7॥
12.157.8: evaṁ hi rājaśārdūla durbalaḥ san balīyasā,
12.157.9: tasmād vairaṁ na kurvīta durbalo balavattaraiḥ,
śoceddhi vairaṁ kurvāṇo yathā vai śālmalistathā ॥9॥
12.157.10: śanaiḥ śanairmahārāja darśayanti sma te balam ॥10॥
12.157.12: na hi buddhyā sama kiñcid vidyate puruṣe nr̥pa,
tathā balena rājendra na samo’stīha kaścana ॥12॥
12.157.13: balādhikāya rājendra tad dr̥ṣṭaṁ tvayi śatruhan ॥13॥
12.157.14: akṣauhiṇyo daśaikā ca sapta caiva mahādyute,
12.157.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi pavanaśālmalisaṁvāde saptapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥157॥
12.158.2: eko lobho mahāgrāho lobhāt pāpaṁ pravartate ॥2॥
12.158.4: lobhāt krodhaḥ prabhavati lobhāt kāmaḥ pravartate,
lobhānmohaśca māyā ca mānaḥ stambhaḥ parāsutā ॥4॥
12.158.11: jātau bālye ca kaumāre yauvane cāpi mānavāḥ ॥11॥
12.158.12: na santyajantyātmakarma yo na jīryati jīryataḥ,
yo na pūrayituṁ śakyo lobhaḥ prāptyā kurūdvaha ॥12॥
12.158.13: na prahr̥ṣyati yo lābhaiḥ kāmairyaśca na tr̥pyati ॥13॥
12.158.15: sa lobhaḥ saha mohena vijetavyo jitātmanā,
dambho drohaśca nindā ca paiśunyaṁ matsarastathā ॥15॥
12.158.20: yā yā vikriyate saṁsthā tataḥ sāpi prapadyate ॥20॥
12.158.21: darpaḥ krodho madaḥ svapno harṣaḥ śoko’timānitā,
eta eva hi kauravya dr̥śyante lubdhabuddhiṣu ॥21॥
12.158.24: śiṣṭācāraḥ priyo yeṣu damo yeṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ,
sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ samaṁ yeṣāṁ satyaṁ yeṣāṁ parāyaṇam ॥24॥
12.158.27: na teṣāṁ bhidyate vr̥ttaṁ yatpurā sādhubhiḥ kr̥tam ॥27॥
12.158.28: na trāsino na capalā na raudrāḥ satyathe sthitāḥ,
12.158.30: na dhanārthaṁ yaśo’rthaṁ vā dharmasteṣāṁ yudhiṣṭhira,
12.158.31: na bhayaṁ krodhacāpalye na śokasteṣu vidyate,
12.158.32: teṣu kaunteya rajyethā yeṣāṁ na bhraśyate punaḥ ॥32॥
12.158.33: ye na hr̥ṣyanti lābheṣu nālābheṣu vyathanti ca,
12.158.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi āpanmūlabhūtadoṣakathane aṣṭapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥158॥
12.159.2: karoti pāpaṁ yo’jñānānnātmano vetti ca kṣayam,
12.159.4: mūlaṁ yogaṁ gatiṁ kālaṁ kāraṇaṁ hetumeva ca ॥4॥
12.159.6: kāmaḥ krodhaśca darpaśca tandrī cālasyameva ca ॥6॥
12.159.10: sthāne sthānaṁ kṣaye kṣaiṇyamupaiti vividhāṁ gatim ॥10॥
12.159.11: mūlaṁ lobhasya moho vai kālātmagatireva ca,
chine bhinne tathā lobhe kāraṇaṁ kāla eva ca ॥11॥
12.159.14: tyaktvā lobhaṁ sukhaṁ loke pretya cānucariṣyasi ॥14॥
12.159.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi ajñānamāhātmye ekonaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥159॥
12.160.1: dharmakāmasya dharmātman kiṁ nu śreya ihocyate ॥1॥
12.160.2: bahudhā darśane loke śreyo yadiha manyase,
asmillom̐ke pare caiva tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
12.160.4: yanmūlaṁ paramaṁ tāta tat sarvaṁ brūhyaśeṣataḥ ॥4॥
12.160.5: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi yena śreyo hyavāpsyasi,
12.160.6: dharmasya vidhayo naike ye vai proktā maharṣibhiḥ,
12.160.9: damastejo vardhayati pavitraṁ ca damaḥ param,
vipāpmā tejasā yuktaḥ puruṣo vindate mahat ॥9॥
12.160.9d1: damena sadr̥śaṁ dharmaṁ nānyaṁ lokeṣu śuśruma.
12.160.10: damo hi paramo loke praśastaḥ sarvadharmiṇām ॥10॥
12.160.11: pretya cātra manuṣyendra paramaṁ vindate sukham,
12.160.12: sukhaṁ dāntaḥ prasvapiti sukhaṁ ca pratibudhyate,
12.160.14: tasya liṅgāni vakṣyāmi yeṣāṁ samudayo damaḥ ॥14॥
12.160.18: kāmaṁ krodhaṁ ca lobhaṁ ca darpaṁ stambhaṁ vikatthanam,
12.160.19: samudrakalpaḥ sa naro na kathañcana pūryate ॥19॥
12.160.20: ahaṁ tvayi mayi tvaṁ ca mayi te teṣu cāpyaham,
12.160.21: nindāṁ caiva praśaṁsāṁ ca yo nāśrayati mucyate ॥21॥
12.160.22: muktasya vividhaiḥ saṅgaistasya pretya phalaṁ mahat ॥22॥
12.160.26: tasya dehād vimuktasya bhayaṁ nāsti kutaścana ॥26॥
12.160.27: avācinoti karmāṇi na ca sampracinoti ha,
12.160.28: yathā gatine dr̥śyeta tathā tasya na saṁśayaḥ ॥28॥
12.160.30: saṁnyasya vividhā vidyāḥ sarvaṁ saṁnyasya caiva ha ॥30॥
12.160.34: eka eva dame doṣo dvitīyo nopapadyate,
12.160.35: eko’sya sumahāprājña doṣaḥ syāt sumahān guṇaḥ,
kṣamayā vipulā lokāḥ sulabhā hi sahiṣṇutā ॥35॥
12.160.37: etad bhīṣmasya vacanaṁ śrutvā rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
12.160.38: tapaḥ prati sa covāca tasmai sarvaṁ kurūdvaha ॥38॥
12.160.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi damakathane ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥160॥
12.161.4: tapasaiva hi siddhyanti tapomūlaṁ hi sādhanam ॥4॥
12.161.5: yad durāpaṁ bhavet kiñcit tat sarvaṁ tapaso bhavet,
12.161.8: etebhyo hi mahārāja tapo nānaśanāt param ॥8॥
12.161.9: traividyebhyaḥ paraṁ nāsti saṁnyāsaḥ paramaṁ tapaḥ ॥9॥
12.161.10: tasmādarthe ca dharme ca tapo nānaśanāt param ॥10॥
12.161.11: yāni cānyāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ॥11॥
12.161.12: tapaḥ parāyaṇāḥ sarve siddhyanti tapasā ca te,
12.162.2: satyaṁ kiṁ lakṣaṇaṁ rājan kathaṁ vā tadavāpyate,
satyaṁ prāpya bhavet kiṁ ca kathaṁ caiva taducyatām ॥2॥
12.162.4: satyaṁ satsu sadā dharmaḥ satyaṁ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ,
satyameva namasyeta satyaṁ hi paramā gatiḥ ॥4॥
12.162.5: satyaṁ dharmastapo yogaḥ satyaṁ brahma sanātanam,
satyaṁ yajñaḥ paraḥ proktaḥ sarvaṁ satye pratiṣṭhitam ॥5॥
12.162.7: prāpyate ca yathā satyaṁ tacca śrotumihārhasi,
12.162.8: satyaṁ ca samatā caiva damaścaiva na saṁśayaḥ,
12.162.11: ātmanīṣṭe tathāniṣṭe ripau ca samatā tathā,
12.162.12: damo nānyaspr̥hā nityaṁ gāmbhīryaṁ dhairyameva ca,
12.162.13: amātsaryaṁ budhāḥ prāhurdāne dharme ca saṁyamaḥ,
12.162.14: kṣamate sammataḥ sādhuḥ sādhvāpnoti ca satyavāk ॥14॥
12.162.15: kalyāṇaṁ kurute bāḍhaṁ dhīmān na glāyate kvacit,
12.162.16: lokasaṅgrahaṇārthaṁ vai sā tu dhairyeṇa labhyate ॥16॥
12.162.17: tyāgaḥ snehasya yat tyāgo viṣayāṇāṁ tathaiva ca,
12.162.18: āryatā nāma bhūtānāṁ yaḥ karoti prayatnataḥ,
12.162.19: dhr̥tirnāma sukhe duḥkhe yathā nāpnoti vikriyām,
tā bhajeta sadā prājño ya icched bhūtimātmanaḥ ॥19॥
12.162.20: sarvathā kṣamiṇā bhāvyaṁ tathā satyapareṇa ca,
12.162.21: anugrahaśca dānaṁ ca satāṁ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥21॥
12.162.23: nāntaḥ śakyo guṇānāṁ ca vaktuṁ satyasya pārthiva,
12.162.24: nāsti satyāt paro dharmo nānr̥tāt pātakaṁ param,
sthitirhi satyaṁ dharmasya tasmāt satyaṁ na lopayet ॥24॥
12.162.25: upaiti satyād dānaṁ hi tathā yajñāḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ,
12.162.26: aśvamedhasahasraṁ ca satyaṁ ca tulayā dhr̥tam,
12.162.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi satyapraśaṁsāyāṁ dviṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥162॥
12.163.1: yataḥ prabhavati krodhaḥ kāmo vā bharatarṣabha,
śokamohau vidhitsā ca parāsutvaṁ tathā madaḥ ॥1॥
12.163.2: lobho mātsaryamīrṣyā ca kutsāsūyā kr̥pā tathā,
etat sarvaṁ mahāprājña yāthātathyena me vada ॥2॥
12.163.4: vr̥kā iva vilumpanti dr̥ṣṭvaiva puruṣaṁ balāt ॥4॥
12.163.9: yadā prājño viramate tadā sadyaḥ praṇaśyati,
12.163.11: yadā prājñeṣu ramate tadā sadyaḥ praṇaśyati ॥11॥
12.163.13: prītyā śokaḥ prabhavati viyogāt tasya dehinaḥ,
yadā nirarthakaṁ vetti tadā sadyaḥ praṇaśyati ॥13॥
12.163.16: ebhireva tu vijñātaiḥ sa ca sadyaḥ praṇaśyati ॥16॥
12.163.17: itareṣāṁ tu sattvānāṁ prajñayā sā praṇaśyati ॥17॥
12.163.20: kr̥paṇān satataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tataḥ sañjāyate kr̥pā,
dharmaniṣṭhāṁ yadā vetti tadā śāmyati sā kr̥pā ॥20॥
12.163.21: asthiratvaṁ ca bhogānāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā jñātvā nivartate ॥21॥
12.163.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi lobhanirūpaṇe triṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥163॥
12.164.1: nr̥śaṁsānna vijānāmi teṣāṁ karma ca bhārata ॥1॥
12.164.2: kaṇṭakān kūpamagniṁ ca varjayanti yathā narāḥ,
12.164.3: nr̥śaṁso dahyate nityaṁ pretya ceha ca bhārata,
tasmāt tvaṁ brūhi kauravya tasya dharmaviniścayam ॥3॥
12.164.4: spr̥hā syād garhitā caiva vidhitsā caiva karmaṇām,
ākroṣṭā kruśyate caiva vañcito buddhyate sa ca ॥4॥
12.164.5: asaṁvibhāgī mānī ca tathā saṅgī vikatthanaḥ ॥5॥
12.164.9: pareṣāṁ yatra doṣaḥ syāt tad guhyaṁ samprakāśayet,
12.164.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi nr̥śaṁsākhyāne catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥164॥
12.165.2: ete vai sādhavo dr̥ṣṭā brāhmaṇā dharmabhikṣavaḥ,
niḥsvebhyo deyametebhyo dānaṁ vidyā ca bhārata ॥2॥
12.165.5: adhikaṁ cāpi vidyeta sa somaṁ pātumarhati ॥5॥
12.165.7: kuṭumbāt tasya tad vittaṁ yajñārthaṁ pārthivo haret ॥7॥
12.165.8: āharedatha no kiñcit kāmaṁ śūdrasya veśmanaḥ,
na hi yajñeṣu śūdrasya kiñcidasti parigrahaḥ ॥8॥
12.165.10: adātr̥bhyo hared vittaṁ vikhyāpya nr̥patiḥ sadā,
12.165.11: tathaiva śr̥ṇu me bhaktaṁ bhaktāni ṣaḍanaśnataḥ,
12.165.12: khalāt kṣetrāt tathā rāmād yato vāpyupapadyate,
12.165.13: na tasmai dhārayed daṇḍaṁ rājā dharmeṇa dharmavit,
kṣatriyasya tu bāliśyād brāhmaṇaḥ kliśyate kṣudhā ॥13॥
12.165.18: na brāhmaṇo nivedeta kiñcid rājani vedavit,
12.165.19: tasmād rājñaḥ sadā tejo duḥsahaṁ brahmavādinām,
kartā śāstā vidhātā ca brāhmaṇo deva ucyate ॥19॥
12.165.21: naiva kanyā na yuvatirnāmantrajño na bāliśaḥ ॥21॥
12.165.22: narakaṁ nipatantyete juhvānāḥ sa ca yasya tat,
12.165.25: prajāḥ paśūṁśca svargaṁ ca hanti yajño hyadakṣiṇaḥ,
12.165.26: homaṁ cāśrotriyaṁ yeṣāṁ te sarve pāpakarmiṇaḥ ॥26॥
12.165.28: abhāryāṁ śayane bibhracchūdraṁ vr̥ddhaṁ ca vai dvijaḥ,
tathā saṁśudhyate rājan śr̥ṇu cātra vaco mama ॥28॥
12.165.32: adūṣyā hi striyo ratnamāpa ityeva dharmataḥ ॥32॥
12.165.39: triṣu tveteṣu pūrveṣu na kurvīta vicāraṇām ॥39॥
12.165.40: amātyān vā gurūn vāpi jahyād dharmeṇa dhārmikaḥ,
12.165.41: bruvan stena iti stenaṁ tāvat prāpnoti kilbiṣam ॥41॥
12.165.43: yastu dūṣayitā tasyāḥ śeṣaṁ prāpnoti pāpmanaḥ,
12.165.44: varṣāṇāṁ hi śataṁ tāvat pratiṣṭhāṁ nādhigacchati,
sahasraṁ caiva varṣāṇāṁ nipatya narakaṁ vaset ॥44॥
12.165.46: tāvatīḥ sa samā rājan narake pratipadyate,
12.165.48: tayā sa kāye nirdagdhe mr̥tyuṁ vā prāpya śuddhyati,
lokāṁśca labhate vipro nānyathā labhate hi saḥ ॥48॥
12.165.51: brāhmaṇārthe’pi vā prāṇān santyajet tena śuddhyati ॥51॥
12.165.52: agniṣṭomena vā samyagiha pretya ca pūjyate ॥52॥
12.165.54: evaṁ vā tapasā yukto brahmahā savanī bhavet,
12.165.57: vaiśyaṁ hatvā tu varṣe dve r̥ṣabhaikaśataṁ ca gāḥ,
śūdraṁ hatvābdamevaikamr̥ṣabhaṁ ca śataṁ ca gāḥ ॥57॥
12.165.60: alpe vāpyatha śoceta pr̥thak saṁvatsaraṁ caret,
trīṇi śrotriyabhāryāyāṁ paradāre ca dve smr̥te ॥60॥
12.165.61: kāle caturthe bhuñjāno brahmacārī vratī bhavet,
12.165.62: patitaḥ syātsa kauravya yathā dharmeṣu niścayaḥ ॥62॥
12.165.63: yat puṁsaḥ paradāreṣu tadenāṁ cārayed vratama ॥63॥
12.165.64: śreyāṁsaṁ śayanaṁ hitvā yā’nyaṁ pāpaṁ nigacchati,
12.165.67: dve tasya trīṇi varṣāṇi catvāri sahasevini,
12.165.69: careyuḥ sarva evaite vīrahā yad vrataṁ caret,
12.165.70: evaṁ ca mokṣamāpnoti tau ca sā caiva dharmataḥ ॥70॥
12.165.73: caret saṁvatsaraṁ cāpi tad vrataṁ yena kr̥ntati ॥73॥
12.165.76: māṁsaṁ mūtraṁ purīṣaṁ ca prāśya saṁskāramarhati,
12.165.77: tryahamuṣṇaṁ payaḥ pītvā vāyubhakṣo bhavet tryaham ॥77॥
12.165.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi prāyaścittīye pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥165॥
12.166.2: matastu mama dharmajña khaḍga eva susaṁśitaḥ ॥2॥
12.166.3: viśīrṇe kārmuke rājan prakṣīṇeṣu ca vājiṣu,
12.166.6: kathaṁ cotpāditaḥ khaḍgaḥ kasmai cārthāya kena ca,
12.166.7: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā mādrīputrasya dhīmataḥ,
12.166.9: uvāca sa tu dharmajño dhanurvedasya pāragaḥ,
12.166.12: niḥśabdaṁ cāprameyaṁ ca tatra jajñe pitāmahaḥ ॥12॥
12.166.13: so’sr̥jad vātamagniṁ ca bhāskaraṁ cāpi vīryavān,
12.166.17: tā vai brahmarṣayaḥ sarvāḥ prajārthaṁ pratipedire ॥17॥
12.166.20: jajñe tāta jagat sarvaṁ tathā sthāvarajaṅgamam ॥20॥
12.166.28: ete cānye ca bahavaḥ sagaṇā daityadānavāḥ,
12.166.42: tataḥ sa tumulaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā taṁ ca bhūtamupasthitam ॥42॥
12.166.52: tasya nādaṁ vinadato mahāhāsaṁ ca muñcataḥ ॥52॥
12.166.53: babhau pratibhayaṁ rūpaṁ tadā rudrasya bhārata,
12.166.56: rudraṁ dr̥ṣṭvā balodbhūtaṁ pramumoha cacāla ca,
12.166.57: chindan bhindan rujan kr̥ntan dārayan pothayannapi ॥57॥
12.166.63: sa rudro dānavān hatvā kr̥tvā dharmottaraṁ jagat ॥63॥
12.166.64: raudraṁ rūpamathotkṣipya cakre rūpaṁ śivaṁ śivaḥ,
12.166.66: asiṁ dharmasya goptāraṁ dadau satkr̥tya viṣṇave,
12.166.70: vibhajya daṇḍaṁ rakṣyāstu dharmato na yadr̥cchayā,
12.166.72: sa visr̥jyātha putraṁ svaṁ prajānāmadhipaṁ tataḥ ॥72॥
12.166.74: āyuśca tasmāllebhe taṁ nahuṣaśca tato bhuvi,
12.166.79: uśīnaro vai dharmātmā tasmād bhojaḥ sa yādavaḥ ॥79॥
12.166.83: aseraṣṭau hi nāmāni rahasyāni nibodha me,
pāṇḍaveya sadā yāni kīrtayan labhate jayam ॥83॥
12.166.85d1: etāni caiva nāmāni purāṇe niścitāni vai,
12.166.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi khaḍgotpattikathane ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥166॥
12.167.2: dharme cārthe ca kāme ca lokavr̥ttiḥ samāhitā,
teṣāṁ garīyān katamo madhyamaḥ ko laghuśca kaḥ ॥2॥
12.167.8: dharmo rājan guṇaḥ śreṣṭho madhyamo hyartha ucyate,
12.167.26: viśvasteṣu hi bhūteṣu kalpate sarvameva hi ॥26॥
12.167.27: tataḥ kāmaṁ caret paścāt siddhārthaḥ sa hi tatparam ॥27॥
12.167.33: samudraṁ vā viśantyanye narāḥ kāmena saṁyutāḥ,
kāmo hi vividhākāraḥ sarvaṁ kāmena santatam ॥33॥
12.167.35: śreyastailaṁ hi piṇyākād ghr̥taṁ śreya udaśvitaḥ,
12.167.36: puṣpato madhviva rasaḥ kāma ābhyāṁ tathā smr̥taḥ,
12.167.44: yo vai na pāpe nirato na puṇye
nārthe na dharme manujo na kāme,
12.167.45: mokṣaṁ praśaṁsanti na taṁ ca vidmaḥ ॥45॥
12.167.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi ṣaḍjagītāyāṁ saptaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥167॥
12.168.2: kīdr̥śā mānavāḥ saumyāḥ kaiḥ prītiḥ paramā bhavet,
āyatyāṁ ca tadātve ca ke kṣamāstān vadasva me ॥2॥
12.168.3: na hi tatra dhanaṁ sphītaṁ na ca sambandhibāndhavāḥ,
12.168.4: durlabho hi suhr̥cchrotā durlabhaśca hitaḥ suhr̥t,
12.168.5: vadato me nibodha tvaṁ nikhilena yudhiṣṭhira ॥5॥
12.168.6: lubdhaḥ krūrastyaktadharmā nikr̥tiḥ śaṭha eva ca,
12.168.11: dadataśca yathāśakti yo na tuṣyati mandadhīḥ,
adhairyamapi yo yuṅkte sadā mitraṁ nararṣabha ॥11॥
12.168.14: na virajyati kalyāṇe yastyajet tādr̥śaṁ naram ॥14॥
12.168.26: ye ca doṣasamāyuktā narāḥ proktā mayānagha ॥26॥
12.168.28: mitradrohī kr̥taghnaśca yaḥ proktastad vadasva me ॥28॥
12.168.29: udīcyāṁ diśi yad vr̥ttaṁ mleccheṣu manujādhipa ॥29॥
12.168.32: pratiśrayaṁ ca vāsārthaṁ bhikṣāṁ caivātha vārṣikīm ॥32॥
12.168.33: prādāt tasmai sa viprāya vastraṁ ca sadr̥śaṁ navam,
nārīṁ cāpi vayopetāṁ bhartrā virahitāṁ tathā ॥33॥
12.168.34: etat samprāpya hr̥ṣṭātmā dasyoḥ sarvaṁ dvijastathā,
tasmin gr̥havare rājaṁstayā reme sa gautamaḥ ॥34॥
12.168.36: cakrāṅgān sa ca nityaṁ vai sarvato vanagocarān ॥36॥
12.168.38: tathā tu vasatastasya dasyugrāme sukhaṁ tadā ॥38॥
12.168.39: agaman bahavo māsā nighnataḥ pakṣiṇo bahūn,
12.168.41: sa brahmacārī taddeśyaḥ sakhā tasyaiva supriyaḥ,
12.168.46: kimidaṁ kuruṣe mohād viprastvaṁ hi kulodvahaḥ,
12.168.47: pūrvān smara dvija jñātīn prakhyātān vedapāragān,
12.168.48: anukrośaṁ ca saṁsmr̥tya tyaja vāsamimaṁ dvija ॥48॥
12.168.49: sa evamuktaḥ suhr̥dā tena tatra hitaiṣiṇā,
12.168.51: tvaddarśanāt tu viprendra kr̥tārtho’smyadya vai dvija,
āvāṁ hi saha yāsyāvaḥ śvo vasasvādya śarvarīm ॥51॥
12.168.52: sa tatra nyavasad vipro ghr̥ṇī kiñcidasaṁspr̥śan,
12.168.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi kr̥taghnopākhyāne aṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥168॥
12.169.1: tasyāṁ niśāyāṁ vyuṣṭāyāṁ gate tasmin dvijottame,
12.169.2: sa tena saha sārthena prayayau sāgaraṁ prati ॥2॥
12.169.3: sa tu sārtho mahān rājan kasmiṁścid girigahvare,
12.169.4: sa kathañcid bhayāt tasmād vimukto brāhmaṇastathā,
12.169.5: sa tu sārthaparibhraṣṭastasmād deśāt tathā cyutaḥ,
ekākī vyacarat tatra vane kimpuruṣo yathā ॥5॥
12.169.12: deśe same sukhe citre svargoddeśasame nr̥pa,
śriyā juṣṭaṁ mahāvr̥kṣaṁ nyagrodhaṁ ca sumaṇḍalam ॥12॥
12.169.17: sa tu vipraḥ praśāntaśca spr̥ṣṭaḥ puṇyena vāyunā,
12.169.19: nāḍījaṅgha iti khyāto dayito brahmaṇaḥ sakhā,
12.169.23: svāgataṁ bhavato vipra diṣṭyā prāpto’si me gr̥ham,
astaṁ ca savitā yātaḥ sandhyeyaṁ samupasthitā ॥23॥
12.169.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi kr̥taghnopākhyāne ekonasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥169॥
12.170.1: giraṁ tāṁ madhurāṁ śrutvā gautamo vismitastadā,
12.170.2: bhoḥ kaśyapasya putro’haṁ mātā dākṣāyaṇī ca me,
12.170.3: tasmai dattvā sa satkāraṁ vidhidr̥ṣṭena karmaṇā,
12.170.6: bhuktavantaṁ ca taṁ vipraṁ prītātmānaṁ mahātapāḥ,
12.170.8: gandhāḍhyaṁ śayanaṁ prādāt sa śiśye tatra vai sukham ॥8॥
12.170.12: pāramparyaṁ tathā daivaṁ kāmyaṁ maitramiti prabho ॥12॥
12.170.13: prādurbhūto’smi te mitraṁ suhr̥ttvaṁ ca mama tvayi,
12.170.15: virūpākṣa iti khyātaḥ sakhā mama mahābalaḥ ॥15॥
12.170.16: taṁ gaccha dvijamukhya tvaṁ sa madvākyapracoditaḥ,
12.170.18: tasmin pathi mahārāja sevamāno drutaṁ yayau ॥18॥
12.170.21: tataḥ sa rākṣasendraḥ svān preṣyānāha yudhiṣṭhira,
12.170.24: sa tvāṁ tvarati vai draṣṭuṁ tat kṣipraṁ saṁvidhīyatām ॥24॥
12.170.25: tataḥ sa prādravad vipro vismayād vigataklamaḥ,
12.170.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi kr̥taghnopākhyāne saptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥170॥
12.171.1: tataḥ sa vidito rājñaḥ praviśya gr̥hamuttamam,
12.171.4: kva te nivāsaḥ kalyāṇa kiṅgotrā brāhmaṇī ca te,
tattvaṁ brūhi na bhīḥ kāryā viśvasasva yathāsukham ॥4॥
12.171.5: śūdrā punarbhūrbhāryā me satyametad bravīmi te ॥5॥
12.171.6: tato rājā vimamr̥śe kathaṁ kāryamidaṁ bhavet,
kathaṁ vā sukr̥taṁ me syāditi buddhyānvacintayat ॥6॥
12.171.7: ayaṁ vai janmanā vipraḥ suhr̥t tasya mahātmanaḥ,
12.171.8: tasya priyaṁ kariṣyāmi sa hi māmāśritaḥ sadā,
bhrātā me bāndhavaścāsau sakhā ca hr̥dayaṅgamaḥ ॥8॥
12.171.9: tatrāyamapi bhoktā ca deyamasmai ca me dhanam ॥9॥
12.171.10: saṅkalpitaṁ caiva dhanaṁ kiṁ vicāryamataḥ param ॥10॥
12.171.14: tāsu te pūjitā rājñā niṣaṇṇā dvijasattamāḥ,
12.171.17: tasya nityaṁ sadā’’ṣāḍhyāṁ māghyāṁ ca bahavo dvijāḥ,
12.171.19: suvarṇaṁ rajataṁ caiva maṇīnatha ca mauktikān ॥19॥
12.171.22: yeṣu yeṣu ca bhāṇḍeṣu bhuktaṁ vo dvijasattamāḥ,
12.171.26: adyaikaṁ divasaṁ viprā na vo’stīha bhayaṁ kvacit,
12.171.32: gr̥hīto lobhamohābhyāṁ dūraṁ ca gamanaṁ mama,
na cāsti pathi bhoktavyaṁ prāṇasandhāraṇaṁ mama ॥32॥
12.171.33: tataḥ sa pathi bhoktavyaṁ prekṣamāṇo na kiñcana ॥33॥
12.171.34: ayaṁ bakapatiḥ pārśve māṁsarāśiḥ sthito mahān ॥34॥
12.171.35: imaṁ hatvā gr̥hītvā ca yāsye’haṁ samabhidrutam ॥35॥
12.171.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi kr̥taghnopākhyāne ekasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥171॥
12.172.2: sa cāpi pārśve suṣvāpa viśvasto bakarāṭ tadā,
12.172.3: nihatya ca mudā yuktaḥ so’nubandhaṁ na dr̥ṣṭavān ॥3॥
12.172.4: taṁ gr̥hītvā suvarṇaṁ ca yayau drutataraṁ dvijaḥ ॥4॥
12.172.4d1: tato dākṣāyaṇīputraṁ nāgataṁ taṁ tu bhārata,
12.172.6: sa pūrvasandhyāṁ brahmāṇaṁ vandituṁ yāti sarvadā,
māṁ vā dr̥ṣṭvā kadācit sa na gacchati gr̥haṁ khagaḥ ॥6॥
12.172.7: ubhe dvirātrisandhye vai nābhyagāt sa mamālayam,
tasmānna śuddhyate bhāvo mama sa jñāyatāṁ suhr̥t ॥7॥
12.172.8: tadvratastatra me śaṅkā hanyāt taṁ sa dvijādhamaḥ ॥8॥
12.172.10: gautamaḥ sa gatastatra tenodvignaṁ mano mama,
12.172.11: jñāyatāṁ sa viśuddhātmā yadi jīvati mā ciram,
12.172.15: kr̥taghnaṁ paruṣaṁ taṁ ca gautamaṁ pāpakāriṇam ॥15॥
12.172.16: ruroda rājā taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ,
12.172.22: na dātumarhasi tvaṁ no bhakṣaṇāyāsya kilviṣam,
12.172.24: kr̥tvā taṁ khaṇḍaśaḥ pāpaṁ dasyubhyaḥ pradadustadā,
12.172.25: brahmaghne ca surāpe ca caure bhagnavrate tathā,
12.172.26: kravyādaiḥ kr̥mibhiścaiva na bhujyante hi tādr̥śāḥ ॥26॥
12.172.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi kr̥taghnopākhyāne dvisaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥172॥
12.173.3: tasmin kāle ca surabhirdevī dākṣāyaṇī śubhā,
12.173.7: yathā śāpaḥ purā datto brahmaṇā rājadharmaṇaḥ ॥7॥
12.173.9: tasmād vadhaṁ sa duṣṭātmā nacirāt samavāpsyati ॥9॥
12.173.13: siktvāmr̥tena taṁ vipraṁ gautamaṁ jīvayat tadā,
12.173.15: yathocitaṁ ca sa bako yayau brahmasadastathā ॥15॥
12.173.17: kukṣau punarbhvāḥ pāpo’yaṁ janayitvā cirāt sutān ॥17॥
12.173.18: etat prāha purā sarvaṁ nārado mama bhārata ॥18॥
12.173.20: kutaḥ kr̥taghnasya yaśaḥ kutaḥ sthānaṁ kutaḥ sukham,
aśraddheyaḥ kr̥taghno hi kr̥taghne nāsti niṣkr̥tiḥ ॥20॥
12.173.22: kr̥tajñena sadā bhāvyaṁ mitrakāmena caiva ha,
mitrācca labhate sarvaṁ mitrāt pūjāṁ labheta ca ॥22॥
12.173.25: eṣa dharmabhr̥tāṁ śreṣṭha proktaḥ pāpo mayā tava,
mitradrohī kr̥taghno vai kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ॥25॥
12.173.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi āpaddharmaparvaṇi kr̥taghnopākhyāne trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥173॥
12.174.2: sarvatra vihito dharmaḥ svargyaḥ satyaphalaṁ tapaḥ,
12.174.3: yasmin yasmiṁstu viṣaye yo yo yāti viniścayam,
12.174.4: tathā tathā virāgo’tra jāyate nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥4॥
12.174.6: naṣṭe dhane vā dāre vā putre pitari vā mr̥te,
yayā buddhyā nudecchokaṁ tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥6॥
12.174.7: naṣṭe dhane vā dāre vā putre pitari vā mr̥te,
12.174.10: kiṁ nu muhyasi mūḍhastvaṁ śocyaḥ kimanuśocasi,
yadā tvāmapi śocantaḥ śocyā yāsyanti tāṁ gatim ॥10॥
12.174.11: tvaṁ caivāhaṁ ca ye cānye tvāmupāsanti pārthiva,
sarve tatra gamiṣyāmo yata evāgatā vayam ॥11॥
12.174.12: kā buddhiḥ kiṁ tapo vipra kaḥ samādhistapodhana,
kiṁ jñānaṁ kiṁ śrutaṁ caiva yat prāpya na viṣīdasi ॥12॥
12.174.13d1: na taṁ paśyāmi yasyāhaṁ taṁ na paśyāmi yo mama.
12.174.14: ātmāpi cāyaṁ na mama sarvā vā pr̥thivī mama,
yathā mama tathā’nyeṣāmiti cintya na me vyathā,
etāṁ buddhimahaṁ prāpya na prahr̥ṣye na ca vyathe ॥14॥
12.174.15: yathā kāṣṭhaṁ ca kāṣṭhaṁ ca sameyātāṁ mahodadhau,
12.174.16: teṣāṁ sneho na kartavyo viprayogo dhruvo hi taiḥ ॥16॥
12.174.17: na tvāsau veda na tvaṁ taṁ kaḥ san kimanuśocasi ॥17॥
12.174.20: na nityaṁ labhate duḥkhaṁ na nityaṁ labhate sukham ॥20॥
12.174.22: jīvitaṁ ca śarīreṇa jātyaiva saha jāyate,
ubhe saha vivartete ubhe saha vinaśyataḥ ॥22॥
12.174.28: saprajñaḥ prajñayā hīno daivena labhate sukham ॥28॥
12.174.29: nālaṁ sukhāya suhr̥do nālaṁ duḥkhāya śatravaḥ,
na ca prajñālamarthānāṁ na sukhānāmalaṁ dhanam ॥29॥
12.174.31: buddhimantaṁ ca śūraṁ ca mūḍhaṁ bhīruṁ jaḍaṁ kavim,
durbalaṁ balavantaṁ ca bhāginaṁ bhajate sukham ॥31॥
12.174.33: ye ca mūḍhatamā loke ye ca buddheḥ paraṁ gatāḥ,
12.174.34: antyeṣu remire dhīrā na te madhyeṣu remire,
12.174.35: ye ca buddhisukhaṁ prāptā dvandvātītā vimatsarāḥ,
tān naivārthā na cānarthā vyathayanti kadācana ॥35॥
12.174.37: nityaṁ pramuditā mūḍhā divi devagaṇā iva,
12.174.38: bhūtistvevaṁ śriyā sārdhaṁ dakṣe vasati nālase ॥38॥
12.174.39: sukhaṁ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṁ priyaṁ vā yadi vāpriyam,
12.174.41: dāntaṁ jitendriyaṁ cāpi śoko na spr̥śate naram ॥41॥
12.174.43: āyāso vā yato mūlamekāṅgamapi tat tyajet ॥43॥
12.174.45: yad yat yajati kāmānāṁ tat sukhasyābhipūryate,
12.174.46: yacca kāmasukhaṁ loke yacca divyaṁ mahat sukham,
12.174.47: pūrvadehakr̥taṁ karma śubhaṁ vā yadi vāśubham,
prājñaṁ mūḍhaṁ tathā śūraṁ bhajate yādr̥śaṁ kr̥tam ॥47॥
12.174.48: jīveṣu parivartane duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ॥48॥
12.174.49: sarvān kāmān jugupseta kāmān kurvīta pr̥ṣṭhataḥ ॥49॥
12.174.50: vr̥tta eṣa hr̥di prauḍho mr̥tyureṣa manobhavaḥ,
krodho nāma śarīrastho dehināṁ procyate budhaiḥ ॥50॥
12.174.52: na bibheti yadā cāyaṁ yadā cāsmānna bibhyati,
yadā necchati na dveṣṭi brahma sampadyate tadā ॥52॥
12.174.54: yadā na kurute dhīraḥ sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam,
karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā ॥54॥
12.174.55: yā dustyajā durmatibhiryā na jīryati jīryataḥ,
yo’sau prāṇāntiko rogastāṁ tr̥ṣṇāṁ tyajataḥ sukham ॥55॥
12.174.56: atra piṅgalayā gītā gāthāḥ śrūyanti pārthiva,
yathā sā kr̥cchrakāle’pi lebhe dharmaṁ sanātanam ॥56॥
12.174.61: anartho hi bhavedartho daivāt pūrvakr̥tena vā,
12.174.62: sukhaṁ nirāśaḥ svapiti nairāśyaṁ paramaṁ sukham,
āśāmanāśāṁ kr̥tvā hi sukhaṁ svapiti piṅgalā ॥62॥
12.174.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi brāhmaṇasenajitsaṁvādakathane catuḥsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥174॥
12.175.1: kiṁ śreyaḥ pratipadyeta tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.175.2: pituḥ putreṇa saṁvādaṁ taṁ nibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
12.175.3: babhūva putro medhāvī medhāvī nāma nāmataḥ ॥3॥
12.175.7: amoghāsu patantīṣu kiṁ dhīra iva bhāṣase ॥7॥
12.175.8: amoghāḥ kāḥ patantīha kiṁ nu bhīṣayasīva mām ॥8॥
12.175.11: gādhodake matsya iva sukhaṁ vindeta kastadā ॥11॥
12.175.14: adyaiva kuru yacchreyo mā tvāṁ kālo’tyagādayam,
12.175.15: na hi pratīkṣate mr̥tyuḥ kr̥tamasya na vā kr̥tam ॥15॥
12.175.16: ko hi jānāti kasyādya mr̥tyukālo bhaviṣyati,
kr̥te dharme bhavet kīrtiriha pretya ca vai sukham ॥16॥
12.175.22: durbalaṁ balavantaṁ ca śūraṁ bhīruṁ jaḍaṁ kavim,
12.175.23: anuṣaktaṁ yadā dehe kiṁ svastha iva tiṣṭhasi ॥23॥
12.175.25: mr̥tyorvā mukhametad vai yā grāme vasato ratiḥ,
12.175.26: nibandhanī rajjureṣā yā grāme vasato ratiḥ,
chittvaitāṁ sukr̥to yānti naināṁ chindanti duṣkr̥taḥ ॥26॥
12.175.30: amr̥taṁ caiva mr̥tyuśca dvayaṁ dehe pratiṣṭhitam,
12.175.34: yasya vāṅmanasī syātāṁ samyak praṇihite sadā,
tapastyāgaśca satyaṁ ca sa vai sarvamavāpnuyāt ॥34॥
12.175.35: nāsti rāgasamaṁ duḥkhaṁ nāsti tyāgasamaṁ sukham ॥35॥
12.175.36: ātmanyeva bhaviṣyāmi na māṁ tārayati prajā ॥36॥
12.175.39: putrasyaitad vacaḥ śrutvā yathākārṣīt pitā nr̥pa,
12.175.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi pitāputrasaṁvādakathane pañcasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥175॥
12.176.5: na sukhaṁ prāpya saṁhr̥ṣyennāsukhaṁ prāpya sañjvaret ॥5॥
12.176.6: na vai carasi yacchreya ātmano vā yadīśiṣe,
akāmātmāpi hi sadā dhuramudyamya caiva ha ॥6॥
12.176.7: akiñcanaḥ sukhaṁ śete samuttiṣṭhati caiva ha ॥7॥
12.176.10: ākiñcanyaṁ ca rājyaṁ ca tulayā samatolayam,
12.176.11: ākiñcanye ca rājye ca viśeṣaḥ sumahānayam,
12.176.12: naivāsyāgnirna cāriṣṭo na mr̥tyurna ca dasyavaḥ,
12.176.22: nātyaktvā cābhayaḥ śete tyaktvā sarvaṁ sukhī bhava ॥22॥
12.176.23: śampākena purā mahyaṁ tasmāt tyāgaḥ paro mataḥ ॥23॥
12.176.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śampākagītāyāṁ ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥176॥
12.177.2: nirvedaścāvidhitsā ca yasya syāt sa sukhī naraḥ ॥2॥
12.177.3: eṣa svargaśca dharmaśca sukhaṁ cānuttamaṁ matam ॥3॥
12.177.8: hriyamāṇau tu tau damyau tenoṣṭreṇa pramāthinā,
12.177.12: maṇī voṣṭrasya lambete priyau vatsatarau mama,
12.177.17: śarīre jīvite caiva tr̥ṣṇā mandasya vardhate ॥17॥
12.177.18: asakr̥ccāsi nikr̥to na ca nirvidyase tataḥ ॥18॥
12.177.19: yadi nāhaṁ vināśyaste yadyevaṁ ramase mayā,
mā māṁ yojaya lobhena vr̥thā tvaṁ vittakāmuka ॥19॥
12.177.20: sañcitaṁ sañcitaṁ dravyaṁ naṣṭaṁ tava punaḥ punaḥ,
12.177.21: aho nu mama bāliśyaṁ yo’haṁ krīḍanakastava,
kiṁ naivaṁ jātu puruṣaḥ pareṣāṁ preṣyatāmiyāt ॥21॥
12.177.23: nūnaṁ te hr̥dayaṁ kāma vajrasāramayaṁ dr̥ḍham,
12.177.24: jānāmi kāma tvāṁ caiva yacca kiñcit priyaṁ tava,
12.177.25: kāma jānāmi te mūlaṁ saṅkalpāt kila jāyase,
na tvāṁ saṅkalpayiṣyāmi samūlo na bhaviṣyasi ॥25॥
12.177.26: īhā dhanasya na sukhā labdhvā cintā ca bhūyasī,
labdhanāśe yathā mr̥tyurlabdhaṁ bhavati vā na vā ॥26॥
12.177.27: parityāge na labhate tato duḥkhataraṁ nu kim,
na ca tuṣyati labdhena bhūya eva ca mārgati ॥27॥
12.177.29: ya imaṁ māmakaṁ dehaṁ bhūtagrāmaḥ samāśritaḥ,
sa yātvito yathākāmaṁ vasatāṁ vā yathāsukham ॥29॥
12.177.31: yoge buddhiṁ śrute sattvaṁ mano brahmaṇi dhārayan ॥31॥
12.177.32: yayā māṁ tvaṁ punarnaivaṁ duḥkheṣu praṇidhāsyasi ॥32॥
12.177.33: tvayā hi me praṇunnasya gatiranyā na vidyate,
tr̥ṣṇāśokaśramāṇāṁ hi tvaṁ kāma prabhavaḥ sadā ॥33॥
12.177.35: dhane sukhakalā yā tu sāpi duḥkhairvidhīyate ॥35॥
12.177.38: naiva tvaṁ vettha sulabhaṁ naiva tvaṁ vettha durlabham ॥38॥
12.177.40: nirvr̥ttiṁ paramāṁ prāpya nādya kāmān vicintaye ॥40॥
12.177.42: na tvaṁ mayā punaḥ kāma vatsyase na ca raṁsyase ॥42॥
12.177.45: nirvedaṁ nirvr̥tiṁ tr̥ptiṁ śāntiṁ satyaṁ damaṁ kṣamām,
12.177.46: tasmāt kāmaśca lobhaśca tr̥ṣṇā kārpaṇyameva ca,
tyajantu māṁ pratiṣṭhantaṁ sattvastho hyasmi sāmpratam ॥46॥
12.177.47: prahāya kāmaṁ lobhaṁ ca sukhaṁ prāpto’smi sāmpratam,
12.177.48: yad yat tyajati kāmānāṁ tat sukhasyābhipūryate,
12.177.49: kāmānubandhaṁ nudate yat kiñcit puruṣo rajaḥ,
12.177.51: yacca kāmasukhaṁ loke yacca divyaṁ mahatsukham,
12.177.53: sarvān kāmān parityajya prāpya brahma mahatsukham ॥53॥
12.177.54: acchinat kāmamūlaṁ sa tena prāpa mahatsukham ॥54॥
12.177.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi maṅkigītāyāṁ saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥177॥
12.178.2: anantamiva me vittaṁ yasya me nāsti kiñcana,
mithilāyāṁ pradīptāyāṁ na me dahyati kiñcana ॥2॥
12.178.3: nirvedaṁ prati vinyastaṁ taṁ nibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥3॥
12.178.6: lakṣaṇaṁ tasya bakṣye’haṁ tat svayaṁ parimr̥śyatām ॥6॥
12.178.7: iṣukāraḥ kumārī ca ṣaḍete guravo mama ॥7॥
12.178.8: āśā balavatī rājan nairāśyaṁ paramaṁ sukham,
āśāṁ nirāśāṁ kr̥tvā tu sukhaṁ svapiti piṅgalā ॥8॥
12.178.10: gr̥hārambho hi duḥkhāya na sukhāya kadācana,
12.178.13: bahūnāṁ kalaho nitya dvayoḥ saṅkathanaṁ dhruvam,
12.178.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi bodhyagītāyām aṣṭasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥178॥
12.179.5: nityatr̥pta iva brahman na kiñcidiva manyase ॥5॥
12.179.7: nānutiṣṭhasi dharmārthau na kāme cāpi vartase,
12.179.8: kā nu prajñā śrutaṁ vā kiṁ vr̥ttirvā kā nu te mune,
kṣipramācakṣva me brahman śreyo yadiha manyase ॥8॥
12.179.10: hrāsaṁ vr̥ddhiṁ vināśaṁ ca na prahr̥ṣye na ca vyathe ॥10॥
12.179.12: sañcayāṁśca vināśāntān na kvacid vidadhe manaḥ ॥12॥
12.179.17: divi sañcaramāṇāni hrasvāni ca mahānti ca,
12.179.21: kaṇaṁ kadācit khādāmi piṇyākamapi ca grase,
12.179.22: śaye kadācit paryaṅke bhūmāvapi punaḥ śaye,
12.179.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi ājagaraprahrādasaṁvāde ekonāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥179॥
12.180.1: bāndhavāḥ karma vittaṁ vā prajñā veha pitāmaha,
narasya kā pratiṣṭhā syādetat pr̥ṣṭo vadasva me ॥1॥
12.180.2: prajñā pratiṣṭhā bhūtānāṁ prajñā lābhaḥ paro mataḥ,
prajñā niḥśreyasī loke prajñā svargo mataḥ satām ॥2॥
12.180.10: sarve lābhāḥ sābhimānā iti satyavatī śrutiḥ,
12.180.11: aho siddhārthatā teṣāṁ yeṣāṁ santīha pāṇayaḥ,
atīva spr̥haye teṣāṁ yeṣāṁ santīha pāṇayaḥ ॥11॥
12.180.12: pāṇimadbhyaḥ spr̥hāsmākaṁ yathā tava dhanasya vai,
12.180.14: atha yeṣāṁ punaḥ pāṇī devadattau daśāṅgulī,
12.180.16: adhiṣṭhāya ca gāṁ loke bhuñjate vāhayanti ca,
12.180.17: sahante tāni duḥkhāni diṣṭyā tvaṁ na tathā mune ॥17॥
12.180.18: diṣṭyā tvaṁ na śr̥gālo vai na kr̥mirna ca mūṣakaḥ,
na sarpo na ca maṇḍūko na cānyaḥ pāpayonijaḥ ॥18॥
12.180.22: madhye vai pāpayonīnāṁ śārgālīṁ yāmahaṁ gataḥ,
12.180.25: bhavestvaṁ yadyapi tvāḍhyo na rājā na ca daivatam,
devatvaṁ prāpya cendratvaṁ naiva tuṣyestathā sati ॥25॥
12.180.26: na tr̥ptiḥ priyalābhe’sti tr̥ṣṇā nādbhiḥ praśāmyati,
12.180.27: astyeva tvayi śoko’pi harṣaścāpi tathā tvayi,
sukhaduḥkhe tathā cobhe tatra kā paridevanā ॥27॥
12.180.29: na ca pāṇestr̥tīyasya yannāsti na tato bhayam ॥29॥
12.180.30: saṁsparśād darśanād vāpi śravaṇād vāpi jāyate ॥30॥
12.180.31: na tvaṁ smarasi vāruṇyā laṭvākānāṁ ca pakṣiṇām,
tābhyāṁ cābhyadhiko bhakṣyo na kaścid vidyate kvacit ॥31॥
12.180.33: puruṣasyaiṣa niyamo manye śreyo na saṁśayaḥ ॥33॥
12.180.35: te khalvapi ramante ca modante ca hasanti ca ॥35॥
12.180.37: svakarmaṇā tu niyataṁ bhavitavyaṁ tu tat tathā ॥37॥
12.180.38: na pulkaso na cāṇḍāla ātmānaṁ tyaktumicchati,
tayā tuṣṭaḥ svayā yonyā māyāṁ paśyasva yādr̥śīm ॥38॥
12.180.40: aṅgāni ca samagrāṇi na ca lokeṣu dhikkr̥taḥ ॥40॥
12.180.42: yadi brahman śr̥ṇoṣyetacchraddadhāsi ca me vacaḥ,
12.180.43: satyaṁ damaṁ ca dānaṁ ca spardhiṣṭhā mā ca kenacit ॥43॥
12.180.48: ākroṣṭā cābhivaktā ca brahmavākyeṣu ca dvijān ॥48॥
12.180.50: yadahaṁ mānuṣīṁ yoniṁ śr̥gālaḥ prāpnuyāṁ punaḥ ॥50॥
12.180.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śr̥gālakāśyapasaṁvāde aśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥180॥
12.181.1: yadyasti dattamiṣṭaṁ vā tapastaptaṁ tathaiva ca,
gurūṇāṁ vāpi śuśrūṣā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.181.3: durbhikṣādeva durbhikṣaṁ kleśāt kleśaṁ bhayād bhayam,
12.181.4: utsavādutsavaṁ yānti svargāt svargaṁ sukhāt sukham,
12.181.7: pulākā iva dhānyeṣu puttikā iva pakṣiṣu,
tadvidhāste manuṣyāṇāṁ yeṣāṁ dharmo na kāraṇam ॥7॥
12.181.8: śete saha śayānena yena yena yathā kr̥tam ॥8॥
12.181.10: yena yena yathā yad yat purā karma samīhitam,
12.181.12: acodyamānāni yathā puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca,
svaṁ kālaṁ nātivartante tathā karma purā kr̥tam ॥12॥
12.181.15: bālo yuvā ca vr̥ddhaśca yat karoti śubhāśubham,
12.181.19: padaṁ yathā na dr̥śyeta tathā jñānavidāṁ gatiḥ ॥19॥
12.182.1: pralaye ca kamabhyeti tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.182.4: kīdr̥śo jīvatāṁ jīvaḥ kva vā gacchanti ye mr̥tāḥ,
asmāllokādamuṁ lokaṁ sarvaṁ śaṁsatu no bhavān ॥4॥
12.182.9: kīdr̥śo jīvatāṁ jīvaḥ kya vā gacchanti ye mr̥tāḥ,
12.182.10: evaṁ sa bhagavān pr̥ṣṭo bharadvājena saṁśayam,
12.182.12: yataḥ sr̥ṣṭāni bhūtāni jāyante ca mriyanti ca ॥12॥
12.182.13: so’sr̥jat prathamaṁ devo mahāntaṁ nāma nāmataḥ,
12.182.15: tasmāt padmāt samabhavad brahmā vedamayo nidhiḥ ॥15॥
12.182.16: brahmā vai sa mahātejā ya ete pañca dhātavaḥ ॥16॥
12.182.18: agnīṣomau tu candrārkau nayane tasya viśrute ॥18॥
12.182.19: nabhaścordhvaṁ śirastasya kṣitiḥ pādau bhujau diśaḥ,
12.182.20: sa eṣa bhagavān viṣṇurananta iti viśrutaḥ,
12.182.21: yataḥ samabhavad viśvaṁ pr̥ṣṭo’haṁ yadiha tvayā ॥21॥
12.182.25: te cāpyantaṁ na paśyanti nabhasaḥ prathitaujasaḥ,
12.182.31: paṭhanti caiva munayaḥ śāstreṣu vividheṣu ca,
trailokye sāgare caiva pramāṇaṁ vihitaṁ yathā ॥31॥
12.182.32: siddhānāṁ devatānāṁ ca yadā parimitā gatiḥ ॥32॥
12.182.34: yadā tu divyaṁ tad rūpaṁ hrasate vardhate punaḥ,
12.182.35: tataḥ puṣkarataḥ sr̥ṣṭaḥ sarvajño mūrtimān prabhuḥ,
12.182.36: puṣkarād yadi sambhūto jyeṣṭhaṁ bhavati puṣkaram,
brahmāṇaṁ pūrvajaṁ cāha bhavān sandeha eva me ॥36॥
12.182.38: tasya madhye sthito lokān sr̥jate jagataḥ prabhuḥ ॥38॥
12.182.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi bhr̥gubharadvājasaṁvāde dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥182॥
12.183.1: prajāvisargaṁ vividhaṁ kathaṁ sa sr̥jate prabhuḥ,
merumadhye sthito brahmā tad brūhi dvijasattama ॥1॥
12.183.3: yat prāṇaḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ vardhante yena ca prajāḥ,
12.183.4: pr̥thivī parvatā meghā mūrtimantaśca ye pare,
12.183.5: kathaṁ vā medinī sr̥ṣṭetyatra me saṁśayo mahān ॥5॥
12.183.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi bhr̥gubharadvājasaṁvāde mānasabhūtotpattikathane tryaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥183॥
12.184.1: ta ete dhātavaḥ pañca brahmā yānasr̥jat purā,
12.184.6: sthāvarāṇāṁ na dr̥śyante śarīre pañca dhātavaḥ ॥6॥
12.184.8: na śr̥ṇvanti na paśyanti na gandharasavedinaḥ,
na ca sparśaṁ vijānanti te kathaṁ pāñcabhautikāḥ ॥8॥
12.184.11: ūṣmato mlāyate parṇaṁ tvak phalaṁ puṣpameva ca,
12.184.13: na hyadr̥ṣṭeśca mārgo’sti tasmāt paśyanti pādapāḥ ॥13॥
12.184.19: jaṅgamānāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ śarīre pañca dhātavaḥ,
12.184.20: tvak ca māṁsaṁ tathāsthīni majjā snāyuśca pañcamam,
12.184.22: śrotraṁ ghrāṇaṁ tathā’’syaṁ ca hr̥dayaṁ koṣṭhameva ca,
12.184.23: śleṣmā pittamatha svedo vasā śoṇitameva ca,
ityāpaḥ pañcadhā dehe bhavanti prāṇināṁ sadā ॥23॥
12.184.24: prāṇāt praṇīyate prāṇī vyānād vyāyacchate tathā,
12.184.26: jyotiṣā cakṣuṣā rūpaṁ sparśaṁ vetti ca vāhinā ॥26॥
12.184.27: gandhaḥ sparśo raso rūpaṁ śabdaścātra guṇāḥ smr̥tāḥ,
12.184.28: nirhārī saṁhataḥ snigdho rūkṣo viśada eva ca ॥28॥
12.184.29: jyotiḥ paśyati cakṣurbhyāṁ sparśaṁ vetti ca vāyunā ॥29॥
12.184.30: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṁ ca rasaścāpi guṇāḥ smr̥tāḥ,
rasajñānaṁ tu vakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śr̥ṇu ॥30॥
12.184.32: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṁ ca triguṇaṁ jyotirucyate ॥32॥
12.184.33: jyotiḥ paśyati rūpāṇi rūpaṁ ca bahudhā smr̥tam,
12.184.36: vāyavyastu guṇaḥ sparśaḥ sparśaśca bahudhā smr̥taḥ,
uṣṇaḥ śītaḥ sukho duḥkhaḥ snigdho viśada eva ca ॥36॥
12.184.37: tathā kharo mr̥dū rūkṣo laghurgurutaro’pi ca,
evaṁ dvādaśadhā sparśo vāyavyo guṇa ucyate ॥37॥
12.184.43: āpyāyyante ca te nityaṁ dhātavastaistu dhātubhiḥ ॥43॥
12.184.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi bhr̥gubharadvājasaṁvāde caturaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥184॥
12.185.3: prāṇo mūrdhani cāgnau ca vartamāno viceṣṭate ॥3॥
12.185.4: sa jantuḥ sarvabhūtātmā puruṣaḥ sa sanātanaḥ,
12.185.5: evaṁ tviha sa sarvatra prāṇena paricālyate,
12.185.7: prayatne karmaṇi bale ya ekastriṣu vartate,
12.185.12: ūṣmā cāgniriti jñeyo yo’nnaṁ pacati dehinām ॥12॥
12.185.16: eṣa mārgo’tha yogānāṁ yena gacchanti tatpadam,
12.186.4: yadi vāyumayo jīvaḥ saṁśleṣo yadi vāyunā,
12.186.5: saṁśleṣo yadi vātena yadi tasmāt praṇaśyati,
12.186.6: kūpe vā salilaṁ dadyāt pradīpaṁ vā hutāśane,
kṣipraṁ praviśya naśyeta yathā naśyatyasau tathā ॥6॥
12.186.10: kiṁ vedayati vā jīvaḥ kiṁ śr̥ṇoti bravīti ca ॥10॥
12.186.11: yo dattvā mriyate jantuḥ sā gauḥ kaṁ tārayiṣyati ॥11॥
12.186.12: gauśca pratigrahītā ca dātā caiva samaṁ yadā,
12.186.14: chinnasya yadi vr̥kṣasya na mūlaṁ pratirohati,
12.186.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi jīvasvarūpākṣepe ṣaḍaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥186॥
12.187.1: na praṇāśo’sti jīvasya dattasya ca kr̥tasya ca,
yāti dehāntaraṁ prāṇī śarīraṁ tu viśīryate ॥1॥
12.187.3: agneryathā tathā tasya yadi nāśo na vidyate,
12.187.4: gatiryasya pramāṇaṁ vā saṁsthānaṁ vā na vidyate ॥4॥
12.187.6: na gr̥hyate tu sūkṣmatvād yathā jyotirna saṁśayaḥ ॥6॥
12.187.7: prāṇān dhārayate hyagniḥ sa jīva upadhāryatām,
12.187.8: patitaṁ yāti bhūmitvamayanaṁ tasya hi kṣitiḥ ॥8॥
12.187.9: jaṅgamānāṁ hi sarveṣāṁ sthāvarāṇāṁ tathaiva ca,
12.187.14: śārīre mānase duḥkhe kastāṁ vedayate rujam ॥14॥
12.187.15: śr̥ṇoti kathitaṁ jīvaḥ karṇābhyāṁ na śr̥ṇoti tat,
12.187.16: sarvaṁ paśyati yad dr̥śyaṁ manoyuktena cakṣuṣā,
manasi vyākule cakṣuḥ paśyannapi na paśyati ॥16॥
12.187.17: na paśyati na cāghrāti na śr̥ṇoti na bhāṣate,
na ca sparśarasau vetti nidrāvaśagataḥ punaḥ ॥17॥
12.187.18: hr̥ṣyati kruddhyate ko’tra śocatyudvijate ca kaḥ,
icchati dhyāyati dveṣṭi vācamīrayate ca kaḥ ॥18॥
12.187.19: sparśaṁ ca rūpaṁ ca guṇāṁśca ye’nye ॥19॥
12.187.21: yadā na rūpaṁ na sparśo noṣmabhāvaśca pañcake,
tadā śānte śarīrāgnau dehatyāge na naśyati ॥21॥
12.187.24: tasmin yaḥ saṁśrito dehe hyabbinduriva puṣkare ॥24॥
12.187.25: tamo rajaśca sattvaṁ ca viddhi jīvaguṇānimān ॥25॥
12.187.30: cittasya hi prasādena hitvā karma śubhāśubham,
12.187.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi bhr̥gubharadvājasaṁvāde jīvasvarūpanirūpaṇe saptāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥187॥
12.188.2: tataḥ satyaṁ ca dharmaṁ ca tapo brahma ca śāśvatam,
ācāraṁ caiva śaucaṁ ca svargāya vidadhe prabhuḥ ॥2॥
12.188.5: brāhmaṇānāṁ sito varṇaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṁ tu lohitaḥ,
12.188.7: kāmaḥ krodho bhayaṁ lobhaḥ śokaścintā kṣudhā śramaḥ,
sarveṣāṁ naḥ prabhavati kasmād varṇo vibhidyate ॥7॥
12.188.8: tanuḥ kṣarati sarveṣāṁ kasmād varṇo vibhajyate ॥8॥
12.188.10: na viśeṣo’sti varṇānāṁ sarva brāhmamidaṁ jagat,
12.188.12: svadharmān nānutiṣṭhanti te dvijā vaiśyatāṁ gatāḥ ॥12॥
12.188.14: dharmo yajñakriyā teṣāṁ nityaṁ na pratiṣidhyate ॥14॥
12.188.15: ityete caturo varṇā yeṣāṁ brāhmī sarasvatī,
vihitā brahmaṇā pūrvaṁ lobhāt tvajñānatāṁ gatāḥ ॥15॥
12.188.17: brahma caiva paraṁ sr̥ṣṭaṁ ye na jānanti te’dvijāḥ,
12.188.19: r̥ṣibhiḥ svena tapasā sr̥jyante cāpare paraiḥ ॥19॥
12.188.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi bhr̥gubharadvājasaṁvāde varṇavibhāgakathane aṣṭāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥188॥
12.189.1: brāhmaṇaḥ kena bhavati kṣatriyo vā dvijottama,
vaiśyaḥ śūdraśca viprarṣe tad brūhi vadatāṁ vara ॥1॥
12.189.3: nityavratī satyaparaḥ sa vai brāhmaṇa ucyate ॥3॥
12.189.4: tapaśca dr̥śyate yatra sa brāhmaṇa iti smr̥taḥ ॥4॥
12.189.7: tyaktavedastvanācāraḥ sa vai śūdra iti smr̥taḥ ॥7॥
12.189.8: śūdre caitadbhavellakṣyaṁ dvije tacca na vidyate,
na vai śūdro bhavecchūdro brāhmaṇo na ca brāhmaṇaḥ ॥8॥
12.189.10: nityaṁ krodhācchriyaṁ rakṣet tapo rakṣecca matsarāt ॥10॥
12.189.12: tyāge yasya hutaṁ sarvaṁ sa tyāgī ca sa buddhimān,
12.189.15: indriyairgr̥hyate yad yat tattad vyaktamiti sthitiḥ,
12.189.16: manaḥ prāṇe nigr̥hṇīyāt prāṇaṁ brahmaṇi dhārayet ॥16॥
12.189.17: nirvedādeva nirvāṇaṁ na ca kiñcid vicintayet,
12.189.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi bhr̥gubharadvājasaṁvāde varṇasvarūpakathane ekonanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥189॥
12.190.1: satyaṁ brahma tapaḥ satyaṁ satyaṁ visr̥jate prajāḥ,
satyena dhāryate lokaḥ svargaṁ satyena gacchati ॥1॥
12.190.2: anr̥taṁ tamaso rūpaṁ tamasā nīyate hyathaḥ,
12.190.3: svargaḥ prakāśa ityāhurnarakaṁ tama eva ca,
12.190.4: dharmādhararmau prakāśaśca tamo duḥkhaṁ sukhaṁ tathā ॥4॥
12.190.5: tatra yat satyaṁ sa dharmo yo dharmaḥ sa prakāśo yaḥ prakāśastat sukhamiti, tatra yadanr̥taṁ so’dharmo yo’dharmastat tamo yat tamastad duḥkhamiti ॥5॥
12.190.8: rāhugrastasya somasya yathā jyotsnā na bhāsate,
12.190.9: tat khalu dvividhaṁ sukhamucyate śārīraṁ mānasaṁ ca, iha khalvamuṣmiṁśca loke vastupravr̥ttayaḥ sukhārtha-mabhidhīyante, na hyataḥ paraṁ trivargaphalaṁ viśiṣṭataramasti sa eva kāmyo guṇaviśeṣo dharmārthaguṇārambhastaddhetura-syotpattiḥ sukhaprayojanārtha ārambhaḥ ॥9॥
12.190.10: yadetad bhavatābhihitaṁ sukhānāṁ paramā sthitiriti na tadupagr̥hṇīmo na hyeṣāmr̥ṣīṇāṁ mahati sthitānāmaprāpya eṣa kāmyo guṇaviśeṣo na cainamabhilaṣanti ca tapasi śrūyate trilokakr̥d brahmā prabhurekākī tiṣṭhati, brahmacārī na kāmasukheṣvātmānamavadadhāti, api ca bhagavān viśveśvara umāpatiḥ kāmamabhivartamānamanaṅgatvena śamamanayat, tasmād brūmo na tu mahātmabhirayaṁ pratigr̥hīto na tveṣāṁ tāvadviśiṣṭo guṇaviśeṣa iti, naitad bhagavataḥ pratyemi bhagavatā tūktaṁ sukhānna paramastīti lokapravādo hi dvividhaḥ phalodayaḥ sukr̥tāt sukhamavāpyate duṣkr̥tād duḥkhamiti ॥10॥
12.190.11: atrocyate-anr̥tāt khalu tamaḥ prādurbhūtaṁ tatastamo-grastā adharmamevānuvartante na dharmaṁ krodhalobhahiṁsānr̥tā-dibhiravacchannā na khalvasmim̐lloke nāmutra sukhamāpnu-vanti, vividhavyādhirujopatāpairavakīryante, vadhabandhana-parikleśādibhiśca kṣutpipāsāśramakr̥tairupatāpairupa-tapyante, varṣavātātyuṣṇātiśītakr̥taiśca pratibhayaiḥ śārīrairduḥkhairupatapyante, bandhudhanavināśaviprayogakr̥taiśca mānasaiḥ śokairabhibhūyante jarāmr̥tyukr̥taiścānyairiti ॥11॥
12.190.12: yastvetaiḥ śārīramānasairduḥkhairna saṁspr̥śyate sa sukhaṁ veda, na caite doṣāḥ svarge prādurbhavanti, tatra khalu bhavanti ॥12॥
12.190.13: kṣutpipāsā śramo nāsti na jarā na ca pāpakam ॥13॥
12.190.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi bhr̥gubharadvājasaṁvāde navatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥190॥
12.191.1: dānasya kiṁ phalaṁ prāhurdharmasya caritasya ca,
12.191.3: dānaṁ tu dvividhaṁ prāhuḥ paratrārthamihaiva ca,
12.191.4: asadbhyo dīyate yattu tad dānamiha bhujyate,
12.191.5: kiṁ kasya dharmācaraṇaṁ kiṁ vā dharmasya lakṣaṇam,
dharmaḥ katividho vāpi tad bhavān vaktumarhati ॥5॥
12.191.7: teṣāṁ sve sve samācārāstān me vaktumihārhasi ॥7॥
12.191.8: pūrvameva bhagavatā brahmaṇā lokahitamanutiṣṭhatā dharmasaṁrakṣaṇārthamāśramāścatvāro’bhinirdiṣṭāḥ, tatra gurukulavāsameva prathamamāśramamudāharanti, samyag yatra śaucasaṁskāraniyamavrataviniyatātmā ubhe sandhye bhāskarāgnidaivatānyupasthāya vihāya tandryālasye gurorabhivādanavedābhyāsaśravaṇapavitrīkr̥tāntarātmā triṣavaṇamupaspr̥śya brahmacaryāgniparicaraṇaguruśuśrūṣāni-tyabhikṣābhaikṣyādi sarvaniveditāntarātmā guruvacanani-rdeśānuṣṭhānāpratikūlo guruprasādalabdhasvādhyāyatatparaḥ syāt ॥8॥
12.191.10: gārhasthyaṁ khalu dvitīyamāśramaṁ vadanti, tasya samudācāralakṣaṇaṁ sarvamanuvyākhyāsyāmaḥ, samāvr̥ttānāṁ sadācārāṇāṁ sahadharmacaryaphalārthinā gr̥hāśramo vidhīyate, dharmārthakāmāvāptirhyatra trivargasādhanamapekṣyāgarhitena karmaṇā dhanānyādāya svādhyāyopalabdhaprakarṣeṇa vā brahmarṣinirmitena vā adrisāragatena vā, havyakavyaniyamābhyāsadaivata-prasādopalabdhena vā dhanena gr̥hastho gārhasthyaṁ vartayet, taddhi sarvāśramāṇāṁ mūlamudāharanti, gurukulanivāsinaḥ parivrājakā ye cānye saṅkalpitavrataniyama-dharmānuṣṭhāyinasteṣāmapyata eva bhikṣābalisaṁvibhāgāḥ pravartante ॥10॥
12.191.11: vānaprasthānāṁ ca dravyopaskāra iti prāyaśaḥ khalvete sādhavaḥ sādhupathyaudanāḥ svādhyāyaprasaṅgina-stīrthābhigamanadeśadarśanārthaṁ pr̥thivīṁ paryaṭanti, teṣāṁ pratyutthānābhigamanābhivādanānasūyavākpradānasukhaśa-ktyāsanasukhaśayanābhyavahārasatkriyā ceti ॥11॥
12.191.12: sa dattvā duṣkr̥taṁ tasmai puṇyamādāya gacchati ॥12॥
12.191.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi bhr̥gubharadvājasaṁvāde ekanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥191॥
12.192.1: vānaprasthāḥ khalvapi dharmamanusarantaḥ puṇyāni tīrthāni nadīprasravaṇāni suvivikteṣvaraṇyeṣu mr̥gamahiṣavarāhaśārdūvanagajākīrṇeṣu tapasyanto’nusañcaranti tyaktagrāmyavastrābhyavahāropabhogā vanyauṣadhi-phalamūlaparṇaparimitavicitraniyatāhārāḥ sthānāsa-nino bhūmipāṣāṇasikatāśarkarāvālukābhasma-śāyinaḥ kāśakuśacarmavalkalasaṁvr̥tāṅgāḥ keśa-śmaśrunakharomadhāriṇo niyatakālopasparśanā aska-nditakālabalihomānuṣṭhāyinaḥ samitkuśakusumāpahā-rasammārjanalabdhaviśrāmāḥ śītoṣṇavarṣapavanaviṣṭambhavi-bhinnasarvatvaco vividhaniyamopayogacaryānuṣṭhānavihi-tapariśuṣkamāṁsaśoṇitatvagasthibhūtā dhr̥tiparāḥ sattva-yogāccharīrāṇyudvahante ॥1॥
12.192.2: yastvetāṁ niyataścaryāṁ brahmarṣivihitāṁ caret sa dahedagnivaddoṣān jayellokāṁśca durjayān ॥2॥
12.192.3: parivrājakānāṁ punarācāraḥ—tadyathā vimucyāgni-dhanakalatraparibarhaṇaṁ saṅgeṣvātmanaḥ snehapāśānavadhūya parivrajanti, samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanāstrivargapravr̥tteṣva-saktabuddhayo’rimitrodāsīnānāṁ tulyadarśanāḥ sthāvara-jarāyujāṇḍajasvedajodbhijjānāṁ bhūtānāṁ bāṅmanaḥ-karmabhiranabhidrohiṇo’niketāḥ parvatapulinavr̥kṣamūla devatāyatanānyanucaranto vāsārthamupeyurnagaraṁ grāmaṁ vā nagare pañcarātrikāḥ grāme caikarātrikāḥ praviśya ca prāṇadhāraṇārthaṁ dvijātīnāṁ bhavanānyasaṅkīrṇakarmaṇāmupatiṣṭheyuḥ pātrapatitāyācitabhaikṣyāḥ kāmakrodhadarpa-lobhamohakārpaṇyadambhaparivādābhimānahiṁsānivr̥ttā iti ॥3॥
12.192.8: puṇyaḥ kṣemyaśca kāmyaśca sa paro loka ucyate ॥8॥
12.192.10: sa svargasadr̥śo deśastatra hyuktāḥ śubhā guṇāḥ,
kāle mr̥tyuḥ prabhavati spr̥śanti vyādhayo na ca ॥10॥
12.192.11: nānyonyaṁ badhyate tatra dravyeṣu ca na vismayaḥ,
paro hyadharmo naivāsti sandeho nāpi jāyate ॥11॥
12.192.15: iha śramo bhayaṁ mohaḥ kṣudhā tīvrā ca jāyate,
12.192.16: yastadvedobhayaṁ prājñaḥ pāpmanā na sa lipyate ॥16॥
12.192.21: ihasthāstatra jāyante ye vai puṇyakr̥to janāḥ ॥21॥
12.192.23: ihaiva parivartante na te yāntyuttarāṁ diśam ॥23॥
12.192.25: dharmādharmau hi lokasya yo vai vetti sa buddhimān ॥25॥
12.192.27: eṣa te prasavo rājan jagataḥ samprakīrtitaḥ,
12.192.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi bhr̥gubharadvājasaṁvāde dvinavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥192॥
12.193.1: śrotumicchāmi dharmajña sarvajño hyasi me mataḥ ॥1॥
12.193.3: purīṣaṁ yadi vā mūtraṁ ye na kurvanti mānavāḥ,
rājamārge gavāṁ madhye dhānyamadhye ca te śubhāḥ ॥3॥
12.193.5: sūryaṁ sadopatiṣṭheta na ca sūryodaye svapet,
sāyaṁ prātarjapet sandhyāṁ tiṣṭhan pūrvāṁ tathetarām ॥5॥
12.193.8: brāhmaṇaṁ dhārmikaṁ caityaṁ nityaṁ kuryāt pradakṣiṇam ॥8॥
12.193.9: atithīnāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ preṣyāṇāṁ svajanasya ca,
12.193.13: loṣṭamardā tr̥ṇacchedo nakhakhādī tu yo naraḥ,
12.193.14: na bhakṣayed vr̥thāmāṁsaṁ pr̥ṣṭhamāṁsaṁ ca varjayet ॥14॥
12.193.17: maithunaṁ satataṁ dharmyaṁ guhme caiva samācaret ॥17॥
12.193.18: tīrthānāṁ hr̥dayaṁ tīrthaṁ śucīnāṁ hr̥dayaṁ śuciḥ,
12.193.21: sāyaṁ prātaśca viprāṇāṁ pūjanaṁ ca yathāvidhi,
paṇyānāṁ śobhate paṇyaṁ kr̥ṣīṇāṁ bādyate kr̥ṣiḥ ॥21॥
12.193.22: bahukāraṁ ca sasyānāṁ vāhye vāho gavāṁ tathā,
sampannaṁ bhojane nityaṁ pānīye tarpaṇaṁ tathā ॥22॥
12.193.23: suśr̥taṁ pāyase brūyād yavāgvāṁ kr̥sare tathā,
12.193.24: pratyādityaṁ na meheta na paśyedātmanaḥ śakr̥t,
saha striyātha śayanaṁ saha bhojyaṁ ca varjayet ॥24॥
12.193.30: tad budhā na praśaṁsanti maraṇaṁ na pratīkṣate ॥30॥
12.193.32: eka eva cared dharmaṁ nāsti dharme sahāyatā,
12.193.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi bhīṣmayudhiṣṭhira saṁvāde ācāravidhau trinavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥193॥
12.194.1: yadadhyātmaṁ yathā caitat tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.194.3: tad vyākhyāsyāmi te tāta śreyaskaratamaṁ sukham ॥3॥
12.194.4: yajjñātvā puruṣo loke prītiṁ saukhyaṁ ca vindati,
phalalābhaśca tasya syāt sarvabhūtahitaṁ ca tat ॥4॥
12.194.6: yataḥ sr̥ṣṭāni tatraiva tāni yānti punaḥ punaḥ,
12.194.7: prasārya ca yathāṅgāni kūrmaḥ saṁharate punaḥ,
tahad bhūtāni bhūtātmā sr̥ṣṭāni harate punaḥ ॥7॥
12.194.8: akarot teṣu vaiṣamyaṁ tattu jīvo na paśyati ॥8॥
12.194.9: vāyoḥ sparśastathā ceṣṭā tvak caiva tritayaṁ smr̥tam ॥9॥
12.194.10: rasaḥ kledaśca jihvā ca trayo jalaguṇāḥ smr̥tāḥ ॥10॥
12.194.11: ghreyaṁ ghrāṇaṁ śarīraṁ ca ete bhūmiguṇāstrayaḥ,
mahābhūtāni pañcaiva ṣaṣṭhaṁ ca mana ucyate ॥11॥
12.194.15: tamo rajaśca sattvaṁ ca te’pi bhāvāstadāśritāḥ ॥15॥
12.194.16: etāṁ buddhvā naro buddhyā bhūtānāmāgatiṁ gatim,
12.194.20: yena prārthayate kiñcit tadā bhavati tanmanaḥ ॥20॥
12.194.23: na sukhena na duḥkhena kadācidapi vartate,
12.194.26: indriyāṇi hi sarvāṇi pravartayati sā tadā,
12.194.27: prītiḥ sattvaṁ rajaḥ śokastamo mohastu te trayaḥ,
ye ye ca bhāvā loke’smin sarveṣveteṣu vai triṣu ॥27॥
12.194.28: iti buddhigatiḥ sarvā vyākhyātā tava bhārata,
12.194.30: sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti bhārata,
12.194.31: tatra yat prītisaṁyuktaṁ kāye manasi vā bhavet,
vartate sāttviko bhāva ityācakṣīta tat tathā ॥31॥
12.194.32: pravr̥ttaṁ raja ityeva tanna saṁrabhya cintayet ॥32॥
12.194.37: manaḥ suniyataṁ yasya sa sukhī pretya ceha ca ॥37॥
12.194.38: sr̥jate tu guṇāneka eko na sr̥jate guṇān ॥38॥
12.194.40: pr̥thagbhūtau prakr̥tyā tau samprayuktau ca sarvadā,
yathā matsyo jalaṁ caiva samprayuktau tathaiva tau ॥40॥
12.194.41: na guṇā vidurātmānaṁ sa guṇān vetti sarvaśaḥ,
12.194.43: sr̥jate hi guṇān sattvaṁ kṣetrajñaḥ paripaśyati,
12.194.44: āśrayo nāsti sattvasya kṣetrajñasya ca kaścana,
sattvaṁ manaḥ saṁsr̥jate na guṇān vai kadācana ॥44॥
12.194.47: yathā vāricaraḥ pakṣī salilena na lipyate,
12.194.49: svabhāvayuktyā yuktastu sa nityaṁ sr̥jate guṇān,
12.194.53: malināḥ prāpnuyuḥ śuddhiṁ yathā pūrṇāṁ nadīṁ narāḥ,
12.194.54: na tu tapyati tattvajñaḥ phale jñāte taratyuta ॥54॥
12.194.56: etāṁ buddhvā naraḥ sarvāṁ bhūtānāmāgatiṁ gatim,
avekṣya ca śanairbuddhyā labhate śamanaṁ tataḥ ॥56॥
12.194.57: trivargo yasya viditaḥ prekṣya yaśca vimuñcati,
12.194.59: etad buddhvā bhaved buddhaḥ kimanyad buddhalakṣaṇam,
12.194.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi adhyātmakathane caturnavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥194॥
12.195.1: hanta vakṣyāmi te pārtha dhyānayogaṁ caturvidham,
yaṁ jñātvā śāśvatīṁ siddhiṁ gacchantīha maharṣayaḥ ॥1॥
12.195.2: yathā svanuṣṭhitaṁ dhyānaṁ tathā kurvanti yoginaḥ,
12.195.6: śabdaṁ na vindecchrotreṇa sparśaṁ tvacā na vedayet,
rūpaṁ na cakṣuṣā vidyājjihvayā na rasāṁstathā ॥6॥
12.195.7: ghreyāṇyapi ca sarvāṇi jahyād dhyānena yogavit,
12.195.21: na tatpuruṣakāreṇa na ca daivena kenacit,
12.195.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi dhyānayogakathane pañcanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥195॥
12.196.2: sandeho’sti tu kaścinme tad bhavān vaktumarhati ॥2॥
12.196.3: kimphalaṁ japatāmuktaṁ kva vā tiṣṭhanti jāpakāḥ ॥3॥
12.196.4: japyasya ca vidhiṁ kr̥tsnaṁ vaktumarhasi me’nagha,
12.196.5: etanme sarvamācakṣva sarvajño hyasi me mataḥ ॥5॥
12.196.6: yamasya yat purāvr̥ttaṁ kālasya brāhmaṇasya ca ॥6॥
12.196.7: saṁnyāsa eva vedānte vartate japanaṁ prati ॥7॥
12.196.9: mārgau tāvapyubhāvetau saṁśritau na ca saṁśritau,
yathā saṁśrūyate rājan kāraṇaṁ cātra vakṣyate ॥9॥
12.196.16: tad dhiyā dhyāyati brahma japan vai saṁhitām hitām,
12.196.18: arāgamoho nirdvandvo na śocati na sajjate,
na kartā kāraṇānāṁ ca na kāryāṇāmiti sthitiḥ ॥18॥
12.196.19: na cārthagrahaṇe yukto nāvamānī na cākriyaḥ ॥19॥
12.196.22: utkrāmati ca mārgastho naiva kvacana jāyate ॥22॥
12.196.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi jāpakopākhyāne ṣaṇṇavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥196॥
12.197.4: avamānena kurute na prīyati na hr̥ṣyati,
īdr̥śo jāpako yāti nirayaṁ nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥4॥
12.197.6: yatrābhidhyāṁ sa kurute taṁ vai nirayamr̥cchati ॥6॥
12.197.7: sa eva nirayastasya nāsau tasmāt pramucyate ॥7॥
12.197.8: rāgeṇa jāpako japyaṁ kurute tatra mohitaḥ,
12.197.9: calāmeva gatiṁ yāti nirayaṁ vā niyacchati ॥9॥
12.197.11: na sampūrṇo na saṁyukto nirayaṁ so’nugacchati ॥11॥
12.197.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi jāpakopākhyāne saptanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥197॥
12.198.1: kīdr̥śaṁ nirayaṁ yāti jāpako varṇayasva me,
kautūhalaṁ hi rājan me tad bhavān vaktumarhati ॥1॥
12.198.7: abhayaṁ cānimittaṁ ca na tat kleśasamāvr̥tam,
12.198.9: kālaḥ sampadyate tatra kālastatra na vai prabhuḥ,
sa kālasya prabhū rājan svargasyāpi tatheśvaraḥ ॥9॥
12.198.10: īdr̥śaṁ paramaṁ sthānaṁ nirayāste ca tādr̥śāḥ ॥10॥
12.198.11: ete te nirayāḥ proktāḥ sarva eva yathātatham,
12.198.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi jāpakopākhyāne aṣṭanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥198॥
12.199.1: vivādo vyāhr̥taḥ pūrvaṁ tad bhavān vaktumarhati ॥1॥
12.199.2: ikṣvākoḥ sūryaputrasya yad vr̥ttaṁ brāhmaṇasya ca ॥2॥
12.199.3: kālasya mr̥tyośca tathā yad vr̥ttaṁ tannibodha me,
yathā sa teṣāṁ saṁvādo yasmin sthāne’pi cābhavat ॥3॥
12.199.6: sodyaṁ brāhmaṁ tapastepe saṁhitāṁ saṁyato japan,
tasya varṣasahasraṁ tu niyamena tathā gatam ॥6॥
12.199.7: sa devyā darśitaḥ sākṣāt prītāsmīti tadā kila,
12.199.10: diṣṭyā devi prasannā tvaṁ darśanaṁ cāgatā mama,
yadi cāpi prasannāsi japye me ramatāṁ manaḥ ॥10॥
12.199.11: kiṁ prārthayasi viprarṣe kiṁ ceṣṭaṁ karavāṇi te,
prabrūhi japatāṁ śreṣṭha sarvaṁ tat te bhaviṣyati ॥11॥
12.199.12: ityuktaḥ sa tadā devyā vipraḥ provāca dharmavit,
japyaṁ prati mameccheyaṁ vardhatviti punaḥ punaḥ ॥12॥
12.199.13: tat tatheti tato devī madhuraṁ pratyabhāṣata ॥13॥
12.199.14: nirayaṁ naiva yātā tvaṁ yatra yātā dvijarṣabhāḥ ॥14॥
12.199.17: bhavitā ca vivādo’tra tava teṣāṁ ca dharmataḥ,
12.199.19: sākṣāt prītastadā dharmo darśayāmāsa taṁ dvijam ॥19॥
12.199.20: dvijāte paśya māṁ dharmamahaṁ tvāṁ draṣṭumāgataḥ,
japyasyāsya phalaṁ yattat samprāptaṁ tacca me śr̥ṇu ॥20॥
12.199.21: jitā lokāstvayā sarve ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ,
12.199.22: prāṇatyāgaṁ kuru mune gaccha lokān yathepsitān,
12.199.23: kiṁ nu lokairhi me dharma gaccha tvaṁ ca yathāsukham,
12.199.24: avaśyaṁ bhoḥ śarīraṁ te tyaktavyaṁ munipuṅgava,
svargamāroha bho vipra kiṁ vā vai rocate’nagha ॥24॥
12.199.25: na rocaye svargavāsaṁ vinā dehamahaṁ vibho,
gaccha dharma na me śraddhā svargaṁ gantuṁ vinā’’tmanā ॥25॥
12.199.26: alaṁ dehe manaḥ kr̥tvā tyaktvā dehaṁ sukhī bhava,
gaccha lokānarajaso yatra gatvā na śocasi ॥26॥
12.199.27: rame japan mahābhāga kiṁ nu lokaiḥ sanātanaiḥ,
saśarīreṇa gantavyaṁ mayā svargaṁ na vā vibho ॥27॥
12.199.28: yadi tvaṁ necchase tyaktuṁ śarīraṁ paśya vai dvija,
12.199.29: atha vaivasvataḥ kālo mr̥tyuśca tritayaṁ vibho,
12.199.32: mr̥tyuṁ māṁ viddhi dharmajña rūpiṇaṁ svayamāgatam,
kālena codito vipra tvāmito netumadya vai ॥32॥
12.199.33: mr̥tyave cātha dharmāya kiṁ kāryaṁ karavāṇi vaḥ ॥33॥
12.199.34: arghyaṁ pādyaṁ ca dattvā sa tebhyastatra samāgame,
abravīt paramaprītaḥ svaśaktyā kiṁ karomi vaḥ ॥34॥
12.199.35: ikṣvākuragamat tatra sametā yatra te vibho ॥35॥
12.199.36: sarvāneva tu rājarṣiḥ sampūjyātha praṇamya ca,
12.199.37: tasmai so’thāsanaṁ dattvā pādyamarghyaṁ tathaiva ca,
12.199.38: svāgataṁ te mahārāja brūhi yad yadihecchasi,
svaśaktyā kiṁ karomīha tad bhavān prabravītu mām ॥38॥
12.199.39: dadāni vasu kiñcitte prathitaṁ tad vadasva me ॥39॥
12.199.40: dvividhā brāhmaṇā rājan dharmaśca dvividhaḥ smr̥taḥ,
12.199.41: tebhyaḥ prayaccha dānāni ye pravr̥ttā narādhipa,
ahaṁ na pratigr̥hṇāmi kimiṣṭaṁ kiṁ dadāmi te,
brūhi tvaṁ nr̥patiśreṣṭha tapasā sādhayāmi kim ॥41॥
12.199.42: kṣatriyo’haṁ na jānāmi dehīti vacanaṁ kvacit,
12.199.43: tuṣyasi tvaṁ svadharmeṇa tathā tuṣṭā vayaṁ nr̥pa,
12.199.44: yāce tvāṁ dīyatāṁ mahyaṁ japyasyāsya phalaṁ dvija ॥44॥
12.199.45: yuddhaṁ mama sadā vāṇī yācatīti vikatthase,
na ca yuddhaṁ mayā sārdhaṁ kimarthaṁ yācase punaḥ ॥45॥
12.199.46: vāgyuddhaṁ tadidaṁ tīvraṁ mama vipra tvayā saha ॥46॥
12.199.47: saivādyāpi pratijñā me svaśaktyā kiṁ pradīyatām,
brūhi dāsyāmi rājendra vibhave sati mā ciram ॥47॥
12.199.48: yattad varṣaśataṁ pūrṇaṁ japyaṁ vai japatā tvayā,
phalaṁ prāptaṁ tat prayaccha mama ditsurbhavān yadi ॥48॥
12.199.49: paramaṁ gr̥hyatāṁ tasya phalaṁ yajjapitaṁ mayā,
12.199.50: rājan prāpnuhi kāmaṁ tvaṁ yadi sarvamihecchasi ॥50॥
12.199.51: kr̥taṁ sarveṇa bhadraṁ te japyaṁ yad yācitaṁ mayā,
svasti te’stu gamiṣyāmi kiñca tasya phalaṁ vada ॥51॥
12.199.52: phalaprāptiṁ na jānāmi dattaṁ yajjapitaṁ mayā,
ayaṁ dharmaśca kālaśca yamo mr̥tyuśca sākṣiṇaḥ ॥52॥
12.199.53: ajñātamasya dharmasya phalaṁ kiṁ me kariṣyati,
phalaṁ bravīṣi dharmasya na cejjapyakr̥tasya mām,
prāpnotu tat phalaṁ vipro nāhamicche sasaṁśayam ॥53॥
12.199.54: vākyaṁ pramāṇaṁ rājarṣe mamādya tava caiva hi ॥54॥
12.199.56: dadasveti tvayā coktaṁ dadānīti mayā tathā,
na vācaṁ dūṣayiṣyāmi satyaṁ rakṣa sthiro bhava ॥56॥
12.199.57: athaivaṁ vadato me’dya vacanaṁ na kariṣyasi,
mahānadharmo bhavitā tava rājan mr̥ṣā kr̥taḥ ॥57॥
12.199.58: na yuktaṁ tu mr̥ṣā vāṇī tvayā vaktumarindama,
tathā mayāpyabhihitaṁ mithyā kartuṁ na śakyate ॥58॥
12.199.59: tad gr̥hṇīṣvāvicāreṇa yadi satye sthito bhavān ॥59॥
12.199.60: ihāgamya hi māṁ rājan jāpyaṁ phalamayācathāḥ,
tanme nisr̥ṣṭaṁ gr̥hṇīṣva bhava satye sthiro’pi ca ॥60॥
12.199.61: nāyaṁ loko’sti na paro na ca pūrvān sa tārayet,
12.199.62: yathā satyaṁ pare loke tatheha puruṣarṣabha ॥62॥
12.199.63: tapāṁsi yāni cīrṇāni cariṣyanti ca yat tapaḥ,
12.199.65: satyaṁ vedeṣu jāgārti phalaṁ satye paraṁ smr̥tam,
satyād dharmo damaścaiva sarvaṁ satye pratiṣṭhitam ॥65॥
12.199.67: prāṇināṁ jananaṁ satyaṁ satyaṁ santatireva ca,
12.199.68: satyaṁ yajñastapo vedāḥ stobhā mantrāḥ sarasvatī ॥68॥
12.199.69: tulāmāropito dharmaḥ satyaṁ caiveti naḥ śrutam,
12.199.70: yato dharmastataḥ satyaṁ sarvaṁ satyena vardhate,
12.199.71: satye kuru sthiraṁ bhāvaṁ mā rājannanr̥taṁ kr̥thāḥ,
12.199.72: yadi japyaphalaṁ dattaṁ mayā naiṣiṣyase nr̥pa,
12.199.73: saṁśrutya yo na ditseta yācitvā yaśca necchati,
12.199.74: yoddhavyaṁ rakṣitavyaṁ ca kṣatradharmaḥ kila dvija,
dātāraḥ kṣatriyāḥ proktā gr̥hṇīyāṁ bhavataḥ katham ॥74॥
12.199.75: na cchandayāmi te rājannāpi te gr̥hamāvrajam,
ihāgamya tu yācitvā na gr̥hṇīṣe punaḥ katham ॥75॥
12.199.77: svargaṁ māṁ viddhi rājendra rūpiṇaṁ svayamāgatam,
12.199.78: kr̥taṁ svargeṇa me kāryaṁ gaccha svarga yathāgatam,
vipro yadīcchate gantuṁ cīrṇaṁ gr̥hṇātu me phalam ॥78॥
12.199.80: svena kāryaṁ kariṣyāmi tvatto necche phalaṁ nr̥pa,
12.199.81: yadi vipra visr̥ṣṭaṁ te japyasya phalamuttamam,
āvayoryat phalaṁ kiñcit sahitaṁ nau tadastviha ॥81॥
12.199.82: yadi dharmaḥ śruto vipra sahaiva phalamastu nau ॥82॥
12.199.83: mā vā bhūt sahabhojyaṁ nau madīyaṁ phalamāpnuhi,
pratīccha matkr̥taṁ dharmaṁ yadi te mayyanugrahaḥ ॥83॥
12.199.86: satyaṁ bravīmyahamidaṁ na me dhārayate bhavān,
12.199.87: parīkṣya tvaṁ yathā syāvo nāvāmiha vigarhitau ॥87॥
12.199.88: dadataśca na gr̥hṇāti vikr̥to me mahīpate ॥88॥
