12.199.89: na me dhārayate kiñcid virūpo’yaṁ narādhipa,
mithyā bravītyayaṁ hi tvāṁ satyābhāsaṁ narādhipa ॥89॥
12.199.90: virūpa kiṁ dhārayate bhavānasya bravītu me,
śrutvā tathā kariṣye’hamiti me dhīyate manaḥ ॥90॥
12.199.94: gāvau ca kapile krītvā vatsale bahudohane ॥94॥
12.199.96: ihādyaiva gr̥hītvā tu prayacche dviguṇaṁ phalam,
evaṁ syāt puruṣavyāghra kaḥ śuddhaḥ ko’tra doṣavān ॥96॥
12.199.97: kuru dharmamadharmaṁ vā vinaye nau samādadha ॥97॥
12.199.98: yadi necchati me dānaṁ yathā dattamanena vai,
bhavānatra sthiro bhūtvā mārge sthāpayitādya nau ॥98॥
12.199.99: dīyamānaṁ na gr̥hṇāsi r̥ṇaṁ kasmāt tvamadya vai,
yathaiva te’bhyanujñātaṁ tathā gr̥hṇīṣva mā ciram ॥99॥
12.199.100: nāyaṁ me dhārayatyadya gacchatāṁ yatra vāñchati ॥100॥
12.199.101: dadato’sya na gr̥hṇāsi viṣamaṁ pratibhāti me,
daṇḍyo hi tvaṁ mama mato nāstyatra khalu saṁśayaḥ ॥101॥
12.199.102: mayāsya dattaṁ rājarṣe gr̥hṇīyāṁ tat kathaṁ punaḥ,
12.199.104: svaṁ mayā yāciteneha dattaṁ kathamihādya tat,
12.199.107: kathaṁ na lipyeyamahaṁ pāpena mahatādya vai ॥107॥
12.199.108: tau covāca sa rājarṣiḥ kr̥takāryau gamiṣyathaḥ,
12.199.110: gr̥hāṇa dhāraye’haṁ ca yācitaṁ saṁśrutaṁ mayā,
na ced grahīṣyase rājan śapiṣye tvāṁ na saṁśayaḥ ॥110॥
12.199.111: ityarthaṁ me grahītavyaṁ kathaṁ tulyaṁ bhavediti ॥111॥
12.199.113: saṁhitāṁ japatā yāvān guṇaḥ kaścit kr̥to mayā,
tat sarvaṁ pratigr̥hṇīṣva yadi kiñcidihāsti me ॥113॥
12.199.115: kāmakrodhau viddhi nau tvamāvābhyāṁ kārito bhavān,
saheti ca yaduktaṁ te samā lokāstavāsya ca ॥115॥
12.199.116: kālo dharmastathā mr̥tyuḥ kāmakrodhau tathā yuvām ॥116॥
12.199.117: gaccha lokān jitān svena karmaṇā yatra vāñchasi ॥117॥
12.199.118: gatiḥ sthānaṁ ca lokāśca jāpakena yathā jitāḥ ॥118॥
12.199.120: sa taijasena bhāvena yadi tatra ramatyuta,
12.199.122: atha tatra virāgī sa gacchati tvatha saṁśayam,
12.199.123: brahmabhūtaḥ sa nirdvandvaḥ sukhī śānto nirāmayaḥ ॥123॥
12.199.127: nispr̥haḥ sarvato muktastatra vai ramate sukham ॥127॥
12.199.128: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ॥128॥
12.199.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi jāpakopākhyāne navanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥199॥
12.200.1: kimuttaraṁ tadā tau sma cakratustasya bhāṣite,
brāhmaṇo vāthavā rājā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.200.2: athavā tau gatau tatra yadetat kīrtitaṁ tvayā,
saṁvādo vā tayoḥ ko’bhūt kiṁ vā tau tatra cakratuḥ ॥2॥
12.200.3: tathetyevaṁ pratiśrutya dharmaṁ sampūjya ca prabho,
yamaṁ kālaṁ ca mr̥tyuṁ ca svargaṁ sampūjya cārhataḥ ॥3॥
12.200.4: pūrvaṁ ye cāpare tatra sametā brāhmaṇarṣabhāḥ,
sarvān sampūjya śirasā rājānaṁ so’bravīd dvijaḥ ॥4॥
12.200.5: bhavatā cābhyanujñāto japeyaṁ bhūya eva ha ॥5॥
12.200.6: varaśca mama pūrvaṁ hi datto devyā mahābala,
śraddhā te japato nityaṁ bhavatviti viśāmpate ॥6॥
12.200.7: yadyevamaphalā siddhiḥ śraddhā ca japituṁ tava,
gaccha vipra mayā sārdhaṁ jāpakaṁ phalamāpnuhi ॥7॥
12.200.8: saha tulyaphalāvāvaṁ gacchāvo yatra nau gatiḥ ॥8॥
12.200.10: sādhyāśca viśve maruto vādyāni sumahānti ca,
nadyaḥ śailāḥ samudrāśca tīrthāni vividhāni ca ॥10॥
12.200.15: saṁsiddhastvaṁ mahābhāga tvaṁ ca siddhastathā nr̥pa ॥15॥
12.200.17: evaṁ tau manasi sthāpya dadhatuḥ prāṇayormanaḥ ॥17॥
12.200.21: tajjyotiḥ stūyamānaṁ sma brahmāṇaṁ prāviśat tadā ॥21॥
12.200.25: uṣyatāṁ mayi cetyuktvā cetayat satataṁ punaḥ,
12.200.31: yaśca yoge bhaved bhaktaḥ so’pi nāstyatra saṁśayaḥ,
12.200.32: āmantrya ca tato devā yayuḥ svaṁ svaṁ niveśanam ॥32॥
12.200.33: te ca sarve mahātmāno dharmaṁ satkr̥tya tatra vai,
12.200.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi jāpakopākhyāne dviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥200॥
12.201.1: kiṁ phalaṁ jñānayogasya vedānāṁ niyamasya ca,
bhūtātmā ca kathaṁ jñeyastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.201.5: kiṁ tatkathaṁ vā bhavitā kva vā tat ॥5॥
12.201.11: iṣṭaṁ ca me syāditaracca na syā-
iṣṭaṁ tvaniṣṭaṁ ca na māṁ bhajete-
12.201.22: vācā tu yat karma karoti kiñcid
12.201.27: na strī pumān nāpi napuṁsakaṁ ca
12.201.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi manubr̥haspatisaṁvāde ekādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥201॥
12.202.1: akṣarāt khaṁ tato vāyustato jyotistato jalam,
jalāt prasūtā jagatī jagatyāṁ jāyate jagat ॥1॥
12.202.3: noṣṇaṁ na śītaṁ mr̥du nāpi tīkṣṇaṁ
12.202.4: ghrāṇaṁ ca gandhān śravaṇau ca śabdān,
12.202.6: yasmiṁśca yad yena ca yaśca kartā
12.202.16: na cāpi taiḥ sādhayate tu kāryaṁ
te taṁ na paśyanti sa paśyate tān ॥16॥
12.202.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi manubr̥haspatisaṁvāde dvyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥202॥
12.203.6: yathā himavataḥ pārśvaṁ pr̥ṣṭhaṁ candramaso yathā,
na dr̥ṣṭapūrvaṁ manujairna ca tannāsti tāvatā ॥6॥
12.203.8: paśyannapi yathā lakṣma jagat some na vindati,
evamasti na cotpannaṁ na ca tanna parāyaṇam ॥8॥
12.203.12: gajānāṁ ca gajaireva jñeyaṁ jñānena gr̥hyate ॥12॥
12.203.13: ahireva hyaheḥ pādān paśyatīti hi naḥ śrutam,
12.203.14: tathaiveha parā buddhiḥ paraṁ bodhyaṁ na paśyati ॥14॥
12.203.15: na ca nāśo’sya bhavati tathā viddhi śarīriṇam ॥15॥
12.203.18: sā tu cāndramasī vr̥ttirna tu tasya śarīriṇaḥ ॥18॥
12.203.19: candra eva tvamāvāsyāṁ tathā bhavati mūrtimān ॥19॥
12.203.20: nopasarpad vimuñcad vā śaśinaṁ dr̥śyate tamaḥ,
12.203.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi manubr̥haspatisaṁvāde tryadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥203॥
12.204.1: yathā vyaktamidaṁ śete svapne carati cetanam,
12.204.2: yathāmbhasi prasanne tu rūpaṁ paśyati cakṣuṣā,
12.204.3: sa eva lulite tasmin yathā rūpaṁ na paśyati,
12.204.7: manasā cānyathā kāṅkṣan paraṁ na pratipadyate ॥7॥
12.204.10: indriyebhyo manaḥ pūrvaṁ buddhiḥ paratarā tataḥ,
buddheḥ parataraṁ jñānaṁ jñānāt parataraṁ mahat ॥10॥
12.204.11: avyaktāt prasr̥taṁ jñānaṁ tato buddhistato manaḥ,
12.204.15: praṇītaṁ karmaṇā mārgaṁ nīyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ,
12.204.17: tadā sampadyate brahma tatraiva pralayaṁ gatam ॥17॥
12.204.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi manubr̥haspatisaṁvāde caturadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥204॥
12.205.1: yasmin na śakyate kartuṁ yatnastaṁ nānucintayet ॥1॥
12.205.4: ārogyaṁ priyasaṁvāso gr̥dhyet tatra na paṇḍitaḥ ॥4॥
12.205.6: sukhād bahutaraṁ duḥkhaṁ jīvite nāsti saṁśayaḥ,
12.205.7: parityajati yo duḥkhaṁ sukhaṁ vāpyubhayaṁ naraḥ,
abhyeti brahma so’tyantaṁ na te śocanti paṇḍitāḥ ॥7॥
12.205.8: duḥkhamarthā hi yujyante pālanena ca te sukham,
12.205.12: tadā prajñāyate brahma nikaṣaṁ nikaṣe yathā ॥12॥
12.205.17: tadā sarvān guṇān hitvā nirguṇaṁ pratipadyate ॥17॥
12.205.20: guṇahīno hi taṁ mārgaṁ bahiḥ samanuvartate,
12.205.22: tathā hi paramaṁ brahma vimuktaṁ prakr̥teḥ param ॥22॥
12.205.23: nivartante nivr̥ttau ca svargaṁ caivopayānti ca ॥23॥
12.205.26: rāgavān prakr̥tiṁ hyeti virakto jñānavān bhavet ॥26॥
12.205.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi manubr̥haspatisaṁvāde pañcādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥205॥
12.206.1: yadā taiḥ pañcabhiḥ pañca yuktāni manasā saha,
atha tad rakṣyate brahma maṇau sūtramivāpitam ॥1॥
12.206.2: tadeva ca yathā sūtraṁ suvarṇe vartate punaḥ,
12.206.4: tena tena śarīreṇa tat tat phalamupāśnute ॥4॥
12.206.7: phalaṁ karmātmakaṁ vidyāt karma jñeyātmakaṁ tathā,
12.206.8: jñānānāṁ ca phalānāṁ ca jñeyānāṁ karmaṇāṁ tathā,
12.206.9: mahaddhi paramaṁ bhūtaṁ yat prapaśyanti yoginaḥ,
12.206.11: pavanācca mahad vyoma tasmāt parataraṁ manaḥ,
manaso mahatī buddhirbuddheḥ kālo mahān smr̥taḥ ॥11॥
12.206.12: kālāt sa bhagavān viṣṇuryasya sarvamidaṁ jagat,
12.206.14: tad brahma paramaṁ proktaṁ taddhāma paramaṁ padam,
12.206.17: na yatnasādhyaṁ tad brahma nādimadhyaṁ na cāntavat ॥17॥
12.206.20: na tena martyāḥ paśyanti yena gacchanti tat padam ॥20॥
12.206.24: sūkṣmeṇa manasā vidmo vācā vaktuṁ na śaknumaḥ,
mano hi manasā grāhyaṁ darśanena ca darśanam ॥24॥
12.206.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi manubr̥haspatisaṁvāde ṣaḍadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥206॥
12.207.6: kiṁ tu yāni vidurloke brāhmaṇāḥ śārṅgadhanvani,
12.207.8: vāyurjyotistathā cāpaḥ khaṁ ca gāṁ cānvakalpayat ॥8॥
12.207.9: sa sr̥ṣṭvā pr̥thivīṁ caiva sarvabhūteśvaraḥ prabhuḥ,
12.207.13: sa tatra bhagavān devaḥ puṣkare bhrājayan diśaḥ,
12.207.22: dadau dharmāya dharmajño dakṣa eva prajāpatiḥ ॥22॥
12.207.29: ahorātraṁ ca kālaṁ ca yathartu madhusūdanaḥ,
12.207.33: sa evaṁ caturo varṇān samutpādya mahātapāḥ,
12.207.38: na caiṣāṁ maithuno dharmo babhūva bharatarṣabha,
12.207.47d1: tasya prasādād duḥkhasya nāśaṁ prāpsyasi mānada.
12.207.47d2: ekaḥ kartā sa kr̥ṣṇaśca jñānināṁ paramā gatiḥ,
12.207.47d3: sve sve pade viviśire bhuktimuktivido janāḥ,
12.207.47d13: tataḥ sa bhagavān śrīmān meghagambhīrayā giraḥ,
12.207.47d14: bhadramastu r̥ṣe tubhyaṁ varaṁ varaya suvrata,
yatte manasi suvyaktamasti ca pradadāmi tat.
12.207.47d18: te māṁ paśyanti satataṁ tān pr̥ccha yadihecchasi,
ye yogino mahāprājñā madaṁśā ye vyavasthitāḥ,
12.207.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi sarvabhūtotpattikathane saptādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥207॥
12.208.1: ke carṣayo mahābhāgā dikṣu pratyekaśaḥ smr̥tāḥ ॥1॥
12.208.2: prajānāṁ patayo ye’smin dikṣu ye carṣayaḥ smr̥tāḥ ॥2॥
12.208.3: brahmaṇaḥ sapta vai putrā mahātmānaḥ svayambhuvaḥ ॥3॥
12.208.7: tasya dve nāmanī loke dakṣaḥ ka iti cocyate ॥7॥
12.208.8: marīceḥ kaśyapaḥ putrastasya dve nāmanī smr̥te,
12.208.10: aryamā caiva bhagavān ye cāsya tanayā vibho,
12.208.12: putrāṇāṁ ca na te kañcidicchantyanyaṁ prajāpatim ॥12॥
12.208.15: savitā caiva dhātā ca vivasvāṁśca mahābalaḥ ॥15॥
12.208.18: te ca pūrvaṁ surāśceti dvividhāḥ pitaraḥ smr̥tāḥ,
12.208.21: te ca pūrvaṁ surāśceti dvividhāḥ pitaraḥ smr̥tāḥ ॥21॥
12.208.24: aśvinau tu smr̥tau śūdrau tapasyugre samāsthitau,
12.208.25: etān vai prātarutthāya devān yastu prakīrtayet ॥25॥
12.208.36: yasyāṁ yasyāṁ diśi hyete tāṁ diśaṁ śaraṇaṁ gataḥ,
12.208.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi diśāsvastikaṁ nāma aṣṭādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥208॥
12.209.2: yaccāsya tejaḥ sumahad yacca karma purā kr̥tam,
tanme sarvaṁ yathātattvaṁ brūhi tvaṁ puruṣarṣabha ॥2॥
12.209.8: na sahante sma devānāṁ samr̥ddhiṁ tāmanuttamām ॥8॥
12.209.13: te vareṇābhisampannā balena ca madena ca,
12.209.14: eṣa vegena gatvā hi yatra te dānavādhamāḥ ॥14॥
12.209.17: dr̥ṣṭvā ca sahitāḥ sarve daityāḥ sattvamamānuṣam,
12.209.19: nāśaknuvaṁśca kiñcit te tasya kartuṁ tadā vibho ॥19॥
12.209.20: tato’gacchat vismayaṁ te dānavendrā bhayaṁ tathā,
12.209.22: saṁnāditā yena lokāḥ sarvāścaiva diśo daśa ॥22॥
12.209.24: sthāvaraṁ jaṅgamaṁ caiva tena nādena mohitam ॥24॥
12.209.25: tataste dānavāḥ sarve tena nādena bhīṣitāḥ,
12.209.27: nādena tena mahatā sanātana iti smr̥taḥ,
12.209.29: nādo’yaṁ kīdr̥śo deva naitaṁ vidma vayaṁ prabho,
ko’sau hi kasya vā nādo yena vihvalitaṁ jagat ॥29॥
12.209.34: na santāpo na bhīḥ kāryā śoko vā surasattamāḥ ॥34॥
12.209.35: lokān dhārayatā tena nādo mukto mahātmanā ॥35॥
12.209.36d5: tvāmakṣaraṁ paraṁ brahma nirguṇaṁ tamasaḥ param,
12.209.36d7: kiṁ ca japyaṁ japennityaṁ kalyamutthāya mānavaḥ,
kathaṁ yuñjan sadā dhyāyed brūhi tattvaṁ sanātanam.
12.209.36d8: śrutvā tasya tu devarṣervākyaṁ vācaspatiḥ svayam,
12.209.36d11: ityukto nāradaḥ prāha prāñjaliḥ praṇataḥ sthitaḥ.
12.209.36d19: yaḥ prabhuḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ yena sarvamidaṁ tatam.
12.209.36d21: brahmayonirhi viśvātmā sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu,
yaḥ purā pralaye prāpte naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame,
12.209.36d22: ekastiṣṭhati viśvātmā sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu.
12.209.36d23: hūyate ca punardvābhyāṁ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu.
12.209.36d24: parjanyaḥ pr̥thivī sasyaṁ kālo dharmaḥ kriyākriye,
12.209.36d25: yastejayati tejāṁsi sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu.
12.209.36d29: yasmāt parataraṁ nāsti tamasmi śaraṇaṁ gataḥ.
12.209.36d30: na pradhāno na ca mahān puruṣaścetano hyajaḥ,
12.209.36d31: cintayanto hi yaṁ nityaṁ brahmeśānādayaḥ prabhum,
12.209.36d32: yaṁ prāpya na nivartante tamasmi śaraṇaṁ gataḥ.
12.209.36d34: somārkāgnimayaṁ tejo yā ca tārāmayī dyutiḥ,
divi sañjāyate yo’yaṁ sa mahātmā prasīdatu.
12.209.36d35: sūkṣmaḥ sarvagato yogī sa mahātmā prasīdatu.
12.209.36d36: yaṁ viditvā vimucyante sa mahātmā prasīdatu.
12.209.36d38: mahān guṇāṁśca yo bhuṅkte sa mahātmā prasīdatu.
12.209.36d39: sūryamadhye sthitaḥ somastasya madhye ca yā sthitā,
bhūtabāhyā ca yā dīptiḥ sa mahātmā prasīdatu.
12.209.36d41: ye ca tvāṁ nābhijānanti saṁsāre saṁsaranti te.
12.209.36d45: tvayi tāni ca teṣu tvaṁ na teṣu tvaṁ na te tvayi.
12.209.36d46: samo’si sarvabhūteṣu na te dveṣyo’sti na priyaḥ.
12.209.36d48: tvayā tvayyeva tat protaṁ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva,
12.209.36d50: ahaṅkāreṇa buddhyā vā na te yogastribhirguṇaiḥ,
na te dharmo’styadharmo vā nārambho janma vā punaḥ.
12.209.36d52: bhaktānāṁ yaddhitaṁ deva tad dhyāhi tridaśeśvara,
12.209.36d53: pr̥thivīṁ yātu me ghrāṇaṁ yātu me rasanā jalam,
rūpaṁ hutāśanaṁ yātu sparśo yātu ca mārutam.
12.209.36d54: indriyāṇyapi saṁyāntu svāsu svāsu ca yoniṣu.
12.209.36d58: ekībhāvastvayā me’stu na me janma bhavet punaḥ.
12.209.36d60: pūrvadehakr̥tā ye me vyādhayaḥ praviśantu mām,
ardayantu ca duḥkhāni r̥ṇaṁ me pratimuñcatu.
12.209.36d61: anudhyāto’si deveśa na me janma bhavet punaḥ,
tasmād bravīmi karmāṇi r̥ṇaṁ me na bhavediti.
12.209.36d62: anr̥ṇo gantumicchāmi tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṁ padam.
12.209.36d63: tasyāhaṁ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati.
12.209.36d66: tato buddheḥ paraṁ buddhvā labhate na punarbhavam,
12.209.36d67: api pāpasamācāraḥ sa yāti paramāṁ gatim,
oṁ namo bhagavate tasmai dehināṁ paramātmane.
12.209.36d69: svapan vibudhyaṁśca paṭhan yatra tatra samabhyaset,
12.209.36d71: abhyarcayan pitr̥̄n devān paṭhan juhvan baliṁ dadat.
12.209.36d72: jvalannagniṁ smared yo māṁ sa yāti paramāṁ gatim,
12.209.36d74: kiṁ punarye yajante māṁ sādhakā vidhipūrvakam.
12.209.36d76: avāpsyasi tataḥ siddhiṁ drakṣyasyeva padaṁ mama.
12.209.36d77: ajñānāya ca yo jñānaṁ dadyād dharmopadeśataḥ,
kr̥tsnāṁ vā pr̥thivīṁ dadyāt tena tulyaṁ ca tatphalam.
12.209.36d78: evaṁ dattvā naraśreṣṭha śreyo vīryaṁ ca vindati.
12.209.36d80: evaṁ pr̥ṣṭaḥ purā tena nāradena surarṣiṇā,
12.209.36d83: idaṁ japan vai prāpnoti tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṁ padam.
12.209.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi antarbhūmivikrīḍanaṁ nāma navādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥209॥
12.210.1: yogaṁ me paramaṁ tāta mokṣasya vada bhārata,
12.210.5: upāsanāt prasanno’si yadi vai bhagavan mama,
saṁśayo me mahān kaścit tanme vyākhyātumarhasi,
kutaścāhaṁ kutaśca tvaṁ tat samyagbrūhi yatparam ॥5॥
12.210.7: vedeṣu cāpi yad vākyaṁ laukikaṁ vyāpakaṁ ca yat,
12.210.10: puruṣaṁ sanātanaṁ viṣṇuṁ yaṁ taṁ vedavido viduḥ,
12.210.16: pralayaṁ prakr̥tiṁ prāpya yugādau sr̥jate punaḥ ॥16॥
12.210.17: dr̥śyante tāni tānyeva tathā bhāvā yugādiṣu ॥17॥
12.210.18: atha yadyad yadā bhāti kālayogād yugādiṣu,
12.210.20: bhārgavo nītiśāstraṁ tu jagāda jagato hitam ॥20॥
12.210.23: anādyaṁ tatparaṁ brahma na devā narṣayo viduḥ,
ekastad veda bhagavān dhātā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ॥23॥
12.210.29: viṣayāḥ pañca caikaṁ ca vikāre ṣoḍaśaṁ manaḥ ॥29॥
12.210.31: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṁ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca,
vijñeyaṁ vyāpakaṁ cittaṁ teṣu sarvagataṁ manaḥ ॥31॥
12.210.32: rasajñāne tu jihveyaṁ vyāhr̥te vāk tathocyate,
12.210.36: ete bhāvā jagat sarvaṁ vahanti sacarācaram,
śritā virajasaṁ devaṁ yamāhuḥ prakr̥teḥ param ॥36॥
12.210.37: vyāpya śete mahānātmā tasmāt puruṣa ucyate ॥37॥
12.210.39: yathā dīpaḥ prakāśātmā hrasvo vā yadi vā mahān,
12.210.40: śrotraṁ vedayate vedyaṁ sa śr̥ṇoti sa paśyati,
kāraṇaṁ tasya deho’yaṁ sa kartā sarvakarmaṇām ॥40॥
12.210.41: agnirdārugato yadvad bhinne dārau na dr̥śyate,
12.210.43: nadīṣvāpo yathā yuktā yathā sūrye marīcayaḥ,
santatatvād yathā yānti tathā dehāḥ śarīriṇām ॥43॥
12.210.46: sa tu dehād yathā dehaṁ tyaktvānyaṁ pratipadyate,
12.210.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vārṣṇeyādhyātmakathane daśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥210॥
12.211.5: na bhūrna khaṁ dyaurbhūtāni narṣayo na surāsurāḥ,
12.211.9: snigdhatvāt tilavat sarvaṁ cakre’smin pīḍyate jagat,
12.211.11: nābhyeti kāraṇaṁ kāryaṁ na kāryaṁ kāraṇaṁ tathā,
12.211.14: na ca taiḥ spr̥śyate bhāvairna te tena mahātmanā,
12.211.15: abhyāsāt sa tathā yukto na gacchet prakr̥tiṁ punaḥ ॥15॥
12.211.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vārṣṇeyādhyātmakathane ekādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥211॥
12.212.3: iyaṁ sā buddhirabhyetya yayā yāti parāṁ gatim ॥3॥
12.212.6: lohayuktaṁ yathā hema vipakvaṁ na virājate,
12.212.9: kamabhiṣṭuvate cāyaṁ kaṁ vā’’krośati kiṁ vadan ॥9॥
12.212.12: madhu tailaṁ payaḥ sarpirmāṁsāni lavaṇaṁ guḍaḥ,
12.212.15: kṣāntyā dhr̥tyā ca buddhyā ca manasā tapasaiva ca ॥15॥
12.212.17: sattvena rajasā caiva tamasā caiva mohitāḥ,
12.212.25: ke doṣā manasā tyaktāḥ ke buddhyā śithilīkr̥tāḥ,
ke punaḥ punarāyānti ke mohādaphalā iva ॥25॥
12.212.26: eṣa me saṁśayastāta tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥26॥
12.212.28: tat sarvaṁ dehināṁ bījaṁ sattvamātmavataḥ samam ॥28॥
12.212.29: tasmādātmavatā varjyaṁ rajaśca tama eva ca,
12.212.33: sattvasthaḥ sāttvikān bhāvān śuddhān paśyati saṁśritaḥ,
12.212.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vārṣṇeyādhyātmakathane dvādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥212॥
12.213.3: mānavā jñānasammohāt tataḥ krodhaṁ prayānti vai ॥3॥
12.213.12: rajastamasi paryastaṁ sattvaṁ ca rajasi sthitam,
12.213.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vārṣṇeyādhyātmakathane trayodaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥213॥
12.214.6: vāgdehamanasāṁ śaucaṁ kṣamā satyaṁ dhr̥tiḥ smr̥tiḥ,
12.214.7: paraṁ tat sarvadharmebhyastena yānti parāṁ gatim ॥7॥
12.214.8: śrotreṇa śravaṇaṁ caiva cakṣuṣā caiva darśanam ॥8॥
12.214.12: yoṣitāṁ na kathā śrāvyā na nirīkṣyā nirambarāḥ,
12.214.19: madhye ca hr̥dayasyaikā śirā tatra manovahā,
12.214.26: bhavitā manaso jñānaṁ mana eva prajāyate,
12.214.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vārṣṇeyādhyātmakathane caturdaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥214॥
12.215.1: ye tvasaktā mahātmānaste yānti paramāṁ gatim ॥1॥
12.215.5: yat kr̥taṁ syācchubhaṁ karma pāpaṁ vā yadi vāśnute,
12.215.6: kṣamā caivāpramādaśca yasyaite sa sukhī bhavet ॥6॥
12.215.7: duḥkhānniḥsaraṇaṁ veda sarvajñaḥ sa sukhī bhavet ॥7॥
12.215.8: tasmāt samāhitaṁ buddhyā mano bhūteṣu dhārayet,
12.215.12: vākprabaddho hi saṁsāro virāgād vyāhared yadi,
12.215.14: prakīrṇameṣa bhāraṁ hi yadvad dhāryeta dasyubhiḥ,
12.215.15: tameva ca yathā dasyuḥ kṣiptvā gacchecchivāṁ diśam,
12.215.21: yena tantrayatastantraṁ vr̥ttiḥ syāt tat tadācaret ॥21॥
12.215.23: āhāraniyamaṁ caiva deśe kāle ca sāttvikam,
12.215.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vārṣṇeyādhyātmakathane pañcadaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥215॥
12.216.2: svapne hi rajasā dehī tamasā cābhibhūyate,
12.216.4: atrāha ko nvayaṁ bhāvaḥ svapne viṣayavāniva,
12.216.5: atrocyate yathā hyetad veda yogeśvaro hariḥ,
12.216.9: tat tat śaṁsanti bhūtāni mano yadbhāvitaṁ yathā ॥9॥
12.216.13: ātmaprabhāvāt taṁ vidyāt sarvā hyātmani devatāḥ ॥13॥
12.216.15: ātmaprasādaṁ taṁ vidyāt sarvā hyātmani devatāḥ ॥15॥
12.216.16: evaṁ hi tapasā yuktamarkavat tamasaḥ param,
12.216.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vārṣṇeyādhyātmakathane ṣoḍaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥216॥
12.217.1: na sa veda paraṁ brahma yo na veda catuṣṭayam,
vyaktāvyaktaṁ ca yat tattvaṁ samproktaṁ paramarṣiṇā ॥1॥
12.217.11: karaṇaiḥ karmanirvr̥ttiḥ kartā yad yad viceṣṭate,
12.217.19: vaimanasyaṁ ca viṣaye yāntyasya karaṇāni ca,
12.217.25: yathāgamaṁ ca gatvā vai buddhyā tatraiva buddhyate,
12.217.27: sarva ete mahātmāno gacchanti paramāṁ gatim ॥27॥
12.217.32: bhāvena yānti śuddhā ye jñānatr̥ptā nirāśiṣaḥ ॥32॥
12.217.33: jñātvā’’tmasthaṁ hariṁ caiva na nivartanti te’vyayāḥ,
12.217.36: sūcyā sūtraṁ yathā vastre saṁsārayati vāyakaḥ,
12.217.37: vikāraṁ prakr̥tiṁ caiva puruṣaṁ ca sanātanam,
yo yathāvad vijānāti sa vitr̥ṣṇo vimucyate ॥37॥
12.217.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vārṣṇeyādhyātmakathane saptadaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥217॥
12.218.2: yena vr̥ttena dharmajñaḥ sa jagāma mahatsukham ॥2॥
12.218.4: tasya sma śatamācāryā vasanti satataṁ gr̥he,
12.218.5: sa teṣāṁ pretyabhāve ca pretyajātau viniścaye,
12.218.9: sa manye tena rūpeṇa vismāpayati hi svayam ॥9॥
12.218.15: tasya pañcaśikhaḥ śiṣyo mānuṣyā payasā bhr̥taḥ,
12.218.16: tasyāḥ putratvamāgamya striyāḥ sa pibati stanau,
tataḥ sa kāpileyatvaṁ lebhe buddhiṁ ca naiṣṭhikīm ॥16॥
12.218.20: abravīt paramaṁ mokṣaṁ yat tat sāṅkhye’bhidhīyate ॥20॥
12.218.24: ātmānaṁ manyate mohāt tadasamyak paraṁ matam ॥24॥
12.218.27: pratyakṣeṇāgamo bhinnaḥ kr̥tānto vā na kiñcana ॥27॥
12.218.28: nānyo jīvaḥ śarīrasya nāstikānāṁ mate sthitaḥ ॥28॥
12.218.32: avidyā karma tr̥ṣṇā ca kecidāhuḥ punarbhave,
kāraṇaṁ lobhamohau tu doṣāṇāṁ tu niṣevaṇam ॥32॥
12.218.33: avidyāṁ kṣetramāhurhi karma bījaṁ tathā kr̥tam,
tr̥ṣṇā sañjananaṁ sneha eṣa teṣāṁ punarbhavaḥ ॥33॥
12.218.34: tasmin gūḍhe ca dagdhe ca bhinne maraṇadharmiṇi,
12.218.35: kathamasmin sa ityevaṁ sarvaṁ vā syādasaṁhitam ॥35॥
12.218.38: tathā hi musalairhanyuḥ śarīraṁ tat punarbhavet,
12.218.41: indriyāṇi mano vāyuḥ śoṇitaṁ māṁsamasthi ca,
12.218.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi pañcaśikhavākye pāṣaṇḍakhaṇḍanaṁ nāmāṣṭādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥218॥
12.219.2: bhagavan yadi na pretya sañjñā bhavati kasyacit,
evaṁ sati kimajñānaṁ jñānaṁ vā kiṁ kariṣyati ॥2॥
12.219.3: apramattaḥ pramatto vā kiṁ viśeṣaṁ kariṣyati ॥3॥
12.219.4: asaṁsargo hi bhūteṣu saṁsargo vā vināśiṣu,
kasmai kriyeta kalpyeta niścayaḥ ko’tra tattvataḥ ॥4॥
12.219.7: dhātavaḥ pañca bhūteṣu khaṁ vāyurjyotiṣo dharā,
12.219.10: śravaṇaṁ sparśanaṁ jihvā dr̥ṣṭirnāsā tathaiva ca,
12.219.12: śabdaḥ sparśaṁ ca rūpaṁ ca raso gandhaśca mūrtayaḥ,
12.219.15: anātmeti ca yad dr̥ṣṭaṁ tenāhaṁ na mametyapi,
12.219.16: śr̥ṇu yat tava mokṣāya bhāṣyamāṇaṁ bhaviṣyati ॥16॥
12.219.17: tyāga eva hi sarveṣāṁ yuktānāmapi karmaṇām,
12.219.23: karṇau śabdaśca cittaṁ ca trayaḥ śravaṇasaṅgrahe,
tathā sparśe tathā rūpe tathaiva rasagandhayoḥ ॥23॥
12.219.26: akutaścit kutaścid vā cintitaḥ sāttviko guṇaḥ ॥26॥
12.219.29: atra yat prītisaṁyuktaṁ kāye manasi vā bhavet,
vartate sāttviko bhāva ityapekṣeta tat tathā ॥29॥
12.219.31: atha yanmohasaṁyuktaṁ kāye manasi vā bhavet,
12.219.32: śrītraṁ vyomāśritaṁ bhūtaṁ śabdaḥ śrotraṁ samāśritaḥ,
12.219.33: evaṁ tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā ceti pañcamī,
sparśe rūpe rase gandhe tāni ceto manaśca tat ॥33॥
12.219.39: kathañcid vartate samyak keṣāñcid vā nivartate ॥39॥
12.219.40: sthito manasi yo bhāvaḥ sa vai kṣetrajña ucyate ॥40॥
12.219.41: evaṁ sati ka ucchedaḥ śāśvato vā kathaṁ bhavet,
12.219.43: evaṁ sati kutaḥ sañjñā pretyabhāve punarbhavet,
12.219.46: kṣīṇe ca puṇye vigate ca pāpe
12.219.50: na khalu mama hi dahyate’tra kiñcit
12.219.52d1: vahninā dīpitā sā tu tanme śr̥ṇu mahāmate.
12.219.52d4: sa tasya hr̥di saṅkalpaṁ jñātumaicchat svayaṁ prabhuḥ,
12.219.52d7: na tvāṁ brāhmaṇa daṇḍena niyokṣyāmi kathañcana,
mama rājyād vinirgaccha yāvat sīmā bhuvo mama.
12.219.52d8: ityuktaḥ sa tathā tena maithilena dvijottamaḥ,
12.219.52d9: aho siddhārtharūpo’si gamiṣye svasti te’stu vai.
12.219.52d11: pradīpyamānāṁ mithilāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā rājā na kampitaḥ,
12.219.52d12: anantaṁ bata me vittaṁ bhāvyaṁ me nāsti kiñcana,
mithilāyāṁ pradīptāyāṁ na me kiñcana dahyate.
12.219.52d13: tadasya bhāṣamāṇasya śrutvā śrutvā hr̥di sthitam,
12.219.52d14: ātmānaṁ darśayāmāsa varaṁ cāsmai dadau punaḥ,
12.219.52d15: satye tiṣṭhasva nirviṇṇaḥ svasti te’stu vrajāmyaham,
etat te kathitaṁ rājan kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi.
12.219.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi pañcaśikhavākyaṁ nāma ekonaviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥219॥
12.220.0d1: asti kaścid yadi vibho sadāro niyato gr̥he,
12.220.0d2: taṁ me brūhi mahāprājña durlabhaḥ puruṣo mahān,
śr̥ṇu rājan yathāvr̥ttaṁ yanmāṁ tvaṁ pr̥ṣṭavānasi,
12.220.0d6: asyāḥ patiḥ kuto veti brāhmaṇaḥ śrotriyaḥ paraḥ,
12.220.0d7: andhāya māṁ mahāprājña dehyanandhāya vai pitaḥ,
evaṁ smara sadā vidvan mamedaṁ prārthitaṁ mune.
12.220.0d8: na śakyaṁ prārthitaṁ vatse tvayādya pratibhāti me,
12.220.0d9: vidyate cet patistādr̥k sa māṁ bharati vedavit.
12.220.0d10: yebhyastvaṁ manyase dātuṁ māmihānaya tān dvijān,
tādr̥śaṁ taṁ patiṁ teṣu varayiṣye yathātatham.
12.220.0d11: tatheti coktvā tāṁ kanyāmr̥ṣiḥ śiṣyānuvāca ha,
12.220.0d13: grāmeṣu ca tato gatvā brāhmaṇebhyo nyavedayan.
12.220.0d14: r̥ṣeḥ prabhāvaṁ matvā te kanyāyāśca dvijottamāḥ,
12.220.0d15: abhyarcya vidhivat tatra kanyāmāha pitā mahān.
12.220.0d17: ye’mī teṣu varaṁ bhadre tvamicchasi mahāvratam,
taṁ kumāraṁ vr̥ṇīṣvādya tasmai dāsyāmyahaṁ śubhe.
12.220.0d19: yadyasti samitau vipro hyandho’nandhaḥ sa me varaḥ.
12.220.0d22: kanyā ca saṁsthitā tatra pitr̥veśmani bhāminī.
12.220.0d28: tāṁ kanyāmāha viprarṣiḥ so’haṁ bhadre samāgataḥ.
12.220.0d29: andho’hamatra tattvaṁ hi tathā manye ca sarvadā,
12.220.0d30: vr̥ṇīṣva māṁ varārohe bhaje ca tvāmanindite,
yenedaṁ vīkṣate nityaṁ vr̥ṇoti spr̥śate’tha vā.
12.220.0d31: ghrāyate vakti satataṁ yenedaṁ rasate punaḥ,
yenedaṁ manyate tattvaṁ yena budhyati vā punaḥ.
12.220.0d32: na cakṣurvidyate hyetat sa vai bhūtāndha ucyate,
yasmin pravartate cedaṁ paśyan śr̥ṇvan spr̥śannapi.
12.220.0d33: tanme nāsti tato hyandho vr̥ṇu bhadre’dya māmataḥ.
12.220.0d34: ātmadr̥ṣṭyā ca tat sarvaṁ vilipyāmi ca nityaśaḥ.
12.220.0d35: avidyayā taran mr̥tyuṁ vidyayā taṁ tathāmr̥tam.
12.220.0d36: krīte vyavasitaṁ bhadre bhartāhaṁ te vr̥ṇīṣva mām.
12.220.0d37: tataḥ suvarcalā dr̥ṣṭvā prāha taṁ dvijasattamam,
manasāsi vr̥to vidvan śeṣakartā pitā mama,
12.220.0d38: tad vijñāya pitā tasyā devalo munisattamaḥ,
12.220.0d39: udāharanti vai tatra śvetaketuṁ nirīkṣya tam.
12.220.0d41: prīyatāṁ mādhavo devaḥ patnī ceyaṁ sutā mama,
12.220.0d44: sa gārhasthye vasan dhīmān bhāryāṁ tāmidamabravīt.
12.220.0d45: yāni coktāni vedeṣu tat sarvaṁ kuru śobhane,
12.220.0d46: ahamityeva bhāvena sthito’haṁ tvaṁ tathaiva ca,
tasmāt karmāṇi kurvīthāḥ kuryāṁ te ca tataḥ param.
12.220.0d47: na mameti ca bhāvena jñānāgninilayena ca,
12.220.0d48: evaṁ tvayā ca kartavyaṁ sarvadādurbhagā mayā,
yad yadācarati śreṣṭhaḥ tat tadevetaro janaḥ.
12.220.0d50: putrānutpādya tasyāṁ ca yajñaiḥ santarpya devatāḥ.
12.220.0d51: bhāryāṁ tāṁ sadr̥śīṁ prāpya buddhiṁ kṣetrajñayoriva,
12.220.0d52: papraccha ko bhavānatra brūhi me tad dvijottama,
tāmāha bhagavān vāgmī tvayā jñāto na saṁśayaḥ.
12.220.0d53: sā tamāha mahātmānaṁ pr̥cchāmi hr̥di śāyinam.
12.220.0d54: tacchrutvā pratyuvācaināṁ sa na vakṣyati bhāmini,
12.220.0d57: tataḥ prahasya sā hr̥ṣṭā bhartāraṁ dharmacāriṇī,
uvāca vacanaṁ kāle smayamānā tadā nr̥pa.
12.220.0d60: yad yadācarati śreṣṭhaḥ tat tadevetaro janaḥ,
12.220.0d61: saṅkīrṇe ca tathā dharme varṇasaṅkarameti ca,
saṅkare ca pravr̥tte tu mātsyo nyāyaḥ pravartate.
12.220.0d64: evaṁ sugahvare mukto yatra me tadbhavābhavam,
chittvā jñānāsinā gacchet sa vidvān sa ca me priyaḥ.
12.220.0d65: so’hameva na sandehaḥ pratijñā iti tasya vai.
12.220.0d67: bhagavatyā tathā loke rakṣitavyaṁ na saṁśayaḥ,
12.220.0d69: vyatyayena ca varṇānāṁ parivādakr̥to hi yaḥ,
12.220.0d70: tanme brūhi yathātattvaṁ śabdasthāne’rtha eva cet.
12.220.0d71: puṣkare ca yathā toyaṁ tathāstīti ca vettha tat.
12.220.0d72: arthe sthitirhi śabdasya nānyathā ca sthitirbhavet,
12.220.0d73: asti ced vartate nityaṁ vikāroccāraṇena vai.
12.220.0d75: na vikūlo’tra kathito nākāśaṁ hi vinā jagat,
12.220.0d76: na vācastatra vartante iti mithyā bhaviṣyati.
12.220.0d78: ayaṁ bhāvaḥ pare’cintye hyātmabhāvo yathā ca tat.
12.220.0d79: tasmād vāco na vartanta iti naiva virudhyate.
12.220.0d80: tasmād vāmena vartante manasā bhīru sarvaśaḥ,
12.220.0d81: saṁsarge sati sambandhāt tad vikāraṁ bhaviṣyati,
anākāśagataṁ sarvaṁ vikāre ca sadā gatam.
12.220.0d82: tad brahma paramaṁ śuddhamanaupamyaṁ na śakyate,
na dr̥śyate tathā tacca dr̥śyate ca matirmama.
12.220.0d83: nirvikāraṁ hyamūrtiṁ ca nirayaṁ sarvagaṁ tathā,
dr̥śyate ca viyannityaṁ dr̥gātmā tena dr̥śyate.
12.220.0d84: tvacā spr̥śati vai vāyumākāśasthaṁ punaḥ punaḥ,
tatsthaṁ gandhaṁ tathā’’ghrāti jyotiḥ paśyati cakṣuṣā.
12.220.0d85: varṣaṁ tārāgaṇaṁ caiva nākāśaṁ dr̥śyate punaḥ.
12.220.0d86: tadarthe kalpitā hyete tat satyo viṣṇureva ca.
12.220.0d87: na cakṣuṣā na manasā na cānyena paro vibhuḥ.
12.220.0d88: cintyate sūkṣmayā buddhyā vācā vaktuṁ na śakyate,
12.220.0d89: na ca strī na pumāṁścaiva tathaiva na napuṁsakaḥ,
12.220.0d92: anena sādhyaṁ kiṁ syād vai śabdeneti matirmama,
12.220.0d93: nirarthako yathā loke tadvat syāditi me matiḥ,
12.220.0d94: vedagamyaṁ paraṁ śuddhamiti satyā parā śrutiḥ,
12.220.0d95: nirarthako na caivāsti śabdo laukika uttame,
12.220.0d98: vedagamyaḥ paraḥ śuddha iti me dhīyate matiḥ,
12.220.0d99: jñāne viddhi śubhācāre tena yānti parāṁ gatim,
yadi me vyāhr̥taṁ guhyaṁ śrutaṁ na tu tvayā śubhe.
12.220.0d100: na vāyustanna sūryastannāgnistat tu paraṁ padam.
12.220.0d102: evaṁ suvarcalā hr̥ṣṭā proktā bhartrā yathārthavat,
12.220.0d104: kālena mahatā rājan prāpnoti paramāṁ gatim.
12.220.0d105: etat te kathitaṁ rājan yasmāt tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi,
gārhasthyaṁ ca samādhāya gatau jāyāpatī param.
12.220.1: kiṁ kurvan sukhamāpnoti kiṁ kurvan duḥkhamāpnuyāt,
12.220.3: kriyā tapaśca satyaṁ ca dame sarvaṁ pratiṣṭhitam ॥3॥
12.220.4: vipāpmā nirbhayo dāntaḥ puruṣo vindate mahat ॥4॥
12.220.5: sukhaṁ dāntaḥ prasvapiti sukhaṁ ca pratibuddhyate,
12.220.8: āśrameṣu ca sarveṣu dama eva viśiṣyate,
yacca teṣu phalaṁ dharme bhūyo dānte taducyate ॥8॥
12.220.9: teṣāṁ liṅgāni vakṣyāmi yeṣāṁ samudayo damaḥ,
12.220.13: prāpya loke ca satkāraṁ svargaṁ vai pretya gacchati,
12.220.14: sarvabhūtahite yukto na sma yo dviṣate janam,
12.220.16: na hr̥ṣyati mahatyarthe vyasane ca na śocati,
sa vai parimitaprajñaḥ sa dānto dvija ucyate ॥16॥
12.220.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi damapraśaṁsāyāṁ viṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥220॥
12.221.3: etat tapo mahārāja utāho kiṁ tapo bhavet ॥3॥
12.221.5: sadopavāsī ca bhaved brahmacārī sadā bhavet ॥5॥
12.221.6: muniśca syāt sadā vipro daivataṁ ca sadā bhavet,
12.221.7: amāṁsādī sadā ca syāt pavitraśca sadā bhavet,
12.221.8: vighasāśī sadā ca syāt sadā caivātithivrataḥ,
12.221.9: kathaṁ sadopavāsī syād brahmacārī kathaṁ bhavet,
vighasāśī kathaṁ ca syāt sadā caivātithivrataḥ ॥9॥
12.221.10: antarā prātarāśaṁ ca sāyamāśaṁ tathaiva ca,
sadopavāsī sa bhaved yo na bhuṅkte’ntarā punaḥ ॥10॥
12.221.11: bhāryāṁ gacchan brahmacārī r̥tau bhavati vai dvijaḥ,
12.221.13: bhr̥tyātithiṣu yo bhuṅkte bhuktavatsu sadā sadā,
amr̥taṁ kevalaṁ bhuṅkte iti viddhi yudhiṣṭhira ॥13॥
12.221.13d1: adattvānnaṁ daivatebhyo yo na bhuṅkte sa daivatam.
12.221.14: abhuktavatsu nāśnānaḥ satataṁ yastu vai dvijaḥ,
12.221.16: teṣāṁ lokā hyaparyantāḥ sadane brahmaṇā saha,
12.221.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi amr̥taprāśaniko nāma ekaviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥221॥
12.222.0d1: na pratyayo na cānyacca dr̥śyate brahma naiva tat.
12.222.0d3: sve sve yuktā mahātmānaḥ śāstreṣu prabhaviṣṇavaḥ,
vartante paṇḍitā loke ko vidvān kaśca paṇḍitaḥ.
12.222.0d6: tatra kecid dhruvaṁ viśvaṁ seśvaraṁ tu nirīśvaram,
prākr̥taṁ kāraṇaṁ nāsti sarvaṁ naivamidaṁ jagat.
12.222.0d7: anena cāpare viprāḥ svabhāvaṁ karma cāpare,
pauruṣaṁ karma daivaṁ ca yat svabhāvādireva tam.
12.222.0d10: vaśiṣṭhamabruvan sarve tvaṁ no brūhi sanātanam.
12.222.0d11: nāhaṁ jānāmi viprendrāḥ pratyuvāca sa tān prabhuḥ,
12.222.0d12: tvaṁ no brūhi mahābhāga tattvavicca bhavānasi,
nāhaṁ dvijā vijānāmi kva hi gacchāma saṅgatāḥ.
12.222.0d13: iti tānāha bhagavāṁstataḥ prāha ca sa dvijān,
12.222.0d14: sanaddhāma dvijā gatvā pr̥cchadhvaṁ sa ca vakṣyati.
12.222.0d18: na cāsya mantā na ca vidyate cet.
12.222.0d28: śr̥ṇudhvaṁ paramaṁ kāraṇamasti, sa eva sarvaṁ vidvān bibheti na gacchati, kutrāhaṁ kasya nāhaṁ kena kenetyavartamāno vijānāti,
sa yugato vyāpī, sa pr̥thak sthitaḥ, tadaparamārtham,
yathā vāyurekaḥ san bahudheritaḥ, yathāvad dvije mr̥ge vyāghre ca, manuje veṇusaṁśrayo bhidyate vāyurarthaikaḥ, ātmā tathāsau paramātmāsāvanya iva bhāti,
evamātmā sa eva gacchati, sarvamātmā paśyan śr̥ṇoti jighrati bhāṣate,
cakre’sya taṁ mahātmānaṁ parito daśa raśmayaḥ,
12.222.0d29: tāvubhau na ravau cāstāṁ tathā vitta śarīriṇam.
12.222.0d30: patite vitta viprendrā bhakṣaṇe caraṇe paraḥ,
12.222.0d32: sañcitaṁ sañcitaṁ pūrvaṁ bhramaro vartate bhraman,
yo’bhimānīva jānāti na muhyati na hīyate.
12.222.0d34: naiva dharmī na cādharmī dvandvātīto vimatsaraḥ,
jñānatr̥ptaḥ sukhaṁ śete hyamr̥tātmā na saṁśayaḥ.
12.222.0d35: na jānāti vimūḍhātmā kāraṇaṁ cātmano hyasau.
12.222.0d36: dhyātā draṣṭā tathā mantā boddhā dr̥ṣṭān sa eva saḥ,
12.222.0d37: yattu śakyaṁ mayā proktaṁ gacchadhvaṁ munipuṅgavāḥ,
12.222.1: yadidaṁ karma loke’smin śubhaṁ vā yadi vāśubham,
12.222.2: kartāsti tasya puruṣa utāho neti saṁśayaḥ,
12.222.6: kāñcane vātha loṣṭe vā ubhayoḥ samadarśanam ॥6॥
12.222.9: yaiḥ kaścit sammato loke guṇaiḥ syāt puruṣo nr̥ṣu,
12.222.10: atha te lakṣyate buddhiḥ samā bālajanairiha,
ātmānaṁ manyamānaḥ san śreyaḥ kimiha manyase ॥10॥
12.222.11: śriyā vihīnaḥ prahrāda śocitavye na śocasi ॥11॥
12.222.14: pravr̥ttiṁ ca nivr̥ttiṁ ca bhūtānāṁ yo na buddhyate,
12.222.16: svayaṁ na kurvatastasya jātu māno bhavediha ॥16॥
12.222.17: tasya doṣavatī prajñā atattvajñeti me matiḥ ॥17॥
12.222.18: yadi syāt puruṣaḥ kartā śakrātmaśreyase dhruvam,
ārambhāstasya siddhyeyurna tu jātu parā bhavet ॥18॥
12.222.23: ātmapratiṣṭhā prajñā vā mama nāsti tato’nyathā ॥23॥
12.222.26: vikārāneva yo veda na veda prakr̥tiṁ parām,
12.222.27: buddhyamānasya darpo vā māno vā kiṁ kariṣyati ॥27॥
12.222.31: prakr̥tau ca vikāre ca na me prītirna ca dviṣe,
dveṣṭāraṁ ca na paśyāmi yo māmadya mamāyate ॥31॥
12.222.32: nordhvaṁ nāvāṅna tiryak ca na kvacicchakra kāmaye,
na hi jñeye na vijñāne na jñāne karma vidyate ॥32॥
12.222.33: prabrūhi tamupāyaṁ me samyak prahrāda pr̥cchataḥ ॥33॥
12.222.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śakraprahrādasaṁvādo nāma dvāviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥222॥
12.223.4: yasya sma dadato vittaṁ na kadācana hīyate,
taṁ baliṁ nādhigacchāmi brahmannācakṣva me balim ॥4॥
12.223.5: sa vāyurvaruṇaścaiva sa raviḥ sa ca candramāḥ,
so’gnistapati bhūtāni jalaṁ ca sa bhavatyuta ॥5॥
12.223.6: taṁ baliṁ nādhigacchāmi brahmannācaśva me balim,
sa eva hyastamayate sa sma vidyotate diśaḥ ॥6॥
12.223.7: taṁ baliṁ nādhigacchāmi brahmannācakṣva me balim ॥7॥
12.223.8: pr̥ṣṭastu nānr̥taṁ brūyāt tasmād vakṣyāmi te balim ॥8॥
12.223.9: uṣṭreṣu yadi vā goṣu khareṣvaśveṣu vā punaḥ,
12.223.10: yadi sma balinā brahman śūnyāgāre sameyivān,
hanyāmenaṁ na vā hanyāṁ tad brahmannanuśādhi mām ॥10॥
12.223.11: mā sma śakra baliṁ hiṁsīrna balirvadhamarhati,
12.223.13: tato dadarśa sa baliṁ kharaveṣeṇa saṁvr̥tam,
12.223.14: iyaṁ te yoniradhamā śocasyāho na śocasi ॥14॥
12.223.17: akr̥ṣṭapacyā ca mahī tavaiśvarye babhūva ha ॥17॥
12.223.18: idaṁ ca te’dya vyasanaṁ śocasyāho na śocasi,
12.223.19: jñātīn vibhajato vittaṁ tadā’’sīt te manaḥ katham,
12.223.23: anantaraṁ sahasreṇa tadā’’sīd daitya kā matiḥ ॥23॥
12.223.24: śamyākṣepeṇa vidhinā tadā’’sīt kiṁ tu te hr̥di ॥24॥
12.223.25: na te paśyāmi bhr̥ṅgāraṁ na cchatraṁ vyajane na ca,
brahmadattāṁ ca te mālāṁ na paśyāmyasurādhipa ॥25॥
12.223.26: na tvaṁ paśyasi bhr̥ṅgāraṁ na cchatraṁ vyajane na ca,
brahmadattāṁ ca me mālāṁ na tvaṁ drakṣyasi vāsava ॥26॥
12.223.27: guhāyāṁ nihitāni tvaṁ mama ratnāni pr̥cchasi,
yadā me bhavitā kālastadā tvaṁ tāni drakṣyasi ॥27॥
12.223.28: na tvetadanurūpaṁ te yaśaso vā kulasya ca,
12.223.29: na hi duḥkheṣu śocante na prahr̥ṣyanti cardhiṣu,
12.223.30: tvaṁ tu prākr̥tayā buddhyā purandara vikatthase,
12.223.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi balivāsavasaṁvādo nāma trayoviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥223॥
12.224.6: antavanta ime dehā bhūtānāṁ ca surādhipa,
tena śakra na śocāmi nāparādhādidaṁ mama ॥6॥
12.224.7: jīvitaṁ ca śarīraṁ ca jātyaiva saha jāyate,
ubhe saha vivardhete ubhe saha vinaśyataḥ ॥7॥
12.224.10: te kr̥cchraṁ prāpya sīdanti buddhiryeṣāṁ praṇaśyati ॥10॥
12.224.11: buddhilābhāt tu puruṣaḥ sarvaṁ tudati kilbiṣam,
12.224.12: tatastu ye nivartante jāyante vā punaḥ punaḥ,
12.224.13: sukhaduḥkhaphale caiva na dveṣmi na ca kāmaye ॥13॥
12.224.14: hataṁ hanti hato hyeva yo naro hanti kañcana,
ubhau tau na vijānīto yaśca hanti hataśca yaḥ ॥14॥
12.224.15: hatvā jitvā ca maghavan yaḥ kaścit puruṣāyate,
akartā hyeva bhavati kartā hyeva karoti tat ॥15॥
12.224.16: kr̥taṁ hi tat kr̥tenaiva kartā tasyāpi cāparaḥ ॥16॥
12.224.19: sarvaṁ kālaḥ samādatte gambhīraḥ svena tejasā,
tasmin kālavaśaṁ prāpte kā vyathā me vijānataḥ ॥19॥
12.224.21: nāsya dvīpaḥ kutaḥ pāro nāvāraḥ sampradr̥śyate,
12.224.22: yadi me paśyataḥ kālo bhūtāni na vināśayet,
12.224.23: tuṣabhakṣaṁ tu māṁ jñātvā praviviktajane gr̥he,
12.224.25: kālaḥ sarvaṁ samādatte kālaḥ sarvaṁ prayacchati,
kālena vihitaṁ sarvaṁ mā kr̥thāḥ śakra pauruṣam ॥25॥
12.224.26: purā sarvaṁ pravyathitaṁ mayi kruddhe purandara,
avaimi tvasya lokasya dharmaṁ śakra sanātanam ॥26॥
12.224.28: kaumārameva te cittaṁ tathaivādya yathā purā,
12.224.29: āsan sarve mama vaśe tat sarvaṁ vettha vāsava ॥29॥
12.224.31: evaṁ me niścitā buddhiḥ śāstustiṣṭhāmyahaṁ vaśe ॥31॥
12.224.32: dr̥śyate hi kule jāto darśanīyaḥ pratāpavān,
duḥkhaṁ jīvan sahāmātyo bhavitavyaṁ hi tat tathā ॥32॥
12.224.33: sukhaṁ jīvan sahāmātyo bhavitavyaṁ hi tat tathā ॥33॥
12.224.34: alakṣaṇā virūpā ca subhagā dr̥śyate parā ॥34॥
12.224.36: na karma bhavitāpyetat kr̥taṁ mama śatakrato,
12.224.38: evaṁ naiva na cet kālo māmākramya sthito bhavet,
12.224.39: kālaḥ sthāpayate sarvaṁ kālaḥ pacati vai tathā ॥39॥
12.224.45: nāhaṁ kartā na caiva tvaṁ nānyaḥ kartā śacīpate,
paryāyeṇa hi bhujyante lokāḥ śakra yadr̥cchayā ॥45॥
12.224.47: asyāḥ pañcaiva cintāyāḥ paryeṣyāmi ca pañcadhā ॥47॥
12.224.50: na hyetāvad bhaved gamyaṁ na yasmāt prabhavet punaḥ ॥50॥
12.224.51: yo dhāvatā na hātavyastiṣṭhannapi na hīyate ॥51॥
12.224.54: taṁ kālamiti jānīhi yasya sarvamidaṁ vaśe ॥54॥
12.224.57: ya idaṁ sarvamādatte tasmācchakra sthiro bhava,
mayā tvayā ca pūrvaiśca na sa śakyo’tivartitum ॥57॥
12.224.58: sthitā mayīti tanmithyā naiṣā hyekatra tiṣṭhati ॥58॥
12.224.59: māṁ ca lolā parityajya tvāmagād vibudhādhipa ॥59॥
12.224.60: maivaṁ śakra punaḥ kārṣīḥ śānto bhavitumarhasi,
12.224.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi balivāsavasaṁvāde caturviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥224॥
12.225.2: tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā prabhayā dīptāṁ bhagavān pākaśāsanaḥ,
12.225.4: na hīmāmāsurīṁ vedmi na daivīṁ ca na mānuṣīm,
tvamenāṁ pr̥ccha vā mā vā yatheṣṭaṁ kuru vāsava ॥4॥
12.225.6: kā tvaṁ tiṣṭhasi māmevaṁ dīpyamānā svatejasā,
12.225.7: na māṁ virocano veda nāyaṁ vairocano baliḥ,
āhurmāṁ duḥsahetyevaṁ vidhitseti ca māṁ viduḥ ॥7॥
12.225.8: tvaṁ māṁ śakra na jānīṣe sarve devā na māṁ viduḥ ॥8॥
12.225.9: kimidaṁ tvaṁ mama kr̥te utāho balinaḥ kr̥te,
12.225.10: no dhātā na vidhātā māṁ vidadhāti kathañcana,
12.225.11: kathaṁ tvayā balistyaktaḥ kimarthaṁ vā śikhaṇḍini,
kathaṁ ca māṁ na jahyāstvaṁ tanme brūhi śucismite ॥11॥
12.225.12: satye sthitāsmi dāne ca vrate tapasi caiva hi,
parākrame ca dharme ca parācīnastato baliḥ ॥12॥
12.225.14: yajñaśīlaḥ sadā bhūtvā māmeva yajata svayam,
12.225.15: apākr̥tā tataḥ śakra tvayi vatsyāmi vāsava,
12.225.17: naiva devo na gandharvo nāsuro na ca rākṣasaḥ,
yo māmeko viṣahituṁ śaktaḥ kaścit purandara ॥17॥
12.225.18: tiṣṭhethā mayi nityaṁ tvaṁ yathā tad brūhi me śubhe,
tat kariṣyāmi te vākyamr̥taṁ tat vaktumarhasi ॥18॥
12.225.19: sthāsyāmi nityaṁ devendra yathā tvayi nibodha tat,
12.225.20: ahaṁ vai tvāṁ nidhāsyāmi yathāśakti yathābalam,
na tu me’tikramaḥ syād vai sadā lakṣmi tavāntike ॥20॥
12.225.21: sā te pādaṁ titikṣeta samarthā hīti me matiḥ ॥21॥
12.225.22: eṣa me nihitaḥ pādo yo’yaṁ bhūmau pratiṣṭhitaḥ,
dvitīyaṁ śakra pādaṁ me tasmāt sunihitaṁ kuru ॥22॥
12.225.24: eṣa me nihitaḥ pādo yo’yamapsu pratiṣṭhitaḥ,
tr̥tīyaṁ śakra pādaṁ me tasmāt sunihitaṁ kuru ॥24॥
12.225.25: yasmin vedāśca yajñāśca yasmin devāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ,
12.225.26: eṣa me nihitaḥ pādo yo’yamagnau pratiṣṭhitaḥ,
caturthaṁ śakra pādaṁ me tasmāt sunihitaṁ kuru ॥26॥
12.225.27: ye vai santo manuṣyeṣu brahmaṇyāḥ satyavādinaḥ,
12.225.28: eṣa me nihitaḥ pādo yo’yaṁ satsu pratiṣṭhitaḥ,
evaṁ hi nihitāṁ śakra bhūteṣu paridhatsva mām ॥28॥
12.225.29: bhūtānāmiha yo vai tvāṁ mayā vinihitāṁ satīm,
upahanyāt sa me dhr̥ṣyastathā śr̥ṇvantu me vacaḥ ॥29॥
12.225.30: yāvat purastāt pratapet tāvad vai dakṣiṇāṁ diśam,
12.225.31: tathā madhyandine sūryo nāstameti yadā tadā,
12.225.32: tadā devāsure yuddhe jetāhaṁ tvāṁ śatakrato ॥32॥
12.225.33: tena te’haṁ bale vajraṁ na vimuñcāmi mūrdhani ॥33॥
12.225.34: yatheṣṭaṁ gaccha daityendra svasti te’stu mahāsura,
12.225.36: yena saṁyāti lokeṣu śītoṣṇe visr̥jan raviḥ ॥36॥
12.225.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śrīsaṁnidhāno nāma pañcaviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥225॥
12.226.3: śriyā vihīno namuce śocasyāho na śocasi ॥3॥
12.226.5: santāpād bhraśyate rūpaṁ santāpād bhraśyate śriyaḥ ॥5॥
12.226.7: yadā yadā hi puruṣaḥ kalyāṇe kurute manaḥ,
tadā tasya prasidhyanti sarvārthā nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥7॥
12.226.9: jñānācchreyo na tu tad vai karomi,
12.226.10: yathā yathāsya prāptavyaṁ prāpnotyeva tathā tathā,
bhavitavyaṁ yathā yacca bhavatyeva tathā tathā ॥10॥
12.226.11: yatra yatraiva saṁyukto dhātrā garbhe punaḥ punaḥ,
tatra tatraiva vasati na yatra svayamicchati ॥11॥
12.226.12: iti yasya sadā bhāvo na sa muhyet kadācana ॥12॥
12.226.13: duḥkhametat tu yad dveṣṭā kartāhamiti manyate ॥13॥
12.226.16: sukhaṁ ca duḥkhaṁ ca tathaiva madhyamaṁ
12.226.18: prāpya yāṁ na kurute sadā bhayam,
12.226.20: na śīlena na vr̥ttena tathā naivārthasampadā,
12.226.22: prāptavyānyeva cāpnoti duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca ॥22॥
12.226.23: etad viditvā kārtsnyena yo na muhyati mānavaḥ,
kuśalī sarvaduḥkheṣu sa vai sarvadhano naraḥ ॥23॥
12.226.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śakranamucisaṁvādo nāma ṣaḍviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥226॥
12.227.1: magnasya vyasane kr̥cchre kiṁ śreyaḥ puruṣasya hi,
12.227.2: tvaṁ hi naḥ paramo vaktā loke’smin bharatarṣabha,
etad bhavantaṁ pr̥cchāmi tanme tvaṁ vaktumarhasi ॥2॥
12.227.3: magnasya vyasane kr̥cchre dhr̥tiḥ śreyaskarī nr̥pa ॥3॥
12.227.4: dhairyeṇa yuktasya sataḥ śarīraṁ na viśīryate,
12.227.6: tasyaiśvaryaṁ ca dhairyaṁ ca vyavasāyaśca karmasu,
12.227.10: caturdantaṁ sudāntaṁ ca vāraṇendraṁ śriyā vr̥tam,
12.227.12: surendramindraṁ daityendro na śuśoca na vivyethe ॥12॥
12.227.17: īśvaro hi purā bhūtvā pitr̥paitāmahe pade,
tattvamadya hr̥taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sapatnaiḥ kiṁ na śocasi ॥17॥
12.227.21: nigr̥hīte mayi bhr̥śaṁ śakra kiṁ katthitena te,
12.227.23: hastaprāptasya vīrasya taṁ caiva puruṣaṁ viduḥ ॥23॥
12.227.25: mā ca te’bhūt svabhāvo’yamiti te devapuṅgava,
12.227.27: ahamāsaṁ yathādya tvaṁ bhavitā tvaṁ yathā vayam,
12.227.28: paryāyeṇāsi śakratvaṁ prāptaḥ śakra na karmaṇā ॥28॥
12.227.29: kālaḥkāle nayati māṁ tvāṁ ca kālo nayatyayam,
tenāhaṁ tvaṁ yathā nādya tvaṁ cāpi na yathā vayam ॥29॥
12.227.31: na vidyā na tapo dānaṁ na mitrāṇi na bāndhavāḥ,
12.227.33: idaṁ tu duḥkhaṁ yacchakra kartāhamiti manyase ॥33॥
12.227.34: yadi kartā bhavet kartā na kriyeta kadācana,
12.227.35: gantā gatimatāṁ kālaḥ kālaḥ kalayati prajāḥ ॥35॥
12.227.36: kecit tvāṁ bahu manyante śraiṣṭhyaṁ prāptaṁ svakarmaṇā ॥36॥
12.227.38: nityaṁ kālaparītasya mama vā madvidhasya vā,
12.227.39: ahaṁ ca tvaṁ ca ye cānye bhaviṣyanti surādhipāḥ,
12.227.42: idaṁ tu labdhvā saṁsthānamātmānaṁ bahu manyase,
12.227.43: tvaṁ tu bāliśayā buddhyā mamedamiti manyase ॥43॥
12.227.45: neyaṁ tava na cāsmākaṁ na cānyeṣāṁ sthirā sadā ॥45॥
12.227.46: kañcit kālamiyaṁ sthitvā tvayi vāsava cañcalā ॥46॥
12.227.49: tānidānīṁ na paśyāmi yairbhukteyaṁ purā mahī,
12.227.54: daiteyā dānavāścaiva sarve te nairr̥taiḥ saha,
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ pūrve pūrvatarāśca ye ॥54॥
12.227.63: tvaṁ caivemāṁ yadā bhuktvā pr̥thivīṁ tyakṣase punaḥ ॥63॥
12.227.64: na śakṣyasi tadā śakra niyantuṁ śokamātmanaḥ,
12.227.65: śokakāle śuco mā tvaṁ harṣakāle ca mā hr̥ṣaḥ ॥65॥
12.227.68: saṁyate mayi nūnaṁ tvamātmānaṁ bahu manyase,
12.227.69: tena garjasi devendra pūrvaṁ kālahate mayi,
ko hi sthātumalaṁ loke mama kruddhasya saṁyuge ॥69॥
12.227.71: yathā me sarvagātrāṇi na susthāni mahaujasaḥ,
12.227.72: kiṁ hi kr̥tvā tvamindro’dya kiṁ vā kr̥tvā vayaṁ cyutāḥ ॥72॥
12.227.74: vidvān prāpyaivamatyarthaṁ na prahr̥ṣyenna ca vyathet,
tvameva hīndra vetthāsmān vedāhaṁ tvāṁ ca vāsava ॥74॥
12.227.75: kiṁ katthase māṁ kiṁ ca tvaṁ kālena nirapatrapaḥ,
tvameva hi purā vettha yat tadā pauruṣaṁ mama ॥75॥
12.227.79: saṭaṅkaśikharā bhagnāḥ samare murdhni te mayā,
kiṁ nu śakyaṁ mayā kartuṁ kālo hi duratikramaḥ ॥79॥
12.227.80: na hi tvāṁ notsahe hantuṁ savajramapi muṣṭinā,
12.227.81: taṁ māṁ pariṇate kāle parītaṁ kālavahninā ॥81॥
12.227.82: ayaṁ sa puruṣaḥ śyāmo lokasya duratikramaḥ ॥82॥
12.227.83: baddhvā tiṣṭhati māṁ raudraḥ paśuṁ raśanayā yathā,
12.227.84: nāhaṁ kartā na kartā tvaṁ kartā yastu sadā prabhuḥ ॥84॥
12.227.85: so’yaṁ pacati kālo māṁ vr̥kṣe phalamivāgatam,
yānyeva puruṣaḥ kurvan sukhaiḥ kālena yujyate ॥85॥
12.227.86: na ca kālena kālajñaḥ spr̥ṣṭaḥ śocitumarhati ॥86॥
12.227.87: tena śakra na śocāmi nāsti śoke sahāyatā,
yadā hi śocataḥ śoko vyasanaṁ nāpakarṣati ॥87॥
12.227.90: sā te na vyathate buddhiracalā tattvadarśinī ॥90॥
12.227.91: dhruvaṁ na vyathase’dya tvaṁ dhairyāt satyaparākrama,
ko hi viśvāsamartheṣu śarīre vā śarīrabhr̥t ॥91॥
12.227.95: anivr̥ttasya kālasya kṣayaṁ prāpto na mucyate,
12.227.97: kālo na parihāryaśca na cāsyāsti vyatikramaḥ,
ahorātrāṁśca māsāṁśca kṣaṇān kāṣṭhā lavān kalāḥ ॥97॥
12.227.98: sampīḍayati yaḥ kālo vr̥ddhi vārdhuṣiko yathā,
12.227.99: kālo harati samprāpto nadīvega iva drumam,
idānīṁ tāvadevāsau mayā dr̥ṣṭaḥ kathaṁ mr̥taḥ ॥99॥
12.227.100: iti kālena hriyatāṁ pralāpaḥ śrūyate nr̥ṇām,
12.227.101: ucchrāyā vinipātāntā bhāvo’bhāvaḥ sa eva ca ॥101॥
12.227.102: sā te na vyathate buddhiracalā tattvadarśinī ॥102॥
12.227.103: ahamāsaṁ purā ceti manasāpi na buddhyate,
12.227.108: viharan sarvato mukto na kvacit pariṣajjate,
rajaśca hi tamaśca tvāṁ spr̥śate na jitendriyam ॥108॥
12.227.110: dr̥ṣṭvā tvāṁ mama sañjātā tvayyanukrośinī matiḥ,
12.227.111: ānr̥śaṁsyaṁ paro dharmo hyanukrośaśca me tvayi,
12.227.112: yadā śvaśrūṁ snuṣā vr̥ddhāṁ paricāreṇa yokṣyate ॥112॥
12.227.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi balivāsavasaṁvāde saptaviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥227॥
12.228.2: bhaviṣyataśca bhadraṁ te tathaiva na bhaviṣyataḥ ॥2॥
12.228.3: śriyā śakrasya saṁvādaṁ taṁ nibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥3॥
12.228.12: tayoḥ samīpaṁ taṁ prāptaṁ pratyadr̥śyata bhārata ॥12॥
12.228.18: cakre cānupamāṁ pūjāṁ tasyāścāpi sa sarvavit,
devarājaḥ śriyaṁ rājan vākyaṁ cedamuvāca ha ॥18॥
12.228.19: kā tvaṁ kena ca kāryeṇa samprāptā cāruhāsini,
kutaścāgamyate subhru gantavyaṁ kva ca te śubhe ॥19॥
12.228.22: ahaṁ śraddhā ca medhā ca saṁnatirvijitiḥ sthitiḥ ॥22॥
12.228.23: ahaṁ dhr̥tirahaṁ siddhirahaṁ tviḍ bhūtireva ca,
ahaṁ svāhā svadhā caiva saṁstutirniyatiḥ smr̥tiḥ ॥23॥
12.228.37: rātrau dadhi ca saktūṁśca nityameva vyavarjayan ॥37॥
12.228.39: sadā hi vadatāṁ dharmaṁ sadā cāpratigr̥hṇatām,
ardhaṁ ca rātryāḥ svapatāṁ divā cāsvapatāṁ tathā ॥39॥
12.228.45: naivākāśe na paśuṣu viyonau ca na parvasu,
12.228.46: nityaṁ dānaṁ tathā dākṣyamārjavaṁ caiva nityadā,
12.228.47: satyaṁ dānaṁ tapaḥ śaucaṁ kāruṇyaṁ vāganiṣṭhurā,
12.228.51: sabhāsadāṁ ca vr̥ddhānāṁ satāṁ kathayatāṁ kathāḥ,
12.228.66: ye ca vedavido viprā vispaṣṭamanr̥caśca ye ॥66॥
12.228.73: pitā caiva janitrī ca śrāntau vr̥ttotsavāviva ॥73॥
12.228.81: nāhaṁ devendra vatsyāmi dānaveṣviti me matiḥ,
12.228.82: tvayārcitāṁ māṁ deveśa puro dhāsyanti devatāḥ,
12.228.83: āśā śraddhā dhr̥tiḥ śāntirvijitiḥ saṁnatiḥ kṣamā ॥83॥
12.228.87: śucau vābhyarthite deśe tridaśāḥ prāyaśaḥ sthitāḥ ॥87॥
12.228.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śrī-vāsavasaṁvādo nāma aṣṭāviṁśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥228॥
12.229.5: na prīyase vandyamāno nindyamāno na kupyase,
kā te prajñā kutaścaiṣā kiṁ te tasyāḥ parāyaṇam ॥5॥
12.229.7: yā gatiryā parā kāṣṭhā yā śāntiḥ puṇyakarmaṇām,
12.229.8: nindatsu ca samā nityaṁ praśaṁsatsu ca devala,
nihnavanti ca ye teṣāṁ samayaṁ sukr̥taṁ ca yat ॥8॥
12.229.9: pratihantuṁ na cecchanti hantāraṁ vai manīṣiṇaḥ ॥9॥
12.229.10: na cātītāni śocanti na caiva pratijānate ॥10॥
12.229.14: nindāpraśaṁse cātyarthaṁ na vadanti parasya ye,
12.229.15: na kruddhyanti na hr̥ṣyanti nāparādhyanti karhicit ॥15॥
12.229.16: na yeṣāṁ bāndhavāḥ santi ye cānyeṣāṁ na bāndhavāḥ ॥16॥
12.229.17: amitrāśca na santyeṣāṁ ye cāmitrā na kasyacit,
ya evaṁ kurvate martyāḥ sukhaṁ jīvanti sarvadā ॥17॥
12.229.18: ye hyato vicyutā mārgāt te hr̥ṣyantyudvijanti ca ॥18॥
12.229.19: nindyamānaḥ praśasto vā hr̥ṣye’haṁ kena hetunā ॥19॥
12.229.20: yad yadicchanti tat tasmādapi gacchantu mānavāḥ,
12.229.22: avajñātaḥ sukhaṁ śete iha cāmutra cābhayam,
12.229.23: parāṁ gatiṁ ca ye kecit prārthayanti manīṣiṇaḥ,
etad vrataṁ samāśritya sukhamedhanti te janāḥ ॥23॥
12.229.25: nāsya devā na gandharvā na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ,
12.229.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi jaigīṣavyāsitasaṁvāde ekonatriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥229॥
12.230.1: guṇaiḥ sarvairupetaśca ko nvasti bhuvi mānavaḥ ॥1॥
12.230.3: manye sa guṇasampanno brūhi tanmama pr̥cchataḥ ॥3॥
12.230.4: kukurādhipa yān manye śr̥ṇu tān me vivakṣataḥ,
12.230.7: upāsyo nārado bāḍhaṁ vāci nāsya vyatikramaḥ,
kāmato yadi vā lobhāt tasmāt sarvatra pūjitaḥ ॥7॥
12.230.8: r̥juśca satyavādī ca tasmāt sarvatra pūjitaḥ ॥8॥
12.230.9: tejasā yaśasā buddhyā jñānena vinayena ca,
12.230.15: nārthe dhane vā kāme vā bhūtapūrvo’sya vigrahaḥ,
12.230.21: kr̥taśramaḥ kr̥taprajño na ca tr̥ptaḥ samādhitaḥ,
12.230.24: kālajñaṁ ca priyajñaṁ ca kaḥ priyaṁ na kariṣyati ॥24॥
12.230.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vāsudevograsenasaṁvāde triṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥230॥
12.231.1: dhyānaṁ karma ca kālaṁ ca tathaivāyuryuge yuge ॥1॥
12.231.2: sargaśca nidhanaṁ caiva kuta etat pravartate ॥2॥
12.231.3: etad bhavantaṁ pr̥cchāmi tad bhavān prabravītu me ॥3॥
12.231.5: tato bhūyastu pr̥cchāmi tad bhavān vaktumarhati ॥5॥
12.231.6: jagau yad bhagavān vyāsaḥ putrāya paripr̥cchate ॥6॥
12.231.9: brāhmaṇasya ca yat kr̥tyaṁ tad bhavān vaktumarhati ॥9॥
12.231.10: tasmai provāca tat sarvaṁ pitā putrāya pr̥cchate,
12.231.18: ye te rātryahanī pūrvaṁ kīrtite jīvalaukike,
12.231.19: kr̥te tretāyuge caiva dvāpare ca kalau tathā ॥19॥
12.231.21: eka pādena hīyante sahasrāṇi śatāni ca ॥21॥
12.231.22: etad brahmavidāṁ tāta viditaṁ brahma śāśvatam ॥22॥
12.231.23: catuṣpāt sakalo dharmaḥ satyaṁ caiva kr̥te yuge,
12.231.25: kr̥te tretāyuge tveṣāṁ pādaśo hrasate vayaḥ ॥25॥
12.231.32: sr̥jate ca mahadbhūtaṁ tasmād vyaktātmakaṁ manaḥ ॥32॥
12.231.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne ekatriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥231॥
12.232.1: brahma tejomayaṁ śukraṁ yasya sarvamidaṁ jagat,
12.232.4: ākāśaṁ jāyate tasmāt tasya śabdaṁ guṇaṁ viduḥ ॥4॥
12.232.5: balavān jāyate vāyustasya sparśo guṇo mataḥ ॥5॥
12.232.8: teṣāṁ yāvad yathā yacca tattat tāvadguṇaṁ smr̥tam ॥8॥
12.232.14: sa vai sr̥jati bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca,
12.232.15: lokān nadīḥ samudrāṁśca diśaḥ śailān vanaspatīn,
avyayaṁ ca vyayaṁ caiva dvayaṁ sthāvarajaṅgamam ॥15॥
12.232.16: teṣāṁ ye yāni karmāṇi prāksr̥ṣṭyāṁ pratipedire,
12.232.17: tadbhāvitāḥ prapadyante tasmāt tat tasya rocate ॥17॥
12.232.19: kecit puruṣakāraṁ tu prāhuḥ karmasu mānavāḥ,
12.232.20: pauruṣaṁ karma daivaṁ ca phalavr̥ttiḥ svabhāvataḥ,
traya ete’pr̥thagbhūtā na vivekaṁ tu kecana ॥20॥
12.232.21: etameva ca naivaṁ ca na cobhe nānubhe na ca,
12.232.22: tapo niḥśreyasaṁ jantostasya mūlaṁ śamo damaḥ,
12.232.23: sa tadbhūtaśca sarveṣāṁ bhūtānāṁ bhavati prabhuḥ ॥23॥
12.232.25: nānārūpaṁ ca bhūtānāṁ karmaṇāṁ ca pravartanam ॥25॥
12.232.30: dve brahmaṇī veditavye śabdabrahma paraṁ ca yat,
12.232.32: tretāyuge vidhistveṣa yajñānāṁ na kr̥te yuge,
dvāpare viplavaṁ yānti yajñāḥ kaliyuge tathā ॥32॥
12.232.33: kāmyā iṣṭīḥ pr̥thag dr̥ṣṭvā tapobhistapa eva ca ॥33॥
12.232.34: tretāyāṁ tu samastā ye prādurāsan mahābalāḥ,
12.232.36: dr̥śyante na ca dr̥śyante vedāḥ kaliyuge’khilāḥ,
12.232.37: kr̥te yuge yastu dharmo brāhmaṇeṣu pradr̥śyate,
12.232.39: yathā viśvāni bhūtāni vr̥ṣṭyā bhūyāṁsi prāvr̥ṣi,
sr̥jyante jaṅgamasthāni tathā dharmā yuge yuge ॥39॥
12.232.41: kīrtitaṁ tatpurastāt te tatsūte cātti ca prajāḥ ॥41॥
12.232.42: dadhāti prabhave sthānaṁ bhūtānāṁ saṁyamo yamaḥ,
12.232.43: proktaṁ te putra sarvaṁ vai yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi ॥43॥
12.232.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne dvātriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥232॥
12.233.3: pr̥thivyāṁ yāni bhūtāni jaṅgamāni dhruvāṇi ca,
12.233.4: tataḥ pralīne sarvasmin sthāvare jaṅgame tathā,
12.233.10: adhaścordhvaṁ ca tiryak ca dodhavīti diśo daśa ॥10॥
12.233.11: praśāmyati tadā vāyuḥ khaṁ tu tiṣṭhati nādavat ॥11॥
12.233.15: taṁ tu kālena mahatā saṅkalpaḥ kurute vaśe,
12.233.16: kālo girati vijñānaṁ kālaṁ balamiti śrutiḥ,
balaṁ kālo grasati tu taṁ vidvān kurute vaśe ॥16॥
12.233.17: ākāśasya yathā ghoṣaṁ taṁ vidvān kurute’’tmani,
12.233.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne trayastriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥233॥
12.234.1: bhūtagrāme niyuktaṁ yat tadetat kīrtitaṁ mayā,
brāhmaṇasya tu yat kr̥tyaṁ tat te vakṣyāmi tacchr̥ṇu ॥1॥
12.234.5: vane gurusakāśe vā yatidharmeṇa vā punaḥ ॥5॥
12.234.6: yatra pakvakaṣāyo hi dāntaḥ sarvatra sidhyati ॥6॥
12.234.7: prajāvān śrotriyo yajvā mukta eva r̥ṇaistribhiḥ,
12.234.8: yat pr̥thivyāṁ puṇyatamaṁ vidyāt sthānaṁ tadāvaset,
yateta tasmin prāmāṇyaṁ gantuṁ yaśasi cottame ॥8॥
12.234.9: tapasā vā sumahatā vidyānāṁ pāraṇena vā,
ijyayā vā pradānairvā viprāṇāṁ vardhate yaśaḥ ॥9॥
12.234.11: na vr̥thā pratigr̥hṇīyānna ca dadyāt kathañcana ॥11॥
12.234.12: yājyataḥ śiṣyato vāpi kanyāyā vā dhanaṁ mahat,
12.234.18: dattvā lokān yayau dhīmānanantān sa mahīpatiḥ ॥18॥
12.234.26: nimī rāṣṭraṁ ca vaideho jāmadagnyo vasundharām,
12.234.30: madayantīṁ priyāṁ dattvā tayā saha divaṁ gataḥ ॥30॥
12.234.33: nāmnā ca dyutimān nāma śālvarājaḥ pratāpavān,
12.234.34: lomapādaśca rājarṣiḥ śāntāṁ dattvā sutāṁ prabhuḥ,
12.234.36: dattvā śatasahasraṁ tu gavāṁ rājā prasenajit,
12.234.37: ete cānye ca bahavo dānena tapasaiva ca,
12.234.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne catustriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥234॥
12.235.2: tiṣṭhatye teṣu bhagavān ṣaṭsu karmasu saṁsthitaḥ,
12.235.4: asaṁrodhena bhūtānāṁ vr̥ttiṁ lipseta vai dvijaḥ,
12.235.5: tiṣṭhate teṣu gr̥havān ṣaṭsu karmasu sa dvijaḥ ॥5॥
12.235.6: pañcabhiḥ satataṁ yajñaiḥ śraddadhāno yajeta ca,
12.235.9: kāmakrodhau vaśe kr̥tvā ninīṣed brahmaṇaḥ padam,
12.235.19: upapannaṁ hi yat prājño nistarennetaro janaḥ,
dūrato guṇadoṣau hi prājñaḥ sarvatra paśyati ॥19॥
12.235.20: aprājño na taratyenaṁ yo hyāste na sa gacchati ॥20॥
12.235.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne pañcatriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥235॥
12.236.6: yadi vā sarvavedajño yadi vāpyanr̥co dvijaḥ,
yadi vā dhārmiko yajvā yadi vā pāpakr̥ttamaḥ ॥6॥
12.236.7: yadi vā puruṣavyāghro yadi vā kleśadhāritaḥ,
12.236.14: sapta yā dhāraṇāḥ kr̥tsnā vāgyataḥ pratipadyate,
12.236.15: kramaśaḥ pārthivaṁ yacca vāyavyaṁ khaṁ tathā payaḥ,
12.236.17: śaiśirastu yathā dhūmaḥ sūkṣmaḥ saṁśrayate nabhaḥ ॥17॥
12.236.18: tathā dehād vimuktasya pūrvaṁ rūpaṁ bhavatyuta,
12.236.21: atha śvetāṁ gatiṁ gatvā vāyavyaṁ sūkṣmamapyuta,
12.236.22: eteṣvapi hi jāteṣu phalajātāni me śr̥ṇu,
12.236.25: varṇato guhyate cāpi kāmāt pibati cāśayān,
na cāsya tejasā rūpaṁ dr̥śyate śāmyate tathā,
12.236.28: tatrāvyaktamayīṁ vidyāṁ śr̥ṇu tvaṁ vistareṇa me,
tathā vyaktamayaṁ caiva sāṅkhye pūrvaṁ nibodha me ॥28॥
12.236.29: yoge sāṅkhye’pi ca tathā viśeṣaṁ tatra me śr̥ṇu ॥29॥
12.236.30: proktaṁ tad vyaktamityeva jāyate vardhate ca yat,
12.236.34: naiva kruddhyati na dveṣṭi nānr̥tā bhāṣate giraḥ ॥34॥
12.236.37: alolupo’vyatho dānto na kr̥tī na nirākr̥tiḥ,
12.236.41: ityeṣā bhāvajā buddhiḥ kathitā te na saṁśayaḥ,
12.236.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne ṣaṭtriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥236॥
12.237.2: kiṁ tajjñānamatho vidyā yathā nistarate dvayam,
12.237.3: puṣyate ca punaḥ sarvān prajñayā muktahetukān ॥3॥
12.237.4: pūtvā tr̥ṇamiṣīkāṁ vā te labhante na kiñcana ॥4॥
12.237.5: svabhāvaṁ kāraṇaṁ jñātvā na śreyaḥ prāpnuvanti te ॥5॥
12.237.10: vidyayā tāta sr̥ṣṭānāṁ vidyaiveha parā gatiḥ ॥10॥
12.237.21: dharmadvayaṁ hi yo veda sa sarvajñaḥ sa sarvavit,
12.237.22: brahmajñānapratiṣṭhaṁ hi taṁ devā brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ,
12.237.23: jñānānvitā hi paśyanti te devāstāta te dvijāḥ ॥23॥
12.237.24: teṣu viśvamidaṁ bhūtaṁ sarvaṁ ca jagadāhitam,
12.237.25: ādyante nidhanaṁ caiva karma cātītya sarvaśaḥ,
12.237.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne saptatriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥237॥
12.238.2: kiṁ tu karma svabhāvo’yaṁ jñānaṁ karmeti vā punaḥ ॥2॥
12.238.3: tatra vedavidhiḥ sa syājjñānaṁ cet puruṣaṁ prati,
12.238.6: etadevaṁ ca naivaṁ ca na cobhe nānubhe tathā,
12.238.8: kāmadveṣau pr̥thak kr̥tvā tapaḥ kr̥ta upāsate ॥8॥
12.238.10: tapasā tadavāpnoti yad bhūtvā sr̥jate jagat,
tad bhūtaśca tataḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ bhavati prabhuḥ ॥10॥
12.238.15: dvāpare viplavaṁ yānti vedāḥ kaliyuge tathā,
dr̥śyante nāpi dr̥śyante kalerante punaḥ kila ॥15॥
12.238.16: gavāṁ bhūmeśca ye cāpāmoṣadhīnāṁ ca ye rasāḥ ॥16॥
12.238.18: sr̥jate sarvato’ṅgāni tathā vedā yuge yuge ॥18॥
12.238.19: kīrtitaṁ yat purastānme sūte yaccātti ca prajāḥ ॥19॥
12.238.20: yaccedaṁ prabhavaḥ sthānaṁ bhūtānāṁ saṁyamo yamaḥ,
12.238.21: sargaḥ kālo dhr̥tirvedāḥ kartā kāryaṁ kriyāphalam,
etat te kathitaṁ tāta yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi ॥21॥
12.238.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne aṣṭātriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥238॥
12.239.3: sāṅkhye vā yadi vā yoga etat pr̥ṣṭho vadasva me ॥3॥
12.239.9: karṇau tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā caiva pañcamī,
12.239.10: śabdaḥ sparśastathā rūpaṁ raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥ,
12.239.11: indriyāṇi mano yuṅkte vaśyān yanteva vājinaḥ,
12.239.12: niyame ca visarge ca bhūtātmā mānasastathā ॥12॥
12.239.13: prāṇāpānau ca jīvaśca nityaṁ deheṣu dehinām ॥13॥
12.239.14: āśrayo nāsti sattvasya guṇāḥ śabdo na cetanā,
sattvaṁ hi tejaḥ sr̥jati na guṇān vai kathañcana ॥14॥
12.239.16: na hyayaṁ cakṣuṣā dr̥śyo na ca sarvairapīndriyaiḥ,
12.239.19: śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ ॥19॥
12.239.20: sa hi sarveṣu bhūteṣu jaṅgameṣu dhruveṣu ca,
12.239.21: yadā paśyati bhūtātmā brahma sampadyate tadā ॥21॥
12.239.22: ya evaṁ satataṁ veda so’mr̥tattvāya kalpate ॥22॥
12.239.24: yathā gatirna dr̥śyeta tathā jñānavidāṁ gatiḥ ॥24॥
12.239.25: yasmiṁstu pacyate kālastaṁ vedeha na kaścana ॥25॥
12.239.26: na tadūrdhvaṁ na tiryak ca nādho na ca punaḥ punaḥ,
na madhye pratigr̥hṇīte naiva kiñcit kutaścana ॥26॥
12.239.27: sarve’ntaḥsthā ime lokā bāhyameṣāṁ na kiñcana,
12.239.28: tasmāt sūkṣmāt sūkṣmataraṁ nāsti sthūlataraṁ tataḥ ॥28॥
12.239.32: navadvāraṁ puraṁ gatvā haṁso hi niyato vaśī,
īśaḥ sarvasya bhūtasya sthāvarasya carasya ca ॥32॥
12.239.34: haṁsoktaṁ cākṣaraṁ caiva kūṭasthaṁ yat tadakṣaram,
12.239.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne ekonacatvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥239॥
12.240.2: yogakr̥tyaṁ tu te kr̥tsnaṁ vartayiṣyāmi tacchr̥ṇu,
12.240.4: yogadoṣān samucchidya pañca yān kavayo viduḥ ॥4॥
12.240.5: kāmaṁ krodhaṁ ca lobhaṁ ca bhayaṁ svapnaṁ ca pañcamam,
12.240.6: dhr̥tyā śiśnodaraṁ rakṣet pāṇipādaṁ ca cakṣuṣā ॥6॥
12.240.7: cakṣuḥśrotre ca manasā manovācaṁ ca karmaṇā,
12.240.9: brahma tejomayaṁ śukraṁ yasya sarvamidaṁ rasaḥ ॥9॥
12.240.12: sidhyanti cāsya sarvārthā vijñānaṁ ca pravartate,
12.240.13: kāmakrodhau vaśe kr̥tvā ninīṣed brahmaṇaḥ padam ॥13॥
12.240.16: tataḥ śrotraṁ tataścakṣurjihvāṁ ghrāṇaṁ ca yogavit ॥16॥
12.240.17: tata etāni saṁyamya manasi sthāpayed yatiḥ,
12.240.19: prasīdanti ca saṁsthāya tadā brahma prakāśate,
12.240.21: taṁ paśyanti mahātmāno brāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ,
12.240.25: kuryāt paricayaṁ yoge traikālye niyato muniḥ,
giriśr̥ṅge tathā caitye vr̥kṣāgreṣu ca yojayet ॥25॥
12.240.27: taṁ ca yukto niṣeveta na caiva vicalet tataḥ ॥27॥
12.240.29: nābhiṣvajet paraṁ vācā karmaṇā manasāpi vā,
12.240.31: na prahr̥ṣyeta lābheṣu nālābheṣu ca cintayet,
12.240.33: etasmin virato mārge viramenna ca mohitaḥ ॥33॥
12.240.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne catvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥240॥
12.241.1: yadidaṁ vedavacanaṁ kuru karma tyajeti ca,
kāṁ diśaṁ vidyayā yānti kāṁ ca gacchanti karmaṇā ॥1॥
12.241.2: etad vai śrotumicchāmi tad bhavān prabravītu me,
12.241.4: yāṁ diśaṁ vidyayā yānti yāṁ ca gacchanti karmaṇā,
12.241.5: asti dharma iti proktaṁ nāstītyatraiva yo vadet,
tasya pakṣasya sadr̥śamidaṁ mama bhaved vyathā ॥5॥
12.241.7: tasmāt karma na kurvanti yatayaḥ pāradarśinaḥ ॥7॥
12.241.10: ye sma buddhiṁ parāṁ prāptā dharmanaipuṇyadarśinaḥ,
na te karma praśaṁsanti kūpaṁ nadyāṁ pibanniva ॥10॥
12.241.11: vidyayā tadavāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati ॥11॥
12.241.12: yatra gatvā na mriyate yatra gatvā na jāyate,
na punarjāyate yatra yatra gatvā na vartate ॥12॥
12.241.14: dvandvairna yatra bādhyante mānasena ca karmaṇā,
12.241.15: viddhi candramasaṁ darśe sūkṣmayā kalayā sthitam ॥15॥
12.241.19: tamo rajaśca satvaṁ ca viddhi jīvaguṇātmakam,
12.242.2: bhūya eva tu loke’smin sadvr̥ttiṁ kālahaitukīm,
12.242.3: vede vacanamuktaṁ tu kuru karma tyajeti ca,
12.242.5: yathā vai vihitā vr̥ttiḥ purastād brahmaṇā svayam,
12.242.7: vane mūlaphalāśī ca tapyan suvipulaṁ tapaḥ,
12.242.8: kāle prāpte caran bhaikṣyaṁ kalpate brahmabhūyase ॥8॥
12.242.10: pramāṇe vāpramāṇe ca viruddhe śāstratā kutaḥ ॥10॥
12.242.16: gurau vā guruputre vā vased dharmārthakovidaḥ ॥16॥
12.242.17: yacca śiṣyeṇa kartavyaṁ kāryaṁ dāsena vā punaḥ ॥17॥
12.242.22: uttānābhyāṁ ca pāṇibhyāṁ pādāvasya mr̥du spr̥śet,
12.242.23: idaṁ kariṣye bhagavannidaṁ cāpi kr̥taṁ mayā ॥23॥
12.242.24: brahmaṁstadapi kartāsmi yad bhavān vakṣyate punaḥ,
12.242.25: kuryāt kr̥tvā ca tatsarvamākhyeyaṁ gurave punaḥ,
yāṁstu gandhān rasān vāpi brahmacārī na sevate ॥25॥
12.242.26: seveta tān samāvr̥tya iti dharmeṣu niścayaḥ,
12.242.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne dvicatvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥242॥
12.243.3: teṣāṁ paraḥ paro jyāyān dharmato dharmajittamaḥ ॥3॥
12.243.5: nātmārthe pācayedannaṁ na vr̥thā ghātayet paśūn ॥5॥
12.243.6: prāṇī vā yadi vāprāṇī saṁskāraṁ yajuṣārhati,
12.243.9: teṣāṁ havyaṁ ca kavyaṁ cāpyarhaṇārthaṁ vidhīyate ॥9॥
12.243.12: amr̥taṁ yajñaśeṣaṁ syād bhojanaṁ haviṣā samam ॥12॥
12.243.20: bhrātā jyeṣṭhaḥ samaḥ pitrā bhāryā putraḥ svakā tanuḥ,
chāyā svā dāsavargaśca duhitā kr̥paṇaṁ param ॥20॥
12.243.25: pūrvān daśa daśa parān punāti ca pitāmahān,
12.243.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne tricatvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥243॥
12.244.6: tadagnihotraṁ tā gāvo yajñāṅgāni ca sarvaśaḥ ॥6॥
12.244.10: grīṣme ca pañca tapasaḥ śaśvacca mitabhojanāḥ ॥10॥
12.244.22: jarayā ca paridyūno vyādhinā ca prapīḍitaḥ ॥22॥
12.244.28: abhayaṁ sarvabhūtebhyo dattvā yaḥ pravrajed dvijaḥ,
12.244.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne catuścatvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥244॥
12.245.1: yoktavyo’’tmā kathaṁ śaktyā vedyaṁ vai kāṅkṣatā param ॥1॥
12.245.5: ekaścarati yaḥ paśyan na jahāti na hīyate,
12.245.8: yasmin vācaḥ prāviśanti kūpe trastā dvipā iva,
na vaktāraṁ punaryānti sa kaivalyāśrame vaset ॥8॥
12.245.10: yad brāhmaṇasya kuśalaṁ tadeva satataṁ vadet,
12.245.11: śūnyaṁ yena janākīrṇaṁ taṁ devā brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ ॥11॥
12.245.12: yatra kvacana śāyī ca taṁ devā brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ ॥12॥
12.245.13: kuṇapādiva ca strībhyastaṁ devā brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ ॥13॥
12.245.17: tasya mohād vimuktasya bhayaṁ nāsti kutaścana ॥17॥
12.245.19: amr̥taḥ sa nityaṁ vasati yo hiṁsāṁ na prapadyate ॥19॥
12.245.22: asvamekacaraṁ śāntaṁ taṁ devā brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ ॥22॥
12.245.23: jīvitaṁ yasya dharmārthaṁ dharmo haryarthameva ca,
ahorātrāśca puṇyārthaṁ taṁ devā brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ ॥23॥
12.245.24: nirmuktaṁ bandhanaiḥ sarvaistaṁ devā brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ ॥24॥
12.245.30: vedāṁśca vedyaṁ tu vidhiṁ ca kr̥tsna-
12.245.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne pañcacatvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥245॥
12.246.1: na cainaṁ te prajānanti sa tu jānāti tānapi ॥1॥
12.246.3: indriyebhyaḥ pare hyarthā arthebhyaḥ paramaṁ manaḥ,
12.246.4: amr̥tānna paraṁ kiñcit sā kāṣṭhā sā parā gatiḥ ॥4॥
12.246.5: evaṁ sarveṣu bhūteṣu gūḍho’’tmā na prakāśate,
12.246.9: sattve cittaṁ samāveśya tataḥ kālañjaro bhavet ॥9॥
12.246.11: lakṣaṇaṁ tu prasādasya yathā svapne sukhaṁ svapet,
nivāte vā yathā dīpo dīpyamāno na kampate ॥11॥
12.246.14: dharmākhyāneṣu sarveṣu satyākhyāne ca yad vasu,
12.246.15: tathaiva viduṣāṁ jñānaṁ putra hetoḥ samuddhr̥tam ॥15॥
12.246.20: idameva tataḥ śreya iti manyeta tattvavit ॥20॥
12.246.22: tat terahaṁ sampravakṣyāmi yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi ॥22॥
12.246.23: putra kiṁ hi kathayāmi te punaḥ ॥23॥
12.246.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne ṣaṭcatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥246॥
12.247.2: tat te’haṁ vartayiṣyāmi tasya vyākhyāmimāṁ śr̥ṇu ॥2॥
12.247.5: sarge ca pralaye caiva tasmin nirdiśyate tathā ॥5॥
12.247.8: śr̥ṇu tat tvamihaikāgro yathātattvaṁ yathā ca tat ॥8॥
12.247.11: ghreyaṁ ghrāṇaṁ śarīraṁ ca bhūmerete guṇāstrayaḥ,
12.247.13: mano buddhiḥ svabhāvaśca traya ete svayonijāḥ,
12.247.17: indriyāṇi nare pañca ṣaṣṭhaṁ tu mana ucyate,
12.247.19: rajastamaśca sattvaṁ ca yatra ete svayonijāḥ,
12.247.21: yat tu santāpasaṁyuktaṁ kāye manasi vā bhavet,
12.247.23: akasmād yadi vā kasmād vartante sāttvikā guṇāḥ ॥23॥
12.247.25: tathā mohaḥ pramādaśca nidrā tandrā prabodhitā,
12.247.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne saptacatvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥247॥
12.248.2: indriyebhyaḥ parā hyarthā arthebhyaḥ paramaṁ manaḥ,
12.248.3: yadā vikurute bhāvaṁ tadā bhavati sā manaḥ ॥3॥
12.248.4: śr̥ṇvatī bhavati śrotraṁ smr̥śatī sparśa ucyate ॥4॥
12.248.5: paśyatī bhavate dr̥ṣṭī rasatī rasanaṁ bhavet,
12.248.7: na sukhena na duḥkhena kadācidiha yujyate ॥7॥
12.248.9: yadā prārthayate kiñcit tadā bhavati sā manaḥ,
12.248.11: ye caiva bhāvā vartante sarva eṣveva te triṣu,
12.248.15: teṣāṁ tu manasā raśmīn yadā samyaṅniyacchati,
12.248.17: yathā vāricaraḥ pakṣī na lipyati jale caran,
12.248.20: na guṇā vidurātmānaṁ guṇān veda sa sarvadā ॥20॥
12.248.22: sr̥jate’tra guṇāneka eko na sr̥jate guṇān,
pr̥thagbhūtau prakr̥tyā tau samprayuktau ca sarvadā ॥22॥
12.248.23: yathā matsyo’dbhiranyaḥ syāt samprayuktau tathaiva tau,
12.248.24: iṣīkā vā yathā muñje pr̥thak ca saha caiva ca,
12.248.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne aṣṭacatvāriṁśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥248॥
12.249.2: svabhāvayuktaṁ tat sarvaṁ yadimān sr̥jate guṇān,
12.249.7: tāmyeyuḥ pracyutāḥ pr̥thvyā yathā pūrṇāṁ nadīṁ narāḥ,
12.249.8: na tu tāmyati vai vidvān sthale carati tattvavit,
12.249.9: evaṁ buddhvā naraḥ sarvaṁ bhūtānāmāgatiṁ gatim,
12.249.11: etad buddhvā bhavet śuddhaḥ kimanyad buddhalakṣaṇam,
12.249.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne ekonapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥249॥
12.250.1: yasmād dharmāt paro dharmo vidyate neha kaścana,
yo viśiṣṭaśca dharmebhyastaṁ bhavān pravravītu me ॥1॥
12.250.4: tajjyāyaḥ sarvadharmebhyaḥ sa dharmaḥ para ucyate ॥4॥
12.250.7: taṁ paśyanti mahātmāno brāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ ॥7॥
12.250.8: ātmano nābhijānīte kva me puṣpaṁ kva me phalam ॥8॥
12.250.9: evamātmā na jānīte kva gamiṣye kutastvaham,
12.250.19: enaṁ vai sarvabhūtebhyo viśiṣṭaṁ menire budhāḥ,
12.250.22: naiva strī na pumānetannaiva cedaṁ napuṁsakam,
12.250.24: yathā matāni sarvāṇi tathaitāni yathā tathā,
kathitāni mayā putra bhavanti na bhavanti ca ॥24॥
12.250.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne pañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥250॥
12.251.1: mānaṁ ca kīrtiṁ ca yaśaśca necchet
12.251.2: r̥co yajūṁsi sāmāni na tena na sa vai dvijaḥ ॥2॥
12.251.3: nākāmo mriyate jātu na tena na ca vai dvijaḥ ॥3॥
12.251.5: yadā cāyaṁ na bibheti yadā cāsmānna bibhyati,
yadā necchati na dveṣṭi brahma sampadyate tadā ॥5॥
12.251.6: yadā na kurute bhāvaṁ sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam,
karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā ॥6॥
12.251.15: ye viduḥ pretya cātmānamihasthaṁ taṁ guṇaṁ viduḥ ॥15॥
12.251.17: niṣpracāraṁ manaḥ kr̥tvā pratiṣṭhāpya ca sarvaśaḥ,
yāmayaṁ labhate tuṣṭiṁ sā na śakyā’’tmano’nyathā ॥17॥
12.251.18: yenāsneho balaṁ dhatte yastaṁ veda sa vedavit ॥18॥
12.251.23: sa yadā sarvato muktaḥ samaḥ paryavatiṣṭhate,
12.251.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne ekapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥251॥
12.252.1: vaktrā guṇavatā śiṣyaḥ śrāvyaḥ pūrvamidaṁ mahat ॥1॥
12.252.2: ākāśaṁ māruto jyotirāpaḥ pr̥thvī ca pañcamī,
12.252.4: sparśanaṁ cendriyaṁ vidyāt tathā sparśaṁ ca tanmayam ॥4॥
12.252.6: asr̥ṅmajjā ca yaccānyat snigdhaṁ vidyāt tadātmakam ॥6॥
12.252.7: rasanaṁ cendriyaṁ jihvā rasaścāpāṁ guṇo mataḥ,
12.252.8: śmaśru roma ca keśāśca śirā snāyu ca carma ca,
12.252.10: mano navamameṣāṁ tu buddhistu daśamī smr̥tā ॥10॥
12.252.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne dvipañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥252॥
12.253.3: sattvavatsu tathā sattvaṁ pratirūpaṁ sa paśyati ॥3॥
12.253.6: yathāhani tathā rātrau yathā rātrau tathāhani,
12.253.7: teṣāṁ nityaṁ sadā nityo bhūtātmā satataṁ guṇaiḥ,
12.253.9: tatrāpi labhate duḥkhaṁ tatrāpi labhate sukham,
12.253.10: karoti puṇyaṁ tatrāpi jīvanniva ca paśyati ॥10॥
12.253.11: daśa māsān vasan kukṣau naiṣo’nnamiva jīryate ॥11॥
12.253.15: viditvā sapta sūkṣmāṇi ṣaḍaṅgaṁ ca maheśvaram,
12.253.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne tripañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥253॥
12.254.4: āyasaiḥ saṁyutāḥ pāśaiḥ phaladaṁ pariveṣṭya tam ॥4॥
12.254.5: yastān pāśān vaśe kr̥tvā taṁ vr̥kṣamapakarṣati,
12.254.8: evaṁ yo veda kāmasya kevalasya nivartanam,
12.254.10: tatra dvau dāruṇau doṣau tamo nāma rajastathā,
12.254.13: pr̥thagbhūtaṁ mano buddhyā mano bhavati kevalam ॥13॥
12.254.14: tanmanaḥ kurute sakhyaṁ rajasā saha saṅgatam,
taṁ cādāya janaṁ pauraṁ rajase samprayacchati ॥14॥
12.254.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne catuṣpañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥254॥
12.255.3: bhūmeḥ sthairyaṁ gurutvaṁ ca kāṭhinyaṁ prasavārthatā,
gandho gurutvaṁ śaktiśca saṅghātaḥ sthāpanā dhr̥tiḥ ॥3॥
12.255.4: apāṁ śaityaṁ rasaḥ kledo dravatvaṁ snehasaumyatā,
jihvā visyandanaṁ cāpi bhaumānāṁ śrapaṇaṁ tathā ॥4॥
12.255.6: balaṁ śaighryaṁ ca mokṣaṁ ca karma ceṣṭā’’tmatā bhavaḥ ॥6॥
12.255.7: ākāśasya guṇaḥ śabdo vyāpitvaṁ cchidratāpi ca,
12.255.9: sadasaccāśutā caiva manaso nava vai guṇāḥ ॥9॥
12.255.11: kathaṁ pañcaguṇā buddhiḥ kathaṁ pañcendriyā guṇāḥ,
12.255.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukānupraśne pañcapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥255॥
12.256.3: naiṣāṁ paśyāmi hantāraṁ prāṇināṁ saṁyuge param,
12.256.4: atha ceme mahāprājñāḥ śerate hi gatāsavaḥ,
mr̥tā iti ca śabdo’yaṁ vartatyeṣu gatāsuṣu ॥4॥
12.256.5: tatra me saṁśayo jātaḥ kutaḥ sañjñā mr̥tā iti ॥5॥
12.256.6: kasya mr̥tyuḥ kuto mr̥tyuḥ kena mr̥tyuriha prajāḥ,
12.256.11: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā nārado’tha tapodhanaḥ,
12.256.13: atīva vr̥ddhā bahulā nāmr̥ṣyata punaḥ prajāḥ ॥13॥
12.256.15: tasya cintā samutpannā saṁhāraṁ prati bhūpate,
12.256.16: tena sarvā diśo rājan dadāha sa pitāmahaḥ ॥16॥
12.256.17: tato divaṁ bhuvaṁ khaṁ ca jagacca sacarācaram,
12.256.20: abravīt paramo devo jvalanniva tadā śivam ॥20॥
12.256.21: karavāṇyadya kaṁ kāmaṁ varārho’si mato mama,
kartā hyasmi priyaṁ śambho tava yad hr̥di vartate ॥21॥
12.256.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi mr̥tyuprajāpatisaṁvādopakrame ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥256॥
12.257.1: viddhi sr̥ṣṭāstvayā hīmā mā kupyāsāṁ pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.257.2: tava tejo’gninā deva prajā dahyanti sarvaśaḥ,
tā dr̥ṣṭvā mama kāruṇyaṁ mā kupyāsāṁ jagatprabho ॥2॥
12.257.3: na kupye na ca me kāmo na bhaveyuḥ prajā iti,
12.257.4: iyaṁ hi māṁ sadā devī bhārārtā samacodayat,
12.257.5: saṁhāramāsāṁ vr̥ddhānāṁ tato māṁ krodha āviśat ॥5॥
12.257.6: mā prajāḥ sthāvaraṁ caiva jaṅgamaṁ ca vyanīnaśat ॥6॥
12.257.7: palvalāni ca sarvāṇi sarvaṁ caiva tr̥ṇopalam,
12.257.8: prasīda bhagavan sādho vara eṣa vr̥to mayā ॥8॥
12.257.9: naṣṭā na punareṣyanti prajā hyetāḥ kathañcana,
12.257.10: yathāmī jantavaḥ sarve na dahyeran pitāmaha ॥10॥
12.257.14: pravr̥ttiṁ ca nivr̥ttiṁ ca kalpayāmāsa vai prabhuḥ ॥14॥
12.257.17: sā viniḥsr̥tya vai khebhyo dakṣiṇāmāśritā diśam,
dadr̥śāte ca tāṁ kanyāṁ devau viśveśvarāvubhau ॥17॥
12.257.18: mr̥tyo iti mahīpāla jahi cemāḥ prajā iti ॥18॥
12.257.19: tvaṁ hi saṁhārabuddhyā me cintitā ruṣitena ca,
12.257.20: aviśeṣeṇa caiva tvaṁ prajāḥ saṁhara kāmini,
mama tvaṁ hi niyogena śreyaḥ paramavāpsyasi ॥20॥
12.257.21: evamuktā tu sā devī mr̥tyuḥ kamalamālinī,
12.257.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi mr̥tyuprajāpatisaṁvāde saptapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥257॥
12.258.2: tvayā sr̥ṣṭā kathaṁ nārī mādr̥śī vadatāṁ vara,
12.258.5: priyān putrān vayasyāṁśca bhrātr̥̄n mātr̥̄ḥ pitr̥̄napi,
12.258.7: prasādaye tvāṁ varada prasādaṁ kuru me prabho ॥7॥
12.258.9: gaccha saṁhara sarvāstvaṁ prajā mā ca vicāraya ॥9॥
12.258.11: na vyājahāra tasthau ca prahvā bhagavadunmukhī ॥11॥
12.258.14: sā kanyātha jagāmāsya samīpāditi naḥ śrutam ॥14॥
12.258.16: sā tatra paramaṁ devī tapo’carad duścaram,
samā hyekapade tasthau daśa padmāni pañca ca ॥16॥
12.258.17: tāṁ tathā kurvatīṁ tatra tapaḥ paramaduścaram,
12.258.18: kuruṣva me vaco mr̥tyo tadanādr̥tya satvarā,
12.258.19: tasthau padmāni ṣaṭ caiva pañca dve caiva mānada,
bhūyaḥ padmāyutaṁ tāta mr̥gaiḥ saha cacāra sā ॥19॥
12.258.21: apsu varṣasahasrāṇi sapta caikaṁ ca pārthiva,
tato jagāma sā kanyā kauśikīṁ nr̥pasattama ॥21॥
12.258.22: tato yayau mahābhāgā gaṅgāṁ meruṁ ca kevalam ॥22॥
12.258.23: tato himavato mūrdhni yatra devāḥ samījire ॥23॥
12.258.25: kimidaṁ vartate putri kriyatāṁ mama tad vacaḥ ॥25॥
12.258.26: na hareyaṁ prajā deva punaścāhaṁ prasādaye ॥26॥
12.258.28: adharmo nāsti te mr̥tyo saṁyacchemāḥ prajāḥ śubhe,
mayā hyuktaṁ mr̥ṣā bhadre bhavitā neha kiñcana ॥28॥
12.258.29: ahaṁ ca vibudhāścaiva tvaddhite niratāḥ sadā ॥29॥
12.258.30: imamanyaṁ ca te kāmaṁ dadāni manasepsitam,
na tvāṁ doṣeṇa yāsyanti vyādhisampīḍitāḥ prajāḥ ॥30॥
12.258.33: tāmabravīt tadā devī mr̥tyo saṁhara mānavān,
adharmaste na bhavitā tathā dhyāsyāmyahaṁ śubhe ॥33॥
12.258.41: putraḥ svargaṁ prāpya te modate ha ॥41॥
12.258.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi mr̥tyuprajāpatisaṁvāde aṣṭapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥258॥
12.259.1: ime vai mānavāḥ sarve dharmaṁ prati viśaṅkitāḥ,
ko’yaṁ dharmaḥ kuto dharmastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.259.2: ubhayārtho hi vā dharmastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
12.259.5: ubhayatra sukhodarka iha caiva paratra ca,
alabdhvā nipuṇaṁ dharmaṁ pāpaḥ pāpena yujyate ॥5॥
12.259.8: tadā teṣāṁ spr̥hayate ye vai tuṣṭāḥ svakairdhanaiḥ ॥8॥
12.259.10: satyasya vacanaṁ sādhu na satyād vidyate param,
satyena vidhr̥taṁ sarvaṁ sarvaṁ satye pratiṣṭhitam ॥10॥
12.259.11: api pāpakr̥to raudrāḥ satyaṁ kr̥tvā pr̥thak pr̥thak,
12.259.14: na hyatyantaṁ balavanto bhavanti sukhino’pi vā,
12.259.15: asādhubhyo’sya na bhayaṁ na caurebhyo na rājataḥ,
12.259.19: na hyatyantaṁ dhanavanto bhavanti sukhino’pi vā ॥19॥
12.259.21: yo’nyasya syādupapatiḥ sa kaṁ kiṁ vaktumarhati,
yadanyasya tataḥ kuryānna mr̥ṣyediti me matiḥ ॥21॥
12.259.22: jīvituṁ yaḥ svayaṁ cecchet kathaṁ so’nyaṁ praghātayet,
yad yadātmani ceccheta tat parasyāpi cintayet ॥22॥
12.259.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi dharmalakṣaṇe ekonaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥259॥
12.260.1: pratibhā tvasti me kācit tāṁ brūyāmanumānataḥ ॥1॥
12.260.2: bhūyāṁso hr̥daye ye me praśnāste vyāhr̥tāstvayā,
idaṁ tvanyat pravakṣyāmi na rājan nigrahādiva ॥2॥
12.260.3: na dharmaḥ paripāṭhena śakyo bhārata veditum ॥3॥
12.260.8: anye kaliyuge dharmā yathāśakti kr̥tā iva ॥8॥
12.260.10: te cet sarvapramāṇaṁ vai pramāṇaṁ hyatra vidyate,
12.260.11: yā yā vikriyate saṁsthā tataḥ sāpi praṇaśyati ॥11॥
12.260.12: vidma caivaṁ na vā vidma śakyaṁ vā vedituṁ na vā,
12.260.14: nipānānīva gobhyo’pi kṣetre kulye ca bhārata,
smr̥tirhi śāśvato dharmo viprahīṇo na dr̥śyate ॥14॥
12.260.16: dharmo bhavati sa kṣipraṁ pralāpastveva sādhuṣu,
12.260.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi dharmaprāmāṇyākṣepe ṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥260॥
12.261.6: apsu vaihāyasaṁ gacchenmayā yo’nyaḥ saheti vai ॥6॥
12.261.8: so’pyevaṁ nārhate vaktuṁ yathā tvaṁ dvijasattama ॥8॥
12.261.12: kiṁ kr̥taṁ duṣkaraṁ tāta karma jājalinā purā,
12.261.13: atīva tapasā yukto ghoreṇa sa babhūva ha,
12.261.15: vane tapasyatiṣṭhat sa na ca dharmamavaikṣata,
12.261.18: atha tasya jaṭāḥ klinnā babhūvurgrathitāḥ prabho,
12.261.19: tasthau kāṣṭhavadavyagro na cacāla ca karhicit ॥19॥
12.261.22: yadā na sa calatyeva sthāṇubhūto mahātapāḥ,
12.261.25: buddhvā ca sa mahātejā na cacāla ca jājaliḥ,
dharme kr̥tamanā nityaṁ nādharmaṁ sa tvarocayat ॥25॥
12.261.27: vyavardhanta ca tatraiva na cākampata jājaliḥ ॥27॥
12.261.30: tataḥ kadācit tāṁstatra paśyan pakṣīn yatavrataḥ,
12.261.31: tathā tānapi saṁvr̥ddhān dr̥ṣṭvā cāpnuvatāṁ mudam,
12.261.32: sāyaṁ sāyaṁ dvijān vipro na cākampata jājaliḥ ॥32॥
12.261.33: tyaktā mātāpitr̥bhyāṁ te na cākampata jājaliḥ ॥33॥
12.261.34: tathā te divasaṁ cāpi gatvā sāyaṁ punarnr̥pa,
12.261.36: krameṇa ca punaḥ sarve divasān subahūnatha,
nopāvartanta śakunā jātaprāṇāḥ sma te yadā ॥36॥
12.261.38: siddho’smīti matiṁ cakre tatastaṁ māna āviśat ॥38॥
12.261.39: sa tathā nirgatān dr̥ṣṭvā śakuntān niyatavrataḥ,
12.261.41: āsphoṭayat tathā’’kāśe dharmaḥ prāpto mayeti vai ॥41॥
12.261.42: athāntarikṣe vāgāsīt tāṁ ca śuśrāva jājaliḥ,
dharmeṇa na samastvaṁ vai tulādhārasya jājale ॥42॥
12.261.43: so’pyevaṁ nārhate vaktuṁ yathā tvaṁ bhāṣase dvija ॥43॥
12.261.45: kālena mahatāgacchat sa tu vārāṇasīṁ purīm,
vikrīṇantaṁ ca paṇyāni tulādhāraṁ dadarśa saḥ ॥45॥
12.261.47: āyānevāsi vidito mama brahman na saṁśayaḥ,
bravīmi yat tu vacanaṁ tacchr̥ṇuṣva dvijottama ॥47॥
12.261.48: na ca dharmasya sañjñāṁ tvaṁ purā vettha kathañcana ॥48॥
12.261.49: tataḥ siddhasya tapasā tava vipra śakuntakāḥ,
12.261.51: karavāṇi priyaṁ kiṁ te tad brūhi dvijasattama ॥51॥
12.261.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi tulādhārajājalisaṁvāde ekaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥261॥
12.262.1: ityuktaḥ sa tadā tena tulādhāreṇa dhīmatā,
12.262.5: sarvabhūtahitaṁ maitraṁ purāṇaṁ yaṁ janā viduḥ ॥5॥
12.262.6: yā vr̥ttiḥ sa paro dharmastena jīvāmi jājale ॥6॥
12.262.9: sarveṣāṁ yaḥ suhr̥nnityaṁ sarveṣāṁ ca hite rataḥ,
karmaṇā manasā vācā sa dharmaṁ veda jājale ॥9॥
12.262.10: nānuruddhye nirudhye vā na dveṣmi na ca kāmaye,
samo’haṁ sarvabhūteṣu paśya me jājale vratam,
tulā me sarvabhūteṣu samā tiṣṭhati jājale ॥10॥
12.262.11: nāhaṁ pareṣāṁ kr̥tyāni praśaṁsāmi na garhaye,
12.262.12: iti māṁ tvaṁ vijānīhi sarvalokasya jājale,
12.262.15: yadā cāyaṁ na bibheti yadā cāsmānna bibhyati,
yadā necchati na dveṣṭi brahma sampadyate tadā ॥15॥
12.262.16: yadā na kurute bhāvaṁ sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam,
karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā ॥16॥
12.262.17: na bhūto na bhaviṣyo’sti na ca dharmo’sti kaścana,
12.262.18: vāk krūrād daṇḍaparuṣāt sa prāpnoti mahad bhayam ॥18॥
12.262.20: tena vaidyastapasvī vā balavān vā vimuhyate ॥20॥
12.262.24: abhayaṁ sarvabhūtebhyaḥ sa prāpnoti sadā mune ॥24॥
12.262.31: na sa dharmamavāpnoti ihaloke paratra ca ॥31॥
12.262.33: bravīmi te satyamidaṁ śraddadhasva ca jājale ॥33॥
12.262.34: sa eva subhago bhūtvā punarbhavati durbhagaḥ,
vyāpattiṁ karmaṇāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā jugupsanti janāḥ sadā ॥34॥
12.262.35: akāraṇo hi naivāsti dharmaḥ sūkṣmo hi jājale,
12.262.37: ye ca cchindanti vr̥ṣaṇān ye ca bhindanti nastakān,
vahanti mahato bhārān badhnanti damayanti ca ॥37॥
12.262.38: hatvā sattvāni khādanti tān kathaṁ na vigarhase,
12.262.41: tāni jīvāni vakrīya kā mr̥teṣu vicāraṇā,
12.262.42: kā taile kā ghr̥te brahman madhunyapyauṣadheṣu vā ॥42॥
12.262.45: na manye bhrūṇahatyāpi viśiṣṭā tena karmaṇā,
kr̥ṣiṁ sādhviti manyante sā ca vr̥ttiḥ sudāruṇā ॥45॥
12.262.47: aghnyā iti gavāṁ nāma ka etā hantumarhati,
mahaccakārākuśalaṁ vr̥ṣaṁ gāṁ vā’’labhet tu yaḥ ॥47॥
12.262.50: bhrūṇahaṁ nahuṣaṁ tvāhurna te hoṣyāmahe haviḥ ॥50॥
12.262.53: yo hanyād yaśca māṁ stauti tatrāpi śr̥ṇu jājale ॥53॥
12.262.54: samau tāvapi me syātāṁ na hi me’sti priyāpriyam,
12.262.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi tulādhārajājalisaṁvāde dviṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥262॥
12.263.3: na hi vartedayaṁ loko vārtāmutsr̥jya kevalām ॥3॥
12.263.4: vakṣyāmi jājale vr̥ttiṁ nāsmi brāhmaṇa nāstikaḥ,
na yajñaṁ ca vinindāmi yajñavit tu sudurlabhaḥ ॥4॥
12.263.5: namo brāhmaṇayajñāya ye ca yajñavido janāḥ,
12.263.7: ataḥ stainyaṁ prabhavati vikarmāṇi ca jājale ॥7॥
12.263.8: yadeva sukr̥taṁ havyaṁ tena tuṣyanti devatāḥ,
12.263.9: pūjā syād devatānāṁ hi yathā śāstranidarśanam,
12.263.10: lubdhebhyo jāyate lubdhaḥ samebhyo jāyate samaḥ,
12.263.12: tasmāt suniṣṭhitāḥ pūrve sarvān kāmāṁśca lebhire ॥12॥
12.263.13: na te yajñeṣvātmasu vā phalaṁ paśyanti kiñcana ॥13॥
12.263.14: śaṅkamānāḥ phalaṁ yajñe ye yajeran kathañcana,
