12.263.16: kartavyamiti kartavyaṁ vetti vai brāhmaṇo bhayam ॥16॥
12.263.17: brahmaiva vartate loke naiva kartavyatāṁ punaḥ,
viguṇaṁ ca punaḥ karma jyāya ityanuśuśruma ॥17॥
12.263.20: akhilaṁ daivataṁ sarvaṁ brahma brahmaṇi saṁśritam ॥20॥
12.263.24: yatra gatvā na śocanti na cyavanti vyathanti ca ॥24॥
12.263.25: te tu tad brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṁ prāpnuvantīha sāttvikāḥ,
naiva te svargamicchanti na yajanti yaśodhanaiḥ ॥25॥
12.263.26: vanaspatīnoṣadhīśca phalaṁ mūlaṁ ca te viduḥ ॥26॥
12.263.27: svameva cārthaṁ kurvāṇā yajñaṁ cakruḥ punardvijāḥ ॥27॥
12.263.29: iti me vartate buddhiḥ samā sarvatra jājale ॥29॥
12.263.30: tena te devayānena pathā yānti mahāmune ॥30॥
12.263.31: ubhau tau devayānena gacchato jājale yathā ॥31॥
12.263.32: svayaṁ caiṣāmanaḍuho yujyanti ca vahanti ca,
12.263.34: iti tyāgaṁ puraskr̥tya tādr̥śaṁ prabravīmi te ॥34॥
12.263.35: akṣīṇaṁ kṣīṇakarmāṇaṁ taṁ devā brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ ॥35॥
12.263.36: na śrāvayan na ca yajan na dadad brāhmaṇeṣu ca,
kāmyāṁ vr̥ttiṁ lipsamānaḥ kāṁ gatiṁ yāti jājale,
idaṁ tu daivataṁ kr̥tvā yathā yajñamavāpnuyāt ॥36॥
12.263.37: na vai munīnāṁ śr̥ṇumaḥ sma tattvaṁ
12.263.38: atha sma karmaṇā kena vāṇija prāpnuyāt sukham ॥38॥
12.263.39: śaṁsa me tanmahāprājña bhr̥śaṁ vai śraddadhāmi te,
uta yajñā utāyajñā makhaṁ nārhanti te kvacit ॥39॥
12.263.41: iṣṭaṁ tu daivataṁ kr̥tvā yathā yajñamavāpnuyāt ॥41॥
12.263.42: puroḍāśo hi sarveṣāṁ paśūnāṁ medhya ucyate,
sarvā nadyaḥ sarasvatyaḥ sarve puṇyāḥ śiloccayāḥ ॥42॥
12.263.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi tulādhārajājalisaṁvāde triṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥263॥
12.264.1: pratyakṣaṁ kriyatāṁ sādhu tato jñāsyasi tad yathā ॥1॥
12.264.2: ete śakuntā bahavaḥ samantād vicaranti ha,
12.264.4: asaṁśayaṁ pitā vai tvaṁ putrānāhūya jājale ॥4॥
12.264.6: ahiṁsādikr̥taṁ karma iha caiva paratra ca,
śraddhāṁ nihanti vai brahman sā hatā hanti taṁ naram ॥6॥
12.264.7: kurvatāṁ yajña ityeva na yajño jātu neṣyate ॥7॥
12.264.8: śraddhā vaivasvatī seyaṁ sūryasya duhitā dvija,
12.264.9: vāgvr̥ddhaṁ trāyate śraddhā manovr̥ddhaṁ ca bhārata,
12.264.15: jahāti pāpaṁ śraddhāvān sarpo jīrṇāmiva tvacam ॥15॥
12.264.16: jyāyasī yā pavitrāṇāṁ nivr̥ttiḥ śraddhayā saha,
nivr̥ttaśīladoṣo yaḥ śraddhāvān pūta eva saḥ ॥16॥
12.264.17: kiṁ tasya tapasā kāryaṁ kiṁ vr̥ttena kimātmanā,
śraddhāmayo’yaṁ puruṣo yo yacchraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ ॥17॥
12.264.19: śraddhāṁ kuru mahāprājña tataḥ prāpsyasi yat param,
12.264.20: tato’cireṇa kālena tulādhāraḥ sa eva ca,
12.264.22: tasya vikhyātavīryasya śrutvā vākyāni sa dvijaḥ ॥22॥
12.264.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi tulādhārajājalisaṁvāde catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥264॥
12.265.2: chinnasthūṇaṁ vr̥ṣaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā vilāpaṁ ca gavāṁ bhr̥śam,
12.265.3: svasti gobhyo’stu lokeṣu tato nirvacanaṁ kr̥tam,
12.265.6: tasmāt pramāṇataḥ kāryo dharmaḥ sūkṣmo vijānatā,
12.265.7: upoṣya saṁśito bhūtvā hitvā vedakr̥tāḥ śrutīḥ,
12.265.8: vr̥thā māṁsaṁ na khādanti naiṣa dharmaḥ praśasyate ॥8॥
12.265.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vicakhnugītāyāṁ pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥265॥
12.266.1: kathaṁ kāryaṁ parīkṣeta śīghraṁ vātha cireṇa vā,
sarvathā kāryadurge’smin bhavān naḥ paramo guruḥ ॥1॥
12.266.3: cirakārika bhadraṁ te bhadraṁ te cirakārika,
12.266.8: ityuktvā sa tadā vipro gautamo japatāṁ varaḥ,
12.266.10: piturājñāṁ kathaṁ kuryāṁ na hanyāṁ mātaraṁ katham,
12.266.11: asvatantraṁ ca putratvaṁ kiṁ tu māṁ nānupīḍayet ॥11॥
12.266.12: striyaṁ hatvā mātaraṁ ca ko hi jātu sukhī bhavet,
12.266.15: so’haṁ mātrā svayaṁ pitrā putratve prakr̥taḥ punaḥ,
vijñānaṁ me kathaṁ na syād dvau buddhye cātmasambhavam ॥15॥
12.266.17: pitā yadāha dharmaḥ sa vedeṣvapi suniścitaḥ ॥17॥
12.266.18: prītimātraṁ pituḥ putraḥ sarvaṁ putrasya vai pitā,
12.266.19: tasmāt piturvacaḥ kāryaṁ na vicāryaṁ kadācana,
12.266.21: pitā dharmaḥ pitā svargaḥ pitā hi paramaṁ tapaḥ,
12.266.22: āśiṣastā bhajantyenaṁ paruṣaṁ prāha yat pitā,
12.266.23: mucyate bandhanāt puṣpaṁ phalaṁ vr̥kṣāt pramucyate,
kliśyannapi sutaṁ snehaiḥ pitā putraṁ na muñcati ॥23॥
12.266.25: yo hyayaṁ mayi saṅghāto martyatve pāñcabhautikaḥ,
asya me jananī hetuḥ pāvakasya yathāraṇiḥ ॥25॥
12.266.29: samarthaṁ vāsamarthaṁ vā kr̥śaṁ vāpyakr̥śaṁ tathā,
rakṣatyeva sutaṁ mātā nānyaḥ poṣṭā vidhānataḥ ॥29॥
12.266.30: tadā sa vr̥ddho bhavati tadā bhavati duḥkhitaḥ,
tadā śūnyaṁ jagat tasya yadā mātrā viyujyate ॥30॥
12.266.31: nāsti mātr̥samā chāyā nāsti mātr̥samā gatiḥ,
nāsti mātr̥samaṁ trāṇaṁ nāsti mātr̥samā priyā ॥31॥
12.266.33: cetanāvān naro hanyād yasya nāsuṣiraṁ śiraḥ ॥33॥
12.266.34: taṁ mātā ca pitā ceti bhūtārtho mātari sthitaḥ ॥34॥
12.266.35: mātā jānāti yadgotraṁ mātā jānāti yasya saḥ,
12.266.36: pāṇibandhaṁ svayaṁ kr̥tvā saha dharmamupetya ca,
yadā yāsyanti puruṣāḥ striyo nārhanti vācyatām ॥36॥
12.266.37: guṇasyāsya nivr̥ttau tu na bhartā na punaḥ patiḥ ॥37॥
12.266.39: striyā hi paramo bhartā daivataṁ paramaṁ smr̥tam,
12.266.42: evaṁ nārīṁ mātaraṁ ca gaurave cādhike sthitām,
12.266.48: arghyaṁ pādyaṁ yathānyāyaṁ mayā ca pratipāditaḥ ॥48॥
12.266.49: atra cākuśale jāte striyā nāsti vyatikramaḥ ॥49॥
12.266.50: evaṁ na strī na caivāhaṁ nādhvagastridaśeśvaraḥ,
12.266.52: hatvā sādhvīṁ ca nārīṁ ca vyasanitvācca vāsitām,
bhartavyatvena bhāryāṁ ca ko nu māṁ tārayiṣyati ॥52॥
12.266.53: yadyadya cirakārī syāt sa māṁ trāyeta pātakāt ॥53॥
12.266.54: cirakārika bhadraṁ te bhadraṁ te cirakārika,
12.266.55: trāhi māṁ mātaraṁ caiva tapo yaccārjitaṁ mayā,
12.266.56: saphalaṁ tat tathā te’stu bhavādya cirakārikaḥ ॥56॥
12.266.61: gautamastaṁ tato dr̥ṣṭvā śirasā patitaṁ bhuvi,
12.266.62: na hi sā tena sambhedaṁ patnī nītā mahātmanā,
12.266.63: hanyā iti samādeśaḥ śastrapāṇau sute sthite,
12.266.65: tataḥ pitrā ciraṁ stutvā ciraṁ cāghrāya mūrdhani,
12.266.67: cirakārika bhadraṁ te cirakārī ciraṁ bhava,
cirāya yadi te saumya ciramasmi na duḥkhitaḥ ॥67॥
12.266.69: cireṇa mitraṁ badhnīyāccireṇa ca kr̥taṁ tyajet,
cireṇa hi kr̥taṁ mitraṁ ciraṁ dhāraṇamarhati ॥69॥
12.266.70: rāge darpe ca māne ca drohe pāpe ca karmaṇi,
12.266.71: bandhūnāṁ suhr̥dāṁ caiva bhr̥tyānāṁ strījanasya ca,
12.266.72: evaṁ sa gautamastatra prītaḥ putrasya bhārata,
12.266.73: cireṇa niścayaṁ kr̥tvā ciraṁ na paritapyate ॥73॥
12.266.74: ciraṁ dhārayate roṣaṁ ciraṁ karma niyacchati,
12.266.77: ciraṁ pr̥ṣṭo’pi ca brūyācciraṁ na paritapyate ॥77॥
12.266.78: samāḥ svargaṁ gato vipraḥ putreṇa sahitastadā ॥78॥
12.266.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi cirakārikopākhyāne ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥266॥
12.267.1: kathaṁ rājā prajā rakṣenna ca kiñcit praghātayet,
pr̥cchāmi tvāṁ satāṁ śreṣṭha tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.267.4: vadho nāma bhaved dharmo naitad bhavitumarhati ॥4॥
12.267.5: atha cedavadho dharmo’dharmaḥ ko jātu cid bhavet,
12.267.6: lokayātrā na caiva syādatha ced vettha śaṁsa naḥ ॥6॥
12.267.7: sarva ete trayo varṇāḥ kāryā brāhmaṇabandhanāḥ,
12.267.8: ayaṁ me na śr̥ṇotīti tasmin rājā pradhārayet ॥8॥
12.267.10: dasyūn nihanti vai rājā bhūyaso vāpyanāgasaḥ,
bhāryā mātā pitā putro hanyante puruṣeṇa te,
12.267.12: na mūlaghātaḥ kartavyo naiṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ,
12.267.14: yadā purohitaṁ vā te paryeyuḥ śaraṇaiṣiṇaḥ,
12.267.16: tadā visargamarhanti na yathā prathame tathā ॥16॥
12.267.17: yatra yatraiva śakyeran saṁyantuṁ samaye prajāḥ,
sa tāvān procyate dharmo yāvanna pratilaṅghyate ॥17॥
12.267.18: pūrve pūrvatare caiva suśāsyā hyabhavan janāḥ ॥18॥
12.267.21: na gandharvapitr̥̄ṇāṁ ca kaḥ kasyeha na kaścana ॥21॥
12.267.22: teṣu yaḥ samayaṁ kaścit kurvīta hatabuddhiṣu ॥22॥
12.267.23: tān na śaknoṣi cet sādhūn paritrātumahiṁsayā,
12.267.30: yatra vai pāpakr̥nnīco na mahad duḥkhamarcchati,
vardhante tatra pāpāni dharmo hrasati ca dhruvam ॥30॥
12.267.33: dvāpare tu dvipādena pādena tvadhare yuge ॥33॥
12.267.34: tathā kaliyuge prāpte rājño duścaritena ha,
12.267.35: āyuḥ śaktiṁ ca kālaṁ ca nirdiśya tapa ādiśet ॥35॥
12.267.36: satyāya hi yathā neha jahyād dharmaphalaṁ mahat,
12.267.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi dyumatsenasatyavatsaṁvāde saptaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥267॥
12.268.9: haṁho vedā3 yadi matā dharmāḥ kenāpare matāḥ ॥9॥
12.268.12: nāhaṁ vedān vinindāmi na vivakṣyāmi karhicit,
12.268.13: gr̥hastho brahmacārī ca ubhau tāvapi gacchataḥ ॥13॥
12.268.17: r̥te tvāgamaśāstrebhyo brūhi tad yadi paśyasi ॥17॥
12.268.18: phalaṁ prakalpya pūrvaṁ hi tato yajñaḥ pratāyate ॥18॥
12.268.23: ko jātu na vicinvīta vidvān svāṁ śaktimātmanaḥ ॥23॥
12.268.25: oṣadhyaḥ paśavo vr̥kṣā vīrudājyaṁ payo dadhi,
12.268.28: evaṁ pratyekaśaḥ sarvaṁ yad yadasya vidhīyate ॥28॥
12.268.30: yajñārthāni hi sr̥ṣṭāni yathārthā śrūyate śrutiḥ,
12.268.35: omiti brahmaṇo yonirnamaḥ svāhā svadhā vaṣaṭ,
12.268.36: na tasya triṣu lokeṣu paralokabhayaṁ viduḥ,
12.268.37: yasminnetāni sarvāṇi bhavantīha sa vai dvijaḥ ॥37॥
12.268.38: agnyādheye yad bhavati yacca some sute dvija,
12.268.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi gokapilīye aṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥268॥
12.269.4: teṣāṁ gatiṁ parāṁ prāpya gārhasthye kiṁ prayojanam ॥4॥
12.269.5: yadyeṣā paramā kāṣṭhā yadyeṣā paramā gatiḥ,
12.269.10: kasyaiṣā vāg bhavet satyā mokṣo nāsti gr̥hāditi,
12.269.14: dāne gavāṁ paśūnāṁ vā piṇḍānāmapsu majjane ॥14॥
12.269.16: evaṁ krośatsu vedeṣu kuto mokṣo’sti kasyacit,
12.269.19: na vedānāṁ paribhavānna śāṭhyena na māyayā,
mahat prāpnoti puruṣo brahmaṇi brahma vindati ॥19॥
12.269.20: darśaṁ ca paurṇamāsaṁ ca agnihotraṁ ca dhīmataḥ,
12.269.28: upasthamudaraṁ bāhū vāk caturthī sa vai dvijaḥ ॥28॥
12.269.29: kiṁ tasya tapasā kāryaṁ kiṁ yajñena kimātmanā ॥29॥
12.269.30: bāhūpadhānaṁ śāmyantaṁ taṁ devā brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ ॥30॥
12.269.31: dvandvārāmeṣu sarveṣu ya eko ramate muniḥ,
12.269.32: gatijñaḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ taṁ devā brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ ॥32॥
12.269.34: avijñāya ca tat sarvamanyad rocayate phalam ॥34॥
12.269.37: phalavanti ca karmāṇi vyuṣṭimanti dhruvāṇi ca,
12.269.39: yathā ca vedaprāmāṇyaṁ tyāgaśca saphalo yathā,
tau panthānāvubhau vyaktau bhagavaṁstad vadasva me ॥39॥
12.269.40: pratyakṣaṁ tu kimatrāsti yad bhavanta upāsate ॥40॥
12.269.42: imaṁ ca saṁśayaṁ ghoraṁ bhagavān prabravītu me,
12.269.46: naiva tyāgī na santuṣṭo nāśoko na nirāmayaḥ,
12.269.47: bhavanto’pi ca hr̥ṣyanti śocanti ca yathā vayam,
12.269.49: yasya yatra hyanuṣṭhānaṁ tatra tatra nirāmayam ॥49॥
12.269.50: jñānaṁ plāvayate sarvaṁ yo jñānaṁ hyanuvartate,
jñānādapetya yā vr̥ttiḥ sā vināśayati prajāḥ ॥50॥
12.269.55: tasya dveṣaśca kāmaśca krodho dambho’nr̥taṁ madaḥ,
12.269.58: yaḥ kaścinnyāyya ācāraḥ sarvaṁ śāstramiti śrutiḥ,
12.269.60: śāstradoṣān na paśyanti śocanti ca yathā vayam,
12.269.66: dhik kartāraṁ ca kāryaṁ ca śramaścāyaṁ nirarthakaḥ ॥66॥
12.269.67: nāstikyamanyathā ca syād vedānāṁ pr̥ṣṭhataḥ kriyā,
12.269.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi gokapilīye ekonasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥269॥
12.270.1: vedāḥ pramāṇaṁ lokānāṁ na vedāḥ pr̥ṣṭhataḥ kr̥tāḥ,
dve brahmaṇī veditavye śabdabrahma paraṁ ca yat ॥1॥
12.270.2: śarīrametat kurute yad vede kurute tanum ॥2॥
12.270.3: ānantyamatra buddhyedaṁ karmaṇāṁ tad bravīmi te ॥3॥
12.270.4: dharma ityeva ye yajñān vitanvanti nirāśiṣaḥ ॥4॥
12.270.10: caranti dharmaṁ kr̥cchre’pi durge caivāpi saṁhatāḥ ॥10॥
12.270.11: saṁhatya dharmaṁ caratāṁ purā’’sīt sukhameva tat,
12.270.14: tasmin vidhau sthitānāṁ hi prāyaścittaṁ na vidyate,
12.270.16: teṣāṁ yajñāśca vedāśca karmāṇi ca yathāgamam ॥16॥
12.270.22: vyastamekaṁ caturdhā hi brāhmaṇā āśramaṁ viduḥ ॥22॥
12.270.23: taṁ santo vidhivat prāpya gacchanti paramāṁ gatim,
12.270.24: ta ete divi dr̥śyante jyotirbhūtā dvijātayaḥ ॥24॥
12.270.27: evaṁ yukto brāhmaṇaḥ syādanyo brāhmaṇako bhavet ॥27॥
12.270.28: karmaivaṁ puruṣasyāha śubhaṁ vā yadi vāśubham,
12.270.29: sarvamānantyamāsīd vai evaṁ naḥ śāśvatī śrutiḥ,
12.270.33: ye bhuñjate ye dadate yajante’dhīyate ca ye,
12.270.35: na tu tyāgasukhaṁ prāptā etat tvamapi paśyasi ॥35॥
12.270.37: tad yathāvad yathānyāyaṁ bhagavān prabravītu me ॥37॥
12.270.38: śarīrapaktiḥ karmāṇi jñānaṁ tu paramā gatiḥ,
kaṣāye karmabhiḥ pakve rasajñāne ca tiṣṭhati ॥38॥
12.270.41: yāṁ viprāḥ sarvataḥ śāntā viśuddhā jñānaniścayāḥ,
12.270.42: vedāṁśca veditavyaṁ ca viditvā ca yathāsthitim,
12.270.43: vede hi niṣṭhā sarvasya yad yadasti ca nāsti ca ॥43॥
12.270.44: eṣaiva niṣṭhā sarvatra yat tadasti ca nāsti ca,
etadanta ca madhyaṁ ca saccāsacca vijānataḥ ॥44॥
12.270.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi gokapilīye saptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥270॥
12.271.1: dharmamarthaṁ ca kāmaṁ ca vedāḥ śaṁsanti bhārata,
kasya lābho viśiṣṭo’tra tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.271.4: bhaktyā na caivādhyagacchad dhanaṁ sampūjya devatāḥ ॥4॥
12.271.7: ayaṁ me dhāsyati śreyo vapuretaddhi tādr̥śam ॥7॥
12.271.8: eṣa me dāsyati dhanaṁ prabhūtaṁ śīghrameva ca ॥8॥
12.271.11: brahmaghne ca surāpe ca caure bhagnavrate tathā,
12.271.12: lobhaḥ putro nikr̥tyāstu kr̥taghno nārhati prajām ॥12॥
12.271.13: tataḥ sa brāhmaṇaḥ svapne kuṇḍadhārasya tejasā,
12.271.14: śamena tapasā caiva bhaktyā ca nirupaskr̥taḥ,
12.271.16: tatra devāḥ prayacchanti rājyāni ca dhanāni ca,
12.271.19: yadi prasannā devā me bhakto’yaṁ brāhmaṇo mama,
12.271.21: uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṁ te kr̥takr̥tyaḥ sukhī bhava,
12.271.22: yāvad dhanaṁ prārthayate brāhmaṇo’yaṁ sakhā tava,
12.271.25: pr̥thivīṁ ratnapūrṇāṁ vā mahad vā ratnasañcayam ॥25॥
12.271.27: sadā dharmaphalaṁ rājyaṁ sukhāni vividhāni ca,
12.271.29: prītāste devatāḥ sarvā dvijasyāsya tathaiva ca,
12.271.32: ayaṁ na sukr̥taṁ vetti konvanyo vetsyate kr̥tam,
12.271.33: nirvedād devatānāṁ ca prasādāt sa dvijottamaḥ,
12.271.37: dharme ca śraddadhānasya tapasyugre ca vartataḥ,
12.271.38: tasya buddhiḥ prādurāsīd yadi dadyāmahaṁ dhanam,
12.271.40: yadi dadyāmahaṁ rājyaṁ tuṣṭo vai yasya kasyacit,
sa bhavedacirād rājā na mithyā vāg bhavenmama,
12.271.42: samāgamya sa tenātha pūjāṁ cakre yathāvidhi,
12.271.43: paśya rājñāṁ gatiṁ vipra lokāṁścaiva tu cakṣuṣā ॥43॥
12.271.45: māṁ pūjayitvā bhāvena yadi tvaṁ duḥkhamāpnuyāḥ,
kr̥taṁ mayā bhavet kiṁ te kaśca te’nugraho bhavet ॥45॥
12.271.46: paśya paśya ca bhūyastvaṁ kāmānicchet kathaṁ naraḥ,
12.271.47: tato’paśyat sa kāmaṁ ca krodhaṁ lobhaṁ bhayaṁ madam,
12.271.49: eṣa śakto’si tapasā dātuṁ rājyaṁ dhanāni ca ॥49॥
12.271.50: uvāca cainaṁ dharmātmā mahān me’nugrahaḥ kr̥taḥ ॥50॥
12.271.54: dharmācchaktyā tathā yogād yā caiva paramā gatiḥ ॥54॥
12.271.55: dhārmikān pūjayantīha na dhanāḍhyān na kāminaḥ ॥55॥
12.271.56: suprasannā hi te devā yatte dharme ratā matiḥ,
dhane sukhakalā kācid dharme tu paramaṁ sukham ॥56॥
12.271.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi kuṇḍadhāropākhyāne ekasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥271॥
12.272.1: dharmārthaṁ na sukhārthārthaṁ kathaṁ yajñaḥ samāhitaḥ ॥1॥
12.272.4: tiktaṁ ca virasaṁ śākaṁ tapasā svādutāṁ gatam ॥4॥
12.272.10: yadi mantrāṅgahīno’yaṁ yajño bhavati vai kr̥taḥ,
māṁ bhoḥ prakṣipa hotre tvaṁ gaccha svargamaninditaḥ ॥10॥
12.272.11: tatastu yajñe sāvitrī sākṣāt taṁ saṁnyamantrayat,
12.272.12: kiṁ nu duścaritaṁ yajñe didr̥kṣuḥ sā rasātalam ॥12॥
12.272.14: tataḥ sa hariṇo gatvā padānyaṣṭau nyavartata,
sādhu hiṁsaya māṁ satya hato yāsyāmi sadgatim ॥14॥
12.272.15: paśya hyapsaraso divya mayā dattena cakṣuṣā,
12.272.16: tataḥ sa suciraṁ dr̥ṣṭvā spr̥hālagnena cakṣuṣā,
12.272.17: sa tu dharmo mr̥go bhūtvā bahuvarṣoṣito vane,
12.272.19: tatastaṁ bhagavān dharmo yajñaṁ yājayataḥ svayam,
samādhānaṁ ca bhāryāyā lebhe sa tapasā param ॥19॥
12.272.20: satyaṁ te’haṁ pravakṣyāmi yo dharmaḥ satyavādinām ॥20॥
12.272.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi yajñanindānāma dvisaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥272॥
12.273.1: kathaṁ bhavati pāpātmā kathaṁ dharmaṁ karoti vā,
kena nirvedamādatte mokṣaṁ vā kena gacchati ॥1॥
12.273.2: viditāḥ sarvadharmāste sthityarthaṁ tvaṁ tu pr̥cchasi,
śr̥ṇu mokṣaṁ sanirvedaṁ pāpaṁ dharmaṁ ca mūlataḥ ॥2॥
12.273.3: prāpyaikaṁ jāyate kāmo dveṣo vā bharatarṣabha ॥3॥
12.273.6: na dharme jāyate buddhirvyājād dharmaṁ karoti ca ॥6॥
12.273.8: tatraiva kurute buddhiṁ tataḥ pāpaṁ cikīrṣati,
12.273.10: pāpaṁ cintayate caiva prabravīti karoti ca,
12.273.11: sa neha sukhamāpnoti kuta eva paratra vai ॥11॥
12.273.12: evaṁ bhavati pāpātmā dharmātmānaṁ tu me śr̥ṇu,
12.273.15: prajñā dharme ca ramate dharmaṁ caivopajīvati,
12.273.16: tasyaiva siñcate mūlaṁ guṇān paśyati tatra vai,
dharmātmā bhavati hyevaṁ mitraṁ ca labhate śubham ॥16॥
12.273.17: sa mitradhanalābhāt tu pretya ceha ca nandati,
śabde sparśe rase rūpe tathā gandhe ca bhārata ॥17॥
12.273.18: sa tu dharmaphalaṁ labdhvā na hr̥ṣyati yudhiṣṭhira ॥18॥
12.273.19: prajñācakṣuryadā kāme rase gandhe na rajyate ॥19॥
12.273.20: śabde sparśe tathā rūpe na ca bhāvayate manaḥ,
vimucyate tadā kāmānna ca dharmaṁ vimuñcati ॥20॥
12.273.21: sarvatyāge ca yatate dr̥ṣṭvā lokaṁ kṣayātmakam,
12.273.22: dharmātmā caiva bhavati mokṣaṁ ca labhate param ॥22॥
12.273.23: etat te kathitaṁ tāta yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi,
12.273.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi catuḥprāśniko nāma trisaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥273॥
12.274.3: karaṇe ghaṭasya yā buddhirghaṭotpattau na sā matā,
12.274.4: pūrve samudre yaḥ panthāḥ sa na gacchati paścimam,
ekaḥ panthā hi mokṣasya tanme vistarataḥ śr̥ṇu ॥4॥
12.274.6: icchāṁ dveṣaṁ ca kāmaṁ ca dhairyeṇa vinivartayet ॥6॥
12.274.7: nidrāṁ ca pratibhāṁ caiva jñānābhyāsena tattvavit ॥7॥
12.274.10: anityatvena ca snehaṁ kṣudhāṁ yogena paṇḍitaḥ,
12.274.11: maunena bahubhāṣyaṁ ca śauryeṇa ca bhayaṁ tyajet ॥11॥
12.274.13: yogadoṣān samucchidya pañca yān kavayo viduḥ ॥13॥
12.274.14: kāmaṁ krodhaṁ ca lobhaṁ ca bhayaṁ svapnaṁ ca pañcamam,
12.274.16: sidhyanti cāsya saṅkalpā vijñānaṁ ca pravartate ॥16॥
12.274.17: kāmakrodhau vaśe kr̥tvā ninīṣed brahmaṇaḥ padam ॥17॥
12.274.19: eṣa mārgo hi mokṣasya prasanno vimalaḥ śuciḥ,
12.274.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi yogācārānuvarṇanaṁ nāma catuḥsaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥274॥
12.275.2: āsīnaṁ devalaṁ vr̥ddhaṁ buddhvā buddhimatāṁ varam,
12.275.3: pralaye ca kamabhyeti tad bhavān prabravītu me ॥3॥
12.275.8: nopapattyā na vā yuktyā tvasad brūyādasaṁśayam,
12.275.9: pañcaiva tāni kālaśca bhāvābhāvau ca kevalau,
12.275.12: cakṣuṣī nāsikākarṇau tvak jihveti ca pañcamī,
12.275.13: darśanaṁ śravaṇaṁ ghrāṇaṁ sparśanaṁ rasanaṁ tathā,
upapattyā guṇān viddhi pañca pañcasu pañcadhā ॥13॥
12.275.14: rūpaṁ gandho rasaḥ sparśaḥ śabdaścaivātha tadguṇāḥ,
12.275.15: rūpaṁ gandhaṁ rasaṁ sparśaṁ śabdaṁ caivātha tadguṇān,
12.275.16: manasastu parā buddhiḥ kṣetrajño buddhitaḥ paraḥ ॥16॥
12.275.19: pāṇipādaṁ ca pāyuśca mehanaṁ pañcamaṁ mukham,
12.275.20: gamanendriyaṁ tathā pādau karmaṇaḥ karaṇe karau ॥20॥
12.275.21: visarge ca purīṣasya visarge cāpi kāmike ॥21॥
12.275.22: balaṁ ṣaṣṭhaṁ ṣaḍetāni vācā samyagyathā mama,
12.275.26: ānandaḥ karmaṇāṁ siddhiḥ pratipattiḥ parā gatiḥ,
12.275.28: indriyāṇi ca bhāvāśca guṇāḥ saptadaśa smr̥tāḥ,
teṣāmaṣṭādaśo dehī yaḥ śarīre sa śāśvataḥ ॥28॥
12.275.29: saṁśritāstad viyoge hi saśarīrā na santi te ॥29॥
12.275.30: ekaśca daśa cāṣṭau ca guṇāḥ saha śarīriṇā ॥30॥
12.275.31: ūṣmaṇā saha viṁśo vā saṅghātaḥ pāñcabhautikaḥ,
12.275.34: hitvā hitvā hyayaṁ praiti dehād dehaṁ kr̥tāśrayaḥ,
kālasañcoditaḥ kṣetrī viśīrṇād vā gr̥hād gr̥ham ॥34॥
12.275.36: na hyayaṁ kasyacit kaścinnāsya kaścana vidyate,
12.275.37: naiva sañjāyate janturna ca jātu vipadyate,
12.275.39: tatkṣaye hyasya paśyanti brahmabhāve parāṁ gatim ॥39॥
12.275.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi nāradāsitasaṁvāde pañcasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥275॥
12.276.1: bhrātaraḥ pitaraḥ pautrā jñātayaḥ suhr̥daḥ sutāḥ,
12.276.4: susukhaṁ bata jīvāmi yasya me nāsti kiñcana,
mithilāyāṁ pradīptāyāṁ na me dahyati kiñcana ॥4॥
12.276.5: arthāḥ khalu samr̥ddhā hi bāḍhaṁ duḥkhaṁ vijānatām,
12.276.6: yacca kāmasukhaṁ loke yacca divyaṁ mahatsukham,
12.276.7: yathaiva śr̥ṅgaṁ goḥ kāle vardhamānasya vardhate,
12.276.9: na kāmānanuruddhyeta duḥkhaṁ kāmeṣu vai ratiḥ,
12.276.10: vidvān sarveṣu bhūteṣu ātmanā sopamo bhavet,
kr̥takr̥tyo viśuddhātmā sarvaṁ tyajati caiva ha ॥10॥
12.276.11: bhayābhayaṁ ca santyajya sa praśānto nirāmayaḥ ॥11॥
12.276.12: yā dustyajā durmatibhiryā na jīryati jīryataḥ,
yo’sau prāṇāntiko rogastāṁ tr̥ṣṇāṁ tyajataḥ sukham ॥12॥
12.276.13: dharmātmā labhate kīrtiṁ pretya ceha yathāsukham ॥13॥
12.276.14: pūjayitvā ca tad vākyaṁ māṇḍavyo mokṣamāśritaḥ ॥14॥
12.276.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi māṇḍavyajanakasaṁvāde ṣaṭsaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥276॥
12.277.1: kiṁ śreyaḥ pratipadyeta tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.277.2: pituḥ putreṇa saṁvādaṁ taṁ nibodha yudhiṣṭhira ॥2॥
12.277.3: putro babhūva medhāvī medhāvī nāma nāmataḥ ॥3॥
12.277.7: amoghāsu patantīṣu kiṁ dhīra iva bhāṣase ॥7॥
12.277.8: amoghāḥ kāḥ patantīha kiṁ nu bhīṣayasīva mām ॥8॥
12.277.11: gādhodake matsya iva sukhaṁ vindeta kastadā ॥11॥
12.277.13: na hi pratīkṣate mr̥tyuḥ kr̥taṁ vāsya na vā kr̥tam ॥13॥
12.277.14: adyaiva kuru yacchreyo mā tvāṁ kālo’tyagānmahān,
ko hi jānāti kasyādya mr̥tyukālo bhaviṣyati ॥14॥
12.277.16: kr̥te dharme bhavet prītiriha pretya ca śāśvatī,
12.277.18: suptaṁ vyāghraṁ mahaugho vā mr̥tyurādāya gacchati,
12.277.21: durbalaṁ balavantaṁ ca prājñaṁ śūraṁ jaḍaṁ kavim ॥21॥
12.277.23: asantyājyaṁ yadā martyaiḥ kiṁ svastha iva tiṣṭhasi,
12.277.25: mr̥tyorvā gr̥hametad vai yā grāme vasato ratiḥ ॥25॥
12.277.26: nibandhanī rajjureṣā yā grāme vasato ratiḥ ॥26॥
12.277.27: chittvaināṁ sukr̥to yānti naināṁ chindanti duṣkr̥taḥ,
12.277.29: amr̥taṁ caiva mr̥tyuśca dvayaṁ dehe pratiṣṭhitam ॥29॥
12.277.34: ātmayajño bhaviṣyāmi na māṁ tārayati prajā,
yasya vāṅmanasī syātāṁ samyak praṇihite sadā ॥34॥
12.277.36: nāsti rāgasamaṁ duḥkhaṁ nāsti tyāgasamaṁ sukham ॥36॥
12.277.39: putrasyaitad vacaḥ śrutvā tathākārṣīt pitā nr̥pa,
12.277.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi pitāputrasaṁvāde saptasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥277॥
12.278.1: prāpnoti brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṁ yat paraṁ prakr̥terdhruvam ॥1॥
12.278.2: prāpnoti paramaṁ sthānaṁ yat paraṁ prakr̥terdhruvam ॥2॥
12.278.2d1: hārītena purā gītaṁ taṁ nibodha yudhiṣṭhira.
12.278.4: na cakṣuṣā na manasā na vācā dūṣayedapi,
na pratyakṣaṁ parokṣaṁ vā dūṣaṇaṁ vyāharet kvacit ॥4॥
12.278.7: pradakṣiṇaṁ ca savyaṁ ca grāmamadhye ca nācaret,
12.278.8: avakīrṇaḥ suguptaśca na vācā hyapriyaṁ vadet,
12.278.10: alābhe na vihanyeta lābhaścainaṁ na harṣayet ॥10॥
12.278.20: ajñātalipsaṁ lipseta na cainaṁ harṣa āviśet ॥20॥
12.278.22: abhayaṁ sarvabhūtebhyo dattvā yaḥ pravrajed gr̥hāt,
12.278.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi hārītagītāyām aṣṭasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥278॥
12.279.1: dhanyā dhanyā iti janāḥ sarve’smān pravadantyuta,
12.279.5: kadā vayaṁ gamiṣyāmo rājyaṁ hitvā parantapa ॥5॥
12.279.7: na cāpi manyase rājanneṣa doṣaḥ prasaṅgataḥ,
12.279.8: tata eva samutthena tamasā rudhyate’pi ca ॥8॥
12.279.15: kācit parājitasyādya na vyathā te’sti dānava ॥15॥
12.279.16: na śocāmi na hr̥ṣyāmi bhūtānāmāgatiṁ gatim ॥16॥
12.279.18: kṣapayitvā tu taṁ kālaṁ gaṇitaṁ kālacoditāḥ,
12.279.20: yathā karma tathā lābha iti śāstranidarśanam ॥20॥
12.279.21: tiryag gacchanti narakaṁ mānuṣyaṁ daivameva ca,
sukhaduḥkhe priye dveṣye caritvā pūrvameva ha ॥21॥
12.279.24: mayā yajjayalubdhena purā taptaṁ mahat tapaḥ ॥24॥
12.279.25: avardhaṁ trīn samākramya lokān vai svena tejasā ॥25॥
12.279.27: aiśvaryaṁ tapasā prāptaṁ bhraṣṭaṁ tacca svakarmabhiḥ,
12.279.28: tato me bhagavān dr̥ṣṭo harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ॥28॥
12.279.30: nūnaṁ tu tasya tapasaḥ sāvaśeṣamihāsti vai,
12.279.31: aiśvaryaṁ vai mahad brahma varṇe kasmin pratiṣṭhitam,
12.279.32: kasmād bhūtāni jīvanti pravartante tathā punaḥ,
kiṁ vā phalaṁ paraṁ prāpya jīvastiṣṭhati śāśvataḥ ॥32॥
12.279.33: kena vā karmaṇā śakyamatha jñānena kena vā,
12.279.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vr̥tragītāsu ekonāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥279॥
12.280.2: mūrdhā yasya tvanantaṁ ca sthānaṁ dānavasattama,
12.280.7: viṣṇau jagat sthitaṁ sarvamiti viddhi parantapa ॥7॥
12.280.8: eṣa cākṣipate kāle kāle visr̥jate punaḥ ॥8॥
12.280.14: na muñcati svakaṁ gandhaṁ tadvat sūkṣmasya darśanam ॥14॥
12.280.15: vimuñcati svakaṁ gandhaṁ mālyagandhe ca tiṣṭhati ॥15॥
12.280.19: devaḥ sr̥jati bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ॥19॥
12.280.20: sa vai sarveṣu bhūteṣu kṣaraścākṣara eva ca,
12.280.21: pādau tasya mahīṁ viddhi mūrdhānaṁ divamityuta,
12.280.23d1: taṁ viddhi bhūtaṁ viśvādiṁ paramaṁ viddhi ceśvaram,
12.280.24: so’’śramāṇāṁ phalaṁ tāta karmaṇastat phalaṁ viduḥ ॥24॥
12.280.25: akamarṇaḥ phalaṁ caiva sa eva paramavyayaḥ,
chandāṁsi yasya romāṇi hyakṣaraṁ ca sarasvatī ॥25॥
12.280.26: sa brahma paramo dharmastapaśca sadasacca saḥ ॥26॥
12.280.28: ekasya viddhi devasya sarvaṁ jagadidaṁ vaśe ॥28॥
12.280.29: jantuḥ paśyati vijñānāt tato brahma prakāśate ॥29॥
12.280.46: aṣṭau ca ṣaṣṭiṁ ca śatāni caiva
12.280.57: evaṁ gate me na viṣādo’sti kaścit
12.280.60: ayaṁ sa bhagavān devaḥ pitāmaha janārdanaḥ,
12.280.63: avāk sthitastu yaḥ sthāyī kalpānte parivartate,
12.280.65: śubhā tasmāt sa sukhito na śocati pitāmaha ॥65॥
12.280.70: mā vo bhayaṁ bhūd vimalāḥ stha sarve ॥70॥
12.280.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vr̥tragītāsu aśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥280॥
12.281.2: kathaṁ vā rājaśārdūla padaṁ tu jñātavānasau ॥2॥
12.281.6: vistareṇa mahābāho paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me ॥6॥
12.281.7: rathenendraḥ prayāto vai sārdhaṁ devagaṇaiḥ purā,
12.281.9: tat prekṣya tādr̥śaṁ rūpaṁ trailokyenāpi durjayam,
12.281.11: tato nādaḥ samabhavad vāditrāṇāṁ ca niḥsvanaḥ,
12.281.12: na sambhramo na bhīḥ kācidāsthā vā samajāyata ॥12॥
12.281.13: śakrasya ca surendrasya vr̥trasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥13॥
12.281.23: eṣa brahmā ca viṣṇuśca śivaścaiva jagatpatiḥ,
somaśca bhagavān devaḥ sarve ca paramarṣayaḥ ॥23॥
12.281.24: mā kārṣīḥ kaśmalaṁ śakra kaścidevetaro yathā,
āryāṁ yuddhe matiṁ kr̥tvā jahi śatrūn surādhipa ॥24॥
12.281.26: stavena śakra divyena stuvanti tvāṁ jayāya vai ॥26॥
12.281.31: samāviśat tadā raudro vr̥traṁ lokapatiṁ tadā,
12.281.34: eṣa vr̥tro mahān śakra balena mahatā vr̥taḥ,
12.281.36: ṣaṣṭiṁ varṣasahasrāṇi brahmā cāsmai varaṁ dadau ॥36॥
12.281.38: etat tvāṁ māmakaṁ tejaḥ samāviśati vāsava,
12.281.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vr̥travadhe ekāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥281॥
12.282.1: abhavan yāni liṅgāni śarīre tāni me śr̥ṇu ॥1॥
12.282.4: niṣpapāta mahāghorā smr̥tiḥ sā tasya bhārata,
12.282.16: sā viniḥsaramāṇaṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvā śakraṁ mahaujasam ॥16॥
12.282.17: jagrāha vadhyā devendraṁ sulagnā cābhavat tadā,
sa hi tasmin samutpanne brahmavadhyākr̥te bhaye ॥17॥
12.282.18: anusr̥tya tu yatnāt sa tathā vai brahmahatyayā ॥18॥
12.282.19: tasyā vyapohane śakraḥ paraṁ yatnaṁ cakāra ha ॥19॥
12.282.20: na cāśakat tāṁ devendro brahmavadhyāṁ vyapohitum,
gr̥hīta eva tu tayā devendro bharatarṣabha ॥20॥
12.282.24: brūhi kiṁ te karomyadya kāmaṁ kiṁ tvamihecchasi ॥24॥
12.282.25: kr̥tameva hi manyāmi nivāsaṁ tu vidhatsva me ॥25॥
12.282.26: sthāpanā vai sumahatī tvayā deva pravartitā ॥26॥
12.282.27: prīte tu tvayi dharmajña sarvalokeśvara prabho,
12.282.28: tatheti tāṁ prāha tadā brahmavadhyāṁ pitāmahaḥ,
12.282.30: yat kartavyaṁ mayā deva tad bhavān vaktumarhasi ॥30॥
12.282.32: mama mokṣasya ko’nto vai brahman dhyāyasva vai prabho,
12.282.33: yastvāṁ jvalantamāsādya svayaṁ vai mānavaḥ kvacit,
12.282.34: tameṣā yāsyati kṣipraṁ tatraiva ca nivatsyati,
brahmavadhyā havyavāha vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ ॥34॥
12.282.39: vayamagniṁ tathā śītaṁ varṣaṁ ca pavaneritam,
12.282.41: parvakāle tu samprāpte yo vai cchedanabhedanam,
12.282.46: tameṣā yāsyati kṣipraṁ vyetu vo mānaso jvaraḥ ॥46॥
12.282.50: śāsanāt tava lokeśa samājñāpaya naḥ prabho ॥50॥
12.282.52: evaṁ bhavatu lokeśa yathā vadasi naḥ prabho,
12.282.53: tvaṁ hi deveśa sarvasya jagataḥ paramā gatiḥ,
ko’nyaḥ prasādo hi bhaved yannaḥ kr̥cchrāt samuddharet ॥53॥
12.282.54: alpā iti matiṁ kr̥tvā yo naro buddhimohitaḥ,
12.282.55: tamiyaṁ yāsyati kṣipraṁ tatraiva ca nivatsyati,
tathā vo bhavitā mokṣa iti satyaṁ bravīmi vaḥ ॥55॥
12.282.58: śrūyate ca mahārāja samprāptā vāsavena vai,
12.282.61: ime hi bhūtale devāḥ prathitāḥ kurunandana ॥61॥
12.282.64: ye tu śakrakathāṁ divyāmimāṁ parvasu parvasu,
vipramadhye vadiṣyanti na te prāpsyanti kilbiṣam ॥64॥
12.282.65: kathitaṁ karma te tāta kiṁ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ॥65॥
12.282.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi brahmahatyāvibhāge dvyaśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥282॥
12.283.1: asmin vr̥travadhe deva vivakṣā mama jāyate ॥1॥
12.283.7: śailarājasutā cāsya nityaṁ pārśve sthitā babhau ॥7॥
12.283.19: kasyacit tvatha kālasya dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ,
12.283.22: uvāca vacanaṁ sādhvī devaṁ paśupatiṁ patim ॥22॥
12.283.23: bhagavan kva nu yāntyete devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ,
brūhi tattvena tattvajña saṁśayo me mahānayam ॥23॥
12.283.25: kena vā pratiṣedhena gamanaṁ te na vidyate ॥25॥
12.283.26: yajñeṣu sarveṣu mama na bhāga upakalpitaḥ ॥26॥
12.283.27: na me surāḥ prayacchanti bhāgaṁ yajñasya dharmataḥ ॥27॥
12.283.30: evamukatvā tu sā devī tadā paśupatiṁ patim,
12.283.31: atha devyā mataṁ jñātvā hr̥dgataṁ yaccikīrṣitam,
12.283.35: tataḥ sa yajño nr̥pate vadhyamānaḥ samantataḥ ॥35॥
12.283.36: taṁ tu yajñaṁ tathārūpaṁ gacchantamupalabhya saḥ ॥36॥
12.283.38: tasmin patitamātre ca svedabindau tadā bhuvi ॥38॥
12.283.42: vyacarat sarvato devān prādravat sa r̥ṣīṁstathā,
devāścāpyādravan sarve tato bhītā diśo daśa ॥42॥
12.283.45: bhavato’pi surāḥ sarve bhāgaṁ dāsyanti vai prabho,
12.283.46: imā hi devatāḥ sarvā r̥ṣayaśca parantapa,
12.283.47: yaścaiṣa puruṣo jātaḥ svedāt te vibudhottama,
12.283.48: ekībhūtasya na tvasya dhāraṇe tejasaḥ prabho,
12.283.49: ityukto brahmaṇā devo bhāge cāpi prakalpite,
12.283.50: avāpa ca tadā bhāgaṁ yathoktaṁ brahmaṇā bhavaḥ ॥50॥
12.283.51: jvaraṁ ca sarvadharmajño bahudhā vyasr̥jat tadā,
12.283.52: apāṁ tu nīlikāṁ vidyānnirmokaṁ bhujageṣu ca ॥52॥
12.283.56: mānuṣeṣu tu dharmajña jvaro nāmaiṣa bhārata ॥56॥
12.283.57: maraṇe janmani tathā madhye cāviśate naram,
12.283.58: anena hi samāviṣṭo vr̥tro dharmabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ ॥58॥
12.283.59: praviśya vajraṁ vr̥traṁ ca dārayāmāsa bhārata ॥59॥
12.283.61: viṣṇubhaktyā hi tenedaṁ jagad vyāptamabhūt tadā,
12.283.62: vistaraḥ kathitaḥ putra kimanyat prabravīmi te ॥62॥
12.283.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi jvarotpattirnāma tryaśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥283॥
12.284.2: devyā manyukr̥taṁ matvā kruddhaḥ sarvātmakaḥ prabhuḥ,
prasādāt tasya dakṣeṇa sa yajñaḥ sandhitaḥ katham,
12.284.3: purā himavataḥ pr̥ṣṭhe dakṣo vai yajñamāharat,
12.284.7: ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyāḥ saha marudgaṇaiḥ ॥7॥
12.284.10: āhūtā mantritāḥ sarve devāśca saha patnibhiḥ ॥10॥
12.284.12: nāyaṁ yajño na vā dharmo yatra rudro na ijyate,
vadhabandhaṁ prapannā vai kiṁ nu kālasya paryayaḥ ॥12॥
12.284.14: sa paśyati mahādevaṁ devīṁ ca varadāṁ śubhām ॥14॥
12.284.15: nāradaṁ ca mahātmānaṁ tasyā devyāḥ samīpataḥ,
santoṣaṁ paramaṁ lebhe iti niścitya yogavit ॥15॥
12.284.16: ekamantrāstu te sarve yeneśo na nimantritaḥ,
12.284.18: anr̥taṁ noktapūrvaṁ me na ca vakṣye kadācana,
12.284.20: santi no bahavo rudrāḥ śūlahastāḥ kapardinaḥ,
12.284.21: tathā dakṣasya vipulo yajño’yaṁ na bhaviṣyati ॥21॥
12.284.23: kiṁ nāma dānaṁ niyamaṁ tapo vā
12.284.27: stauti garvāyate cāpi svamātmānaṁ na saṁśayaḥ ॥27॥
12.284.28: nātmānaṁ staumi deveśi paśya me tanumadhyame,
12.284.29: so’sr̥jad bhagavān vaktrād bhūtaṁ ghoraṁ praharṣaṇam ॥29॥
12.284.31: devyā manyuvyapohārthaṁ hato dakṣasya vai kratuḥ,
12.284.39: agnayo naiva dīpyante naiva dīpyati bhāskaraḥ,
grahā naiva prakāśante nakṣatrāṇi na candramāḥ ॥39॥
12.284.40: r̥ṣayo na prakāśante na devā na ca mānuṣāḥ,
12.284.41: pramardanti tathā cānye vimardanti tathā pare ॥41॥
12.284.46: pānakāni ca divyāni lehyacoṣyāṇi yāni ca,
12.284.50: chittvā śiro vai yajñasya nanāda ca mumoda ca,
12.284.51: ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve kathyatāṁ ko bhavāniti,
nāhaṁ rudro na vā devī naiva bhoktumihāgataḥ ॥51॥
12.284.52: devyā manyukr̥taṁ matvā kruddhaḥ sarvātmakaḥ prabhuḥ,
draṣṭuṁ vā naiva viprendrān naiva kautūhalena vā ॥52॥
12.284.55: varaṁ krodho’pi devasya varadānaṁ na cānyataḥ ॥55॥
12.284.60: smitaṁ kr̥tvābravīd vākyaṁ brūhi kiṁ karavāṇi te,
śrāvite ca makhādhyāye devānāṁ guruṇā tataḥ ॥60॥
12.284.62: yadi prasanno bhagavān yadi cāhaṁ bhavatpriyaḥ,
yadi vāhamanugrāhyo yadi vā varado mama ॥62॥
12.284.63: yad dagdhaṁ bhakṣitaṁ pītamaśitaṁ yacca nāśitam,
12.284.66: jānubhyāmavanīṁ gatvā dakṣo labdhyā bhavād varam,
12.284.67: vaktumarhasi me tāta śrītuṁ śraddhā mamānagha ॥67॥
12.284.74: sarvā vai devatā hyasmin gāvo goṣṭha ivāsate ॥74॥
12.284.75: ādityamatha vai viṣṇuṁ brahmāṇaṁ ca br̥haspatim ॥75॥
12.284.76: bhagavān kāraṇaṁ kāryaṁ kriyā karaṇameva ca,
12.284.77: namo bhavāya śarvāya rudrāya varadāya ca,
12.284.84: namaḥ stutāya stutyāya stūyamānāya vai namaḥ,
12.284.85: namo nābhāya nābhyāya namaḥ kaṭakaṭāya ca ॥85॥
12.284.90: ugrāya ca namo nityaṁ namo’stu daśabāhave ॥90॥
12.284.93: namo vr̥ṣāya vr̥ṣyāya govr̥ṣāya vr̥ṣāya ca,
12.284.96: namaḥ śivāya śāntāya namaḥ śāntatamāya ca ॥96॥
12.284.101: namo yajñāya yajine hutāya prahutāya ca ॥101॥
12.284.105: namo vr̥ddhāya lubdhāya kṣubdhāya kṣobhaṇāya ca ॥105॥
12.284.107: namo ghuṣyāya ghoṣāya namaḥ kalakalāya ca ॥107॥
12.284.112: sarva sarvada sarvaghna sandhyārāga namo’stu te ॥112॥
12.284.118: carācarasya sraṣṭā tvaṁ pratihartā tathaiva ca,
12.284.119: manasaḥ paramā yoniḥ khaṁ vāyurjyotiṣāṁ nidhiḥ,
12.284.122: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā varṇāvarāśca ye,
12.284.123: yugaṁ nimeṣāḥ kāṣṭhāstvaṁ nakṣatrāṇi grahāḥ kalāḥ ॥123॥
12.284.124: vr̥kṣāṇāṁ kakudo’si tvaṁ girīṇāṁ śikharāṇi ca,
12.284.125: kṣīrodo hyudadhīnāṁ ca yantrāṇāṁ dhanureva ca,
vajraḥ praharaṇānāṁ ca vratānāṁ satyameva ca ॥125॥
12.284.126: tvameva dveṣa icchā ca rāgo mohaḥ kṣamākṣame,
12.284.127: tvaṁ gadī tvaṁ śarī cāpī khaṭvāṅgī jharjharī tathā,
chettā bhettā prahartā tvaṁ netā mantā pitā mataḥ ॥127॥
12.284.128: gaṅgā samudrāḥ saritaḥ palvalāni sarāṁsi ca ॥128॥
12.284.131: suvarṇanāmā ca tathā suvarṇapriya eva ca ॥131॥
12.284.133: hotraṁ hotā ca homyaṁ ca hutaṁ caiva tathā prabhuḥ,
12.284.134: pavitraṁ ca pavitrāṇāṁ maṅgalānāṁ ca maṅgalam,
giriko hiṇḍuko vr̥kṣo jīvaḥ pudgala eva ca ॥134॥
12.284.135: prāṇo’pānaḥ samānaśca udāno vyāna eva ca ॥135॥
12.284.144: svāhā svadhā vaṣaṭkāro namaskāro namo namaḥ,
12.284.151: śreṣṭhaḥ sthiraśca sthāṇuśca niṣkampaḥ kampa eva ca ॥151॥
12.284.157: tvaṁ strī pumāṁstvaṁ ca napuṁsakaṁ ca,
12.284.158: candrādityau cakṣuṣī te hr̥dayaṁ ca pitāmahaḥ ॥158॥
12.284.160: na brahmā na ca govindaḥ paurāṇā r̥ṣayo na te,
māhātmyaṁ vedituṁ śaktā yāthātathyena te śiva ॥160॥
12.284.161: yā mūrtayaḥ susūkṣmāste na mahyaṁ yānti darśanam,
trāhi māṁ satataṁ rakṣa pitā putramivaurasam ॥161॥
12.284.162: rakṣa māṁ rakṣaṇīyo’haṁ tavānagha namo’stu te,
12.284.163: tiṣṭhatyekaḥ samudrānte sa me goptāstu nityaśaḥ ॥163॥
12.284.168: praviśya vadanaṁ rāhoryaḥ somaṁ pibate niśi,
12.284.169: namastebhyaḥ svadhā svāhā prāpnuvantu mudantu te ॥169॥
12.284.170: rakṣantu te hi māṁ nityaṁ nityaṁ cāpyāyayantu mām ॥170॥
12.284.171: ye na rodanti dehasthā dehino rodayanti ca,
12.284.172: ye nadīṣu samudreṣu parvateṣu guhāsu ca,
12.284.174: yeṣu pañcasu bhūteṣu diśāsu vidiśāsu ca,
12.284.175: rasātalagatā ye ca ye ca tasmai paraṁ gatāḥ,
12.284.176: yeṣāṁ na vidyate saṅkhyā pramāṇaṁ rūpameva ca,
12.284.177: sarvabhūtāntarātmā ca tena tvaṁ na nimantritaḥ ॥177॥
12.284.178: tvameva kartā sarvasya tena tvaṁ na nimantritaḥ ॥178॥
12.284.179: athavā māyayā deva sūkṣmayā tava mohitaḥ,
etasmāt kāraṇād vāpi tena tvaṁ na nimantritaḥ ॥179॥
12.284.180: prasīda mama bhadraṁ te bhava bhāvagatasya me,
tvayi me hr̥dayaṁ deva tvayi buddhirmanastvayi ॥180॥
12.284.185: dakṣa dakṣa na kartavyo manyurvighnamimaṁ prati,
12.284.186: bhūyaśca te varaṁ dadmi taṁ tvaṁ gr̥hṇīṣva suvrata,
12.284.190: tasya cīrṇasya tat samyak phalaṁ bhavati puṣkalam,
taccāstu te mahābhāga tyajyatāṁ mānaso jvaraḥ ॥190॥
12.284.192: dakṣaproktaṁ stavamimaṁ kīrtayed yaḥ śr̥ṇoti vā,
12.284.193: yathā sarveṣu deveṣu variṣṭho bhagavān śivaḥ,
12.284.196: anenaiva tu dehena gaṇānāṁ samatāṁ vrajet,
tejasā yaśasā caiva yukto bhavati nirmalaḥ ॥196॥
12.284.197: na rākṣasāḥ piśācā vā na bhūtā na vināyakāḥ,
vighnaṁ kuryurgr̥he tasya yatrāyaṁ paṭhyate stavaḥ ॥197॥
12.284.199: śr̥ṇuyād yaḥ stavaṁ kr̥tsnaṁ kīrtayed vā samāhitaḥ,
12.284.201: devasya ca guhasyāpi devyā nandīśvarasya ca,
baliṁ suvihitaṁ kr̥tvā damena niyamena ca ॥201॥
12.284.202: īpsitān labhate so’rthān bhogān kāmāṁśca mānavaḥ ॥202॥
12.284.203: mr̥taśca svargamāpnoti tiryakṣu ca na jāyate,
12.284.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi dakṣaproktaśivasahasranāmastave caturaśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥284॥
12.285.2: tad vyākhyāsyāmi te tāta tasya vyākhyāmimāṁ śr̥ṇu ॥2॥
12.285.4: satataṁ hi pralīyante guṇāste prabhavanti ca ॥4॥
12.285.5: tataḥ sr̥ṣṭāni bhūtāni tāni yānti punaḥ punaḥ,
12.285.7: ākāśāt khalu yo ghoṣaḥ saṅghātastu mahīguṇaḥ,
12.285.10: rasaḥ snehaśca jihvā ca apāmete guṇāḥ smr̥tāḥ ॥10॥
12.285.11: ghreyaṁ ghrāṇaṁ śarīraṁ ca ete bhūmiguṇāḥ smr̥tāḥ ॥11॥
12.285.12: prāṇaḥ sparśaśca ceṣṭā ca vāyorete guṇāḥ smr̥tāḥ,
12.285.13: sattvaṁ rajastamaḥ kālaḥ karma buddhiśca bhārata,
12.285.15: indriyāṇi nare pañca ṣaṣṭhaṁ tu mana ucyate,
12.285.16: indriyāṇi ca kartā ca vicetavyāni bhāgaśaḥ,
12.285.17: tamaḥ sattvaṁ rajaśceti kālaḥ karma ca bhārata ॥17॥
12.285.19: jighratī bhavati ghrāṇaṁ rasatī rasanā rasān ॥19॥
12.285.20: yadā prārthayate kiñcit tadā bhavati sā manaḥ ॥20॥
12.285.23: na sukhena na duḥkhena kadācidapi vartate,
12.285.27: avidyā rāgamohau ca pramādaḥ stabdhatā bhayam ॥27॥
12.285.29: tatra yat prītisaṁyuktaṁ kāye manasi vā bhavet,
vartate sāttviko bhāva ityupekṣeta tat tathā ॥29॥
12.285.31: atha yanmohasaṁyuktaṁ kāye manasi vā bhavet,
12.285.32: etad buddhvā bhaved buddhaḥ kimanyad buddhalakṣaṇam ॥32॥
12.285.33: sr̥jate’tra guṇāneka eko na sr̥jate guṇān ॥33॥
12.285.34: pr̥thagbhūtau prakr̥tyā tu samprayuktau ca sarvadā,
yathā matsyo’dbhiranyaḥ syāt samprayukto bhavet tathā ॥34॥
12.285.35: na guṇā vidurātmānaṁ sa guṇān veda sarvataḥ,
paridraṣṭā guṇānāṁ tu saṁsraṣṭā manyate yathā ॥35॥
12.285.37: sr̥jate hi guṇān sattvaṁ kṣetrajñaḥ paripaśyati,
12.285.43: tāmyeyuḥ pracyutāḥ pr̥thvīṁ mohapūrṇāṁ nadīṁ narāḥ,
12.285.44: adhyātmaviduṣo dhīrā jñānaṁ tu paramaṁ plavaḥ ॥44॥
12.285.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi pāñcabhautike pañcāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥285॥
12.286.1: śokād duḥkhācca mr̥tyośca trasante prāṇinaḥ sadā,
ubhayaṁ no yathā na syāt tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.286.2: nāradasya ca saṁvādaṁ samaṅgasya ca bhārata ॥2॥
12.286.4: udvegaṁ na hi te kiñcit susūkṣmamapi lakṣaye,
12.286.5: bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ bhaviṣyaṁ ca sarvametat tu mānada,
teṣāṁ tattvāni jānāmi tato na vimanā hyaham ॥5॥
12.286.6: loke phalāni citrāṇi tato na vimanā hyaham ॥6॥
12.286.10: yadā na śocemahi kiṁ nu naḥ syād
12.286.15: na bāndhavā na ca vittaṁ na kaulyaṁ
na ca śrutaṁ na ca mantrā na vīryam,
12.286.20: na ca mr̥tyorna cādharmānna lobhānna kutaścana,
12.286.21: etad brahman vijānāmi mahat kr̥tvā tapo’vyayam,
tena nārada samprāpto na māṁ śokaḥ prabādhate ॥21॥
12.286.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi samaṅganāradasaṁvāde ṣaḍaśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥286॥
12.287.2: śravaṇaṁ caiva śāstrāṇāṁ kūṭasthaṁ śreya ucyate ॥2॥
12.287.5: yaiḥ kaścit sammato loke guṇaiśca puruṣo mune,
12.287.7: yat kāryaṁ na vyavasyāmastad bhavān vaktumarhati ॥7॥
12.287.8: idaṁ śreya idaṁ śreya iti sarve prabodhitāḥ ॥8॥
12.287.10: śāstraṁ yadi bhavedekaṁ śreyo vyaktaṁ bhavet tadā,
12.287.13: teṣāṁ teṣāṁ yathā hi tvamāśramāṇāṁ tatastataḥ,
12.287.18: vāk caiva madhurā proktā śreya etadasaṁśayam ॥18॥
12.287.20: satyasya vacanaṁ śreyaḥ satyajñānaṁ tu duṣkaram,
12.287.21: ahaṅkārasya ca tyāgaḥ pramādasya ca nigrahaḥ,
12.287.30: jvalanti yaśasā loke yāni na vyāharanti ca ॥30॥
12.287.37: na tatra vāsaṁ kurvīta śreyo’rthī vai kathañcana ॥37॥
12.287.38: puṇyaṁ puṇyeṣu vimalaṁ pāpaṁ pāpeṣu cāpnuyāt ॥38॥
12.287.41: prabrūyād brahmaṇo dharmaṁ tyajet taṁ deśamātmavān ॥41॥
12.287.43: ātmapūjābhikāmo vai ko vaset tatra paṇḍitaḥ ॥43॥
12.287.44: pradīptamiva cailāntaṁ kastaṁ deśaṁ na santyajet ॥44॥
12.287.46: na tānanuvasejjātu te hi pāpakr̥to janāḥ ॥46॥
12.287.49: yatra rājā ca rājñaśca puruṣāḥ pratyanantarāḥ,
12.287.56: yatra rājā dharmanityo rājyaṁ dharmeṇa pālayet,
12.287.58: na hi śakyaṁ pradhānena śreyaḥ saṅkhyātumātmanaḥ ॥58॥
12.287.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śreyovāciko nāma saptāśītyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥287॥
12.288.1: kathaṁ nu yuktaḥ pr̥thivīṁ caredasmadvidho nr̥paḥ,
12.288.3: kiṁ śreyaḥ paramaṁ brahman kr̥tveha sukhamaśnute,
12.288.5: sukhaṁ mokṣasukhaṁ loke na ca mūḍho’vagacchati,
12.288.6: snehapāśasito mūḍho na sa mokṣāya kalpate ॥6॥
12.288.7: snehajāniha te pāśān vakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu tān mama,
12.288.8: sambhāvya putrān kālena yauvanasthān niveśya ca,
12.288.12: eṣa tāvat samāsena tava saṅkīrtito mayā,
12.288.13: muktā vītabhayā loke caranti sukhino narāḥ,
12.288.15: svajane na ca te cintā kartavyā mokṣabuddhinā,
ime mayā vinābhūtā bhaviṣyanti kathaṁ tviti ॥15॥
12.288.17: bhojanācchādane caiva mātrā pitrā ca saṅgraham,
12.288.19: ko hetuḥ svajanaṁ poṣṭuṁ rakṣituṁ vādr̥ḍhātmanaḥ ॥19॥
12.288.20: svajanaṁ hi yadā mr̥tyurhantyeva tava paśyataḥ,
12.288.22: yadā mr̥taṁ ca svajanaṁ na jñāsyasi kadācana,
12.288.23: mr̥te vā tvayi jīve vā yadā bhokṣyati vai janaḥ,
12.288.25: krodho lobhastathā mohaḥ sattvavān mukta eva saḥ ॥25॥
12.288.26: dyūte pāne tathā strīṣu mr̥gayāyāṁ ca yo naraḥ,
na pramādyati sammohāt satataṁ mukta eva saḥ ॥26॥
12.288.27: divase divase nāma rātrau rātrau pumān sadā,
bhoktavyamiti yaḥ khinno doṣabuddhiḥ sa ucyate ॥27॥
12.288.28: ātmabhāvaṁ tathā strīṣu muktameva punaḥ punaḥ,
yaḥ paśyati sadā yukto yathāvanmukta eva saḥ ॥28॥
12.288.29: sambhavaṁ ca vināśaṁ ca bhūtānāṁ ceṣṭitaṁ tathā,
yastattvato vijānāti loke’smin mukta eva saḥ ॥29॥
12.288.30: prāsāde mañcakaṁ sthānaṁ yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥30॥
12.288.31: avr̥ttikarśitaṁ caiva yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥31॥
12.288.32: yaḥ paśyati sa santuṣṭo na paśyaṁśca vihanyate,
yaścāpyalpena santuṣṭo loke’smin mukta eva saḥ ॥32॥
12.288.33: na ca saṁspr̥śyate bhāvairadbhutairmukta eva saḥ ॥33॥
12.288.34: śālayaśca kadannaṁ ca yasya syānmukta eva saḥ ॥34॥
12.288.35: kṣaumaṁ ca kuśacīraṁ ca kauśeyaṁ valkalāni ca,
āvikaṁ carma ca samaṁ yasya syānmukta eva saḥ ॥35॥
12.288.36: tathā ca vartate dr̥ṣṭvā loke’smin mukta eva saḥ ॥36॥
12.288.37: icchādveṣau bhayodvegau sarvathā mukta eva saḥ ॥37॥
12.288.39: kubjabhāvaṁ ca jarayā yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥39॥
12.288.40: bādhiryaṁ prāṇamandatvaṁ yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥40॥
12.288.41: lokādasmāt paraṁ lokaṁ yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥41॥
12.288.42: ye gatāḥ pr̥thivīṁ tyaktvā iti jñātvā vimucyate ॥42॥
12.288.43: duḥkhaṁ caiva kuṭumbārthe yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate ॥43॥
12.288.44: apatyānāṁ ca vaiguṇyaṁ janaṁ viguṇameva ca,
paśyan bhūyiṣṭhaśo loke ko mokṣaṁ nābhipūjayet ॥44॥
12.288.45: śāstrāllokācca yo buddhaḥ sarvaṁ paśyati mānavaḥ,
asāramiva mānuṣyaṁ sarvathā mukta eva saḥ ॥45॥
12.288.46: etat śrutvā mama vaco bhavāṁścaratu muktavat,
gārhasthye yadi vā mokṣe kr̥tā buddhiraviklavā ॥46॥
12.288.47: tat tasya vacanaṁ śrutvā samyak sa pr̥thivīpatiḥ,
12.289.1: tiṣṭhate me sadā tāta kautūhalamidaṁ hr̥di,
12.289.4: r̥ddhiṁ ca sa kathaṁ prāptaḥ sarvametad vadasva me ॥4॥
12.289.5: na yāti ca sa tejasvī madhyena nabhasaḥ katham,
12.289.9: ruddhvā dhanapatiṁ devaṁ yogena hr̥tavān vasu ॥9॥
12.289.10: hr̥te dhane tataḥ śarma na lebhe dhanadastathā,
12.289.15: sa mahāyogino buddhvā taṁ roṣaṁ vai mahātmanaḥ,
gatimāgamanaṁ vetti sthānaṁ caiva tataḥ prabhuḥ ॥15॥
12.289.17: jñātvā śūlaṁ ca deveśaḥ pāṇinā samanāmayat ॥17॥
12.289.20: sa tu praviṣṭa uśanā koṣṭhaṁ māheśvaraṁ prabhuḥ,
12.289.25: tatsaṁyogena buddhiṁ cāpyapaśyat sa tu śaṅkaraḥ,
12.289.26: sa tenāḍhyo mahāyogī tapasā ca dhanena ca,
12.289.27: uśanā tu samudvigno nililye jaṭhare tataḥ ॥27॥
12.289.28: tuṣṭāva ca mahāyogī devaṁ tatrastha eva ca,
niḥsāraṁ kāṅkṣamāṇaḥ sa tena sma pratihanyate ॥28॥
12.289.33: viniṣkrāntaṁ tu taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā jvalantamiva tejasā,
12.289.34: avārayata taṁ devī kruddhaṁ paśupatiṁ patim,
putratvamagamad devyā vārite śaṅkare ca saḥ ॥34॥
12.289.37: tataḥ praṇamya varadaṁ devaṁ devīmumāṁ tathā,
12.289.38: etat te kathitaṁ tāta bhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ,
12.289.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi bhavabhārgavasamāgame ekonanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥289॥
12.290.1: ataḥ paraṁ mahābāho yacchreyastad vadasva me,
12.290.2: kiṁ karma puruṣaḥ kr̥tvā śubhaṁ puruṣasattama,
śreyaḥ paramavāpnoti pretya ceha ca tad vada ॥2॥
12.290.4: yad bhavet pratipattavyaṁ tad bhavān prabravītu me ॥4॥
12.290.6: dharma eva kr̥taḥ śreyāniha loke paratra ca,
12.290.9: caturvidhā hi loke’smin yātrā tāta vidhīyate,
martyā yatrāvatiṣṭhante sā ca kāmāt pravartate ॥9॥
12.290.11: sauvarṇaṁ rājataṁ cāpi yathā bhāṇḍaṁ niṣicyate,
12.290.13: daivaṁ tāta na paśyāmi nāsti daivasya sādhanam,
12.290.14: pretya jātikr̥taṁ karma na smaranti sadā janāḥ,
te vai tasya phalaprāptau karma cāpi caturvidham ॥14॥
12.290.16: cakṣuṣā manasā vācā karmaṇā ca caturvidham,
12.290.17: nirantaraṁ ca miśraṁ ca labhate karma pārthiva,
kalyāṇaṁ yadi vā pāpaṁ na tu nāśo’sya vidyate ॥17॥
12.290.19: tato duḥkhakṣayaṁ kr̥tvā sukr̥taṁ karma sevate,
12.290.21: duṣkr̥te sukr̥te cāpi na janturniyato bhavet,
12.290.22: nāyaṁ parasya sukr̥taṁ duṣkr̥taṁ cāpi sevate,
12.290.23: anyenaiva janaḥ sarvaḥ saṅgato yaśca pārthivaḥ ॥23॥
12.290.24: pareṣāṁ yadasūyeta na tat kuryāt svayaṁ naraḥ,
12.290.25: satyād vibhraṣṭo dhārmikaḥ strī ca duṣṭā ॥25॥
12.290.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi parāśaragītāyāṁ navatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥290॥
12.291.4: varṇebhyo hi paribhraṣṭo na vai sammānamarhati,
na tu yaḥ satkriyāṁ prāpya rājasaṁ karma sevate ॥4॥
12.291.5: durlabhaṁ tamalabdhvā hi hanyāt pāpena karmaṇā ॥5॥
12.291.6: pāpaṁ hi karma phalati pāpameva svayaṁ kr̥tam,
tasmāt pāpaṁ na seveta karma duḥkhaphalodayam ॥6॥
12.291.7: tanna seveta medhāvī śuciḥ kuśalinaṁ yathā ॥7॥
12.291.8: pratyāpannasya hi tato nātmā tāvad virocate ॥8॥
12.291.10: viraktaṁ śodhyate vastraṁ na tu kr̥ṣṇopasaṁhitam,
12.291.11: svayaṁ kr̥tvā tu yaḥ pāpaṁ śubhamevānutiṣṭhati,
12.291.14: ahaṁ tu tāvat paśyāmi karma yad vartate kr̥tam,
12.291.17: na caret tāni dharmātmā śrutvā cāpi na kutsayet ॥17॥
12.291.18: karoti yaḥ śubhaṁ karma sa vai bhadrāṇi paśyati ॥18॥
12.291.19: nave kapāle salilaṁ saṁnyastaṁ hīyate yathā,
12.291.20: satoye’nyat tu yat toyaṁ tasminneva prasicyate,
12.291.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi parāśaragītāyām ekanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥291॥
12.292.1: kaḥ kasya copakurute kaśca kasmai prayacchati,
12.292.3: tayoḥ puṇyataraṁ dānaṁ tad dvijasya prayacchataḥ ॥3॥
12.292.6: apo hi prayataḥ śītāstāpitā jvalanena vā,
12.292.13: r̥gbhiḥ stutvā mahābāho devān vai yajñabhāginaḥ ॥13॥
12.292.14: devīṁ stutvā tu gagane modate yaśasā vr̥taḥ ॥14॥
12.292.17: lebhire tapasā siddhiṁ prasādāt tasya dhīmataḥ ॥17॥
12.292.18: anarhāścārhatāṁ prāptāḥ santaḥ stutvā tameva ha,
na tu vr̥ddhimihānvicchet karma kr̥tvā jugupsitam ॥18॥
12.292.19: ye’rthā dharmeṇa te satyā ye’dharmeṇa dhigastu tān,
dharmaṁ vai śāśvataṁ loke na jahyād dhanakāṅkṣayā ॥19॥
12.292.20: vedā hi sarve rājendra sthitāstriṣvagniṣu prabho ॥20॥
12.292.21: sa cāpyagnyāhito vipraḥ kriyā yasya na hīyate,
12.292.22: agnirātmā ca mātā ca pitā janayitā tathā,
12.292.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi parāśaragītāyāṁ dvinavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥292॥
12.293.2: na vr̥ttiṁ parato mārgecchuśrūṣāṁ tu prayojayet ॥2॥
12.293.6: tasmād guṇeṣu rajyethā mā doṣeṣu kadācana,
12.293.7: sukhe vā yadi vā duḥkhe vartamāno vicakṣaṇaḥ,
12.293.8: na tat seveta medhāvī na taddhitamihocyate ॥8॥
12.293.13: apraṇaṣṭe tato dharme bhavanti sukhitāḥ prajāḥ,
sukhena tāsāṁ rājendra modante divi devatāḥ ॥13॥
12.293.14: tasmād yo rakṣati nr̥paḥ sa dharmeṇeti pūjyate,
adhīte cāpi yo vipro vaiśyo yaścārjane rataḥ ॥14॥
12.293.17: satkr̥tya hi dvijātibhyo yo dadāti narādhipaḥ,
12.293.18: yācitena tu yad dattaṁ tadāhurmadhyamaṁ budhāḥ ॥18॥
12.293.20: tathā prayatnaṁ kurvīta yathā mucyeta saṁśrayāt ॥20॥
12.293.21: damena śobhate vipraḥ kṣatriyo vijayena tu,
dhanena vaiśyaḥ śūdrastu nityaṁ dākṣyeṇa śobhate ॥21॥
12.293.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi parāśaragītāyāṁ trinavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥293॥
12.294.2: nityaṁ trayāṇāṁ varṇānāṁ śuśrūṣuḥ śūdra ucyate ॥2॥
12.294.3: śūdradharmā yadā tu syāt tadā patati vai dvijaḥ ॥3॥
12.294.6: apūrviṇā na kartavyaṁ karma loke vigarhitam,
kr̥tapūrvaṁ tu tyajato mahān dharma iti śrutiḥ ॥6॥
12.294.9: dharma eva sadā nr̥̄ṇāmiha rājan praśasyate,
dharmavr̥ddhā guṇāneva sevante hi narā bhuvi ॥9॥
12.294.14: tāḥ prāpya tu sa dhigdaṇḍo na kāraṇamato’bhavat,
12.294.15: etasminneva kāle tu devā devavaraṁ śivam,
12.294.16: tena sma te gaganagāḥ sapurāḥ pātitāḥ kṣitau,
12.294.18: tasmin hate’tha svaṁ bhāvaṁ pratyapadyanta mānavāḥ,
prāpadyanta ca vedān vai śāstrāṇi ca yathā purā ॥18॥
12.294.21: mahākuleṣu ye jātā vr̥ddhāḥ pūrvatarāśca ye,
12.294.23: bhajante tāni cādyāpi ye bāliśatarā narāḥ ॥23॥
12.294.24: tasmādahaṁ bravīmi tvāṁ rājan sañcintya śāstrataḥ,
12.294.28: tasmād guṇeṣu rajyethā mā doṣeṣu kathañcana,
12.294.31: yadā vyapetahr̥llekhaṁ mano bhavati tasya vai,
12.294.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi parāśaragītāyāṁ caturnavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥294॥
12.295.1: tapovidhiṁ tu vakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śr̥ṇu ॥1॥
12.295.2: prāyeṇa ca gr̥hasthasya mamatvaṁ nāma jāyate,
12.295.3: gr̥hāṇyāśritya gāvaśca kṣetrāṇi ca dhanāni ca,
dārāḥ putrāśca bhr̥tyāśca bhavantīha narasya vai ॥3॥
12.295.9: karoti yena bhogī syāmiti tasmād vinaśyati ॥9॥
12.295.10: anvicchatāṁ śubhaṁ karma narāṇāṁ tyajatāṁ sukham ॥10॥
12.295.13: yo vai priyasukhe kṣīṇe tapaḥ kartuṁ vyavasyati ॥13॥
12.295.18: ye cādau brāhmaṇāḥ sr̥ṣṭā brahmaṇā tapasā purā,
te bhāvayantaḥ pr̥thivīṁ vicaranti divaṁ tathā ॥18॥
12.295.19: martyaloke ca rājāno ye cānye gr̥hamedhinaḥ,
mahākuleṣu dr̥śyante tat sarvaṁ tapasaḥ phalam ॥19॥
12.295.21: vāsaḥ prāsādapr̥ṣṭhe ca tat sarvaṁ tapasaḥ phalam ॥21॥
12.295.22: śayanāni ca mukhyāni bhojyāni vividhāni ca,
12.295.24: sukhito duḥkhito vāpi naro lobhaṁ parityajet,
avekṣya manasā śāstraṁ buddhyā ca nr̥pasattama ॥24॥
12.295.26: naṣṭaprajño yadā tu syāt tadā nyāyaṁ na paśyati,
12.295.28: prākāśyaṁ caiva gacchanti kr̥tvā niṣkalmaṣaṁ tapaḥ ॥28॥
12.295.30: dharme tapasi dāne ca vicikitsāsya jāyate,
12.295.31: sukhe tu vartamāno vai duḥkhe vāpi narottama,
suvr̥ttād yo na calate śāstracakṣuḥ sa mānavaḥ ॥31॥
12.295.32: rasane darśane ghrāṇe śravaṇe ca viśāmpate ॥32॥
12.295.33: tato’sya jāyate tīvrā vedanā tatkṣayāt punaḥ,
12.295.34: tataḥ phalārthaṁ sarvasya bhavanti jyāyase guṇāḥ,
dharmavr̥ttyā ca satataṁ kāmārthābhyāṁ na hīyate ॥34॥
12.295.37: kriyamāṇaṁ yadā karma nāśaṁ gacchati mānuṣam,
teṣāṁ nānyadr̥te loke tapasaḥ karma vidyate ॥37॥
12.295.39: yathā nadīnadāḥ sarve sāgare yānti saṁsthitim,
12.295.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi parāśaragītāyāṁ pañcanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥295॥
12.296.1: etadicchāmyahaṁ jñātuṁ tad brūhi vadatāṁ vara ॥1॥
12.296.3: evametanmahārāja yena jātaḥ sa eva saḥ,
12.296.7: ato’nye tvatiriktā ye te vai saṅkarajāḥ smr̥tāḥ ॥7॥
12.296.9: ete caturbhyo varṇebhyo jāyante vai parasparāt ॥9॥
12.296.10: bahūnīha hi loke vai gotrāṇi munisattama ॥10॥
12.296.11: yatra tatra kathaṁ jātāḥ svayoniṁ munayo gatāḥ,
śuddhayonau samutpannā viyonau ca tathā pare ॥11॥
12.296.13: utpādya putrān munayo nr̥pate yatra tatra ha,
12.296.15: āyurmataṅgo dattaśca drupado matsya eva ca ॥15॥
12.296.16: ete svāṁ prakr̥tiṁ prāptā vaideha tapaso’’śrayāt,
12.296.18: nāmadheyāni tapasā tāni ca grahaṇaṁ satām ॥18॥
12.296.21: kr̥ṣiśca pāśupālyaṁ ca vāṇijyaṁ ca viśāmapi,
12.296.24: ātmajñānaṁ titikṣā ca dharmāḥ sādhāraṇā nr̥pa ॥24॥
12.296.29: mantravarjaṁ na duṣyanti kurvāṇāḥ pauṣṭikīḥ kriyāḥ ॥29॥
12.296.30: tathā tathā sukhaṁ prāpya pretya ceha ca modate ॥30॥
12.296.32: karma caiva hi jātiśca viśeṣaṁ tu niśāmaya ॥32॥
12.296.33: jātyā ca karmaṇā caiva duṣṭaṁ karma na sevate,
jātyā duṣṭaśca yaḥ pāpaṁ na karoti sa pūruṣaḥ ॥33॥
12.296.34: jātyā pradhānaṁ puruṣaṁ kurvāṇaṁ karma dhikkr̥tam,
karma tad dūṣayatyenaṁ tasmāt karma na śobhanam ॥34॥
12.296.36: śr̥ṇu me’tra mahārāja yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi,
12.296.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi parāśaragītāyāṁ ṣaṇṇavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥296॥
12.297.4: na vai hiṁsyād bālavr̥ddhau ca rājan ॥4॥
12.297.7: pāpa eva vadhaḥ prokto narakāyeti niścayaḥ ॥7॥
12.297.8: na kaścit trāti vai rājan diṣṭāntavaśamāgatam,
12.297.13: dvitīyaṁ kāraṇaṁ tatra nānyat kiñcana vidyate,
tad dehaṁ dehināṁ yuktaṁ pañcabhūteṣu vartate ॥13॥
12.297.17: bhāvitaṁ karmayogena jāyate tatra tatra ha,
idaṁ śarīraṁ vaideha mriyate yatra yatra ha,
12.297.18: na jāyate tu nr̥pate kañcit kālamayaṁ punaḥ,
12.297.19: manasaḥ paramo hyātmā indriyebhyaḥ paraṁ manaḥ ॥19॥
12.297.20: vividhānāṁ ca bhūtānāṁ jaṅgamāḥ paramā nr̥pa,
12.297.21: dvipadānāmapi tathā dvijā vai paramāḥ smr̥tāḥ,
12.297.22: antavanti hi karmāṇi sevante guṇataḥ prajāḥ ॥22॥
12.297.23: āpanne tūttarāṁ kāṣṭhāṁ sūrye yo nidhanaṁ vrajet,
nakṣatre ca muhurte ca puṇye rājan sa puṇyakr̥t ॥23॥
12.297.24: ayojayitvā kleśena janaṁ plāvya ca duṣkr̥tam,
12.297.27: ūrdhvaṁ bhittvā pratiṣṭhante prāṇāḥ puṇyavatāṁ nr̥pa,
12.297.32: iyaṁ hi yoniḥ prathamā yāṁ prāpya jagatīpate,
ātmā vai śakyate trātuṁ karmabhiḥ śubhalakṣaṇaiḥ ॥32॥
12.297.33: kathaṁ na vipraṇaśyema yonito’syā iti prabho,
12.297.34: yo durlabhataraṁ prāpya mānuṣyaṁ dviṣate naraḥ,
12.297.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi parāśaragītāyāṁ saptanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥297॥
12.298.2: kiṁ śreyaḥ kā gatirbrahman kiṁ kr̥taṁ na vinaśyati,
kva gato na nivarteta tanme brūhi mahāmate ॥2॥
12.298.3: asaṅgaḥ śreyaso mūlaṁ jñānaṁ caiva parā gatiḥ,
cīrṇaṁ tapo na praṇaśyedvāpaḥ kṣetre na naśyati ॥3॥
12.298.9: buddhikarmendriyāṇāṁ hi pramatto yo na buddhyate,
12.298.10: vītarāgo jitakrodhaḥ samyag bhavati yaḥ sadā,
viṣaye vartamāno’pi na sa pāpena yujyate ॥10॥
12.298.12: yathā bhānugataṁ tejo maṇiḥ śuddhaḥ samādhinā,
12.298.14: padaṁ ca yānaṁ vividhāśca yāḥ kriyāḥ,
12.298.18: tathā yuktena manasā prājño gacchati tāṁ gatim ॥18॥
12.298.19: maraṇaṁ janmani proktaṁ janma vai maraṇāśritam,
12.298.22: yukto yadā sa bhavati tadā taṁ paśyate param ॥22॥
12.298.24: adhastiryaggatiṁ caiva svarge caiva parāṁ gatim,
12.298.25: mr̥ṇmaye bhājane pakve yathā vai na śyati dravaḥ,
12.298.26: yastu bhogāṁstyajedātmā sa vai bhoktuṁ vyavasyati ॥26॥
12.298.28: vaṇig yathā samudrād vai yathārthaṁ labhate dhanam,
12.298.39: na mātā na pitā kiñcit kasyacit pratipadyate,
12.298.40: mātā putraḥ pitā bhrātā bhāryā mitrajanastathā,
12.298.45: sarvaḥ svāni śubhāśubhāni niyataṁ karmāṇi jantuḥ svayaṁ
garbhāt sampratipadyate tadubhayaṁ yat tena pūrvaṁ kr̥tam,
12.298.47: śrutvā dharmavidāṁ śreṣṭhaḥ parāṁ mudamavāpa ha ॥47॥
12.299.1: satyaṁ damaṁ kṣamāṁ prajñāṁ praśaṁsanti pitāmaha,
12.299.4: śakune vayaṁ sma devā vai sādhyāstvāmanuyuṅkṣmahe,
12.299.14: staṁ manye’haṁ brāhmaṇaṁ vai muniṁ ca ॥14॥
12.299.17: yo nātyuktaḥ prāha rūkṣaṁ priyaṁ vā
yo vā hato na pratihanti dhairyāt,
pāpaṁ ca yo necchati tasya hantu-
12.299.23: na tathā vaktumicchanti kalyāṇān puruṣe guṇān,
12.299.24: yasya vāṅmanasī gupte samyak praṇihite sadā,
12.299.26: sukhaṁ hyavamataḥ śete yo’vamantā sa naśyati ॥26॥
12.299.28: upasthamudaraṁ hastau vāk caturthī sa dharmavit ॥28॥
12.299.35: tenaiva devāḥ prīyante satāṁ mārgasthitena vai ॥35॥
12.299.39: kenāyamāvr̥to lokaḥ kena vā na prakāśate,
kena tyajati mitrāṇi kena svargaṁ na gacchati ॥39॥
12.299.40: lobhāt tyajati mitrāṇi saṅgāt svargaṁ na gacchati ॥40॥
12.299.43: kiṁ brāhmaṇānāṁ devatvaṁ kiṁ ca sādhutvamucyate,
asādhutvaṁ ca kiṁ teṣāṁ kimeṣāṁ mānuṣaṁ matam ॥43॥
12.299.44d1: ityuktvā paramo devo bhagavān nitya avyayaḥ,
12.299.44d2: etad yaśasyamāyuṣyaṁ puṇyaṁ svargāya ca dhruvam,
12.299.45: kṣetraṁ vai karmaṇāṁ yoniḥ sadbhāvaḥ satyamucyate ॥45॥
12.299.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi haṁsagītāsamāptau navanavatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥299॥
12.300.1: sāṅkhye yoge ca me tāta viśeṣaṁ vaktumarhasi,
tava dharmajña sarvaṁ hi viditaṁ kurusattama ॥1॥
12.300.2: sāṅkhyāḥ sāṅkhyaṁ praśaṁsanti yogā yogaṁ dvijātayaḥ,
12.300.4: vadanti kāraṇaṁ cedaṁ sāṅkhyāḥ samyag dvijātayaḥ,
vijñāyeha gatīḥ sarvā virakto viṣayeṣu yaḥ ॥4॥
12.300.5: ūrdhvaṁ sa dehāt sūvyaktaṁ vimucyediti nānyathā,
12.300.6: svapakṣe kāraṇaṁ grāhyaṁ samaye vacanaṁ hitam,
śiṣṭānāṁ hi mataṁ grāhyaṁ tvadvidhaiḥ śiṣṭasammataiḥ ॥6॥
12.300.7: ubhe caite mate tattve mama tāta yudhiṣṭhira ॥7॥
12.300.8: ubhe caite mate jñāte nr̥pate śiṣṭasammate,
12.300.9: tulyaṁ śaucaṁ tapoyuktaṁ dayā bhūteṣu cānagha,
vratānāṁ dhāraṇaṁ tulyaṁ darśanaṁ na samaṁ tayoḥ ॥9॥
12.300.10: yadi tulyaṁ vrataṁ śaucaṁ dayā cātra phalaṁ tathā,
na tulyaṁ darśanaṁ kasmāt tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥10॥
12.300.11: rāgaṁ mohaṁ tathā snehaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ ca kevalam,
yogācchittvā tato doṣān pañcaitān prāpnuvanti tat ॥11॥
12.300.12: yathā cānimiṣāḥ sthūlā jālaṁ chittvā punarjalam,
12.300.13: tathaiva vāgurāṁ chittvā balavanto yathā mr̥gāḥ,
12.300.14: chittvā yogāḥ paraṁ mārgaṁ gacchanti vimalaṁ śivam ॥14॥
12.300.15: abalāśca mr̥gā rājan vāgurāsu tathā pare,
12.300.16: balahīnāśca kaunteya yathā jālaṁ gatā jhaṣāḥ,
12.300.17: yathā ca śakunāḥ sūkṣmaṁ prāpya jālamarindama,
tatra saktā vipadyante mucyante ca balānvitāḥ ॥17॥
12.300.18: abalā vai vinaśyanti mucyante ca balānvitāḥ ॥18॥
12.300.19: alpakaśca yathā rājan vahniḥ śāmyati durbalaḥ,
12.300.20: sa eva ca yadā rājan vahnirjātabalaḥ punaḥ,
12.300.22: durbalaśca yathā rājan srotasā hriyate naraḥ,
12.300.23: tadvad yogabalaṁ labdhvā vyūhate viṣayān bahūn ॥23॥
12.300.25: na yamo nāntakaḥ kruddho na mr̥tyurbhīmavikramaḥ,
12.300.26: yogaḥ kuryād balaṁ prāpya taiśca sarvairmahīṁ caret ॥26॥
12.300.30: ātmanaśca samādhāne dhāraṇāṁ prati vā vibho,
12.300.31: apramatto tathā dhanvī lakṣyaṁ hanti samāhitaḥ,
yuktaḥ samyak tathā yogī mokṣaṁ prāpnotyasaṁśayam ॥31॥
12.300.32: snehapūrṇe yathā pātre mana ādhāya niścalam,
12.300.34: yathā ca nāvaṁ kaunteya karṇadhāraḥ samāhitaḥ,
12.300.37: prāpnotyāśu paraṁ sthānaṁ lakṣaṁ mukta ivāśugaḥ ॥37॥
12.300.39: nābhyāṁ kaṇṭhe ca śīrṣa ca hr̥di vakṣasi pārśvayoḥ,
12.300.42: āhārān kīdr̥śān kr̥tvā kāni jitvā ca bhārata,
12.300.43: kaṇānāṁ bhakṣaṇe yuktaḥ piṇyākasya ca bhārata,
12.300.47: kāmaṁ jitvā tathā krodhaṁ śītoṣṇe varṣameva ca,
bhayaṁ śokaṁ tathā śvāsaṁ pauruṣān viṣayāṁstathā ॥47॥
12.300.48: aratiṁ durjayāṁ caiva ghorāṁ tr̥ṣṇāṁ ca pārthiva,
sparśaṁ nidrāṁ tathā tandrīṁ durjayāṁ nr̥pasattama ॥48॥
12.300.50: yaḥ kaścid vrajati hyasmin kṣemeṇa bharatarṣabha ॥50॥
12.300.53: yogamārgaṁ tathā’’sādya yaḥ kaścid vrajate dvijaḥ,
12.300.55: vipannā dhāraṇāstāta nayanti na śubhāṁ gatim,
12.300.56: maraṇaṁ janma duḥkhaṁ ca sukhaṁ ca sa vimuñcati ॥56॥
12.300.57: paraṁ yogasya yat kr̥tyaṁ niścitaṁ tad dvijātiṣu ॥57॥
12.300.58: bhavaṁ ca dharmaṁ ca ṣaḍānanaṁ ca
12.300.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi yogavidhau triśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥300॥
12.301.2: sāṅkhye tvidānīṁ kārtsnyena vidhiṁ prabrūhi pr̥cchate,
triṣu lokeṣu yajjñānaṁ sarvaṁ tad viditaṁ hi te ॥2॥
12.301.3: śr̥ṇu me tvamidaṁ sūkṣmaṁ sāṅkhyānāṁ viditātmanām,
12.301.4: yasmin na vibhramāḥ kecid dr̥śyante manujarṣabha,
12.301.7: pitr̥̄ṇāṁ viṣayān jñātvā tiryakṣu caratāṁ nr̥pa,
12.301.10: āyuṣaśca paraṁ kālaṁ loke vijñāya tattvataḥ,
sukhasya ca paraṁ tattvaṁ vijñāya vadatāṁ vara ॥10॥
12.301.11: prāpte kāle ca yad duḥkhaṁ satataṁ viṣayaiṣiṇām,
tiryakṣu patatāṁ duḥkhaṁ patatāṁ narake ca yat ॥11॥
12.301.12: svargasya ca guṇān kr̥tsnān doṣān sarvāṁśca bhārata,
vedavāde’pi ye doṣā guṇā ye cāpi vaidikāḥ ॥12॥
12.301.13: jñānayoge ca ye doṣā guṇā yoge ca ye nr̥pa,
sāṅkhyajñāne ca ye doṣāstathaiva ca guṇā nr̥pa ॥13॥
12.301.14: sattvaṁ daśaguṇaṁ jñātvā rajo navaguṇaṁ tathā,
12.301.15: ṣaḍguṇaṁ ca mano jñātvā nabhaḥ pañcaguṇaṁ tathā,
buddhiṁ caturguṇāṁ jñātvā tamaśca triguṇaṁ tathā ॥15॥
12.301.16: dviguṇaṁ ca rajo jñātvā sattvamekaguṇaṁ punaḥ,
mārgaṁ vijñāya tattvena pralaye prekṣaṇe tathā ॥16॥
12.301.17: prāpnuvanti śubhaṁ mokṣaṁ sūkṣmā iva nabhaḥ param ॥17॥
12.301.18: rūpeṇa dr̥ṣṭiṁ saṁyuktāṁ ghrāṇaṁ gandhaguṇena ca,
śabde saktaṁ tathā śrītraṁ jihvā rasaguṇeṣu ca ॥18॥
12.301.19: tanuṁ sparśe tathā saktāṁ vāyuṁ nabhasi cāśritam,
12.301.20: viṣṇuṁ krānte bale śakraṁ koṣṭhe saktaṁ tathānalam,
12.301.21: tejo vāyau tu saṁsaktaṁ vāyuṁ nabhasi cāśritam,
nabho mahati saṁyuktaṁ mahad buddhau ca saṁśritam ॥21॥
12.301.22: buddhiṁ tamasi saṁsaktāṁ tamo rajasi saṁśritam,
rajaḥ sattve tathā saktaṁ sattvaṁ saktaṁ tathā’’tmani ॥22॥
12.301.23: devaṁ mokṣe ca saṁsaktaṁ mokṣaṁ saktaṁ tu na kvacit ॥23॥
12.301.27: prāṇāpānau samānaṁ ca vyānodānau ca tattvataḥ,
12.301.28: sapta vātāṁstathā jñātvā saptadhā vihitān punaḥ,
12.301.30: mahatāṁ bhūtasaṅghānāṁ śrutvā nāśaṁ ca pārthiva ॥30॥
12.301.31: vaitaraṇyāṁ ca yad duḥkhaṁ patitānāṁ yamakṣaye ॥31॥
12.301.37: tārāṇāṁ patanaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā nakṣatrāṇāṁ ca paryayam,
dvandvānāṁ viprayogaṁ ca vijñāya kr̥paṇaṁ nr̥pa ॥37॥
12.301.38: bālye mohaṁ ca vijñāya kṣayaṁ dehasya cāśubham ॥38॥
12.301.39: rāge mohe ca samprāpte kvacit sattvaṁ samāśritam,
12.301.41: viṣayāṇāṁ ca daurātmyaṁ vijñāya nr̥pate punaḥ,
gatāsūnāṁ ca kaunteya dehān dr̥ṣṭvā tathāśubhān ॥41॥
12.301.42: vāsaṁ kuleṣu jantūnāṁ duḥkhaṁ vijñāya bhārata,
12.301.44: jananīṣu ca vartante ye na samyag yudhiṣṭhira,
sadevakeṣu lokeṣu ye na vartanti mānavāḥ ॥44॥
12.301.46: kṣayaṁ saṁvatsarāṇāṁ ca māsānāṁ ca kṣayaṁ tathā ॥46॥
12.301.47: pakṣakṣayaṁ tathā dr̥ṣṭvā divasānāṁ ca saṅkṣayam,
kṣayaṁ vr̥ddhiṁ ca candrasya dr̥ṣṭvā pratyakṣatastathā ॥47॥
12.301.48: vr̥ddhiṁ dr̥ṣṭvā samudrāṇāṁ kṣayaṁ teṣāṁ tathā punaḥ,
kṣayaṁ dhanānāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā ca punarvr̥ddhiṁ tathaiva ca ॥48॥
12.301.49: saṁyogānāṁ kṣayaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā yugānāṁ ca viśeṣataḥ,
kṣayaṁ ca dr̥ṣṭvā śailānāṁ kṣayaṁ ca saritāṁ tathā ॥49॥
12.301.50: varṇānāṁ ca kṣayaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kṣayāntaṁ ca punaḥ punaḥ,
jarāmr̥tyuṁ tathā janma dr̥ṣṭvā duḥkhāni caiva ha ॥50॥
12.301.51: dehadoṣāṁstathā jñātvā teṣāṁ duḥkhaṁ ca tattvataḥ,
12.301.54: pañca doṣān prabho dehe pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ,
12.301.55: kāmakrodhau bhayaṁ nidrā pañcamaḥ śvāsa ucyate,
12.301.73: tatra tān sukr̥tīn sāṅkhyān sūryo bahati raśmibhiḥ,
12.301.74: tatra tān pravaho vāyuḥ pratigr̥hṇāti bhārata,
12.301.75: sūkṣmaḥ śītaḥ sugandhī ca sukhasparśaśca bhārata,
saptānāṁ marutāṁ śreṣṭho lokān gacchati yaḥ śubhān,
sa tān vahati kaunteya nabhasaḥ paramāṁ gatim ॥75॥
12.301.76: nabho vahati lokeśa rajasaḥ paramāṁ gatim,
rajo vahati rājendra sattvasya paramāṁ gatim ॥76॥
12.301.77: sattvaṁ vahati śuddhātman paraṁ nārāyaṇaṁ prabhum,
12.301.78: amr̥tatvāya kalpante na nivartanti vā vibho ॥78॥
12.301.79: paramā sā gatiḥ pārtha nirdvandvānāṁ mahātmanām,
12.301.80: ājanmamaraṇaṁ vā te smarantyuta na vānagha ॥80॥
12.301.81: yadatra tathyaṁ tanme tvaṁ yathāvad vaktumarhasi,
12.301.82: mokṣe doṣo mahāneṣa prāpya siddhiṁ gatānr̥ṣīn,
yadi tatraiva vijñāne vartante yatayaḥ pare ॥82॥
12.301.83: magnasya hi pare jñāne kiṁ nu duḥkhataraṁ bhavet ॥83॥
12.301.84: yathānyāyaṁ tvayā tāta praśnaḥ pr̥ṣṭaḥ susaṅkaṭaḥ,
12.301.85: atrāpi tattvaṁ paramaṁ śr̥ṇu samyaṅ mayeritam,
12.301.87: vinaśyanti na sandehaḥ phenā iva mahārṇave ॥87॥
12.301.89: sa paśyati yathānyāyaṁ sparśān spr̥śati vā vibho,
12.301.90: indriyāṇīha sarvāṇi sve sve sthāne yathāvidhi,
12.301.92: sattvasya ca guṇān kr̥tsnān rajasaśca guṇān punaḥ,
guṇāṁśca tamasaḥ sarvān guṇān buddheśca bhārata ॥92॥
12.301.95: mano’nu yāti kṣetrajñaṁ karmaṇī ca śubhāśubhe,
śiṣyā iva mahātmānamindriyāṇi ca taṁ prabho ॥95॥
12.301.98: śiṣṭaṁ tatra manastāta indriyāṇi ca bhārata,
12.301.99: śakyaṁ cālpena kālena śāntiṁ prāptuṁ guṇārthinā,
12.301.100: sāṅkhyā rājan mahāprājñā gacchanti paramāṁ gatim,
jñānenānena kaunteya tulyaṁ jñānaṁ na vidyate ॥100॥
12.301.101: atra te saṁśayo mā bhūjjñānaṁ sāṅkhyaṁ paraṁ matam,
12.301.102: kūṭasthaṁ caiva nityaṁ ca yad vadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ॥102॥
12.301.104: sarve viprāśca devāśca tathā śamavido janāḥ,
12.301.113: na vā pradhānā api te dvijātayo
12.301.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi sāṅkhyakathane ekādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥301॥
12.302.5: tvayi pratigate śreyaḥ kutaḥ śroṣyāmahe vayam,
12.302.8: papraccha janako rājā jñānaṁ naiḥśreyasaṁ param ॥8॥
12.302.12: yacca tat kṣaramityuktaṁ yatredaṁ kṣarate jagat,
12.302.25: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṁ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca ॥25॥
12.302.27: śrotraṁ tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā ghrāṇameva ca pañcamam,
vāk ca hastau ca pādau ca pāyurmeḍhrantathaiva ca ॥27॥
12.302.35: ahanyahani bhūtātmā tataḥ kṣara iti smr̥taḥ ॥35॥
12.302.37: kathitaṁ te mahārāja yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi ॥37॥
12.302.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vasiṣṭhakarālajanakasaṁvāde dvyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥302॥
12.303.3: mānuṣatvād divaṁ yāti divo mānuṣyameva ca,
12.303.24: viviktāni ca japyāni vratāni vividhāni ca ॥24॥
12.303.27: sattvaṁ rajastamaścaiva dharmārthau kāma eva ca ॥27॥
12.303.31: prakr̥tiḥ kurute devī bhavaṁ pralayameva ca,
12.303.39: sukhameva tu kartavyaṁ sakr̥t kr̥tvā sukhaṁ mama,
yāvadantaṁ ca me saukhyaṁ jātyāṁ jātyāṁ bhaviṣyati ॥39॥
12.303.40: mahad duḥkhaṁ hi mānuṣyaṁ niraye cāpi majjanam ॥40॥
12.303.42: ya evaṁ vetti nityaṁ vai nirātmā’’tmaguṇairvr̥taḥ ॥42॥
12.303.45: sa evaṁ phalamāpnoti triṣu lokeṣu murtimān,
12.303.46: trīṇi sthānāni caitāni jānīyāt prakr̥tāni ha ॥46॥
12.303.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vasiṣṭhakarālajanakasaṁvāde tryadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥303॥
12.304.4: nityametad vijānīhi somaṁ vai ṣoḍaśīṁ kalām ॥4॥
12.304.6: ṣoḍaśī tu kalā sūkṣmā sa soma upadhāryatām,
12.304.10: aśuddha eva śuddhātmā tādr̥g bhavati pārthiva,
12.304.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vasiṣṭhakarālajanakasaṁvāde caturadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥304॥
12.305.2: r̥te tu puruṣaṁ neha strī garbhaṁ dhārayatyuta,
r̥te striyaṁ na puruṣo rūpaṁ nirvarta yet tathā ॥2॥
12.305.4: r̥tau nirvartyate rūpaṁ tad vakṣyāmi nidarśanam ॥4॥
12.305.5: ye guṇāḥ puruṣasyeha ye ca mātr̥guṇāstathā,
asthi snāyuśca majjā ca jānīmaḥ pitr̥to guṇāḥ ॥5॥
12.305.6: evametad dvijaśreṣṭha vede śāstre ca paṭhyate ॥6॥
12.305.7: pramāṇaṁ yat svavedoktaṁ śāstroktaṁ yacca paṭhyate,
12.305.12: na ca granthasya tattvajño yathātattvaṁ nareśvara ॥12॥
12.305.13: yo hi vede ca śāstre ca granthadhāraṇatatparaḥ,
12.305.14: bhāraṁ sa vahate tasya granthasyārthaṁ na vetti yaḥ,
12.305.16: na yaḥ saṁsatsu kathayed granthārthaṁ sthūlabuddhimān,
sa kathaṁ mandavijñāno granthaṁ vakṣyati nirṇayāt ॥16॥
12.305.17: nirṇayaṁ cāpi chidrātmā na taṁ vakṣyati tattvataḥ,
12.305.19: ekaṁ sāṅkhyaṁ ca yogaṁ ca yaḥ paśyati sa buddhimān ॥19॥
12.305.20: tvaṅmāṁsaṁ rudhiraṁ medaḥ pittaṁ majjā ca snāyu ca,
atha caindriyakaṁ tāta tad bhavānidamāha mām ॥20॥
12.305.21: dehād dehamavāpnoti bījād bījaṁ tathaiva ca ॥21॥
12.305.23: guṇā guṇeṣu jāyante tatraiva niviśanti ca,
evaṁ guṇāḥ prakr̥tito jāyante niviśanti ca ॥23॥
12.305.24: tvaṅmāṁsaṁ rudhira medaḥ pittaṁ majjāsthi snāyu ca,
aṣṭau tānyatha śukreṇa jānīhi prākr̥tāni vai ॥24॥
12.305.29: guṇā guṇavataḥ santi nirguṇasya kuto guṇāḥ,
12.305.31: yat tad buddheḥ paraṁ prāhuḥ sāṅkhyā yogāśca sarvaśaḥ,
12.305.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vasiṣṭhakarālajanakasaṁvāde pañcādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥305॥
12.306.4: buddhaṁ cāpratibuddhaṁ ca budhyamānaṁ ca tattvataḥ ॥4॥
12.306.5: sāṅkhyaṁ yogaṁ ca kārtsnyena pr̥thak caivāpr̥thak ca ha ॥5॥
12.306.7: yogakr̥tyaṁ tu yogānāṁ dhyānameva paraṁ balam,
12.306.11: tiṣṭhantamajaraṁ taṁ tu yat taduktaṁ manīṣibhiḥ ॥11॥
12.306.14: mano buddhyā sthiraṁ kr̥tvā pāṣāṇa iva niścalaḥ ॥14॥
12.306.16: na śr̥ṇoti na cāghrāti na raṁsyati na paśyati,
na ca sparśaṁ vijānāti na saṅkalpayate manaḥ ॥16॥
12.306.17: na cābhimanyate kiñcinna ca budhyati kāṣṭhavat,
12.306.18: nirvāte hi yathā dīpyan dīpastadvat prakāśate,
12.306.19: tadā tamanupaśyeta yasmin dr̥ṣṭe na kathyate,
12.306.22: tat tattvaṁ sarvabhūteṣu dhruvaṁ tiṣṭhan na dr̥śyate ॥22॥
12.306.25: yoga eṣa hi yogānāṁ kimanyad yogalakṣaṇam,
12.306.29: pañca caiva viśeṣā vai tathā pañcendriyāṇi ca ॥29॥
12.306.33: ekatvaṁ pralaye cāsya bahutvaṁ ca yadāsr̥jat ॥33॥
12.306.35: ekatvaṁ pralaye cāsya bahutvaṁ ca pravartanāt ॥35॥
12.306.38: kṣetraṁ jānāti cāvyaktaṁ kṣetrajña iti cocyate,
12.306.39: anyadeva ca kṣetraṁ syādanyaḥ kṣetrajña ucyate,
12.306.42: sāṅkhyāḥ prakurvate caiva prakr̥tiṁ ca pracakṣate ॥42॥
12.306.43: sāṅkhyāḥ saha prakr̥tyā tu nistattvaḥ pañcaviṁśakaḥ ॥43॥
12.306.44: yadā tu budhyate’’tmānaṁ tadā bhavati kevalaḥ ॥44॥
12.306.50: ya enamabhijānanti na bhayaṁ teṣu vidyate ॥50॥
12.306.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vasiṣṭhakarālajanakasaṁvāde ṣaḍadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥306॥
12.307.4: buddhīndriyāṇāṁ ca tathā viśeṣā iti naḥ śrutam ॥4॥
12.307.7: vidyā jñeyā naraśreṣṭha vidhiśca paramaḥ smr̥taḥ ॥7॥
12.307.10: akṣaraṁ ca kṣaraṁ caiva yaduktaṁ tannibodha me ॥10॥
12.307.11: kāraṇaṁ tu pravakṣyāmi yāthātathyaṁ tu jñānataḥ ॥11॥
12.307.21: tadaiṣa tattvatāmeti na cāpi miśratāṁ vrajet,
prakr̥tyā caiva rājendra miśro hyanyaśca dr̥śyate ॥21॥
12.307.22: yadā tu guṇajālaṁ tat prākr̥taṁ vai jugupsate,
paśyate ca paraṁ paśyaṁ tadā paśyanna santyajet ॥22॥
12.307.23: kiṁ mayā kr̥tametāvad yo’haṁ kālamimaṁ janam,
12.307.27: ayamatra bhaved bandhuranena saha me kṣamam,
12.307.35: prāk kr̥tena mamatvena tāsu tāsviha yoniṣu,
nirmamasya mamatvena kiṁ kr̥taṁ tāsu tāsu ca ॥35॥
12.307.37: ātmānaṁ bahudhā kr̥tvā yeyaṁ bhūyo yunakti mām,
12.307.41: nirguṇaṁ prathamaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tādr̥g bhavati maithila ॥41॥
12.307.43: niḥsandigdhaṁ ca sūkṣmaṁ ca vibuddhaṁ vimalaṁ yathā,
12.307.47: pañcaviṁśāt paraṁ tattvaṁ paṭhyate na narādhipa,
12.307.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vasiṣṭhakarālajanakasaṁvāde saptādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥307॥
12.308.4: na tveva budhyate’vyaktaṁ saguṇaṁ tāta nirguṇam,
12.308.7: sa tu taṁ pañcaviṁśaṁ ca caturviṁśaṁ ca budhyate ॥7॥
12.308.8: avyaktamatra tad brahma budhyate tāta kevalam ॥8॥
12.308.9: kevalaṁ pañcaviṁśaṁ ca caturviṁśaṁ na paśyati,
12.308.10: budhyate ca parāṁ buddhiṁ viśuddhāmamalāṁ yadā ॥10॥
12.308.15: eṣa muñcati tattvaṁ hi kṣipraṁ buddhasya lakṣaṇam ॥15॥
12.308.18: ekatvaṁ vai bhavatyasya yadā buddhyā na budhyate ॥18॥
12.308.26: pareṇa paradharmā ca bhavatyeṣa sametya vai ॥26॥
12.308.27: viśuddhadharmā śuddhena buddhena ca sa buddhimān,
12.308.30: kevalātmā tathā caiva kevalena sametya vai,
12.308.33: deyaṁ tu deyaṁ ca nibodha yādr̥śe ॥33॥
12.308.35: dame ca śaktāya śame ca deyam ॥35॥
12.308.46: mā śucaḥ kauravendra tvaṁ śrutvaitat paramaṁ padam ॥46॥
12.308.47: yena kṣarākṣare vitte bhayaṁ tasya na vidyate,
vidyate tu bhayaṁ tasya yo naitad vetti pārthiva ॥47॥
12.308.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi vasiṣṭhakarālajanakasaṁvādasamāptau aṣṭādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥308॥
12.309.3: bhagavan kimidaṁ śreyaḥ pretya cāpīha vā bhavet,
12.309.6: dharmaḥ satāṁ hitaḥ puṁsāṁ dharmaścaivāśrayaḥ satām,
12.309.7: svādukāmuka kāmānāṁ vaitr̥ṣṇyaṁ kiṁ na gacchasi,
12.309.9: satā tu dharmakāmena sukaraṁ karma duṣkaram ॥9॥
12.309.11: nivr̥ttau vā pravr̥ttau vā sampradhārya guṇāguṇān ॥11॥
12.309.16: sa eva dharmaḥ so’dharmastaṁ taṁ prati naraṁ bhavet,
12.309.17: līlayālpaṁ yathā gātrāt pramr̥jyāt tu rajaḥ pumān,
12.309.18: viriktasya yathā samyag ghr̥taṁ bhavati bheṣajam,
12.309.20: sarvaṁ sarveṇa sarvatra kriyamāṇaṁ ca pūjaya,
svadharme yatra rāgaste kāmaṁ dharmo vidhīyatām ॥20॥
12.309.21: adhr̥tātman dhr̥tau tiṣṭha durbuddhe buddhimān bhava,
12.309.22: iha ca pretya ca śreyastasya mūlaṁ dhr̥tiḥ parā ॥22॥
12.309.25: vinivartya manaḥ kāmād dharme buddhiṁ cakāra ha ॥25॥
12.309.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi janakānuśāsane navādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥309॥
12.310.4: papraccha janako rājā praśnaṁ praśnavidāṁ varam ॥4॥
12.310.5: kimavyaktaṁ paraṁ brahma tasmācca paratastu kim ॥5॥
12.310.6: prabhavaṁ cāpyayaṁ caiva kālasaṅkhyāṁ tathaiva ca,
12.310.7: ajñānāt paripr̥cchāmi tvaṁ hi jñānamayo nidhiḥ,
12.310.8: yogānāṁ paramaṁ jñānaṁ sāṅkhyānāṁ ca viśeṣataḥ ॥8॥
12.310.9: na tavāviditaṁ kiñcinmāṁ tu jijñāsate bhavān,
12.310.11: avyaktaṁ ca mahāntaṁ ca tathāhaṅkāra eva ca,
12.310.12: śrotraṁ tvakcaiva cakṣuśca jihvā ghrāṇaṁ ca pañcamam ॥12॥
12.310.13: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṁ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca,
vāk ca hastau ca pādau ca pāyurmeḍhraṁ tathaiva ca ॥13॥
12.310.20: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṁ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca,
12.310.21: śrotraṁ tvak caiva cakṣuśca jihvā ghrāṇaṁ ca pañcamam,
12.310.25: etāni nava sargāṇi tattvāni ca narādhipa,
12.310.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi yājñavalkyajanakasaṁvāde daśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥310॥
12.311.4: sandadhe sa mahīṁ kr̥tsnāṁ divamūrdhvaṁ prajāpatiḥ ॥4॥
12.311.8: te vai pitr̥̄ṇāṁ pitaraḥ śrūyante rājasattama ॥8॥
12.311.9: devāḥ pitr̥̄ṇāṁ ca sutā devairlokāḥ samāvr̥tāḥ,
12.311.12: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṁ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca,
12.311.17: cakṣuḥ paśyati rūpāṇi manasā tu na cakṣuṣā ॥17॥
12.311.18: manasi vyākule cakṣuḥ paśyannapi na paśyati,
12.311.19: na cendriyāṇi paśyanti mana evātra paśyati,
12.311.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi yājñavalkyajanakasaṁvāde ekādaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥311॥
12.312.1: tattvānāṁ sarvasaṅkhyā ca kālasaṅkhyā tathaiva ca,
12.312.2: yathā saṁharate jantūn sasarja ca punaḥ punaḥ,
12.312.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi yājñavalkyajanakasaṁvāde dvādaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥312॥
12.313.14: ādau madhye tathānte ca yathātattvena tattvavit ॥14॥
12.313.23: bhedaḥ paruṣatā caiva kāmaḥ krodho madastathā ॥23॥
12.313.27: divāsvapne’tivāde ca pramādeṣu ca vai ratiḥ ॥27॥
12.313.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi yājñavalkyajanakasaṁvāde trayodaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥313॥
12.314.5: dvandvameṣāṁ trayāṇāṁ tu saṁnipātaṁ ca tattvataḥ ॥5॥
12.314.6: sattvasya tu rajo dr̥ṣṭaṁ rajasaśca tamastathā ॥6॥
12.314.9: śāśvataṁ cāvyayaṁ caivamakṣayaṁ cāmr̥taṁ ca tat ॥9॥
12.314.11: avyaktasthaṁ paraṁ yat tat pr̥ṣṭaste’haṁ narādhipa,
sa eṣa prakr̥tistho hi tatstha ityabhidhīyate ॥11॥
12.314.16: astitvaṁ kevalatvaṁ ca vinābhāvaṁ tathaiva ca,
daivatāni ca me brūhi dehaṁ yānyāśritāni vai ॥16॥
12.314.17: kālena yaddhi prāpnoti sthānaṁ tat prabravīhi me ॥17॥
12.314.18: sāṅkhyajñānaṁ ca tattvena pr̥thagyogaṁ tathaiva ca,
12.314.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi yājñavalkyajanakasaṁvāde caturdaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥314॥
12.315.3: upayuṅkte ca tāneva sa caivājñaḥ svabhāvataḥ ॥3॥
12.315.4: avyaktastu na jānīte puruṣo jñaḥ svabhāvataḥ,
12.315.6: yadā’’tmānaṁ na jānīte tadā’’tmāpi na mucyate ॥6॥
12.315.14: na codakasya sparśena matsyo lipyati sarvaśaḥ ॥14॥
12.315.16: na codakasya sparśena lipyate tatra puṣkaram ॥16॥
12.315.17: eteṣāṁ sahavāsaṁ ca nivāsaṁ caiva nityaśaḥ,
yāthātathyena paśyanti na nityaṁ prākr̥tā janāḥ ॥17॥
12.315.18: ye tvanyathaiva paśyanti na samyak teṣu darśanam,
te vyaktaṁ nirayaṁ ghoraṁ praviśanti punaḥ punaḥ ॥18॥
12.315.19: evaṁ hi parisaṅkhyāya sāṅkhyāḥ kevalatāṁ gatāḥ ॥19॥
12.315.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi yājñavalkyajanakasaṁvāde pañcadaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥315॥
12.316.1: sāṅkhyajñānaṁ mayā proktaṁ yogajñānaṁ nibodha me,
12.316.2: nāsti sāṅkhyasamaṁ jñānaṁ nāsti yogasamaṁ balam,
12.316.3: vayaṁ tu rājan paśyāma ekameva tu niścayāt ॥3॥
12.316.4: yadeva yogāḥ paśyanti tat sāṅkhyairapi dr̥śyate,
ekaṁ sāṅkhyaṁ ca yogaṁ ca yaḥ paśyati sa tattvavit ॥4॥
12.316.5: tenaiva cātha dehena vicaranti diśo daśa ॥5॥
12.316.6: yogena lokān vicaran sukhaṁ saṁnyasya cānagha ॥6॥
12.316.10: vātādhikyaṁ bhavatyeva tasmāt taṁ na samācaret ॥10॥
12.316.11: niśāyāḥ prathame yāme codanā dvādaśa smr̥tāḥ,
madhye svapnāt pare yāme dvādaśaiva tu codanāḥ ॥11॥
12.316.13: śabdaṁ rūpaṁ tathā sparśaṁ rasaṁ gandhaṁ tathaiva ca ॥13॥
12.316.15: ahaṅkāraṁ tathā buddhau buddhiṁ ca prakr̥tāvapi ॥15॥
12.316.16: evaṁ hi parisaṅkhyāya tato dhyāyanti kevalam,
12.316.17: śāśvataṁ cāvyayaṁ caiva īśānaṁ brahma cāvyayam ॥17॥
12.316.18: lakṣaṇaṁ tu prasādasya yathā tr̥ptaḥ sukhaṁ svapet ॥18॥
12.316.19: nirvāte tu yathā dīpo jvalet snehasamanvitaḥ,
12.316.22: tailapātraṁ yathā pūrṇaṁ karābhyāṁ gr̥hya pūruṣaḥ,
12.316.23: saṁyatātmā bhayāt teṣāṁ na pātrād bindumutsr̥jet,
12.316.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi yājñavalkyajanakasaṁvāde ṣoḍaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥316॥
12.317.2: jaṅghābhyāṁ tu vasūn devānāpnuyāditi naḥ śrutam,
12.317.10: paracakṣuṣi cātmānaṁ ye na paśyanti pārthiva ॥10॥
12.317.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi yājñavalkyajanakasaṁvāde saptadaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥317॥
12.318.1: avyaktasthaṁ paraṁ yat tat pr̥ṣṭaste’haṁ narādhipa,
12.318.4: varaṁ vr̥ṇīṣva viprarṣe yadiṣṭaṁ te sudurlabham,
tat te dāsyāmi prītātmā matprasādo hi durlabhaḥ ॥4॥
12.318.6: tato māṁ bhagavānāha vitariṣyāmi te dvija,
12.318.7: tato māmāha bhagavānāsyaṁ svaṁ vivr̥taṁ kuru,
vivr̥taṁ ca tato me’’syaṁ praviṣṭā ca sarasvatī ॥7॥
12.318.10: śītībhūtaṁ ca māṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bhagavānāha bhāskaraḥ,
pratiṣṭhāsyati te vedaḥ sakhilaḥ sottaro dvija ॥10॥
12.318.12: prāpsyase ca yadiṣṭaṁ tat sāṅkhyayogepsitaṁ padam,
12.318.16: cakre sapariśeṣaṁ ca harṣeṇa parameṇa ha ॥16॥
12.318.20: sumantunātha pailena tathā jaimininā ca vai,
12.318.23: kartuṁ śatapathaṁ cedamapūrvaṁ ca kr̥taṁ mayā,
12.318.24: sarve ca śiṣyāḥ śucayo gatāḥ paramaharṣitāḥ ॥24॥
12.318.29: jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ tathā jño’jñaḥ kastapā atapāstathā,
sūryāti sūrya iti ca vidyāvidye tathaiva ca ॥29॥
12.318.32: bāḍhamityeva kr̥tvā ca tūṣṇīṁ gandharva āsthitaḥ ॥32॥
12.318.33: manasā sa ca me praśno dadhno ghr̥tamivoddhr̥tam ॥33॥
12.318.34: mathnāmi manasā tāta dr̥ṣṭvā cānvīkṣikīṁ parām ॥34॥
12.318.39: avyaktaṁ prakr̥tiṁ prāhuḥ puruṣeti ca nirguṇam,
tathaiva mitraṁ puruṣaṁ varuṇaṁ prakr̥tiṁ tathā ॥39॥
12.318.40: jñānaṁ tu prakr̥tiṁ prāhurjñeyaṁ niṣkalameva ca,
12.318.41: kastapā atapāḥ proktaḥ ko’sau puruṣa ucyate,
12.318.42: calācalamiti proktaṁ tvayā tadapi me śr̥ṇu ॥42॥
12.318.43: calāṁ tu prakr̥tiṁ prāhuḥ kāraṇaṁ kṣayasargayoḥ,
12.318.46: akṣayaṁ puruṣaṁ prāhuḥ kṣayo hyasya na vidyate ॥46॥
12.318.49: jāyante ca mriyante ca yasminnete yataścyutāḥ,
vedārthaṁ ye na jānanti vedyaṁ gandharvasattama ॥49॥
12.318.50: vedavedyaṁ na jānīte vedabhāravaho hi saḥ ॥50॥
12.318.51: viṣṭhāṁ tatrānupaśyeta na maṇḍaṁ na ca vai ghr̥tam ॥51॥
12.318.52: tathā vedyamavedyaṁ ca vedavidyo na vindati,
12.318.53: tathāsya janmanidhane na bhavetāṁ punaḥ punaḥ ॥53॥
12.318.58: tathā tanna tathā ceti tad bhavān vaktumarhati ॥58॥
12.318.64: tasmāt tad vai bhavadbuddhyā śrotumicchāmi brāhmaṇa,
12.318.65: na tavāviditaṁ kiñcid bhavān śrutinidhiḥ smr̥taḥ,
kathyate devaloke ca pitr̥loke ca brāhmaṇa ॥65॥
12.318.70: na tu budhyati gandharva prakr̥tiḥ pañcaviṁśakam ॥70॥
12.318.72: ṣaḍviṁśaṁ pañcaviṁśaṁ ca caturviṁśaṁ ca paśyati ॥72॥
12.318.76: sa nimajjati kālasya yadaikatvaṁ na budhyate,
12.318.77: yadā tu manyate’nyo’hamanya eṣa iti dvijaḥ,
12.318.80: tadā sa sarvavid vidvān na punarjanma vindati ॥80॥
12.318.82: paśyāpaśyaṁ yo na paśyet kṣemyaṁ tattvaṁ ca kāśyapa,
kevalākevalaṁ cādyaṁ pañcaviṁśaṁ paraṁ ca yat ॥82॥
12.318.85: samyak kṣemyaṁ ye pathaṁ saṁśritā vai ॥85॥
12.318.93: samyak proktaṁ svasti te tvastu nityam ॥93॥
12.318.95: gate munivare tasmin kr̥te cāpi pradakṣiṇam,
12.318.96: gokoṭiṁ sparśayāmāsa hiraṇyaṁ tu tathaiva ca,
12.318.97: videharājyaṁ ca tadā pratiṣṭhāpya sutasya vai,
12.318.99: ananta iti kr̥tvā sa nityaṁ kevalameva ca,
12.318.103: dadāti ca naraśreṣṭha pratigr̥hṇāti yacca ha,
12.318.105: yasyāvyaktaṁ na viditaṁ saguṇaṁ nirguṇaṁ punaḥ,
12.318.108: ye tvavyaktāt paraṁ nityaṁ jānate śāstratatparāḥ,
12.318.109: jñānaṁ viśiṣṭaṁ na tathā hi yajñā
12.318.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi yājñavalkyajanakasaṁvādasamāptau aṣṭādaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥318॥
12.319.1: aiśvaryaṁ vā mahat prāpya dhanaṁ vā bharatarṣabha,
12.319.2: tapasā vā sumahatā karmaṇā vā śrutena vā,
12.319.5: tapasā vātha buddhyā vā karmaṇā vā śrutena vā ॥5॥
12.319.7: na hyahāni nivartante na māsā na punaḥ kṣapāḥ,
12.319.9: naivāsya kaścid bhavati nāsau bhavati kasyacit ॥9॥
12.319.11: kṣipyante tena tenaiva niṣṭanantaḥ punaḥ punaḥ,
12.319.13: kathaṁ hi hr̥ṣyejjāteṣu mr̥teṣu ca kathaṁ jvaret ॥13॥
12.319.14: kuto’hamāgataḥ ko’smi kva gamiṣyāmi kasya vā,
12.319.15: draṣṭā svargasya ko’nyo’sti tathaiva narakasya ca,
12.319.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi pañcaśikhajanakasaṁvāde ekonaviṁśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥319॥
12.320.1: kaḥ prāpto vinayaṁ buddhyā mokṣatattvaṁ vadasva me ॥1॥
12.320.2: saṁnyasyate yathā’’tmāyaṁ vyaktasyātmā yathā ca yat,
paraṁ mokṣasya yaccāpi tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥2॥
12.320.4: maithilo janako nāma dharmadhvaja iti śrutaḥ ॥4॥
12.320.5: sa vede mokṣaśāstre ca sve ca śāstre kr̥taśramaḥ,
