12.320.6: tasya vedavidaḥ prājñāḥ śrutvā tāṁ sādhuvr̥ttatām,
12.320.9: sātisūkṣmāṁ kathāṁ śrutvā tathyaṁ neti sasaṁśayā,
12.320.10: tatra sā viprahāyātha pūrvarūpaṁ hi yogataḥ,
12.320.13: rājā tasyāḥ paraṁ dr̥ṣṭvā saukumāryaṁ vapustadā,
12.320.14: tato’syāḥ svāgataṁ kr̥tvā vyādiśya ca varāsanam,
12.320.16: sulabhā tvasya dharmeṣu mukto neti sasaṁśayā,
12.320.17: sā sma taṁ codayiṣyantī yogabandhairbabandha ha ॥17॥
12.320.20: bhagavatyāḥ kva caryeyaṁ kr̥tā kva ca gamiṣyasi,
kasya ca tvaṁ kuto veti papracchaināṁ mahīpatiḥ ॥20॥
12.320.21: śrute vayasi jātau ca sadbhāvo nādhigamyate,
12.320.22: chatrādiṣu viśeṣeṣu muktaṁ māṁ viddhi tattvataḥ,
sa tvāṁ sammantumicchāmi mānārhā hi matāsi me ॥22॥
12.320.23: yasya nānyaḥ pravaktāsti mokṣaṁ tamapi me śr̥ṇu ॥23॥
12.320.25: sāṅkhyajñāne ca yoge ca mahīpālavidhau tathā,
12.320.27: śrāvitastrividhaṁ mokṣaṁ na ca rājyāddhi cālitaḥ ॥27॥
12.320.29: jñānādeva ca vairāgyaṁ jāyate yena mucyate ॥29॥
12.320.30: jñānena kurute yatnaṁ yatnena prāpyate mahat,
12.320.31: seyaṁ paramikā buddheḥ prāptā nirdvandvatā mayā,
12.320.33: yathā cottāpitaṁ bījaṁ kapāle yatra tatra vā,
12.320.34: jñānaṁ kr̥tamabījaṁ me viṣayeṣu na jāyate ॥34॥
12.320.36: yaśca me dakṣiṇaṁ bāhuṁ candanena samukṣayet,
12.320.41: yame ca niyame caiva kāme dveṣe parigrahe,
māne dambhe tathā snehe sadr̥śāste kuṭumbibhiḥ ॥41॥
12.320.42: chatrādiṣu kathaṁ na syāt tulyahetau parigrahe ॥42॥
12.320.43: yena yena hi yasyārthaḥ kāraṇeneha karmaṇi,
12.320.49: athavā duḥkhaśaithilyaṁ vīkṣya liṅge kr̥tā matiḥ,
12.320.50: ākiñcanye na mokṣo’sti kiñcanye nāsti bandhanam,
12.320.53: ayathārthaṁ hi te varṇaṁ vakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu tanmama ॥53॥
12.320.54: saukumāryaṁ tathā rūpaṁ vapuragyraṁ tathā vayaḥ,
12.320.55: mukto’yaṁ syānna veti syād dharṣito matparigrahaḥ ॥55॥
12.320.56: na rakṣyate tvayā cedaṁ na muktasyāsti gopanā ॥56॥
12.320.58: praveśaste kr̥taḥ kena mama rāṣṭre pure’pi vā,
kasya vā saṁnikarṣāt tvaṁ praviṣṭā hr̥dayaṁ mama ॥58॥
12.320.61: sagotrāṁ vāsagotrāṁ vā na veda tvāṁ na vettha mām,
12.320.62: atha jīvati te bhartā proṣito’pyathavā kvacit,
12.320.63: avijñānena vā yuktā mithyājñānena vā punaḥ ॥63॥
12.320.70: kr̥teyaṁ hi vijijñāsā mukto neti tvayā mama,
etat sarvaṁ praticchannaṁ mayi nārhasi gūhitum ॥70॥
12.320.71: sā yadi tvaṁ svakāryeṇa yadyanyasya mahīpateḥ,
tat tvaṁ satrapraticchannā mayi nārhasi gūhitum ॥71॥
12.320.72: na rājānaṁ mr̥ṣā gacchenna dvijātiṁ kathañcana,
na striyaṁ strīguṇopetāṁ hanyurhyete mr̥ṣā gatāḥ ॥72॥
12.320.73: rājñāṁ hi balamaiśvaryaṁ brahma brahmavidāṁ balam,
12.320.75: sā tvaṁ jātiṁ śrutaṁ vr̥ttaṁ bhāvaṁ prakr̥timātmanaḥ,
12.320.81: jñānaṁ jñeyeṣu bhinneṣu yadā bhedena vartate,
12.320.82: doṣāṇāṁ ca guṇānāṁ ca pramāṇaṁ pravibhāgataḥ,
12.320.83: idaṁ pūrvamidaṁ paścād vaktavyaṁ yad vivakṣitam,
12.320.84: idaṁ taditi vākyānte procyate sa vinirṇayaḥ ॥84॥
12.320.87: nāślakṣṇaṁ na ca sandigdhaṁ vakṣyāmi paramaṁ tataḥ ॥87॥
12.320.89: na nyūnaṁ kaṣṭaśabdaṁ vā vikramābhihitaṁ na ca,
12.320.91: vaktā śrotā ca vākyaṁ ca yadā tvavikalaṁ nr̥pa,
12.320.92: vaktavye tu yadā vaktā śrotāramavamanya vai,
svārthamāha parārthaṁ tat tadā vākyaṁ na rohati ॥92॥
12.320.93: atha yaḥ svārthamutsr̥jya parārthaṁ prāha mānavaḥ,
viśaṅkā jāyate tasmin vākyaṁ tadapi doṣavat ॥93॥
12.320.97: yathā jatu ca kāṣṭhaṁ ca pāṁsavaścodabindavaḥ,
12.320.98: śabdaḥ sparśo raso rūpaṁ gandhaḥ pañcendriyāṇi ca,
12.320.100: na veda cakṣuścakṣuṣṭvaṁ śrotraṁ nātmani vartate,
12.320.101: praśliṣṭaṁ ca na jānanti yathā’’pa iva pāṁsavaḥ,
12.320.105: atha dvādaśake tasmin sattvaṁ nāmāparo guṇaḥ,
12.320.106: mamāyamiti yenāyaṁ manyate na mameti ca ॥106॥
12.320.112: ityevaṁ viṁśakaścaiva guṇāḥ sapta ca ye smr̥tāḥ,
vidhiḥ śukraṁ balaṁ ceti traya ete guṇāḥ pare ॥112॥
12.320.113: viṁśatirdaśa caivaṁ hi guṇāḥ saṅkhyānataḥ smr̥tāḥ,
12.320.114: vyaktaṁ cāsāṁ tathā cānyaḥ sthūladarśī prapaśyati ॥114॥
12.320.115: avyaktaṁ yadi vā vyaktaṁ dvayīmatha catuṣṭayīm,
12.320.116: ahaṁ ca tvaṁ ca rājendra ye cāpyanye śarīriṇaḥ ॥116॥
12.320.118: kalalād budbudotpattiḥ peśī ca budbudāt smr̥tā,
12.320.119: jāyate nāmarūpatvaṁ strī pumān veti liṅgataḥ ॥119॥
12.320.121: kaumārād yauvanaṁ cāpi sthāvīryaṁ cāpi yauvanāt,
anena kramayogena pūrvaṁ pūrvaṁ na labhyate ॥121॥
12.320.122: vartate sarvabhūteṣu saukṣmyāt tu na vibhāvyate ॥122॥
12.320.123: na caiṣāmatyayo rājan lakṣyate prabhavo na ca,
12.320.124: ajasraṁ sarvalokasya kaḥ kuto vā na vā kutaḥ ॥124॥
12.320.125: kasyedaṁ kasya vā nedaṁ kuto vedaṁ na vā kutaḥ,
12.320.129: idaṁ me syādidaṁ neti dvandvairmuktasya maithila,
kāsi kasya kuto veti vacanaiḥ kiṁ prayojanam ॥129॥
12.320.130: kr̥tavān yo mahīpālaḥ kiṁ tasmin muktalakṣaṇam ॥130॥
12.320.131: trivargaṁ saptadhā vyaktaṁ yo na vedeha karmasu,
12.320.132: yasya nāsti samaṁ cakṣuḥ kiṁ tasmin muktalakṣaṇam ॥132॥
12.320.136: ya imāṁ pr̥thivīṁ kr̥tsnāmekacchatrāṁ praśāsti ha,
eka eva sa vai rājā puramadhyāvasatyuta ॥136॥
12.320.142: avaśaḥ kārya te tatra tasmiṁstasmin kṣaṇe sthitaḥ ॥142॥
12.320.144: bravīhi śr̥ṇu cāpīti vivaśaḥ kāryate paraiḥ ॥144॥
12.320.148: tathā caite praduṣyanti rājan ye kīrtitā mayā,
tathaivāsya bhayaṁ tebhyo jāyate paśya yādr̥śam ॥148॥
12.320.149: sarvaḥ sve sve gr̥he rājā sarvaḥ sve sve gr̥he gr̥hī,
12.320.151: hato deśaḥ puraṁ dagdhaṁ pradhānaḥ kuñjaro mr̥taḥ,
12.320.155: mamedamiti yaccedaṁ puraṁ rāṣṭraṁ ca manyase ॥155॥
12.320.156: balaṁ kośamamātyāṁśca kasyaitāni na vā nr̥pa,
12.320.158: teṣu teṣu hi kāleṣu tattadaṅgaṁ viśiṣyate,
yena yat sidhyate kāryaṁ tat prādhānyāya kalpate ॥158॥
12.320.159: sambhūya daśavargo’yaṁ bhuṅkte rājyaṁ hi rājavat ॥159॥
12.320.160: yaśca rājā mahotsāhaḥ kṣatradharme rato bhavet,
12.320.161: rājye’sati kuto dharmo dharme’sati kutaḥ param ॥161॥
12.320.165: nanu nāma tvayā mokṣaḥ kr̥tsnaḥ pañcaśikhācchrutaḥ,
12.320.166: chatrādiṣu viśeṣeṣu punaḥ saṅgaḥ kathaṁ nr̥pa ॥166॥
12.320.167: śrutaṁ te na śrutaṁ manye mr̥ṣā vāpi śrutaṁ śrutam,
12.320.169: sattvenānupraveśo hi yo’yaṁ tvayi kr̥to mayā,
kiṁ tavāpakr̥taṁ tatra yadi mukto’si sarvaśaḥ ॥169॥
12.320.170: śūnyamāveśayantyā ca mayā kiṁ kasya dūṣitam ॥170॥
12.320.171: na pāṇibhyāṁ na bāhubhyāṁ pādorubhyāṁ na cānagha,
12.320.174: strīpuṁsoḥ samavāyo’yaṁ tvayā vācyo na saṁsadi ॥174॥
12.320.176: yadi vāpyaspr̥śantyā me sparśaṁ jānāsi kañcana,
jñānaṁ kr̥tamabījaṁ te kathaṁ teneha bhikṣuṇā ॥176॥
12.320.177: sa gārhasthyāccyutaśca tvaṁ mokṣaṁ cānāpya durvidam,
12.320.180: pāṇau kuṇḍaṁ tathā kuṇḍe payaḥ payasi makṣikā,
12.320.181: na tu kuṇḍe payobhāvaḥ payaścāpi na makṣikā,
12.320.183: nāsmi varṇottamā jātyā na vaiśyā nāvarā tathā,
12.320.184: kule tasya samutpannāṁ sulabhāṁ nāma viddhi mām ॥184॥
12.320.185: mama satreṣu pūrveṣāṁ citā maghavatā saha ॥185॥
12.320.186: sāhaṁ tasmin kule jātā bhartaryasati madvidhe,
12.320.189: mokṣe te bhāvitāṁ buddhiṁ śrutvāhaṁ kuśalaiṣiṇī,
12.320.190: mukto vyāyacchate yaśca śāntau yaśca na śāmyāti ॥190॥
12.320.191: yathā śūnye purāgāre bhikṣurekāṁ niśāṁ vaset,
12.320.192: suptā suśaraṇaṁ prītā śvo gamiṣyāmi maithila ॥192॥
12.320.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi sulabhājanakasaṁvāde viṁśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥320॥
12.321.1: etadicchāmyahaṁ śrotuṁ paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me ॥1॥
12.321.3: adhyāpya kr̥tsnaṁ svādhyāyamanvaśād vai pitā sutam ॥3॥
12.321.4: dharmaṁ putra niṣevasva sutīkṣṇau ca himātapau,
kṣutpipāse ca vāyuṁ ca jaya nityaṁ jitendriyaḥ ॥4॥
12.321.6: satye tiṣṭha rato dharme hitvā sarvamanārjavam,
12.321.9: jīvite likhyamāne ca kimutthāya na dhāvasi ॥9॥
12.321.12: ye tu tuṣṭāḥ śrutiparā mahātmāno mahābalāḥ,
12.321.14: ādyakālikayā buddhyā dūre śva iti nirbhayāḥ,
12.321.17: kāmaṁ krodhaṁ ca mr̥tyuṁ ca pañcendriyajalāṁ nadīm,
12.321.19: tiṣṭhantaṁ ca śayānaṁ ca mr̥tyuranveṣate yadā,
12.321.23: brāhmaṇasya tu deho’yaṁ na kāmārthāya jāyate,
iha kleśāya tapase pretya tvanupamaṁ sukham ॥23॥
12.321.26: dharme te bhavatu manaḥ paraṁ niśāmya ॥26॥
12.321.36: taveha jīvitaṁ yamo na cāsti tasya vārakaḥ ॥36॥
12.321.38: purā sa hi kva eva te pravāti māruto’ntakaḥ,
purā ca vibhramanti te diśo mahābhayāgame ॥38॥
12.321.40: smaran purā na tapyase nidhatsva kevalaṁ nidhim ॥40॥
12.321.46: dhanasya yasya rājato bhayaṁ na cāsti corataḥ,
mr̥taṁ ca yanna muñcati samarjayasva tad dhanam ॥46॥
12.321.47: yadeva yasya yautakaṁ tadeva tatra so’śnute ॥47॥
12.321.48: paratra yena jīvyate tadeva putra dīyatām,
dhanaṁ yadakṣaraṁ dhruvaṁ samarjayasva tat svayam ॥48॥
12.321.49: apakva eva yāvake purā pralīyase tvara ॥49॥
12.321.50: na mātr̥putrabāndhavā na saṁstutaḥ priyo janaḥ,
12.321.51: yadeva karma kevalaṁ purā kr̥taṁ śubhāśubham,
12.321.53: na sākṣi ātmanā samo nr̥ṇāmihāsti kaścana ॥53॥
12.321.55: ta eva tasya sākṣiṇo bhavanti dharmadarśinaḥ ॥55॥
12.321.57: svameva karma rakṣyatāṁ svakarma tatra gacchati ॥57॥
12.321.58: tathā kr̥taṁ svakarmajaṁ tadeva bhujyate phalam ॥58॥
12.321.60: yatheha yat kr̥taṁ śubhaṁ vipāpmabhiḥ kr̥tātmabhiḥ,
12.321.65: tathā gatiṁ gamiṣyataḥ kimātmanā pareṇa vā ॥65॥
12.321.67: na santi yasya vārakāḥ kuruṣva dharmasaṁnidhim ॥67॥
12.321.68: idaṁ nidarśanaṁ mayā taveha putra sāmpratam,
12.321.69: dadhāti yaḥ svakarmaṇā dadāti yasya kasyacit,
12.321.71: nibandhanī rajjureṣā yā grāme vasato ratiḥ,
chittvaitāṁ sukr̥to yānti naināṁ chindanti duṣkr̥taḥ ॥71॥
12.321.72: kiṁ te putraiḥ putraka yo mariṣyasi,
12.321.73: na hi pratīkṣate mr̥tyuḥ kr̥taṁ vāsya na vākr̥tam ॥73॥
12.321.77: athemaṁ darśanopāyaṁ samyag yo vetti mānavaḥ,
12.321.78: dharmaṁ hi yo vardhayate sa paṇḍito
12.321.82: svarge kr̥tāvakāśasya nāsti tasya mahad bhayam ॥82॥
12.321.84: na tena kiñcinna prāptaṁ tanme bahu mataṁ phalam ॥84॥
12.321.85: anāgatānyatītāni kasya te kasya vā vayam ॥85॥
12.321.86: na taṁ paśyāmi yasyāhaṁ tanna paśyāmi yo mama ॥86॥
12.321.87: na teṣāṁ bhavatā kāryaṁ na kāryaṁ tava tairapi,
12.321.88: iha loke hi dhanināṁ svajanaḥ svajanāyate,
12.321.90: tat kuruṣva tathā putra kr̥tsnaṁ yat samudāhr̥tam ॥90॥
12.321.93: balena kiṁ yena ripuṁ na bādhate,
12.321.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi pāvakādhyayanaṁ nāmaikaviṁśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥321॥
12.322.1: yadyasti dattamiṣṭaṁ vā tapastaptaṁ tathaiva ca,
gurūṇāṁ vāpi śuśrūṣā tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.322.2: sa karma kaluṣaṁ kr̥tvā kleśe mahati dhīyate ॥2॥
12.322.3: durbhikṣādeva durbhikṣaṁ kleśāt kleśaṁ bhayād bhayam,
12.322.4: utsavādutsavaṁ yānti svargāt svargaṁ sukhāt sukham,
12.322.7: pulākā iva dhānyeṣu putyaṇḍā iva pakṣiṣu,
tadvidhāste manuṣyeṣu yeṣāṁ dharmo na kāraṇam ॥7॥
12.322.8: śete saha śayānena yena yena yathā kr̥tam ॥8॥
12.322.10: yena yena yathā yad yatpurā karma suniścitam,
12.322.12: acodyamānāni yathā puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca,
svaṁ kālaṁ nātivartante tathā karma purā kr̥tam ॥12॥
12.322.15: bālo yuvā vā vr̥ddhaśca yat karoti śubhāśubham,
12.322.17: malinaṁ hi yathā vastraṁ paścācchuddhyati vāriṇā,
12.322.19: padaṁ yathā na dr̥śyeta tathā puṇyakr̥tāṁ gatiḥ ॥19॥
12.322.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi dharmamūliko nāma dvāviṁśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥322॥
12.323.1: kathaṁ vyāsasya dharmātmā śuko jajñe mahātapāḥ,
siddhiṁ ca paramāṁ prāptastanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥1॥
12.323.2: na hyasya jananīṁ vidma janma cāgryaṁ mahātmanaḥ ॥2॥
12.323.3: kathaṁ ca bālasya sataḥ sūkṣmajñāne gatā matiḥ,
12.323.5: māhātmyamātmayogaṁ ca vijñānaṁ ca śukasya ha,
12.323.6: na hāyanairna palitairna vittairna ca bandhubhiḥ,
r̥ṣayaścakrire dharmaṁ yo’nūcānaḥ sa no mahān ॥6॥
12.323.9: yogasya kalayā tāta na tulyaṁ vidyate phalam ॥9॥
12.323.14: dhairyeṇa sammitaḥ putro mama bhūyāditi sma ha ॥14॥
12.323.22: na cāsya hīyate prāṇo na glānirupajāyate,
12.323.25: etā adyāpi kr̥ṣṇasya tapasā tena dīpitāḥ,
12.323.26: evaṁvidhena tapasā tasya bhaktyā ca bhārata,
12.323.28: yathā ca khaṁ tathā śuddho bhavitā te suto mahān ॥28॥
12.323.29: tejasā’’vr̥tya lokāṁstrīn yaśaḥ prāpsyati te sutaḥ ॥29॥
12.323.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukotpattau trayoviṁśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥323॥
12.324.1: sa labdhvā paramaṁ devād varaṁ satyavatīsutaḥ,
12.324.2: atha rūpaṁ paraṁ rājan bibhratīṁ svena tejasā,
12.324.3: abhavad bhagavān vyāso vane tasmin yudhiṣṭhira ॥3॥
12.324.4: sā ca daṣṭvā tadā vyāsaṁ kāmasaṁvignamānasam,
12.324.6: sa tu dhairyeṇa mahatā nigr̥hṇan hr̥cchayaṁ muniḥ,
na śaśāka niyantuṁ tad vyāsaḥ pravisr̥taṁ manaḥ ॥6॥
12.324.9: araṇī mamantha brahmarṣistasyāṁ jajñe śuko nr̥pa,
śukre nirmathyāmāne sa śuko jajñe mahātapāḥ ॥9॥
12.324.12: babhau tadā bhāvitātmā vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ,
taṁ gaṅgā saritāṁ śreṣṭhā merupr̥ṣṭhe janeśvara ॥12॥
12.324.13: antarikṣācca kauravya daṇḍaḥ kr̥ṣṇājinaṁ ca ha ॥13॥
12.324.18: taṁ mahātmā svayaṁ prītyā devyā saha mahādyutiḥ ॥18॥
12.324.20: dadau kamaṇḍaluṁ prītyā devavāsāṁsi vā vibho,
12.324.25: itihāsaṁ ca kārtsnyena rājaśāstrāṇi vā vibho,
12.324.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukotpattau caturviṁśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥324॥
12.325.2: yathā me manasaḥ śāntiḥ paramā sambhavet prabho ॥2॥
12.325.3: śrutvā putrasya tu vacaḥ paramarṣiruvāca tam,
adhīṣva putra mokṣaṁ vai dharmāṁśca vividhānapi ॥3॥
12.325.4: yogaśāstraṁ ca nikhilaṁ kāpilaṁ caiva bhārata ॥4॥
12.325.5: sa taṁ brāhmyā śriyā yuktaṁ brahmatulyaparākramam,
12.325.6: sa te vakṣyati mokṣārthaṁ nikhilaṁ mithileśvaraḥ ॥6॥
12.325.7: praṣṭuṁ dharmasya niṣṭhāṁ vai mokṣasya ca parāyaṇam ॥7॥
12.325.10: ahaṅkāro na kartavyo yājye tasmin narādhipe,
sthātavyaṁ ca vaśe tasya sa te chetsyati saṁśayam ॥10॥
12.325.11: yājyo mama sa yad brūyāt tat kāryamaviśaṅkayā ॥11॥
12.325.12: evamuktaḥ sa dharmātmā jagāma mithilāṁ muniḥ,
12.325.14: merorhareśca dve varṣe varṣaṁ haimavataṁ tataḥ,
12.325.17: pattanāni ca ramyāṇi sphītāni nagarāṇi ca,
ratnāni ca vicitrāṇi paśyannapi na paśyati ॥17॥
12.325.24: manasā taṁ vahan bhāraṁ tamevārthaṁ vicintayan,
12.325.25: tasyā dvāraṁ samāsādya niḥśaṅkaḥ praviveśa ha,
12.325.27: pratāmyati glāyati vā nāpaiti ca tathā’’tapāt,
12.325.40: vaśyendriyo jitakrodho na hr̥ṣyati na kupyati,
12.325.41: pādaśaucaṁ tu kr̥tvaiva śukaḥ sandhyāmupāsya ca ॥41॥
12.325.45: tāṁ ca rātriṁ nr̥pakule vartayāmāsa bhārata ॥45॥
12.325.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukotpattau pañcaviṁśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥325॥
12.326.1: tataḥ sa rājā janako mantribhiḥ saha bhārata,
12.326.2: āsanaṁ ca puraskr̥tya ratnāni vividhāni ca,
12.326.5: pādyaṁ nivedya prathamamarghyaṁ gāṁ ca nyavedayat ॥5॥
12.326.6: sa ca tāṁ mantravatpūjāṁ pratyagr̥hṇād yathāvidhi,
pratigr̥hya tu tāṁ pūjāṁ janakād dvijasattamaḥ ॥6॥
12.326.8: anāmayaṁ ca rājendra śukaḥ sānucarasya ha,
12.326.9: kuśalaṁ cāvyayaṁ caiva pr̥ṣṭvā vaiyāsakiṁ nr̥paḥ,
12.326.10: videharājo yājyo me janako nāma viśrutaḥ ॥10॥
12.326.11: tatra gacchasva vai tūrṇaṁ yadi te hr̥di saṁśayaḥ,
pravr̥ttau vā nivr̥ttau vā sa te cchetsyati saṁśayam ॥11॥
12.326.13: kathaṁ ca mokṣaḥ prāptavyo jñānena tapasāthavā ॥13॥
12.326.15: tapasā guruvr̥ttyā ca brahmacaryeṇa vā vibho,
12.326.21: etad bhavantaṁ pr̥cchāmi tad bhavān vaktumarhati,
yathā vedārthatattvena brūhi me tvaṁ janādhipa ॥21॥
12.326.23: guruḥ plāvayitā tasya jñānaṁ plava ihocyate,
12.326.25: hitvā śubhāśubhaṁ karma mokṣo nāmeha labhyate ॥25॥
12.326.31: atra gāthāḥ purā gītāḥ śr̥ṇu rājñā yayātinā,
12.326.33: na bibheti paro yasmānna bibheti parācca yaḥ,
yaśca necchati na dveṣṭi brahma sampadyate tadā ॥33॥
12.326.34: yadā bhāvaṁ na kurute sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam,
karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā ॥34॥
12.326.35: tyaktvā kāmaṁ ca mohaṁ ca tadā brahmatvamaśnute ॥35॥
12.326.36: yadā śrāvye ca dr̥śye ca sarvabhūteṣu cāpyayam,
samo bhavati nirdvandvo brahma sampadyate tadā ॥36॥
12.326.37: yadā stutiṁ ca nindāṁ ca samatvenaiva paśyati,
kāñcanaṁ cāyasaṁ caiva sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ tathaiva ca ॥37॥
12.326.38: jīvitaṁ maraṇaṁ caiva brahma sampadyate tadā ॥38॥
12.326.40: tamaḥ parigataṁ veśma yathā dīpena dr̥śyate,
12.326.41: etat sarvaṁ ca paśyāmi tvayi buddhimatāṁ vara,
yaccānyadapi vettavyaṁ tattvato veda tad bhavān ॥41॥
12.326.43: jñānaṁ divyaṁ mamāpīdaṁ tenāsi vidito mama ॥43॥
12.326.44: adhikaṁ tava caiśvaryaṁ tacca tvaṁ nāvabudhyase ॥44॥
12.326.45: bālyād vā saṁśayād vāpi bhayād vāpyavimokṣajāt,
utpanne cāpi vijñāne nādhigacchati tāṁ gatim ॥45॥
12.326.48: nāsti te sukhaduḥkheṣu viśeṣo nāsi lolupaḥ,
12.326.49: na bandhuṣvanubandhaste na bhayeṣvasti te bhayam,
12.326.51: tasmin vai vartase brahman kimanyat paripr̥cchasi ॥51॥
12.326.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukotpattau ṣaḍviṁśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥326॥
12.327.9: tatraiva ca kumāreṇa bālye kṣiptā divaukasaḥ,
12.327.10: tatrovāca jagat skandaḥ kṣipan vākyamidaṁ tadā,
12.327.11: yo brahmaṇyo dvitīyo’sti triṣu lokeṣu vīryavān,
12.327.13: kiṁ tvatra sukr̥taṁ kāryaṁ bhavediti vicintayan ॥13॥
12.327.15: śaktyāṁ tu kampyamānāyāṁ viṣṇunā balinā tadā ॥15॥
12.327.19: jagrāha tāṁ tadā śaktiṁ na caināṁ sa vyakampayat,
nādaṁ mahāntaṁ muktvā sa mūrcchito girimūrdhani ॥19॥
12.327.27: jaiminiṁ ca mahāprājñaṁ pailaṁ cāpi tapasvinam ॥27॥
12.327.28: yatra śiṣyaiḥ parivr̥tau vyāsa āste mahātapāḥ,
12.327.33: evamadhyāpayan śiṣyān vyāsaḥ putraṁ ca vīryavān,
12.327.35: athocuste tadā vyāsaṁ śiṣyāḥ prāñjalayo gurum ॥35॥
12.327.36: mahatā tejasā yuktā yaśasā cāpi vardhitāḥ,
12.327.37: iti teṣāṁ vacaḥ śrutvā brahmarṣistānuvāca ha,
ucyatāmiti tad vatsā yad vaḥ kāryaṁ priyaṁ mayā ॥37॥
12.327.38: etad vākyaṁ guroḥ śrutvā śiṣyāste hr̥ṣṭamānasāḥ,
punaḥ prāñjalayo bhūtvā praṇamya śirasā gurum ॥38॥
12.327.39: yadi prīta upādhyāyo dhanyāḥ smo munisattama ॥39॥
12.327.40: kāṅkṣāmastu vayaṁ sarve varaṁ dātuṁ maharṣiṇā,
ṣaṣṭhaḥ śiṣyo na te khyātiṁ gacchedatra prasīda naḥ ॥40॥
12.327.41: iha vedāḥ pratiṣṭheranneṣa naḥ kāṅkṣito varaḥ ॥41॥
12.327.43: uvāca śiṣyān dharmātmā dharmyaṁ naiḥśreyasaṁ vacaḥ,
brāhmaṇāya sadā deyaṁ brahma śuśrūṣave tathā ॥43॥
12.327.47: na niyojyāśca vaḥ śiṣyā aniyoge mahābhaye ॥47॥
12.327.49: vedasyādhyayanaṁ hodaṁ tacca kāryaṁ mahat smr̥tam ॥49॥
12.327.52: etad vaḥ sarvamākhyātaṁ svādhyāyasya vidhiṁ prati,
12.328.2: tanno manasi saṁrūḍhaṁ kariṣyāmastathā ca tat ॥2॥
12.328.4: vedānanekadhā kartuṁ yadi te rucitaṁ prabho ॥4॥
12.328.6: kṣitiṁ vā devalokaṁ vā gamyatāṁ yadi rocate,
apramādaśca vaḥ kāryo brahma hi pracuracchalam ॥6॥
12.328.7: jagmuḥ pradakṣiṇaṁ kr̥tvā vyāsaṁ mūrdhnābhivādya ca ॥7॥
12.328.12: bho bho brahmarṣivāsiṣṭha brahmaghoṣo na vartate,
12.328.13: rajasā tamasā caiva somaḥ sopaplavo yathā ॥13॥
12.328.15: viyuktā brahmaghoṣeṇa na bhrājante yathā purā ॥15॥
12.328.17: sarvajñaḥ sarvadarśī ca sarvatra ca kutūhalī ॥17॥
12.328.18: triṣu lokeṣu yad bhūtaṁ sarvaṁ tava mate sthitam,
tadājñāpaya viprarṣe brūhi kiṁ karavāṇi te ॥18॥
12.328.20: malaṁ pr̥thivyā vāhīkāḥ strīṇāṁ kautūhalaṁ malam ॥20॥
12.328.21: adhīyatāṁ bhavān vedān sārdhaṁ putreṇa dhīmatā,
12.328.28: divyaṁ te cakṣurutpannaṁ svayaṁ te nirmalaṁ manaḥ,
tamasā rajasā cāpi tyaktaḥ sattve vyavasthitaḥ ॥28॥
12.328.30: dvāvetau pretya panthānau divaṁ cādhaśca gacchataḥ ॥30॥
12.328.34: pr̥thak karmāṇi teṣāṁ te pravakṣyāmi yathātatham ॥34॥
12.328.36: prathamaḥ prathame mārge pravaho nāma yo’nilaḥ ॥36॥
12.328.37: āvaho nāma saṁvāti dvitīyaḥ śvasano nadan ॥37॥
12.328.38: udayaṁ jyotiṣāṁ śaśvat somādīnāṁ karoti yaḥ,
12.328.41: samūhyamānā bahudhā yena nītāḥ pr̥thag ghanāḥ,
12.328.42: saṁhatā yena cāviddhā bhavanti nadatāṁ nadāḥ,
12.328.43: caturthaḥ saṁvaho nāma vāyuḥ sa girimardanaḥ ॥43॥
12.328.44: yena vegavatā rugṇā rūkṣeṇa ruvatā nagān,
12.328.45: pañcamaḥ sa mahāvego vivaho nāma mārutaḥ ॥45॥
12.328.48: ṣaṣṭhaḥ parivaho nāma sa vāyurjayatāṁ varaḥ ॥48॥
12.328.52: yena spr̥ṣṭaḥ parābhūto yātyeva na nivartate,
parāvaho nāma paro vāyuḥ sa duratikramaḥ ॥52॥
12.328.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi anadhyāyanimittakathanaṁ nāmāṣṭāviṁśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥328॥
12.329.2: devarṣiṁ tu śuko dr̥ṣṭvā nāradaṁ samupasthitam,
12.329.3: kena tvāṁ śreyasā vatsa yojayāmīti hr̥ṣṭavat ॥3॥
12.329.4: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā śukaḥ provāca bhārata,
asmim̐lloke hitaṁ yat syāt tena māṁ yoktumarhasi ॥4॥
12.329.6: nāsti rāgasamaṁ duḥkhaṁ nāsti tyāgasamaṁ sukham ॥6॥
12.329.8: mānuṣyamasukhaṁ prāpya yaḥ sajjati sa muhyati,
12.329.10: sarvopāyāt tu kāmasya krodhasya ca vinigrahaḥ,
12.329.11: nityaṁ krodhāt tapo rakṣecchriyaṁ rakṣecca matsarāt,
12.329.12: ānr̥śaṁsyaṁ paro dharmaḥ kṣamā ca paramaṁ balam,
ātmajñānaṁ paraṁ jñānaṁ na satyād vidyate param ॥12॥
12.329.13: satyasya vacanaṁ śreyaḥ satyādapi hitaṁ vadet,
12.329.14: yena sarvaṁ parityaktaṁ sa vidvān sa ca paṇḍitaḥ ॥14॥
12.329.17: yasya bhūtaiḥ saha mune sa śreyo vindate param ॥17॥
12.329.18: nedaṁ janma samāsādya vairaṁ kurvīta kenacit ॥18॥
12.329.24: dvandvārāmeṣu bhūteṣu ya eko ramate muniḥ,
viddhi prajñānatr̥ptaṁ taṁ jñānatr̥pto na śocati ॥24॥
12.329.35: na hi tvāṁ prasthitaṁ kaścit pr̥ṣṭhato’nugamiṣyati,
12.329.36: vidyā karma ca śaucaṁ ca jñānaṁ ca bahuvistaram,
12.329.37: nibandhanī rajjureṣā yā grāme vasato ratiḥ,
chittvaitāṁ sukr̥to yānti naināṁ chindanti duṣkr̥taḥ ॥37॥
12.329.39: tyāgavātādhvagāṁ śīghrāṁ nautāryāṁ tāṁ nadīṁ taret ॥39॥
12.329.40: tyaja dharmamadharmaṁ ca tathā satyānr̥te tyaja,
ubhe satyānr̥te tyaktvā yena tyajasi taṁ tyaja ॥40॥
12.329.44: idaṁ viśvaṁ jagat sarvamajagaccāpi yad bhavet,
12.329.45: indriyāṇi ca pañcaiva tamaḥ sattvaṁ rajastathā,
12.329.47: trivargaṁ tu sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ jīvitaṁ maraṇaṁ tathā ॥47॥
12.329.48: ya idaṁ veda tattvena sa veda prabhavāpyayau,
12.329.49: indriyairgr̥hyate yad yat tat tad vyaktamiti sthitiḥ,
12.329.59: saṁyamena navaṁ bandhaṁ nivartya tapaso balāt,
12.330.1: niśamya labhate buddhiṁ tāṁ labdhvā sukhamedhate ॥1॥
12.330.5: dravyeṣu samatīteṣu ye guṇāstān na cintayet,
12.330.6: doṣadarśī bhavet tatra yatra rāgaḥ pravartate,
12.330.7: nārtho na dharmo na yaśo yo’tītamanuśocati,
12.330.9: mr̥taṁ vā yadi vā naṣṭaṁ yo’tītamanuśocati,
12.330.10: nāśru kurvanti ye buddhyā dr̥ṣṭvā lokeṣu santatim,
12.330.12: cintyamānaṁ hi na vyeti bhūyaścāpi pravardhate ॥12॥
12.330.14: ārogyaṁ priyasaṁvāso gr̥dhyet tatra na paṇḍitaḥ ॥14॥
12.330.16: sukhād bahutaraṁ duḥkhaṁ jīvite nātra saṁśayaḥ,
12.330.17: parityajati yo duḥkhaṁ sukhaṁ vāpyubhayaṁ naraḥ,
abhyeti brahma so’tyantaṁ na taṁ śocanti paṇḍitāḥ ॥17॥
12.330.18: tyajyante duḥkhamarthā hi pālane na ca te sukhāḥ,
12.330.19: atr̥ptā yānti vidhvaṁsaṁ santoṣaṁ yānti paṇḍitāḥ ॥19॥
12.330.23: bhūteṣu bhāvaṁ sañcintya ye buddhvā manasaḥ param,
na śocanti gatādhvānaḥ paśyantaḥ paramāṁ gatim ॥23॥
12.330.26: śabde sparśe ca rūpe ca gandheṣu ca raseṣu ca,
nopabhogāt paraṁ kiñcid dhanino vādhanasya ca ॥26॥
12.330.27: viprayogāt tu sarvasya na śocet prakr̥tisthitaḥ ॥27॥
12.330.28: dhr̥tyā śiśnodaraṁ rakṣet pāṇipādaṁ ca cakṣuṣā,
cakṣuḥśrotre ca manasā mano vācaṁ ca vidyayā ॥28॥
12.330.29: vicaredasamunnaddhaḥ sa sukhī sa ca paṇḍitaḥ ॥29॥
12.330.30: ātmanaiva sahāyena yaścaret sa sukhī bhavet ॥30॥
12.330.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukābhipatane triṁśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥330॥
12.331.1: nainaṁ prajñā sunītaṁ vā trāyate nāpi pauruṣam ॥1॥
12.331.12: vañcanāyāṁ ca lokasya sa sukheṣveva jīryate ॥12॥
12.331.15: tasya yonau prayuktasya garbho bhavati vā na vā,
12.331.17: āyuṣmān jāyate putraḥ kathaṁ preta ivābhavat ॥17॥
12.331.23: kena yatnena jīvantaṁ garbhaṁ tvamiha paśyasi ॥23॥
12.331.25: dhāraṇe vā visarge vā na kartā vidyate vaśaḥ ॥25॥
12.331.27: prajāṁ ca labhate kāñcit punardvandveṣu sajjati ॥27॥
12.331.28: sa tasya sahajātasya saptamīṁ navamīṁ daśām,
prāpnuvanti tataḥ pañca na bhavanti gatāyuṣaḥ ॥28॥
12.331.32: te pibantaḥ kaṣāyāṁśca sarpīṁṣi vividhāni ca,
12.331.33: ke vā bhuvi cikitsante rogārtān mr̥gapakṣiṇaḥ,
śvāpadāni daridrāṁśca prāyo nārtā bhavanti te ॥33॥
12.331.36: na dhanena na rājyena nogreṇa tapasā tathā,
12.331.37: na mriyeran na jīryeran sarve syuḥsarvakāminaḥ,
12.331.38: yatate ca yathāśakti na ca tad vartate tathā ॥38॥
12.331.40: svaṁ svaṁ ca punaranyeṣāṁ na kiñcidadhigamyate ॥40॥
12.331.43: idamanyat padaṁ paśya mātra mohaṁ kariṣyasi ॥43॥
12.331.44: tyaja dharmamadharmaṁ ca ubhe satyānr̥te tyaja,
ubhe satyānr̥te tyaktvā yena tyajasi taṁ tyaja ॥44॥
12.331.45: yena devāḥ parityajya martyalokaṁ divaṁ gatāḥ ॥45॥
12.331.50: paraṁ bhāvaṁ hi kāṅkṣāmi yatra nāvartate punaḥ,
12.331.52: na tu yogamr̥te śakyā prāptuṁ sā paramā gatiḥ,
12.331.54: na hyeṣa kṣayatāṁ yāti somaḥ suragaṇairyathā,
12.331.59: āpr̥cchāmi nagān nāgān girimurvīṁ diśo divam,
12.331.60: paśyantu yogavīryaṁ me sarve devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ ॥60॥
12.331.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukābhigamane ekatriṁśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥331॥
12.332.1: same deśe vivikte sa niḥśalāka upāviśat ॥1॥
12.332.4: na tatra pakṣisaṅghāto na śabdo nātidarśanam,
12.332.5: prajahāsa tato hāsaṁ śukaḥ samprekṣya tatparam ॥5॥
12.332.7: tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṁ kr̥tvā devarṣiṁ nāradaṁ tataḥ,
nivedayāmāsa ca taṁ svaṁ yogaṁ paramarṣaye ॥7॥
12.332.8: dr̥ṣṭo mārgaḥ pravr̥tto’smi svasti te’stu tapodhana,
12.332.14: yathāśakti yathānyāyaṁ pūjāṁ vai cakrire tadā,
12.332.15: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā vismitāḥ sarve gandharvāpsarasāṁ gaṇāḥ,
12.332.30: śukasya vacanaṁ śrutvā diśaḥ sarvāḥ sakānanāḥ,
12.332.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukābhipatane dvātriṁśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥332॥
12.333.2: tamo hyaṣṭavidhaṁ hitvā jahau pañcavidhaṁ rajaḥ,
12.333.5: drumāḥ śākhāśca mumucuḥ śikharāṇi ca parvatāḥ,
12.333.6: na babhāse sahasrāṁśurna jajvāla ca pāvakaḥ,
12.333.12: na ca pratijaghānāsya sa gatiṁ parvatottamaḥ,
12.333.21: sa dadarśa dvidhā kr̥tvā parvatāgraṁ śukaṁ gatam ॥21॥
12.333.29: jale nililyire kāścit kāścid gulmān prapedire ॥29॥
12.333.30: tāṁ muktatāṁ tu vijñāya muniḥ putrasya vai tadā ॥30॥
12.333.34: vīryeṇa sadr̥śaḥ putraḥ purā mattastvayā vr̥taḥ ॥34॥
12.333.37: yāvat sthāsyanti girayo yāvat sthāsyanti sāgarāḥ,
12.333.39: chāyāṁ paśyan samāvr̥ttaḥ sa muniḥ parayā mudā ॥39॥
12.333.42: dhārayed yaḥ śamaparaḥ sa gacchet paramāṁ gatim ॥42॥
12.333.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi śukotpatanasamāptirnāma trayastriṁśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥333॥
12.334.1: ya icchet siddhimāsthātuṁ devatāṁ kāṁ yajeta saḥ ॥1॥
12.334.2: kuto hyasya dhruvaḥ svargaḥ kuto naiḥśreyasaṁ param,
vidhinā kena juhuyād daivaṁ pitryaṁ tathaiva ca ॥2॥
12.334.3: svargataścaiva kiṁ kuryād yena na cyavate divaḥ ॥3॥
12.334.4: devatānāṁ ca ko devaḥ pitr̥̄ṇāṁ ca pitā tathā,
tasmāt parataraṁ yacca tanme brūhi pitāmaha ॥4॥
12.334.5: gūḍhaṁ māṁ praśnavit praśnaṁ pr̥cchase tvamihānagha,
na hyetat tarkayā śakyaṁ vaktuṁ varṣaśatairapi ॥5॥
12.334.6: r̥te devaprasādād vā rājan jñānāgamena vā,
12.334.11: aṣṭacakraṁ hi tad yānaṁ bhūtayuktaṁ manoramam,
12.334.12: yasya prasādaṁ kurvāte sa devau draṣṭumarhati ॥12॥
12.334.19: sthitau dharmottarau hyetau tathā tapasi dhiṣṭhitau,
12.334.20: kāṁ devatāṁ tu yajataḥ pitr̥̄n vā kān mahāmatī ॥20॥
12.334.21: iti sañcintya manasā bhaktyā nārāyaṇasya tu,
12.334.22: kr̥te daive ca pitrye ca tatastābhyāṁ nirīkṣitaḥ,
12.334.27: pitā mātā ca sarvasya jagataḥ śāśvato guruḥ,
kaṁ tvadya yajase devaṁ pitaraṁ kaṁ na vidmahe ॥27॥
12.334.28: tava bhaktimato brahman vakṣyāmi tu yathātatham ॥28॥
12.334.32: āvābhyāṁ pūjyate’sau hi daive pitrye ca kalpyate ॥32॥
12.334.33: nāsti tasmāt paro’nyo hi pitā devo’thavā dvija,
ātmā hi naḥ sa vijñeyastatastaṁ pūjayāvahe ॥33॥
12.334.36: vasiṣṭhaḥ parameṣṭhī ca vivasvān soma eva ca,
kardamaścāpi yaḥ proktaḥ krodho vikrīta eva ca ॥36॥
12.334.38: daivaṁ pitryaṁ ca satataṁ tasya vijñāya tattvataḥ,
12.334.39: svargasthā api ye kecit tān namasyanti dehinaḥ,
te tatprasādād gacchanti tenādiṣṭa phalāṁ gatim ॥39॥
12.334.40: kalāḥ pañcadaśa tyaktā te muktā iti niścayaḥ ॥40॥
12.334.41: muktānāṁ tu gatirbrahman kṣetrajña iti kalpitā,
12.334.42: dr̥śyate jñānayogena āvāṁ ca prasr̥tau tataḥ,
12.334.43: bhaktyā sampūjayantyāśu gatiṁ caiṣāṁ dadāti saḥ ॥43॥
12.334.44: ye tu tadbhāvitā loke hyekāntitvaṁ samāsthitāḥ,
etadabhyadhikaṁ teṣāṁ yat te taṁ praviśantyuta ॥44॥
12.334.45: bhaktyā premṇā ca viprarṣe asmadbhaktyā ca te śrutaḥ ॥45॥
12.335.4: śatrau ca mitre ca samo’smi nityam,
12.335.13: kathaṁ te puruṣā jātāḥ kā teṣāṁ gatiruttamā ॥13॥
12.335.14: ye ca muktā bhavantīha narā bharatasattama,
12.335.15: tasmānme saṁśayaṁ chindhi paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me,
12.335.16: vistīrṇaiṣā kathā rājan śrutā me pitr̥saṁnidhau,
yaiṣā tava hi vaktavyā kathāsāro hi sā matā ॥16॥
12.335.16d1: rājñā pr̥ṣṭaḥ purā prāha tatrāhaṁ śrutavān purā.
12.335.23: ātmarājyaṁ dhanaṁ caiva kalatraṁ vāhanaṁ tathā,
12.335.26: nānr̥tā vāk samabhavanmano duṣṭaṁ na cābhavat ॥26॥
12.335.27: na ca kāyena kr̥tavān sa pāpaṁ paramaṇvapi,
ye hi te r̥ṣayaḥ khyātāḥ sapta citraśikhaṇḍinaḥ ॥27॥
12.335.32: idaṁ śreya idaṁ brahma idaṁ hitamanuttamam,
lokān sañcintya manasā tataḥ śāstraṁ pracakrire ॥32॥
12.335.33: tatra dharmārthakāmā hi mokṣaḥ paścācca kīrtitaḥ,
maryādā vividhāścaiva divi bhūmau ca saṁsthitāḥ ॥33॥
12.335.34: ārādhya tapasā devaṁ hariṁ nārāyaṇaṁ prabhum,
divyaṁ varṣasahasraṁ vai sarve te r̥ṣibhiḥ saha ॥34॥
12.335.36: śabde cārthe ca hetau ca eṣā prathamasargajā ॥36॥
12.335.37: r̥ṣibhaḥ śrāvitaṁ yatra tatra kāruṇiko hyasau ॥37॥
12.335.40: pravr̥ttau ca nivr̥ttau ca yasmādetad bhaviṣyati,
12.335.41: yathā pramāṇaṁ hi mayā kr̥to bahmā prasādataḥ,
12.335.43: sarve pramāṇaṁ hi yathā tathā tacchāstramuttamam ॥43॥
12.335.44: tasmāt pravakṣyate dharmān manuḥ svāyambhuvaḥ svayam ॥44॥
12.335.48: sa hi sadbhāvito rājā madbhaktaśca bhaviṣyati,
tena śāstreṇa lokeṣu kriyāḥ sarvāḥ kariṣyati ॥48॥
12.335.49: etadarthyaṁ ca dharmyaṁ ca rahasyaṁ caitaduttamam ॥49॥
12.335.50: sa ca rājaśriyā yukto bhaviṣyati mahān vasuḥ ॥50॥
12.335.51: saṁsthite tu nr̥pe tasmin śāstrametat sanātanam,
antardhāsyati tat sarvametad vaḥ kathitaṁ mayā ॥51॥
12.335.52: visr̥jya tānr̥ṣīn sarvān kāmapi prasr̥to diśam ॥52॥
12.335.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi nārāyaṇīye pañcatriṁśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥335॥
12.336.4: sa rājā bhāvitaḥ pūrvaṁ daivena vidhinā vasuḥ,
12.336.10: na tatra paśughāto’bhūt sa rājaivaṁ sthito’bhavat ॥10॥
12.336.15: grāhyaḥ svayaṁ hi devena matpratyakṣaṁ na saṁśayaḥ ॥15॥
12.336.16: udyatā yajñabhāgā hi sākṣāt prāptāḥ surairiha,
kimarthamiha na prāpto darśanaṁ sa harirvibhuḥ ॥16॥
12.336.17: tataḥ sa taṁ samuddhūtaṁ bhūmipālo mahān vasuḥ,
12.336.19: na śakyaḥ sa tvayā draṣṭumasmābhirvā br̥haspate ॥19॥
12.336.20: yasya prasādaṁ kurute sa vai taṁ draṣṭumarhati,
12.336.21: vayaṁ hi brahmaṇaḥ putrā mānasāḥ parikīrtitāḥ,
12.336.23: sa deśo yatra nastaptaṁ tapaḥ paramadāruṇam ॥23॥
12.336.24: kathaṁ paśyema hi vayaṁ devaṁ nārāyaṇātmakam,
vareṇyaṁ varadaṁ taṁ vai devadevaṁ sanātanam ॥24॥
12.336.25: kathaṁ paśyema hi vayaṁ devaṁ nārāyaṇaṁ tviti,
12.336.27: yūyaṁ jijñāsavo bhaktāḥ kathaṁ drakṣyatha taṁ vibhum,
12.336.31: atha śrutvā vayaṁ sarve vācaṁ tāmaśarīriṇīm,
12.336.35: vratāvasāne ca śubhān narān dadr̥śire vayam,
12.336.36: mānaso nāma sa japo japyate tairmahātmabhiḥ ॥36॥
12.336.38: tejonivāsaḥ sa dvīpa iti vai menire vayam ॥38॥
12.336.39: na tatrābhyadhikaḥ kaścit sarve te samatejasaḥ,
12.336.41: tato hi vadatāṁ teṣāmaśrauṣma vipulaṁ dhvanim ॥41॥
12.336.42: vayaṁ tu tejasā tasya sahasā hr̥tacetasaḥ ॥42॥
12.336.48: vayaṁ tvenaṁ na paśyāmo mohitāstasya māyayā,
mārute saṁnivr̥tte ca balau ca pratipādite ॥48॥
12.336.54: na sa śakyastvabhaktena draṣṭuṁ devaḥ kathañcana,
12.336.59: devo’smābhirna dr̥ṣṭaḥ sa kathaṁ tvaṁ draṣṭumarhasi,
12.336.62: brahmaśāpād divo bhraṣṭaḥ praviveśa mahīṁ tataḥ ॥62॥
12.336.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi nārāyaṇīye ṣaṭtriṁśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥336॥
12.337.1: kimarthaṁ sa paribhraṣṭo viveśa vivaraṁ bhuvaḥ ॥1॥
12.337.2: r̥ṣīṇāṁ caiva saṁvādaṁ tridaśānāṁ ca bhārata ॥2॥
12.337.3: sa ca cchāgo’pyajo jñeyo nānyaḥ paśuriti sthitiḥ ॥3॥
12.337.5: naiṣa dharmaḥ satāṁ devā yatra vadhyeta vai paśuḥ,
idaṁ kr̥tayugaṁ śreṣṭhaṁ kathaṁ vadhyeta vai paśuḥ ॥5॥
12.337.7: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sahasā’’yāntaṁ vasuṁ te tvantarikṣagam ॥7॥
12.337.9: evaṁ te saṁvidaṁ kr̥tvā vibudhā r̥ṣayastathā ॥9॥
12.337.11: etannaḥ saṁśayaṁ chindhi pramāṇaṁ no bhavān mataḥ,
sa tān kr̥tāñjalirbhūtvā paripapraccha vai vasuḥ ॥11॥
12.337.12: kasya vai ko mataḥ kāmo brūta satyaṁ dvijottamāḥ,
12.337.13: devānāṁ tu paśuḥ pakṣo mato rājan vadasva naḥ,
devānāṁ tu mataṁ jñātvā vasunā pakṣasaṁśrayāt ॥13॥
12.337.15: surapakṣo gr̥hītaste yasmāt tasmād divaḥ pata ॥15॥
12.337.18: smr̥tistvenaṁ na hi jahau tadā nārāyaṇājñayā,
12.337.22: mānanā tu dvijātīnāṁ kartavyā vai mahātmanām ॥22॥
12.337.24: ekaṁ tvanugrahaṁ tubhyaṁ dadmo vai nr̥pasattama,
12.337.27: sa devo’smadvarāt prīto brahmalokaṁ hi neṣyati ॥27॥
12.337.28: evaṁ dattvā varaṁ rājñe sarve te ca divaukasaḥ,
12.337.31: tato’sya tuṣṭo bhagavān bhaktyā nārāyaṇo hariḥ,
12.337.34: mānitāste tu viprendrāstvaṁ tu gaccha dvijottama ॥34॥
12.337.35: adhaścaraṁ nr̥paśreṣṭhaṁ khecaraṁ kuru mā ciram ॥35॥
12.337.40: tataḥ śīghraṁ jahau śāpaṁ brahmalokamavāpa ca ॥40॥
12.337.41: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ sambhūtā mānavā yathā,
nārado’pi yathā śvetaṁ dvīpaṁ sa gatavānr̥ṣiḥ,
tat te sarvaṁ pravakṣyāmi śr̥ṇuṣvaikamanā nr̥pa ॥41॥
12.337.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi nārāyaṇīye saptatriṁśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥337॥
12.338.3: stotraṁ jagau sa viśvāya nirguṇāya guṇātmane ॥3॥
12.339.1: evaṁ stutaḥ sa bhagavān guhyaistathyaiśca nāmabhiḥ,
12.339.9: ajinaṁ daṇḍakāṣṭhaṁ ca jvalitaṁ ca hutāśanam ॥9॥
12.339.13: na ca māṁ te dadr̥śire na ca drakṣyati kaścana,
12.339.15: vr̥ṇīṣva ca varaṁ vipra mattastvaṁ yadihecchasi,
12.339.16: adya me tapaso deva yamasya niyamasya ca,
sadyaḥ phalamavāptaṁ vai dr̥ṣṭo yad bhagavān mayā ॥16॥
12.339.17: vara eṣa mamātyantaṁ dr̥ṣṭastvaṁ yat sanātanaḥ,
12.339.18: uvāca vacanaṁ bhūyo gaccha nārada mā ciram ॥18॥
12.339.21: na dr̥śyaścakṣuṣā yo’sau na spr̥śyaḥ sparśanena ca,
na ghreyaścaiva gandhena rasena ca vivarjitaḥ ॥21॥
12.339.22: sattvaṁ rajastamaścaiva na guṇāstaṁ bhajanti vai,
12.339.25: yaṁ praviśya bhavantīha muktā vai dvijasattamāḥ,
12.339.26: paśya devasya māhātmyaṁ mahimānaṁ ca nārada,
12.339.28: etān guṇāṁstu kṣetrajño bhuṅkte naibhiḥ sa bhujyate,
12.339.30: khe vāyuḥ pralayaṁ yāti manasyākāśameva ca,
mano hi paramaṁ bhūtaṁ tadavyakte pralīyate ॥30॥
12.339.31: nāsti tasmāt parataraḥ puruṣād vai sanātanāt ॥31॥
12.339.32: nityaṁ hi nāsti jagati bhūtaṁ sthāvarajaṅgamam,
12.339.35: utpanna eva bhavati śarīraṁ ceṣṭayan prabhuḥ,
na vinā dhātusaṅghātaṁ śarīraṁ bhavati kvacit ॥35॥
12.339.36: na ca jīvaṁ vinā brahman vāyavaśceṣṭayantyuta,
sa jīvaḥ parisaṅkhyātaḥ śeṣaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ॥36॥
12.339.38: tasmāt prasūto yaḥ kartā kāraṇaṁ kāryameva ca ॥38॥
12.339.39: so’niruddhaḥ sa īśāno vyaktaḥ sa sarvakarmasu ॥39॥
12.339.40: jñeyaḥ sa eva rājendra jīvaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ॥40॥
12.339.42: akṣaraṁ ca kṣaraṁ caiva saccāsaccaiva nārada ॥42॥
12.339.43: māṁ praviśya bhavantīha muktā bhaktāstu ye mama,
ahaṁ hi puruṣo jñeyo niṣkriyaḥ pañcaviṁśakaḥ ॥43॥
12.339.44: etat tvayā na vijñeyaṁ rūpavāniti dr̥śyate ॥44॥
12.339.45: māyā hyeṣā mayā sr̥ṣṭā yanmāṁ paśyasi nārada ॥45॥
12.339.47: ahaṁ hi jīvasañjñāto mayi jīvaḥ samāhitaḥ,
naivaṁ te buddhiratrābhūd dr̥ṣṭo jīvo mayeti vai ॥47॥
12.339.49: siddhā hi te mahābhāgā narā hyekāntino’bhavan,
tamorajobhyāṁ nirmuktāḥ pravekṣyanti ca māṁ mune ॥49॥
12.339.51: lalāṭāccaiva me rudro devaḥ krodhād viniḥsr̥taḥ,
12.339.53: nāsatyaṁ caiva dasraṁ ca bhiṣajau paśya pr̥ṣṭhataḥ,
sarvān prajāpatīn paśya paśya sapta r̥ṣīṁstathā ॥53॥
12.339.55: śriyaṁ lakṣmīṁ ca kīrtiṁ ca pr̥thivīṁ ca kakudminīm ॥55॥
12.339.56: vedānāṁ mātaraṁ paśya matsthāṁ devīṁ sarasvatīm,
dhruvaṁ ca jyotiṣāṁ śreṣṭhaṁ paśya nārada khecaram ॥56॥
12.339.59: devānāṁ ca pitr̥̄ṇāṁ ca pitā hyeko’hamāditaḥ,
12.339.60: pibāmi suhutaṁ havyaṁ kavyaṁ ca śraddhayānvitam,
mayā sr̥ṣṭaḥ purā brahmā māṁ yajñamayajat svayam ॥60॥
12.339.62: tvayā kr̥tāṁ ca maryādāṁ nātikraṁsyati kaścana ॥62॥
12.339.63: tvaṁ caiva varado brahman varepsūnāṁ bhaviṣyasi,
12.339.71: ekākī vidyayā sārdhaṁ vihariṣye jagat punaḥ ॥71॥
12.339.72: tato bhūyo jagat sarvaṁ kariṣyāmīha vidyayā,
12.339.73: sa hi saṅkarṣaṇaḥ proktaḥ pradyumnaṁ so’pyajījanat,
12.339.75: etāṁ sr̥ṣṭiṁ vijānīhi kalpādiṣu punaḥ punaḥ,
12.339.76d1: keṣu keṣu ca bhāveṣu tvaṁ draṣṭavyo mahāprabho.
12.339.76d3: rāmo rāmaśca rāmaśca kr̥ṣṇaḥ kalkī ca te daśa,
12.339.81d1: yajñastavaṁ kariṣyāmi śrutvā prīto bhaved baliḥ.
12.339.81d2: kimicchasi vaṭo brūhītyukto yāce mahad varam,
12.339.88: te sahāyā bhaviṣyanti surakārye mama dvija,
12.339.90d1: kaṁsaṁ keśiṁ tathā kālamariṣṭaṁ ca mahāsuram,
cāṇūraṁ ca mahāvīryaṁ muṣṭikaṁ ca mahābalam.
12.339.90d2: kālīyaṁ ca vaśe kr̥tvā yamunāyā mahāhrade.
12.339.90d3: gokule tu tataḥ paścād gavārthe tu mahāgirim,
12.339.90d4: indreṇa saha saṁvādaṁ kariṣyāmi tadā dvija.
12.339.92: haniṣye narakaṁ bhaumaṁ muraṁ pīṭhaṁ ca dānavam,
12.339.93d1: kr̥kalāsaṁ nr̥gaṁ caiva mocayiṣye ha vai punaḥ.
12.339.93d2: tatra pautranimittena gatvā vai śoṇitaṁ puram,
bāṇasya ca puraṁ gatvā kariṣye kadanaṁ mahat.
12.339.99: vāsaviḥ susahāyo vai mama tveko bhaviṣyati,
12.339.104: varāho narasiṁhaśca vāmano rāma eva ca,
12.339.105: savedāḥ saśrutīkāśca kr̥tāḥ pūrvaṁ kr̥te yuge ॥105॥
12.339.106: atikrāntāḥ purāṇeṣu śrutāste yadi vā kvacit,
12.339.107: lokakāryāṇi kr̥tvā ca punaḥ svāṁ prakr̥tiṁ gatāḥ,
na hyetad brahmaṇā prāptamīdr̥śaṁ mama darśanam ॥107॥
12.339.108: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ brahman bhaktimato mayā ॥108॥
12.339.109: purāṇaṁ ca bhaviṣyaṁ ca sarahasyaṁ ca sattama,
12.339.114: kiṁ vai brahmā na jānīte yataḥ śuśrāva nāradāt,
12.339.119: teṣāṁ sakāśāt sūryastu śrutvā vai bhāvitātmanām,
12.339.120: sūryasya tapato lokān nirmitā ye puraḥ sarāḥ ॥120॥
12.339.122: devānāṁ tu sakāśād vai tataḥ śrutvāsito dvijaḥ ॥122॥
12.339.123: mama cāpi pitā tāta kathayāmāsa śāntanuḥ ॥123॥
12.339.124: tato mayāpi śrutvā ca kīrtitaṁ tava bhārata,
12.339.126d1: ākhyānamuttamaṁ cedaṁ śrāvayed yaḥ sadā nr̥pa,
12.339.129: prāpya śvetaṁ mahādvīpaṁ bhūtvā candraprabho naraḥ ॥129॥
12.339.132: sa hi mātā pitā caiva kr̥tsnasya jagato guruḥ,
12.339.138: pāramparyāgataṁ hyetat pitrā me kathitaṁ purā,
12.339.139: yūyaṁ hi taptatapasaḥ sarve ca caritavratāḥ ॥139॥
12.339.141: pāramparyāgataṁ hyetat pitrā me kathitaṁ purā ॥141॥
12.339.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi nārāyaṇīye ekonacatvāriṁśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥339॥
12.340.1: kathaṁ sa bhagavān devo yajñeṣvagraharaḥ prabhuḥ,
12.340.2: nivr̥ttaṁ cāsthito dharmaṁ kṣamī bhāgavataḥ prabhuḥ,
nivr̥ttidharmān vidadhe sa eva bhagavān prabhuḥ ॥2॥
12.340.4: etaṁ naḥ saṁśayaṁ saute chindhi guhyaṁ sanātanam,
12.340.5: janamejayena yat pr̥ṣṭaḥ śiṣyo vyāsasya dhīmataḥ,
12.340.10: kiṁ ca brahmā ca rudraśca śakraśca balabhit prabhuḥ ॥10॥
12.340.11: ākāśaṁ jagatī caiva ye ca śeṣā divaukasaḥ ॥11॥
12.340.15: kathaṁ bhāgaharāḥ proktā devatāḥ kratuṣu dvija,
12.340.16: ye ca bhāgaṁ pragr̥hṇanti yajñeṣu dvijasattama,
te yajanto mahāyajñaiḥ kasya bhāgaṁ dadanti vai ॥16॥
12.340.18: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi yanme pr̥ṣṭaḥ purā guruḥ ॥18॥
12.340.20: ahaṁ caturthaḥ śiṣyo vai pañcamaśca śukaḥ smr̥taḥ,
etān samāgatān sarvān pañca śiṣyān damānvitān ॥20॥
12.340.23: eṣa vai yastvayā pr̥ṣṭastena teṣāṁ prakīrtitaḥ,
tataḥ śruto mayā cāpi tavākhyeyo’dya bhārata ॥23॥
12.340.25: mayā hi sumahat taptaṁ tapaḥ paramadāruṇam,
bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ bhaviṣyaṁ ca jānīyāmiti sattamāḥ ॥25॥
12.340.28: yathā vr̥ttaṁ hi kalpādau dr̥ṣṭaṁ me jñānacakṣuṣā,
12.340.31: so’haṅkāra iti proktaḥ sarvatejomayo hi saḥ ॥31॥
12.340.33: mahābhūtāni sr̥ṣṭvaiva tān guṇān nirmame punaḥ,
12.340.35: jñeyāḥ prakr̥tayo’ṣṭau tā yāsu lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ,
12.340.37: rudro roṣātmako jāto daśānyān so’sr̥jat svayam,
12.340.38: te rudrāḥ prakr̥tiścaiva sarve caiva surarṣayaḥ,
12.340.39: vayaṁ sr̥ṣṭā hi bhagavaṁstvayā ca prabhaviṣṇunā,
12.340.42: mamāpyeṣā samutpannā cintā yā bhavatāṁ matā ॥42॥
12.340.43: kathaṁ balakṣayo na syād yuṣmākaṁ hyātmanaśca me ॥43॥
12.340.49: bho bhoḥ sabrahmakā devā r̥ṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ,
12.340.50: vijñātaṁ vo mayā kāryaṁ tacca lokahitaṁ mahat,
12.340.52: yūyaṁ ca vibudhaśreṣṭhā māṁ yajadhvaṁ samāhitāḥ ॥52॥
12.340.53: sarve bhāgān kalpayadhvaṁ yajñeṣu mama nityaśaḥ,
12.340.54: tataste vibudhāḥ sarve brahmā te ca maharṣayaḥ ॥54॥
12.340.55: tasmin satre sadā brahmā svayaṁ bhāgamakalpayat ॥55॥
12.340.59: yena yaḥ kalpito bhāgaḥ sa tathā māmupāgataḥ,
12.340.61: yajñairye cāpi yakṣyanti sarvalokeṣu vai surāḥ ॥61॥
12.340.62: yo me yathā kalpitavān bhāgamasmin mahākratau ॥62॥
12.340.63: sa tathā yajñabhāgārho vedasūtre mayā kr̥taḥ,
12.340.65: yūyaṁ hi bhāvitā yajñaiḥ sarvayajñeṣu mānavaiḥ ॥65॥
12.340.66: māṁ tato bhāvayiṣyadhvameṣā vo bhāvanā mama,
12.340.67: ebhiḥ samyak prayuktairhi prīyante devatāḥ kṣitau,
12.340.69: vasiṣṭha iti saptaite mānasā nirmitā hi te ॥69॥
12.340.73: saptaite mānasāḥ proktā r̥ṣayo brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ,
12.340.75: tasmāt parataro yo’sau kṣetrajña iti kalpitaḥ ॥75॥
12.340.76: yo yathā nirmito janturyasmin yasmiṁśca karmaṇi ॥76॥
12.340.77: pravr̥ttau vā nivr̥ttau vā tatphalaṁ so’śnute mahat,
12.340.78: eṣa mātā pitā caiva yuṣmākaṁ ca pitāmahaḥ,
12.340.79: asya caivātmajo rudro lalāṭād yaḥ samutthitaḥ,
12.340.80: pravartantāṁ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ sarvalokeṣu mā ciram ॥80॥
12.340.82: idaṁ kr̥tayugaṁ nāma kālaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pravartitaḥ,
12.340.83: catuṣpāt sakalo dharmo bhaviṣyatyatra vai surāḥ,
12.340.84: prokṣitā yatra paśavo vadhaṁ prāpsyanti vai makhe,
yatra pādaścaturtho vai dharmasya na bhaviṣyati ॥84॥
12.340.85: tato vai dvāparaṁ nāma miśraḥ kālo bhaviṣyati,
12.340.88: yatra vedāśca yajñāśca tapaḥ satyaṁ damastathā ॥88॥
12.340.89: sa vo deśaḥ sevitavyo mā vo’dharmaḥ padā spr̥śet ॥89॥
12.340.92: taṁ devo darśayāmāsa kr̥tvā hayaśiro mahat,
12.340.95: dhātā tvaṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ tvaṁ prabhurjagato guruḥ ॥95॥
12.340.96: yadā ca surakāryaṁ te aviṣahyaṁ bhaviṣyati ॥96॥
12.340.100: sa ādiḥ sa madhyaḥ sa cāntaḥ prajānāṁ
sa dhātā sa dheyaṁ sa kartā sa kāryam,
12.340.103: aśvibhyāṁ pataye caiva marutāṁ pataye tathā,
12.340.105: vacasāṁ pataye nityaṁ saritāṁ pataye tathā ॥105॥
12.340.108: eṣa caitat paraṁ brahma jñeyo vijñānacakṣuṣā,
evametat purā dr̥ṣṭaṁ mayā vai jñānacakṣuṣā ॥108॥
12.340.109: kathitaṁ tacca vai sarvaṁ mayā pr̥ṣṭena tattvataḥ,
12.340.112: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi,
evaṁ me’kathayad rājan purā dvaipāyano guruḥ ॥112॥
12.340.114: āturo mucyate rogād baddho mucyeta bandhanāt ॥114॥
12.340.115: kāmān kāmī labhet kāmaṁ dīrghaṁ cāyuravāpnuyāt,
brāhmaṇaḥ sarvavedī syāt kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet ॥115॥
12.340.116: aputro labhate putraṁ kanyā caivepsitaṁ patim ॥116॥
12.340.118: yo yaṁ kāmaṁ kāmayate sa tamāpnoti ca dhruvam ॥118॥
12.340.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi nārāyaṇīye catvāriṁśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥340॥
12.341.2: śrutvā bhaveyaṁ yat pūtaḥ śaraccandra ivāmalaḥ ॥2॥
12.341.3: śr̥ṇu rājan yathā’’caṣṭa phālgunasya hariḥ prabhuḥ,
12.341.6: yāni nāmāni te deva kīrtitāni maharṣibhiḥ,
12.341.7: na hyanyo varṇa yennāmnāṁ niruktaṁ tvāmr̥te prabho ॥7॥
12.341.9: sāṅkhye ca yogaśāstre ca āyurvede tathaiva ca,
12.341.10: gauṇāni tatra nāmāni karmajāni ca kānicit,
12.341.11: kathyamānaṁ mayā tāta tvaṁ hi me’rdhaṁ smr̥taḥ purā,
12.341.13: yo’sau yonirhi sarvasya sthāvarasya carasya ca,
aṣṭādaśaguṇaṁ yat tat sattvaṁ sattvavatāṁ vara ॥13॥
12.341.14: prakr̥tiḥ sā parā mahyaṁ rodasī yogadhāriṇī,
12.341.15: tapo yajñaśca yaṣṭā ca purāṇaḥ puruṣo virāṭ ॥15॥
12.341.17: tato brahmā samabhavat sa tasyaiva prasādajaḥ ॥17॥
12.341.18: ahnaḥ kṣaye lalāṭācca suto devasya vai tathā,
12.341.22: tasmin hi pūjyamāne vai devadeve maheśvare ॥22॥
12.341.23: sampūjito bhavet pārtha devo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ,
12.341.24: yadyahaṁ nārcayeyaṁ vai īśānaṁ varadaṁ śivam ॥24॥
12.341.25: mayā pramāṇaṁ hi kr̥taṁ lokaḥ samanuvartate ॥25॥
12.341.26: yastaṁ vetti sa māṁ vetti yo’nutaṁ sa hi māmanu ॥26॥
12.341.28: na hi me kenacid deyo varaḥ pāṇḍavanandana,
12.341.29: na hi viṣṇuḥ praṇamati kasmaicid vibudhāya ca ॥29॥
12.341.31: bhaviṣyatāṁ vartatāṁ ca bhūtānāṁ caiva bhārata ॥31॥
12.341.32: namasva havyadaṁ viṣṇuṁ tathā śaraṇadaṁ nama ॥32॥
12.341.33: caturvidhā mama janā bhaktā eva hi me śrutam ॥33॥
12.341.35: ye ca śiṣṭāstrayo bhaktāḥ phalakāmā hi te matāḥ,
12.341.36: brahmāṇaṁ śitikaṇṭhaṁ ca yāścānyā devatāḥ smr̥tāḥ,
12.341.37: tvaṁ caivāhaṁ ca kaunteya naranārāyaṇau smr̥tau ॥37॥
12.341.40: āpo nārā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ,
ayanaṁ mama tat pūrvamato nārāyaṇo hyaham ॥40॥
12.341.41: chādayāmi jagad viśvaṁ bhūtvā sūrya ivāṁśubhiḥ,
12.341.42: vyāptā me rodasī pārtha kāntiścābhyadhikā mama ॥42॥
12.341.44: damāt siddhiṁ parīpsanto māṁ janāḥkāmayanti ha,
divaṁ corvīṁ ca madhyaṁ ca tasmād dāmodaro hyaham ॥44॥
12.341.47: tataḥ sa brahmaṇaḥ putra ādyo hyr̥ṣivarastritaḥ,
12.341.49: evaṁ hi varadaṁ nāma keśaveti mamārjuna,
12.341.51: api hi purāṇe bhavati ekayonyātmakāvagnīṣomau devāścāgnimukhā iti ekayonitvācca parasparamarhanto lokān dhārayanta iti ॥51॥
12.341.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi nārāyaṇīye ekacatvāriṁśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥341॥
12.342.1: eṣa me saṁśayo jātastaṁ chindhi madhusūdana ॥1॥
12.342.3: samprakṣālanakāle’tikrānte caturyugasahasrānte avyakte sarvabhūte pralaye sarvabhūtasthā varajaṅgame jyotirdharaṇivāyurahite’ndhe tamasi jalaikārṇave loke ॥3॥
12.342.5: na vai rātryāṁ na divase na sati nāsati na vyakte na cāpyavyakte vyavasthite ॥5॥
12.342.6: evamasyāṁ vyavasthāyāṁ nārāyaṇaguṇāśrayādajarāma-rādanindriyādagrāhyādasambhavāt satyādahiṁsrāllalāmād vividhapravr̥ttiviśeṣādavairādakṣayādamarādajarādamūrtitaḥ sarvavyāpinaḥ sarvakartuḥ śāśvatastasmāt puruṣaḥ prādurbhūto hariravyayaḥ ॥6॥
12.342.8: nāsīdaho na rātrirāsīnna sadāsīnnāsadāsīt tama eva purastādabhavad viśvarūpam, sā viśvarūpasya rajanī hi evamasyārtho’nubhāṣyaḥ ॥8॥
12.342.9: tasyedānīṁ tamasaḥ sambhavasya puruṣasya brahmayone-rbrahmaṇaḥ prādurbhāve sa puruṣaḥ prajāḥ sisr̥kṣamāṇo netrābhyāmagnīṣomau sasarja, tato bhūtasargeṣu sr̥ṣṭeṣu prajākramavaśād brahmakṣatramupātiṣṭhat, yaḥ somastad brahma yad brahma te brāhmaṇā yo’gnistat kṣatraṁ kṣatrād brahma balavattaram, kasmāditi lokapratyakṣaguṇametattadyathā, brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paraṁ bhūtaṁ notpannapūrvaṁ dīpyamāne’gnau juhoti, yo brāhmaṇamukhe juhotīti kr̥tvā bravīmi bhūtasargaḥ kr̥to brahmaṇā bhūtāni ca pratiṣṭhāpya trailokyaṁ dhāryata iti mantravādo’pi hi bhavati ॥9॥
12.342.10: tvamagne yajñānāṁ hotā viśveṣāṁ hito devānāṁ mānuṣāṇāṁ ca jagata iti ॥10॥
12.342.11: nidarśanaṁ cātra bhavati viśveṣāmagne yajñānāṁ tvaṁ hoteti, tvaṁ hito devairmanuṣyairjagata iti ॥11॥
12.342.12: agnirhi yajñānāṁ hotā kartā sa cāgnirbrahma ॥12॥
12.342.13: na hyr̥te mantrāṇāṁ havanamasti na vinā puruṣaṁ tapaḥ sambhavati, havirmantrāṇāṁ sampūjā vidyate devamānuṣa-r̥ṣīṇāmanena tvaṁ hoteti niyuktaḥ, ye ca mānuṣa-hotrādhikārāste ca brāhmaṇasya hi yājanaṁ vidhīyate na kṣatravaiśyayordvijātyostasmād brāhmaṇā hyagnibhūtā yajñānudvahanti, yajñāste devāṁstarpayanti devāḥ pr̥thivīṁ bhāvayanti śatapathe’pi hi brāhmaṇamukhe bhavati ॥13॥
12.342.14: agnau samiddhe sa juhoti yo vidvān brāhmaṇa-mukhenāhutiṁ juhoti ॥14॥
12.342.15: evamapyagnibhūtā brāhmaṇā vidvāṁso’gniṁ bhāvayanti, agnirviṣṇuḥ sarvabhūtānyanupraviśya prāṇān dhārayati ॥15॥
12.342.17: brāhmaṇānāṁ matirvākyaṁ karma śraddhāṁ tapāṁsi ca,
dhārayanti mahīṁ dyāṁ ca śaikyo vāgamr̥taṁ tathā ॥17॥
12.342.18: nāsti satyāt paro dharmo nāsti mātr̥samo guruḥ,
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paraṁ nāsti pretya ceha ca bhūtaye ॥18॥
12.342.21: vāksaṁyamakāle hitasya varapradasya devadevasya brāhmaṇāḥ prathamaṁ prādurbhūtā brāhmaṇebhyaśca śeṣā varṇāḥ prādurbhūtāḥ ॥21॥
12.342.22: itthaṁ ca surāsuraviśiṣṭā brāhmaṇā ya eva mayā brahmabhūtena purā svayamevotpāditāḥ surāsuramaharṣayo bhūtaviśeṣāḥ sthāpitā nigr̥hītāśca ॥22॥
12.342.23: ahalyādharṣaṇanimittaṁ hi gautamāddhariśmaśrutāmindraḥ prāptaḥ kauśikanimittaṁ cendro muṣkaviyogaṁ meṣavr̥ṣaṇatvaṁ cāvāpa ॥23॥
12.342.25: kratuvadhaprāptamanyunā ca dakṣeṇa bhūyastapasā cātmānaṁ saṁyojya netrākr̥tiranyā lalāṭe rudrasyotpāditā ॥25॥
12.342.26: tripuravadhārthaṁ dīkṣāmupagatasya rudrasya uśanasā jaṭāḥ śirasa utkr̥tya prayuktāstataḥ prādurbhūtā bhujagāstairasya bhujagaiḥ pīḍyamānaḥ kaṇṭho nīlatāmupagataḥ pūrve ca manvantare svāyambhuve nārāyaṇahastagrahaṇānnīlakaṇṭhatvameva ca ॥26॥
12.342.27: amr̥totpādane puraścaraṇatāmupagatasyāṅgiraso br̥hasyaterupaspr̥śato na prasādaṁ gatavatyaḥ kilāpaḥ, atha br̥haspatirapāṁ cukrodha yasmānmamopaspr̥śataḥ kaluṣībhūtā na ca prasādamupagatāstasmādadyaprabhr̥ti jhaṣamakarakacchapa-jantubhiḥkaluṣībhavateti, tadā prabhr̥tyāpo yādobhiḥ saṅkīrṇāḥ sampravr̥ttāḥ ॥27॥
12.342.28: viśvarūpo hi vai tvāṣṭraḥ purohito devānāmāsīt, svasrīyo’surāṇāṁ sa pratyakṣaṁ devebhyo bhāgamadāt parokṣamasurebhyaḥ ॥28॥
12.342.29: atha hiraṇyakaśipuṁ puraskr̥tya viśvarūpamātaraṁ svasāramasurā varamayācanta he svasarayaṁ te putrastvāṣṭro viśvarūpastriśirā devānāṁ purohitaḥ pratyakṣaṁ devebhyo bhāgamadāt parokṣamasmākaṁ tato devā vardhante vayaṁ kṣīyāmastadenaṁ tvaṁ vārayitumarhasi tathā yathāsmān bhajediti ॥29॥
12.342.30: atha viśvarūpaṁ nandanavanamupagataṁ mātovāca putra kiṁ parapakṣavardhanastvaṁ mātulapakṣaṁ nāśayasi nārhasyevaṁ kartumiti sa viśvarūpo māturvākyamanatikramaṇīyamiti matvā sampūjya hiraṇyakaśipumagāt ॥30॥
12.342.31: hairaṇyagarbhācca vasiṣṭhāddhiraṇyakaśipuḥ śāpaṁ prāptavān yasmāt tvayānyo vr̥to hotā tasmādasamāpta-yajñastvamapūrvāt sattvajātād vadhaṁ prāpsyasīti tacchāpadānāddhiraṇyakaśipuḥ prāptavān vadham ॥31॥
12.342.32: atha viśvarūpo mātr̥pakṣavardhano’tyarthaṁ tapasya bhavat tasya vratabhaṅgārthamindro bahvīḥ śrīmatyo’psaraso niyuyoja tāśca dr̥ṣṭvā manaḥ kṣubhitaṁ tasyābhavat tāsu cāpsaraḥsu nacirādeva sakto’bhavat saktaṁ cainaṁ jñātvā apsarasa ūcurgacchāmahe vayaṁ yathāgatamiti ॥32॥
12.342.33: tāstvāṣṭra uvāca kva gamiṣyathāsyatāṁ tāvanmayā saha śreyo bhaviṣyantīti tāstamabruvan vayaṁ devastriyo’psarasa indraṁ devaṁ varadaṁ purā prabhaviṣṇuṁ vr̥ṇīmaha iti ॥33॥
12.342.34: atha tā viśvarūpo’bravīdadyaiva sendrā devā na bhaviṣyantīti tato mantrān jajāpa tairmantrairavardhata triśirā ekenāsyena sarvalokeṣu yathāvad dvijaiḥ kriyāvadbhiyajñeṣu suhutaṁ somaṁ papāvekenānnamekena sendrān devānathendrastaṁ vivardhamānaṁ somapānāpyāyitasarvagātraṁ dr̥ṣṭvā cintāmāpede saha devaiḥ ॥34॥
12.342.35: te devāḥ sendrā brahmāṇamabhijagmusta ūcurviśvarūpeṇa sarvayajñeṣu suhutaḥ somaḥ pīyate vayamabhāgāḥ saṁvr̥ttā asurapakṣo vardhate vayaṁ kṣīyāmastadarhasi no vidhātuṁ śreyo’nantaramiti ॥35॥
12.342.36: tān brahmovāca r̥ṣirbhārgavastapastapyate dadhīcaḥ sa yācyatāṁ varaṁ sa yathā kalevaraṁ jahyāt tathā vidhīyatāṁ tasyāsthibhirvajraṁ kriyatāmiti ॥36॥
12.342.37: tato devāstatrāgacchan yatra dadhīco bhagavānr̥ṣistapastepe sendrā devāstaṁ tathābhigamyo-curbhagavaṁstapaḥ sukuśalamabhinnaṁ ceti ॥37॥
12.342.38: tān dadhīca uvāca svāgataṁ bhavadbhya ucyatāṁ kiṁ kriyatāmiti yad vakṣyatha tat kariṣyāmi ॥38॥
12.342.39: te tamabruvan śarīraparityāgaṁ lokahitārthaṁ bhagavān kartumarhatīti ॥39॥
12.342.40: atha dadhīcastathaivāvimanāḥ sukhaduḥkhasamo mahāyogī ātmānaṁ samādhāya śarīraparityāgaṁ cakāra ॥40॥
12.342.41: tasya paramātmanyapasr̥te tānyasthīni dhātā saṅgr̥hya vajramakarot tena vajreṇābhedyenāpradhr̥ṣyeṇa brahmāsthisambhūtena viṣṇupraviṣṭenendro viśvarūpaṁ jaghāna śirasāṁ cāsya cchedanamakarot tasmādanantaraṁ viśvarūpagātramathanasambhavaṁ tvaṣṭrotpāditamevāriṁ vr̥tramindro jaghāna ॥41॥
12.342.42: tasyāṁ dvaidhībhūtāyāṁ brahmavadhyāyāṁ bhayādindro devarājyaṁ paryatyajadapsu sambhavāṁ ca śītalāṁ mānasasarogatāṁ nalinīṁ pratipede tatra caiśvaryayogādaṇumātro bhūtvā bisagranthiṁ praviveśa ॥42॥
12.342.43: atha brahmavadhyābhayapraṇaṣṭe trailokyanāthe śacīpatau jagadanīśvaraṁ babhūva devān rajastamaścāviveśa mantrā na prāvartanta maharṣīṇāṁ rakṣāṁsi prādurabhavan brahma cotsādanaṁ jagāmānindrāścābalā lokāḥ supradhr̥ṣyā babhūvuḥ ॥43॥
12.342.44: atha devā r̥ṣayaścāyuṣaḥ putraṁ nahuṣaṁ nāma devarājye’bhiṣiṣicurnahuṣaḥ pañcabhiḥ śatairjyotiṣāṁ lalāṭe jvaladbhiḥ sarvatejoharaistriviṣṭapaṁ pālayāmbabhūva ॥44॥
12.342.45: atha lokāḥ prakr̥timāpedire svasthāśca hr̥ṣṭāśca babhūvuḥ ॥45॥
12.342.46: athovāca nahuṣaḥ sarvaṁ māṁ śakropabhuktamupasthitamr̥te śacīmiti sa evamuktvā śacīsamīpamagamaduvācaināṁ subhage’hamindro devānāṁ bhajasva māmiti taṁ śacī pratyuvāca prakr̥tyā tvaṁ dharmavatsalaḥ somavaṁśodbhavaśca nārhasi parapatnīdharṣaṇaṁ kartumiti ॥46॥
12.342.47: tāmathovāca nahuṣa aindraṁ padamadhyāsyate mayā-’hamindrasya rājyaratnaharo nātrādharmaḥ kaścit tvamindropa-bhukteti sā tamuvācāsti mama kiñcid vratamaparyavasitaṁ tasyāvabhr̥the tvāmupagamiṣyāmi kaiścidevāhobhiriti sa śacyevamabhihito jagāma ॥47॥
12.342.48: atha śacī duḥkhaśokārtā bhartr̥darśanalālasā nahuṣa-bhayagr̥hītā br̥haspatimupāgacchat sa ca tāmatyudvignāṁ dr̥ṣṭvaiva dhyānaṁ praviśya bhartr̥kāryatatparāṁ jñātvā br̥haspati-ruvācānenaiva vratena tapasā cānvitā devīṁ varadāmupa-śrutimāhvaya tadā sā te indraṁ darśayiṣyatīti sā’tha mahāniyamasthitā devīṁ varadāmupaśrutiṁ mantrairāhvayati sopaśrutiḥ śacīsamīpamagāduvāca caināmiyamasmīti tvayā’’hūtopasthitā kiṁ te priyaṁ karavāṇīti tāṁ mūrdhnā praṇamyovāca śacī bhagavatyarhasi me bhartāraṁ darśayituṁ tvaṁ satyā r̥tā ceti saināṁ mānasaṁ saro’nayat tatrendraṁ bisagranthigatamadarśayat ॥48॥
12.342.49: tāmatha patnīṁ kr̥śāṁ glānāṁ cendro dr̥ṣṭvā cintayā-mbabhūva aho mama duḥkhamidamupagataṁ naṣṭaṁ hi māmiya-manviṣya yatyatnyabhyagamad duḥkhārteti tāmindra uvāca kathaṁ vartayasīti sā tamuvāca nahuṣo māmāhvayati patnīṁ kartuṁ kālaścāsya mayā kr̥ta iti tāmindra uvāca gaccha nahuṣastvayā vācyo’pūrveṇa māmr̥ṣiyuktena yānena tvamadhirūḍha udvahasveti indrasya mahānti vāhanāni santi manaḥpriyāṇyadhirūḍhāni mayā tvamanyenopayātumarhasīti saivamuktā hr̥ṣṭā jagāmendro’pi bisagranthimevāviveśa bhūyaḥ ॥49॥
12.342.50: athendrāṇīmabhyāgatāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tāmuvāca nahuṣaḥ pūrṇaḥ sa kāla iti taṁ śacyabravīcchakreṇa yathoktaṁ sa maharṣiyuktaṁ vāhanamadhirūḍhaḥ śacīsamīpamupāgacchat ॥50॥
12.342.51: atha maitrāvaruṇiḥ kumbhayoniragastya r̥ṣivaro maharṣīn dhikkriyamāṇāṁstān nahuṣeṇāpaśyat padbhyāṁ ca tenāspr̥śyata tataḥ sa nahuṣamabravīdakāryapravr̥tta pāpa patasva mahīṁ sarpo bhava yāvadbhumirgirayaśca tiṣṭheyustāvaditi sa maharṣivākyasamakālameva tasmād yānādavāpatat ॥51॥
12.342.52: athānindraṁ punastrailokyamabhavat tato devā r̥ṣayaśca bhagavantaṁ viṣṇuṁ śaraṇamindrārthe’bhijagmurūcuścainaṁ bhagavannindraṁ brahmahatyābhibhūtaṁ trātumarhasīti tataḥ sa varadastānabravīdaśvamedhaṁ yajñaṁ vaiṣṇavaṁ śakro’bhiyajatāṁ tataḥ svasthānaṁ prāpsyatīti tato devā r̥ṣayaścendraṁ nāpaśyan yadā tadā śacīmūcurgaccha subhage indramānayasveti sā punastatsaraḥ samabhyagacchadindraśca tasmāt sarasaḥ pratyutthāya br̥haspatimabhijagāma br̥haspatiścāśvamedhaṁ mahākratuṁ śakrāyāharat tatra kr̥ṣṇasāraṅgaṁ medhyamaśvamutsr̥jya vāhanaṁ tameva kr̥tvā indraṁ marutpatiṁ br̥haspatiḥ svaṁ sthānaṁ prāpayāmāsa ॥52॥
12.342.53: tataḥ sa devarāḍ devairr̥ṣibhiḥ stūyamānastriviṣṭa-pastho niṣkalmaṣo babhūva ha brahmavadhyāṁ caturṣu sthāneṣu vanitāgnivanaspatigoṣu vyabhajadevamindro brahmatejaḥ-prabhāvopabr̥ṁhitaḥ śatruvadhaṁ kr̥tvā svaṁ sthānaṁ prāpitaḥ ॥53॥
12.342.53d1: kathayitvā svakān praśnān bhīmaṁ taṁ ca vimokṣyate.
12.342.54: ākāśagaṅgāgataśca purā bharadvājo maharṣirupāspr̥śat trīn kramān kramatā viṣṇunābhyāsāditaḥ sa bharadvājena sasalilena pāṇinorasi tāḍitaḥ salakṣaṇoraskaḥ saṁvr̥ttaḥ ॥54॥
12.342.56: aditirvai devānāmannamapacadetad bhuktvāsurān haniṣyantīti tatra budho vratacaryāsamāptāvāgacchadaditiṁ cāvocad bhikṣāṁ dehīti tatra devaiḥ pūrvametat prāśyaṁ nānyenetyaditirbhikṣāṁ nādādatha bhikṣāpratyākhyāna-ruṣitena budhena brahmabhūtenāditiḥ śaptā aditerudare bhaviṣyati vyathā vivasvato dvitīyajanmanyaṇḍasañjñitasya aṇḍaṁ māturadityā māritaṁ sa mārtaṇḍo vivasvānabhavacchrāddhadevaḥ ॥56॥
12.342.57: dakṣasya yā vai duhitaraḥ ṣaṣṭirāsaṁstābhyaḥ kaśyapāya trayodaśa prādād daśa dharmāya daśa manave saptaviṁśatimindave tāsu tulyāsu nakṣatrākhyāṁ gatāsu somo rohiṇyāmabhyadhikaṁ prītimānabhūt tatastāḥ śiṣṭāḥ patnya īrṣyāvatyaḥ pituḥ samīpaṁ gatvemamarthaṁ śaśaṁsurbhagavannasmāsu tulyaprabhāvāsu somo rohiṇīṁ pratyadhikaṁ bhajatīti so’bravīd yakṣmainamāviśyeteti dakṣaśāpāt somaṁ rājānaṁ yakṣmā viveśa sa yakṣmaṇā’’viṣṭo dakṣamagād dakṣaścainamabravīnna samaṁ vartayasīti tatrarṣayaḥ somamabruvan kṣīyase yakṣmaṇā paścimāyāṁ diśi samudre hiraṇyasarastīrthaṁ tatra gatvā ātmānamabhiṣecayasvetyathāgacchat somastatra hiraṇyasarastīrthaṁ gatvā cātmanaḥ secanamakarot snātvā cātmānaṁ pāpmano mokṣayāmāsa tatra cāvabhāsitastīrthe yadā somastadā prabhr̥ti ca tīrthaṁ tat prabhāsamiti nāmnā khyātaṁ babhūva ॥57॥
12.342.58: tacchāpādadyāpi kṣīyate somo’māvāsyāntarasthaḥ paurṇamāsīmātre’dhiṣṭhito meghalekhāpraticchannaṁ vapurdarśayati meghasadr̥śaṁ varṇamagamat tadasya śaśalakṣma vimalamabhavat ॥58॥
12.342.59: sthūlaśirā maharṣirmeroḥ prāguttare digvibhāge tapastepe tatastasya tapastapyamānasya sarvagandhavahaḥ śucirvāyurvāyamānaḥ śarīramaspr̥śat sa tapasā tāpita-śarīraḥ kr̥śo vāyunopavījyamāno hr̥daye paritoṣamagamat tatra kila tasyānilavyajanakr̥taparitoṣasya sadyo vanaspatayaḥ puṣpaśobhāṁ nidarśitavanta iti sa etān śaśāpa na sarvakālaṁ puṣpavanto bhaviṣyatheti ॥59॥
12.342.60: nārāyaṇo lokahitārthaṁ vaḍavāmukho nāma purā maharṣirbabhūva tasya merau tapastapyataḥ samudra āhūto nāgatastenāmarṣitenātmagātroṣmaṇā samudraḥ stimitajalaḥ kr̥taḥ svedaprasyandanasadr̥śaścāsya lavaṇabhāvo janitaḥ ॥60॥
12.342.61: uktaścāpyapeyo bhaviṣyasyetacca te toyaṁ vaḍavāmukhasañjñitena pepīyamānaṁ madhuraṁ bhaviṣyati tadetadadyāpi vaḍavāmukhasañjñitenānuvartinā toyaṁ samudrāt pīyate ॥61॥
12.342.62: himavato girerduhitaramumāṁ kanyāṁ rudraścakame bhr̥gurapi ca maharṣirhimavantamāgatyābravīt kanyāmimāṁ me dehīti tamabravīddhimavānabhilakṣito varo rudra iti tamabravīd bhr̥guryasmāt tvayāhaṁ kanyāvaraṇa-kr̥tabhāvaḥ pratyākhyātastasmānna ratnānāṁ bhavān bhājanaṁ bhaviṣyatīti ॥62॥
12.342.64: kṣatramapi ca brāhmaṇaprasādādeva śāśvatīmavyayāṁ ca pr̥thivīṁ patnīmabhigamya bubhūje ॥64॥
12.342.69: dhāma sāro hi bhūtānām r̥taṁ caiva vicāritam,
12.342.70: naṣṭāṁ ca dharaṇīṁ pūrvamavindaṁ vai guhāgatām,
12.342.71: śipiviṣṭeti cākhyāyāṁ hīnaromā ca yo bhavet,
12.342.74: na hi jāto na jāyeyaṁ na janiṣye kadācana,
12.342.75: r̥tā brahmasutā sā me satyā devī sarasvatī ॥75॥
12.342.77: janmanīhā bhavet sattvaṁ paurvikaṁ me dhanañjaya ॥77॥
12.342.79: kr̥ṣāmi medinīṁ pārtha bhūtvā kārṣṇāyaso mahān,
kr̥ṣṇo varṇaśca me yasmāt tasmāt kr̥ṣṇo’hamarjuna ॥79॥
12.342.80: vāyuśca tejasā sārdhaṁ vaikuṇṭhatvaṁ tato mama ॥80॥
12.342.81: nirvāṇaṁ paramaṁ brahma dharmo’sau para ucyate,
12.342.83: te māṁ gāyanti prāgvaṁśe adhokṣaja iti sthitiḥ ॥83॥
12.342.83d1: adho na kṣīyate yasmād vadantyanye hyadhokṣajam,
12.342.84: nānyo hyadhokṣajo loke r̥te nārāyaṇaṁ prabhum ॥84॥
12.342.86: trayo hi dhātavaḥ khyātāḥ karmajā iti te smr̥tāḥ,
pittaṁ śleṣmā ca vāyuśca eṣa saṅghāta ucyate ॥86॥
12.342.88: vr̥ṣo hi bhagavān dharmaḥ khyāto lokeṣu bhārata,
12.342.89: tasmād vr̥ṣākapiṁ prāha kaśyapo māṁ prajāpatiḥ ॥89॥
12.342.90: na cādiṁ na madhyaṁ tathā caiva nāntaṁ
12.342.91: na ca pāpāni gr̥hṇāmi tato’haṁ vai śuciśravāḥ ॥91॥
12.342.93: trikakut tena vikhyātaḥ śarīrasya tu māpanāt ॥93॥
12.342.96: hiraṇyagarbho dyutimān ya eṣa cchandasi stutaḥ,
yogaiḥ sampūjyate nityaṁ sa evāhaṁ bhuvi smr̥taḥ ॥96॥
12.342.97: sahasraśākhaṁ yat sāma ye vai vedavido janāḥ ॥97॥
12.342.100: śākhābhedāśca ye kecid yāśca śākhāsu gītayaḥ ॥100॥
12.342.101: yat tad hayaśiraḥ pārtha samudeti varapradam ॥101॥
12.342.104: kramaṁ praṇīya śikṣāṁ ca praṇayitvā sa gālavaḥ ॥104॥
12.342.105: jātīmaraṇajaṁ duḥkhaṁ smr̥tvā smr̥tvā punaḥ punaḥ ॥105॥
12.342.109: na caivākalpayad bhāgaṁ dakṣo rudrasya bhārata,
12.342.114: tata enaṁ samudbhūtaṁ kaṇṭhe jagrāha pāṇinā ॥114॥
12.342.117: asmin yuddhe tu vārṣṇeya trailokyaśamane tadā ॥117॥
12.342.119: nāgr̥hṇāt pāvakaḥ śubhraṁ makheṣu suhutaṁ haviḥ ॥119॥
12.342.120: vedā na pratibhānti sma r̥ṣīṇāṁ bhāvitātmanām,
12.342.121: vasudhā sañcakampe ca nabhaśca vicacāla ha,
12.342.124: uvāca vacanaṁ rudraṁ lokānāmastu vai śivam ॥124॥
12.342.126: kūṭasthaṁ kartr̥ nirdvandvamakarteti ca yaṁ viduḥ,
12.342.129: mayā ca sārdhaṁ varada vibudhaiśca maharṣibhiḥ,
12.342.130: śaraṇaṁ ca jagāmādyaṁ vareṇyaṁ varadaṁ prabhum ॥130॥
12.342.133: yastvāṁ vetti sa māṁ vetti yastvāmanu sa māmanu,
12.342.136: eṣa te kathitaḥ pārtha nārāyaṇajayo mr̥dhe ॥136॥
12.342.137: nāmāni caiva guhyāni niruktāni ca bhārata,
12.342.138: brahmalokaṁ ca kaunteya golokaṁ ca sanātanam ॥138॥
12.342.139: mayā tvaṁ rakṣito yuddhe mahāntaṁ prāptavāñjayam,
yastu te so’grato yāti yuddhe sampratyupasthite ॥139॥
12.342.140: taṁ viddhi rudraṁ kaunteya devadevaṁ kapardinam,
kālaḥ sa eva kathitaḥ krodhajeti mayā tava ॥140॥
12.342.141: nihatāstena vai pūrvaṁ hatavānasi yān ripūn,
12.342.142: yaśca te kathitaḥ pūrvaṁ krodhajeti punaḥ punaḥ,
tasya prabhāva evāgre yacchrutaṁ te dhanañjaya ॥142॥
12.342.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi nārāyaṇīye dvicatvāriṁśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥342॥
12.343.1: yacchrutvā munayaḥ sarve vismayaṁ paramaṁ gatāḥ ॥1॥
12.343.2: na tathā phaladaṁ saute nārāyaṇakathā yathā ॥2॥
12.343.5: dr̥ṣṭavān nārado yattu devaṁ nārāyaṇaṁ harim,
12.343.7: naranārāyaṇau draṣṭuṁ kāraṇaṁ tad bravīhi me,
tasmin yajñe vartamāne rājñaḥ pārikṣitasya vai ॥7॥
12.343.11: kiyantaṁ kālamavasat kāṁ kathāṁ pr̥ṣṭavāṁśca saḥ,
12.343.16: na tato’sti paraṁ manye pāvanaṁ divi ceha ca ॥16॥
12.343.17: na tathā phaladaṁ cāpi nārāyaṇakathā yathā ॥17॥
12.343.19: na citraṁ kr̥tavāṁstatra yadāryo me dhanañjayaḥ,
12.343.20: na cāsya kiñcidaprāpyaṁ manye lokeṣvapi triṣu,
trailokyanātho viṣṇuḥ sa yathā’’sīt sāhyakr̥t sa vai ॥20॥
12.343.21: dhanyāśca sarva evāsan brahmaṁste mama pūrvajāḥ,
12.343.24: śvetadvīpaṁ samāsādya yena dr̥ṣṭaḥ svayaṁ hariḥ,
12.343.25: badarīmāśramaṁ yat tu nāradaḥ prādravat punaḥ ॥25॥
12.343.26: naranārāyaṇau draṣṭuṁ kiṁ tu tat kāraṇaṁ mune,
12.343.27: kiyantaṁ kālamavasat praśnān kān pr̥ṣṭavāṁśca ha ॥27॥
12.343.30: prāpya śvetaṁ mahādvīpaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā ca harimavyayam ॥30॥
12.343.33: nipapāta ca khāt tūrṇaṁ viśālāṁ badarīmanu ॥33॥
12.343.39: tau dr̥ṣṭvā nārado hr̥ṣṭastābhyāṁ ca pratipūjitaḥ,
12.343.42: sa copaviviśe tatra pīṭhe kuśamaye śubhe,
12.343.47: śvetadvīpe tvayā dr̥ṣṭa āvayoḥ prakr̥tiḥ parā,
12.343.48: sarve lokā hi tatrasthāstathā devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ,
adyāpi cainaṁ paśyāmi yuvāṁ paścan sanātanau ॥48॥
12.343.50: dr̥ṣṭau yuvāṁ mayā tatra tasya devasya pārśvataḥ,
12.343.51: ko hi nāma bhavet tasya tejasā yaśasā śriyā,
12.343.52: tena me kathitaḥ kr̥tsno dharmaḥ kṣetrajñasañjñitaḥ,
prādurbhāvāśca kathitā bhaviṣyā iha ye yathā ॥52॥
12.343.54: te’rcayanti sadā devaṁ taiḥ sārdhaṁ ramate ca saḥ,
12.343.56: sa kartā kāraṇaṁ caiva kāryaṁ cātibaladyutiḥ,
hetuścājñā vidhānaṁ ca tattvaṁ caiva mahāyaśāḥ ॥56॥
12.343.57: tapasā yojya so’’tmānaṁ śvetadvīpāt paraṁ hi yat,
12.343.58: śāntiḥ sā triṣu lokeṣu vihitā bhāvitātmanā,
12.343.61: yad brahmā r̥ṣayaścaiva svayaṁ paśupatiśca yat ॥61॥
12.343.62: nāgāḥ suparṇā gandharvāḥ siddhā rājarṣayaśca ye ॥62॥
12.343.63: havyaṁ kavyaṁ ca satataṁ vidhiyuktaṁ prayuñjate,
12.343.64: tāḥ sarvāḥ śirasā devaḥ pratigr̥hṇāti vai svayam ॥64॥
12.343.66: evaṁ me bhagavān devaḥ svayamākhyātavān hariḥ,
āsiṣye tatparo bhūtvā yuvābhyāṁ saha nityaśaḥ ॥66॥
12.343.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi nārāyaṇīye tricatvāriṁśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥343॥
12.344.1: dhanyo’syanugr̥hīto’si yat te dr̥ṣṭaḥ svayaṁ prabhuḥ,
na hi taṁ dr̥ṣṭavān kaścit padmayonirapi svayam ॥1॥
12.344.3: nāsya bhaktāt priyataro loke kaścana vidyate,
12.344.4: tapo hi tapyatastasya yat sthānaṁ paramātmanaḥ,
na tat samprāpnute kaścidr̥te hyāvāṁ dvijottama ॥4॥
12.344.5: yā hi sūryasahasrasya samastasya bhaved dyutiḥ,
sthānasya sā bhavet tasya svayaṁ tena virājatā ॥5॥
12.344.6: kṣamā kṣamāvatāṁ śreṣṭha yayā bhūmistu yujyate ॥6॥
12.344.7: āpo hi tena yujyante dravatvaṁ prāpnuvanti ca ॥7॥
12.344.9: yena sma yujyate vāyustato lokān vivātyasau ॥9॥
12.344.15: paramāṇubhūtā bhūtvā tu taṁ devaṁ praviśantyuta,
12.344.20: āvāmapi ca dharmasya gr̥he jātau dvijottama,
12.344.21: ye tu tasyaiva devasya prādurbhāvāḥ surapriyāḥ,
12.344.24: sarvaṁ hi nau saṁviditaṁ trailokye sacarācare,
yad bhaviṣyati vr̥ttaṁ vā vartate vā śubhāśubham,
sarvaṁ sa te kathitavān devadevo mahāmune ॥24॥
12.344.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi nārāyaṇīye catuścatvāriṁśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥344॥
12.345.1: daivaṁ kr̥tvā yathānyāyaṁ pitryaṁ cakre tataḥ param ॥1॥
12.345.2: tatastaṁ vacanaṁ prāha jyeṣṭho dharmātmajaḥ prabhuḥ,
ka ijyate dvijaśreṣṭha daive pitrye ca kalpite ॥2॥
12.345.3: tvayā matimatāṁ śreṣṭha tanme śaṁsa yathāgamam,
kimetat kriyate karma phalaṁ vāsya kimiṣyate ॥3॥
12.345.4: daivataṁ ca paro yajñaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ ॥4॥
12.345.7: yajāmi vai pitr̥̄n sādho nārāyaṇavidhau kr̥te,
evaṁ sa eva bhagavān pitā mātā pitāmahaḥ ॥7॥
12.345.11: trīn piṇḍān nyasya vai pr̥thvyāṁ pūrvaṁ dattvā kuśāniti,
kathaṁ tu piṇḍasañjñāṁ te pitaro lebhire purā ॥11॥
12.345.12: imāṁ hi dharaṇīṁ pūrvaṁ naṣṭāṁ sāgaramekhalām,
12.345.13: sthāpayitvā tu dharaṇīṁ sve sthāne puruṣottamaḥ,
12.345.16: saṅkalpayitvā trīn piṇḍān svenaiva vidhinā prabhuḥ,
12.345.18: ahaṁ hi pitaraḥ sraṣṭumudyato lokakr̥t svayam,
12.345.19: āśritā dharaṇīṁ piṇḍāstasmāt pitara eva te ॥19॥
12.345.20: bhavantu pitaro loke mayā sr̥ṣṭāḥ sanātanāḥ ॥20॥
12.345.22: nāsti matto’dhikaḥ kaścit ko vānyo’rcyo mayā svayam,
ko vā mama pitā loke ahameva pitāmahaḥ ॥22॥
12.345.27: karmaṇā manasā vācā viṣṇumeva yajanti te,
12.345.28: mahān mahātmā sarvātmā nārāyaṇa iti śrutiḥ ॥28॥
12.345.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi nārāyaṇīye pañcacatvāriṁśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥345॥
12.346.6: karmaṇā manasā vācā yo dviṣyād viṣṇumavyayam,
12.346.7: yo dviṣyād vibudhaśreṣṭhaṁ devaṁ nārāyaṇaṁ harim,
kathaṁ nāma bhaved dveṣya ātmā lokasya kasyacit ॥7॥
12.346.8: ātmā hi puruṣavyāghra jñeyo viṣṇuriti sthitiḥ,
12.346.9: tasmācchrutaṁ mayā cedaṁ kathitaṁ ca tavānagha ॥9॥
12.346.11: evameṣa mahān dharmaḥ sa te pūrvaṁ nr̥pottama,
12.346.13: dharmān nānāvidhāṁścaiva ko brūyāt tamr̥te prabhum ॥13॥
12.346.17: nāradena purā rājan gurave me niveditam,
12.346.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi nārāyaṇīye ṣaṭcatvāriṁśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥346॥
12.347.2: pravr̥ttau ca nivr̥ttau ca yo yathā parikalpitaḥ ॥2॥
12.347.3: tathā ca naḥ śruto brahman kathyamānastvayānagha,
12.347.4: yacca tat kathitaṁ pūrvaṁ tvayā hayaśiro mahat,
12.347.8: pāvitāḥ sma tvayā brahman puṇyāṁ kathayatā kathām,
12.347.9: jagau yad bhagavān vyāso rājñaḥ pārikṣitasya vai,
12.347.11: yat kiñcidiha loke vai dehasattvaṁ viśāmpate ॥11॥
12.347.14: jyotirbhūte jale cāpi līne jyotiṣi cānile ॥14॥
12.347.15: vyakte manasi saṁlīne vyakte cāvyaktatāṁ gate ॥15॥
12.347.16: avyakte puruṣaṁ yāte puṁsi sarvagate’pi ca,
tama evābhavat sarvaṁ na prājñāyata kiñcana ॥16॥
12.347.21: ahaṅkārastato jāto brahmā sa tu caturmukhaḥ,
12.347.23: sattvasthaḥ parameṣṭhī sa tato bhūtagaṇān sr̥jan ॥23॥
12.347.30: atha tau dānavaśreṣṭhau vedān gr̥hya sanātanān,
12.347.32: vedā me paramaṁ cakṣurvedā me paramaṁ balam,
vedā me paramaṁ dhāma vedā me brahma cottaram ॥32॥
12.347.33: mama vedā hr̥tāḥ sarve dānavābhyāṁ balāditaḥ,
andhakārā hi me lokā jātā vedairvinākr̥tāḥ ॥33॥
12.347.34: vedānr̥te hi kiṁ kuryāṁ lokānāṁ sr̥ṣṭimuttamām,
aho bata mahad duḥkhaṁ vedanāśanajaṁ mama ॥34॥
12.347.35: ko hi śokārṇave magnaṁ māmito’dya samuddharet ॥35॥
12.347.37: tato jagau paraṁ japyaṁ sāñjalipragrahaḥ prabhuḥ ॥37॥
12.347.40: tvatto me mānasaṁ janma prathamaṁ dvijapūjitam,
cākṣuṣaṁ vai dvitīyaṁ me janma cāsīt purātanam ॥40॥
12.347.41: tvatprasādāt tu me janma tr̥tīyaṁ vācikaṁ mahat,
tvattaḥ śravaṇajaṁ cāpi caturthaṁ janma me vibho ॥41॥
12.347.42: nāsikyaṁ cāpi me janma tvattaḥ paramamucyate,
aṇḍajaṁ cāpi me janma tvattaḥ ṣaṣṭhaṁ vinirmitam ॥42॥
12.347.43: idaṁ ca saptamaṁ janma padmajanmeti vai prabho,
12.347.45: te me vedā hr̥tāścakṣurandho jāto’smi jāgr̥hi ॥45॥
12.347.46: dadasva cakṣūṁṣi mama priyo’haṁ te priyo’si me,
evaṁ stutaḥ sa bhagavān puruṣaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ ॥46॥
12.347.51: cakṣuṣī somasūryau te nāsā sandhyā punaḥ smr̥tā,
oṁ kārastvatha saṁskāro vidyujjihvā ca nirmitā ॥51॥
12.347.52: dantāśca pitaro rājan somapā iti viśrutāḥ,
12.347.54: antardadhau sa viśveśo viveśa ca rasāṁ prabhuḥ,
12.347.55: śaikṣyaṁ svaraṁ samāsthāya udgītaṁ prāsr̥jat svaram,
sa svaraḥ sānunādī ca sarvaśaḥ snigdha eva ca ॥55॥
12.347.58: prādācca brahmaṇe bhūyastataḥ svāṁ prakr̥tiṁ gataḥ ॥58॥
12.347.61: yatra vedā vinikṣiptāstat sthānaṁ śūnyameva ca,
12.347.66: ūcatuśca samāviṣṭau rajasā tamasā ca tau,
ayaṁ sa puruṣaḥ śvetaḥ śete nidrāmupāgataḥ ॥66॥
12.347.67: kasyaiṣa ko nu khalveṣa kiṁ ca svapiti bhogavān ॥67॥
12.347.69: nirīkṣya cāsurendrau tau tato yuddhe mano dadhe,
12.347.72: nirmame sa tadā lokān kr̥tsnān sthāvarajaṅgamān ॥72॥
12.347.76: yo hyetad brāhmaṇo nityaṁ śr̥ṇuyād dhārayīta vā,
12.347.77: pañcālena kramaḥ prāpto devena pathi deśite ॥77॥
12.347.79: yāṁ yāmicchet tanuṁ devaḥ kartuṁ kāryavidhau kvacit,
12.347.80: eṣa vedanidhiḥ śrīmāneṣa vai tapaso nidhiḥ,
eṣa yogaśca sāṅkhyaṁ ca brahma cāgryaṁ havirvibhuḥ ॥80॥
12.347.84: apāṁ cāpi guṇā rājan rasā nārāyaṇātmakāḥ,
jyotiṣāṁ ca paraṁ rūpaṁ smr̥taṁ nārāyaṇātmakam ॥84॥
12.347.88: kāraṇaṁ puruṣo hyeṣāṁ pradhānaṁ cāpi kāraṇam,
svabhāvaścaiva karmāṇi daivaṁ yeṣāṁ ca kāraṇam ॥88॥
12.347.89: adhiṣṭhānaṁ tathā kartā karaṇaṁ ca pr̥thagvidham,
vividhā ca tathā ceṣṭā daivaṁ caivātra pañcamam ॥89॥
12.347.92: manīṣitaṁ vijānāti keśavo na tu tasya te ॥92॥
12.347.93: ye kecit sarvalokeṣu daivaṁ pitryaṁ ca kurvate,
dānāni ca prayacchanti tapyante ca tapo mahat ॥93॥
12.347.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi nārāyaṇīye saptacatvāriṁśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥347॥
12.348.1: aho hyekāntinaḥ sarvān prīṇāti bhagavān hariḥ,
vidhiprayuktāṁ pūjāṁ ca gr̥hṇāti bhagavān svayam ॥1॥
12.348.3: caturthyāṁ caiva te gatyāṁ gacchanti puruṣottamam,
12.348.6: kenaiṣa dharmaḥ kathito devena r̥ṣiṇāpi vā ॥6॥
12.348.7: ekāntināṁ ca kā caryā kadā cotpāditā vibho,
etanme saṁśayaṁ chindhi paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me ॥7॥
12.348.8: arjune vimanaske ca gītā bhagavatā svayam ॥8॥
12.348.9: agatiśca gatiścaiva pūrvaṁ te kathitā mayā,
12.348.12: yathā tat kathitaṁ tatra nāradena tathā śr̥ṇu ॥12॥
12.348.14: tena dharmeṇa kr̥tavān daivaṁ pitryaṁ ca bhārata,
12.348.17: nārāyaṇātmako rājan rudrāya pradadau ca tam,
tato yogasthito rudraḥ purā kr̥tayuge nr̥pa ॥17॥
12.348.19: tr̥tīyaṁ brahmaṇo janma yadāsīd vācikaṁ mahat,
12.348.20: tapasā vai sutaptena damena niyamena ca ॥20॥
12.348.28: sr̥ja prajāḥ putra sarvā mukhataḥ pādatastathā,
12.348.29: dharmaṁ ca matto gr̥hṇīṣva sātvataṁ nāma nāmataḥ,
12.348.30: dharmaṁ cāgyraṁ sa jagrāha sarahasyaṁ sasaṅgraham ॥30॥
12.348.33: asr̥jat sa tato lokān kr̥tsnān sthāvarajaṅgamān ॥33॥
12.348.34: tataḥ prāvartata tadā ādau kr̥tayugaṁ śubham,
tato hi sātvato dharmo vyāpya lokānavasthitaḥ ॥34॥
12.348.37: tataḥ svarociṣaḥ putraṁ svayaṁ śaṅkhapadaṁ nr̥pa,
12.348.38: so’ntardadhe tato bhūyaḥ prāpte tretāyuge punaḥ ॥38॥
12.348.43: kukṣināmne sa pradadau diśāṁ pālāya dharmiṇe,
12.348.47: antardadhe tato rājanneṣa dharmaḥ prabho hareḥ ॥47॥
12.348.48: yadidaṁ saptamaṁ janma padmajaṁ brahmaṇo nr̥pa,
tatraiṣa dharmaḥ kathitaḥ svayaṁ nārāyaṇena ha ॥48॥
12.348.50: tato jyeṣṭhe tu dauhitre prādād dakṣo nr̥pottama,
12.348.51: tretāyugādau ca tato vivasvān manave dadau,
12.348.53: yatīnāṁ cāpi yo dharmaḥ sa te pūrvaṁ nr̥pottama,
12.348.55: evameṣa mahān dharma ādyo rājan sanātanaḥ,
12.348.60: akartā caiva kartā ca kāryaṁ kāraṇameva ca,
12.348.62: ekāntino hi puruṣā durlabhā bahavo nr̥pa,
12.348.64: evaṁ sa bhagavān vyāso gururmama viśāmpate,
12.348.67: na kurvanti kathaṁ viprā anye nānāvrate sthitāḥ ॥67॥
12.348.68: sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī caiva bhārata ॥68॥
12.348.72: manīṣiṇo hi ye kecid yatayo mokṣadharmiṇaḥ,
12.348.73: sāttvikastu sa vijñeyo bhavenmokṣe ca niścitaḥ ॥73॥
12.348.74: nārāyaṇātmake mokṣe tato yānti parāṁ gatim ॥74॥
12.348.76: rājasī tāmasī caiva vyāmiśre prakr̥tī smr̥te,
12.348.79: hīnāḥ sattvena śuddhena tato vaikārikāḥ smr̥tāḥ,
12.348.80: vada sarvaṁ yathādr̥ṣṭaṁ pravr̥ttiṁ ca yathākramam,
12.348.84: eṣa te kathito dharmaḥ sātvataḥ kurunandana,
12.348.85: evaṁ hi sa mahābhāgo nārado gurave mama,
12.348.86: sa evāyaṁ mayā tubhyamākhyātaḥ prasr̥to guroḥ ॥86॥
12.348.87: itthaṁ hi duścaro dharma eṣa pārthivasattama,
12.348.88: kr̥ṣṇa eva hi lokānāṁ bhāvano mohanastathā,
12.349.2: prabrūhi vai mayā pr̥ṣṭaḥ pravr̥ttiṁ ca yathākramam ॥2॥
12.349.10: śuśrūṣāṁ tatparā rājan kr̥tavanto vayaṁ tadā ॥10॥
12.349.19: mama tvaṁ nābhito jātaḥ prajāsargakaraḥ prabhuḥ,
12.349.21: kā śaktirmama deveśa prajāḥ sraṣṭuṁ namo’stu te,
12.349.23: yogena caināṁ niryogaḥ svayaṁ niyuyuje tadā ॥23॥
12.349.24: uvāca vacanaṁ devo buddhiṁ vai prabhuravyayaḥ ॥24॥
12.349.26: athainaṁ buddhisaṁyuktaṁ punaḥ sa dadr̥śe hariḥ,
bhūyaścaiva vacaḥ prāha sr̥jemā vividhāḥ prajāḥ ॥26॥
12.349.29: sr̥ṣṭāḥ prajā imāḥ sarvā brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā ॥29॥
12.349.34: nigraheṇa ca pāpānāṁ sādhūnāṁ pragraheṇa ca,
12.349.35: mayā hyeṣā hi dhriyate pātālasthena bhoginā,
mayā dhr̥tā dhārayati jagad viśvaṁ carācaram ॥35॥
12.349.36: tasmāt pr̥thvyāḥ paritrāṇaṁ kariṣye sambhavaṁ gataḥ,
evaṁ sa cintayitvā tu bhagavān madhusūdanaḥ ॥36॥
12.349.37: vārāhaṁ nārasiṁhaṁ ca vāmanaṁ mānuṣaṁ tathā ॥37॥
12.349.41: vedākhyāne śrutiḥ kāryā tvayā matimatāṁ vara,
tasmāt kuru yathā’’jñaptaṁ mamaitad vacanaṁ mune ॥41॥
12.349.43: tapasā ca sutaptena yamena niyamena ca,
12.349.44: punastiṣye ca samprāpte kuravo nāma bhāratāḥ ॥44॥
12.349.47: kr̥ṣṇe yuge ca samprāpte kr̥ṣṇavarṇo bhaviṣyasi,
bhaviṣyasi tapoyukto na ca rāgād vimokṣyase ॥47॥
12.349.54: anādinidhanaṁ loke cakrahastaṁ ca māṁ mune,
12.349.61: mayā hi sumahat taptaṁ tapaḥ paramadāruṇam,
12.349.62: etad vaḥ kathitaṁ sarvaṁ yanmāṁ pr̥cchata putrakāḥ,
pūrvajanma bhaviṣyaṁ ca bhaktānāṁ snehato mayā ॥62॥
12.349.64: sāṅkhyaṁ yogaḥ pāñcarātraṁ vedāḥ pāśupataṁ tathā,
12.349.65: sāṅkhyasya vaktā kapilaḥ paramarṣiḥ sa ucyate,
12.349.68: pāñcarātrasya kr̥tsnasya vettā tu bhagavān svayam,
12.349.71: niḥsaṁśayeṣu sarveṣu nityaṁ vasati vai hariḥ,
12.349.73: sāṅkhyaṁ ca yogaṁ ca sanātane dve
12.349.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi dvaipāyanotpattau ekonapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥349॥
12.350.1: bahavaḥ puruṣā brahmannutāho eka eva tu,
ko hyatra puruṣaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ ko vā yonirihocyate ॥1॥
12.350.3: tathā taṁ puruṣaṁ viśvaṁ vyākhyāsyāmi guṇādhikam ॥3॥
12.350.15: svāgataṁ te mahābāho diṣṭyā prāpto’si me’ntikam,
kaccit te kuśalaṁ putra svādhyāyatapasoḥ sadā ॥15॥
12.350.16: nityamugratapāstvaṁ hi tataḥ pr̥cchāmi te punaḥ ॥16॥
12.350.19: kautūhalaṁ cāpi hi me ekāntagamanena te,
12.350.23: sr̥jyante cāpare brahman sa caikaḥ puruṣo virāṭ ॥23॥
12.350.24: etanme saṁśayaṁ brūhi mahat kautūhalaṁ hi me ॥24॥
12.350.25: bahavaḥ puruṣāḥ putra tvayā ye samudāhr̥tāḥ,
12.350.26: ādhāraṁ tu pravakṣyāmi ekasya puruṣasya te,
12.350.27: tathā taṁ puruṣaṁ viśvaṁ paramaṁ sumahattamam,
12.350.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi nārāyaṇīye brahmarudrasaṁvāde pañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥350॥
12.351.1: śr̥ṇu putra yathā hyeṣa puruṣaḥ śāśvato’vyayaḥ,
12.351.2: na sa śakyastvayā draṣṭuṁ mayānyairvāpi sattama,
saguṇo nirguṇo viśvo jñānadr̥śyo hyasau smr̥taḥ ॥2॥
12.351.3: vasannapi śarīreṣu na sa lipyati karmabhiḥ ॥3॥
12.351.4: mamāntarātmā tava ca ye cānye dehisañjñitāḥ,
sarveṣāṁ sākṣibhūto’sau na grāhyaḥ kenacit kvacit ॥4॥
12.351.6: kṣetrāṇi hi śarīrāṇi bījaṁ cāpi śubhāśubham,
tāni vetti sa yogātmā tataḥ kṣetrajña ucyate ॥6॥
12.351.7: sāṅkhyena vidhinā caiva yogena ca yathākramam ॥7॥
12.351.8: cintayāmi gatiṁ cāsya na gatiṁ vedmi cottarām,
yathājñānaṁ tu vakṣyāmi puruṣaṁ tu sanātanam ॥8॥
12.351.9: tasyaikatvaṁ mahattvaṁ ca sa caikaḥ puruṣaḥ smr̥taḥ,
12.351.11: hitvā guṇamayaṁ sarvaṁ karma hitvā śubhāśubham,
ubhe satyānr̥te tyaktvā evaṁ bhavati nirguṇaḥ ॥11॥
12.351.12: acintyaṁ cāpi taṁ jñātvā bhāvasūkṣmaṁ catuṣṭayam,
vicared yo’samunnaddhaḥ sa gacchet puruṣaṁ śubham ॥12॥
12.351.14: tatra yaḥ paramātmā hi sa nityaṁ nirguṇaḥ smr̥taḥ,
sa hi nārāyaṇo jñeyaḥ sarvātmā puruṣo hi saḥ ॥14॥
12.351.15: karmātmā tvaparo yo’sau mokṣabandhaiḥ sa yujyate ॥15॥
12.351.16: sa saptadaśakenāpi rāśinā yujyate ca saḥ,
12.351.18: yad vai proktaṁ tāta samyak pradhānaṁ
12.351.19: yad vai loke vaidikaṁ karma sādhu
12.351.22: evaṁ sa bhagavān svena jñānena pratibodhitaḥ ॥22॥
12.351.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi nārāyaṇīyasamāptau ekapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥351॥
12.352.2: sarvatra vihito dharmaḥ svargaḥ satyaphalaṁ mahat,
12.352.3: yasmin yasmiṁśca viṣaye yo yo yāti viniścayam,
12.352.4: imāṁ ca tvaṁ naravyāghra śrotumarhasi me kathām,
12.352.9: na hyastyaviditaṁ loke devarṣe tava kiñcana,
śrutaṁ vāpyanubhūtaṁ vā dr̥ṣṭaṁ vā kathayasva me ॥9॥
12.352.10: tasmai rājan surendrāya nārado vadatāṁ varaḥ,
12.352.11: yathā yena ca kalpena sa tasmai dvijasattamaḥ,
kathāṁ kathitavān pr̥ṣṭastathā tvamapi me śr̥ṇu ॥11॥
12.352.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi uñchavr̥ttyupākhyāne dvipañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥352॥
12.353.1: gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe tīre kaścid vipraḥ samāhitaḥ ॥1॥
12.353.5: sa putrān bahulān dr̥ṣṭvā vipule karmaṇi sthitaḥ,
12.353.6: tataḥ sa dharmaṁ vedoktaṁ tathā śāstroktameva ca,
śiṣṭācīrṇaṁ ca dharmaṁ ca trividhaṁ cintya cetasā ॥6॥
12.353.7: kinnu me syācchubhaṁ kr̥tvā kiṁ kr̥taṁ kiṁ parāyaṇam,
ityevaṁ khidyate nityaṁ na ca yāti viniścayam ॥7॥
12.353.9: sa tasmai satkriyāṁ cakre kriyāyuktena hetunā,
12.353.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi uñchavr̥ttyupākhyāne tripañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥353॥
12.354.2: dharmaṁ paramakaṁ kuryāṁ ko hi mārgo bhaved dvija ॥2॥
12.354.5: utpannā me matiriyaṁ kuto dharmamayaḥ plavaḥ ॥5॥
12.354.8: provāca vacanaṁ ślakṣṇaṁ prājño madhurayā girā ॥8॥
12.354.9: na ca saṁniścayaṁ yāmi bahudvāre triviṣṭape ॥9॥
12.354.12: ahiṁsayā pare svargaṁ satyena ca tathā pare ॥12॥
12.354.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi uñchavr̥ttyupākhyāne catuḥpañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥354॥
12.355.1: upadeśaṁ tu te vipra kariṣye’haṁ yathākramam,
guruṇā me yathākhyātamarthatattvaṁ tu me śr̥ṇu ॥1॥
12.355.5: sa vācā karmaṇā caiva manasā ca dvijarṣabha,
12.355.7: sa te paramakaṁ dharmaṁ na mithyā darśayiṣyati ॥7॥
12.355.10: yajvā dānapatiḥ kṣānto vr̥tte ca parame sthitaḥ,
12.355.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi uñchavr̥ttyupākhyāne pañcapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥355॥
12.356.2: tr̥ṣitasya ca pānīyaṁ kṣudhārtasya ca bhojanam ॥2॥
12.356.6: bāḍhamevaṁ kariṣyāmi yathā me bhāṣate bhavān,
imāṁ hi rajanīṁ sādho nivasasva mayā saha ॥6॥
12.356.8: uvāsa kila tāṁ rātriṁ saha tena dvijena vai ॥8॥
12.356.9: vyatītā sā niśā kr̥tsnā sukhena divasopamā ॥9॥
12.356.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi uñchavr̥ttyupākhyāne ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥356॥
12.357.1: sa vanāni vicitrāṇi tīrthāni ca sarāṁsi ca,
12.357.2: taṁ sa tena yathoddiṣṭaṁ nāgaṁ vipreṇa brāhmaṇaḥ,
paryapr̥cchad yathānyāyaṁ śrutvaiva ca jagāma saḥ ॥2॥
12.357.4: tat tasya vacanaṁ śrutvā rūpiṇī dharmavatsalā,
12.357.5: sā tasmai vidhivat pūjāṁ cakre dharmaparāyaṇā,
12.357.9: bharturbhavatu kiṁ cānyat kriyatāṁ tad vadasva me ॥9॥
12.357.13: tataḥ sa viprastāṁ nāgīṁ samādhāya punaḥ punaḥ,
12.357.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi uñchavr̥ttyupākhyāne saptapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥357॥
12.358.2: sarve sambhūya sahitā hyasya nāgasya bāndhavāḥ,
12.358.3: te’paśyan puline taṁ vai vivikte niyatavratam,
12.358.7: mūlaṁ phalaṁ vā parṇaṁ vā payo vā dvijasattama,
12.358.9: na hi no bhrūṇahā kaścijjātāpadyanr̥to’pi vā,
12.358.12: kartavyo na ca santāpo gamyatāṁ ca yathāgatam,
12.358.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi uñchavr̥ttyupākhyāne aṣṭapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥358॥
12.359.1: atha kāle bahutithe pūrṇe prāpto bhujaṅgamaḥ,
12.359.2: upapannāṁ ca tāṁ sādhvīṁ pannagaḥ paryapr̥cchata ॥2॥
12.359.9: ahaṁ kasya kuto vāpi kaḥ ko me ha bhavediti,
12.359.11: sāhaṁ dharmaṁ vijānantī dharmanitye tvayi sthite,
12.359.13: tacca kāryaṁ na me khyāti darśanaṁ tava kāṅkṣati ॥13॥
12.359.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi uñchavr̥ttyupākhyāne ekonaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥359॥
12.360.1: mānuṣaṁ kevalaṁ vipraṁ devaṁ vātha śucismite ॥1॥
12.360.2: ko hi māṁ mānuṣaḥ śakto draṣṭukāmo yaśasvini,
12.360.4: manuṣyāṇāṁ viśeṣeṇa nāvekṣyā iti me matiḥ ॥4॥
12.360.6: sa hi kāryāntarākāṅkṣī jalepsuḥ stokako yathā,
varṣaṁ varṣapriyaḥ pakṣī darśanaṁ tava kāṅkṣati ॥6॥
12.360.7: hitvā tvaddarśanaṁ kiñcid vighnaṁ na pratipālayet,
12.360.9: rājā vā rājaputro vā bhrūṇahatyaiva yujyate ॥9॥
12.360.12: na yāti nirayaṁ kaściditi dharmavido viduḥ ॥12॥
12.360.13: abhimānairna māno me jātidoṣeṇa vai mahān,
roṣaḥ saṅkalpajaḥ sādhvi dagdho vāgagninā tvayā ॥13॥
12.360.14: na ca roṣādahaṁ sādhvi paśyeyamadhikaṁ tamaḥ,
12.360.15: roṣasya hi vaśaṁ gatvā daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān,
12.360.18: nigr̥hīto mayā roṣaḥ śrutvaivaṁ vacanaṁ tava ॥18॥
12.360.19: yasya me tvaṁ viśālākṣi bhāryā guṇasamanvitā ॥19॥
12.360.20: eṣa tatraiva gacchāmi yatra tiṣṭhatyasau dvijaḥ,
sarvathā coktavān vākyaṁ sa kr̥tārthaḥ prayāsyati ॥20॥
12.360.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi uñchavr̥ttyupākhyāne ṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥360॥
12.361.3: bho bhoḥ kṣāmyābhibhāṣe tvāṁ na roṣaṁ kartumarhasi,
12.361.4: vivikte gomatītīre kaṁ vā tvaṁ paryupāsase ॥4॥
12.361.5: dharmāraṇyaṁ hi māṁ viddhi nāgaṁ draṣṭumihāgatam,
12.361.9: ahaṁ sa nāgo viprarṣe yathā māṁ vindate bhavān,
ājñāpaya yathā svairaṁ kiṁ karomi priyaṁ tava ॥9॥
12.361.12: vayaṁ hi bhavatā sarve guṇakrītā viśeṣataḥ,
12.361.16: paścāt kāryaṁ vadiṣyāmi śrotumarhati tad bhavān ॥16॥
12.361.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi uñchavr̥ttyupākhyāne ekaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥361॥
12.362.5: vibhajya taṁ tu viprarṣe prajānāṁ hitakāmyayā,
12.362.9: yato bījaṁ mahī ceyaṁ dhāryate sacarācarā ॥9॥
12.362.16: ekībhūtaṁ ca tat tejaḥ kṣaṇenādityatāṁ gatam ॥16॥
12.362.17: anayoḥ ko bhavet sūryo rathastho yo’yamāgataḥ ॥17॥
12.362.18: ka eṣa divamākramya gataḥ sūrya ivāparaḥ ॥18॥
12.362.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi uñchavr̥ttyupākhyāne dviṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥362॥
12.363.1: naiṣa devo’nilasakho nāsuro na ca pannagaḥ,
12.363.5: na hi devā na gandharvā nāsurā na ca pannagāḥ,
12.363.6: saṁsiddho mānuṣaḥ kārma yo’sau siddhagatiṁ gataḥ,
12.363.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi uñchavr̥ttyupākhyāne triṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥363॥
12.364.3: anuktvā hr̥dgataṁ kāryaṁ kvedānīṁ prasthito bhavān,
ucyatāṁ dvija yat kāryaṁ yadarthaṁ tvamihāgataḥ ॥3॥
12.364.5: na hi māṁ kevalaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tyaktvā praṇayavāniha,
12.364.6: tvayi cāhaṁ dvijaśreṣṭha bhavān mayi na saṁśayaḥ,
loko’yaṁ bhavataḥ sarvaḥ kā cintā mayi te’nagha ॥6॥
12.364.8: sa eva tvaṁ sa evāhaṁ yo’haṁ sa tu bhavānapi,
ahaṁ bhavāṁśca bhūtāni sarve yatra gatāḥ sadā ॥8॥
12.364.9: āsīt tu me bhogapate saṁśayaḥ puṇyasañcaye,
12.364.10: eṣa me niścayaḥ sādho kr̥taṁ kāraṇamuttamam,
12.364.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi uñchavr̥ttyupākhyāne catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥364॥
12.365.5: devarājena ca purā kathitaiṣā kathā śubhā,
12.365.6: yadā ca mama rāmeṇa yuddhamāsīt sudāruṇam,
vasubhiśca tadā rājan katheyaṁ kathitā mama ॥6॥
12.365.7: katheyaṁ kathitā puṇyā dharmyā dharmabhr̥tāṁ vara ॥7॥
12.365.8: yadayaṁ paramo dharmo yanmāṁ pr̥cchasi bhārata,
12.365.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate śatasāhasryāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ vaiyāsikyāṁ śāntiparvaṇi mokṣadharmaparvaṇi uñchavr̥ttyupākhyāne pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥365॥
